jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.excerpt: About Kindsight:Kindsight builds technology that helps fundraisers make a difference.
jobs.description:
About Kindsight:

Kindsight builds technology that helps fundraisers make a difference. For decades, Kindsight has supported the education, healthcare, and nonprofit sectors with fundraising tools and the largest charitable giving database on the market. And as the giving sector evolves, so does Kindsight. As the leader in fundraising intelligence, Kindsight leverages real-time data and AI to help thousands of organizations around the world identify, manage, and engage with donors - at any scale. With purpose-built CRMs that corral all of that donor information and campaign tracking into one place, donor prospect research tools that offer proactive insights and real-time donor intel, and generative AI that creates personalized, meaningful content drafts at scale, Kindsight’s product suite is truly changing the game for donor fundraising.

Position Summary:

We are seeking a hands-on Data Engineer to build and maintain the data platform behind Kindsight's customer-facing analytics products. You will work across the full pipeline: ingesting data from customer environments into our data lake, and transforming it through a dimensional data warehouse that powers dashboards and AI-driven insights. This is a strong fit for someone who enjoys building production data systems and wants depth in modern data engineering, cloud infrastructure, and multi-tenant analytics at scale.

What You’ll Do:

  • Build and maintain ELT pipelines that ingest data from customer Salesforce environments into our AWS data lake, covering both scheduled batch loads and near-real-time change data capture.

  • Develop data transformation layers (medallion architecture) and dimensional models in dbt on Redshift or Snowflake, implementing incremental logic, slowly changing dimensions, and derived metrics against defined specifications.

  • Write and optimize advanced SQL for transformation, aggregation, and data quality validation across large, multi-tenant datasets.

  • Work hands-on with AWS: S3, Glue, Athena, Redshift, Step Functions, Lambda, IAM, Lake Formation, and CloudWatch.

  • Onboard new customer data sources by extending existing configuration-driven pipelines, and verify each onboarding against defined acceptance criteria.

  • Build automated data quality checks, reconciliation queries, and monitoring so that pipeline failures are caught and diagnosed quickly.

  • Investigate and resolve data issues end to end — from source system behaviour through ingestion and transformation to the final reported number.

  • Contribute to infrastructure as code (AWS CDK or Terraform) for the pipelines and resources you work on.

  • Support dashboard and reporting development in QuickSight or Tableau, ensuring the underlying data models serve them correctly.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 3+ years of hands-on data engineering experience building and operating production data pipelines.

  • Advanced SQL. You are comfortable with window functions, CTEs, complex joins, and query performance tuning, and you can debug a wrong number by reading the query plan and the data.

  • 2+ years of hands-on AWS experience, including S3, Glue, Athena or Redshift, IAM, and at least one orchestration service such as Step Functions, or Airflow.

  • 2+ years building ETL/ELT pipelines with dbt, or equivalent transformation frameworks, including incremental models and testing.

  • 2+ years working with cloud data warehouses ; Redshift, or Snowflake — including dimensional modeling with star schemas and query optimization.

  • Solid Python for data work: API integrations, data processing scripts, and pipeline code.

  • Experience with Git-based workflows, code review, and CI/CD for data pipelines.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Bonus:

  • Experience integrating Salesforce data, including the REST and Bulk APIs, Change Data Capture, and Salesforce data models and objects.

  • Familiarity with fundraising or nonprofit sector data, or CRM and ERP data models more generally.

  • Experience with open table formats such as Apache Iceberg, or Delta Lake

  • Experience with multi-tenant data platforms and tenant isolation patterns.

  • Experience with infrastructure as code, particularly AWS CDK.

  • Experience with BI development in QuickSight or Tableau.

Compensation Range: $120,000 - $135,000 CAD OTE annually, based on experience, market benchmarks and role complexity. We aim to offer fair, competitive pay that reflects your skills and the market.

This advertised position is for an existing vacancy at Kindsight. At Kindsight, we’re proud to be a place where everyone belongs and has an equal opportunity to contribute, thrive and grow. We hire based on skills, potential, and impact, and we believe our differences fuel innovation. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. We’re building a workplace where everyone has the opportunity to do meaningful work and make a difference.

We leverage artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools may help with resume screening, drafting job descriptions, creating interview questions and occasionally identifying potential candidates. All hiring decisions are made by our people, not AI. Our intent is to use AI thoughtfully to streamline administrative tasks, improve the candidate experience and support fair, unbiased hiring practices consistent with industry standards.

jobs.excerpt: About MagicFor over 10 years, Magic has connected top remote talent with fast-growing businesses — backed by Y Combinator and Sequoia Capital, with thousands of remote workers worldwide.
jobs.description:
About Magic

For over 10 years, Magic has connected top remote talent with fast-growing businesses — backed by Y Combinator and Sequoia Capital, with thousands of remote workers worldwide.

Role Overview

When a business brings on a Magic assistant, the relationship doesn't run itself. That's where you come in.
This is a post-sale, account-first role. You'll carry a book of client-assistant pairings and be accountable for how well each one works — from day one of onboarding through every milestone after. Inbound requests will come in, but fielding requests isn't the core of the job. The core is knowing your accounts well enough that you can spot what's about to go wrong before it does, get on a call, and fix it.
Shift: Monday–Friday, 10 PM–7 AM PHT. Training runs 4 weeks across two phases — Product Skills (shadowing, live-call listening) then Immersion (live tickets and onboarding under supervision, KPIs measured from day one). Zero absences during training, documented medical emergencies only, 80%+ required on daily assessments and mock calls to continue.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage a portfolio of client accounts — track the health of each pairing, flag risks early, and keep every relationship on track
  • Lead onboarding sessions, 30-day account reviews, and recurring check-ins that keep clients and their assistants aligned
  • Advocate for assistants internally — coaching conversations, feedback loops, and surfacing what they need to leadership
  • Own retention conversations — identify accounts at risk and lead win-back efforts before the client decides to leave
  • Handle 30+ inbound account requests daily with fast, personalized responses that reflect actual knowledge of that account
  • Maintain clean, detailed HubSpot records for every client interaction — useful to anyone who touches the account after you
  • Coordinate across Operations, Finance, and Engineering when an account issue goes beyond your direct scope

Qualifications Technical Requirements

  • 3+ years of client-facing experience in account management, account support, or B2B customer success — US accounts strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple active client accounts simultaneously without losing thread or detail
  • Fluent written and verbal English — equally sharp in a written account update and a live escalation call
  • Reliable night-shift availability (10 PM–7 AM PHT) with documented history of night-shift work
  • CRM proficiency, HubSpot preferred
  • Proactive by default — you identify account risks and act on them before anyone has to ask

Why You'll Be a Great Fit

After 90 days, your accounts run smoothly not because nothing went wrong — but because you caught the problems early and handled them. You know your client portfolio without having to look everything up. You're as comfortable on a direct call with a frustrated client as you are writing a clear, concise account note at 3 AM. You've worked night shift before, and you know how to pace yourself through a shift that gets busy fast when US business hours kick in.
This isn't the role if you've never managed a real account portfolio before, if "account ownership" means something different to you than being personally responsible for how each relationship turns out, or if your default is to wait for issues to escalate before you move.

Application Process

Application + Pre-Qualifying Questions → HR Interview (30 min) → Skill Assessment (Written Case Study) → Second-Level Interview with Support Management → Mock Feedback Call → Final Interview with Head of Sales → Job Offer → 4-Week Training Program

Compensation Benefits

Gross package ₱32,000–₱38,000/month, total potential ₱38,000–₱40,000/month · Night shift (10 PM–7 AM PHT) · Full training program included

Why Magic?

We're ambitious, driven, and unapologetically the type to plow through obstacles instead of waiting for perfect conditions. Our work dynamic is genuinely different — dynamic, friendly conversations, zero politics, and no hierarchy standing in your way. You can talk to anyone, on any team, about anything, because we respect each other's time and actually like working together. Y Combinator and Sequoia-backed, thousands of remote workers strong, and growing.
﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿

In a nutshell

Title:Account Manager, Academia

Location:United States (remote) - EST preferred
Type: Full-time
Compensation: $100K-$120K base, $30k-$50K variable comp, $130K-$170K OTE
Reporting to: Director of Sales and Account Management
Travel:Approximately 50% (typically 2–3 trips per month), including overnight stays.


The Opportunity

Oxford Medical Simulation Inc (OMS) is scaling fast in the US and we’re hiring a commercial, Account Manager to own renewals and expansion across a portfolio of academic institutions.

This is a role for someone who loves running a book of business, building executive relationships, and closing revenue - protecting and growing ARR through structured renewal motion, account planning, and value-led commercial negotiation.

You do not need prior virtual reality experience. We’ll train you on OMS’s platform and products. What matters most is that you can retain and grow accounts with rigor, pace, and commercial instinct.

What You’ll Own

You will be accountable for:

  • Renewal revenue: own end-to-end renewals for your portfolio,

  • Expansion revenue: identify, qualify, and close upsell/cross-sell opportunities to deliver

  • Forecasting & accuracy: maintain a reliable forecast and pipeline, with strong CRM hygiene and forecasting in Hubspot

  • Executive relationships: build multi-threaded relationships across faculty leadership, program directors, simulation leadership, procurement, IT, and budget owners

  • Commercial negotiation: lead pricing, packaging, and contract negotiations (including multi-year deals), partnering with Legal/Finance as needed

  • Account strategy: run account plans for top customers, mapping stakeholders, renewal risks, competitive threats, and expansion paths

What You’ll Do Day-to-Day

  • Manage a portfolio of 25-50 academic customers and drive a disciplined renewal motion beginning 6 months before contract end

  • Build and execute account plans to expand footprint across programs, campuses, cohorts, or departments

  • Identify new buying centers and develop expansion opportunities (e.g., additional programs, multi-campus rollout, new use cases)

  • Run executive check-ins and commercial reviews tied to outcomes, budget cycles, and renewal timelines

  • Recurring QBRs and touch points with key stakeholders to drive utilization and best practices for Success

  • Own and progress commercial conversations through procurement, contracting, and approvals

  • Collaborate with internal teams (e.g., Product, Clinical, Support) to remove blockers and protect revenue

  • Represent OMS at conferences and events to deepen customer relationships and uncover expansion opportunities

Who You Are

We’re looking for a commercial AM who has consistently delivered results.

Required

  • 3+ years experience in quota-carrying Account Management (renewals + expansion) in B2B healthcare or healthcare academia SaaS

  • Proven record of achieving or exceeding 100%+ NRR targets

  • Experience managing renewals end-to-end, including pricing and negotiation

  • Strong pipeline management, forecasting discipline, and CRM excellence ideally in Hubspot

  • Comfort with complex, multi-stakeholder environments and long buying cycles

Preferred

  • Experience selling intoacademic institutions(universities, nursing schools, medical schools etc)

  • Familiarity with healthcare education, clinical training, simulation, or adjacent markets

  • Experience working through procurement, IT review, and contracting processes common in academia

You’ll thrive here if you

  • Love owning a number and building a plan to hit it

  • Are proactive, organized, and relentless about renewal risk management

  • Can communicate value with senior stakeholders and defend price with confidence

  • Enjoy travel and relationship-based selling in the field

About Oxford Medical Simulation

OMS helps health systems, nursing schools, and medical schools deliver training and assessment better, cheaper, faster and at scale.

Our award-winning simulation platform is transforming the way healthcare and educational institutions train, assess, and recruit healthcare professionals. By combining cutting-edge 3D visualization with artificial intelligence and leading educational theory, OMS delivers all of the benefits of physical simulation while driving significant savings and improving patient care.

Founded in 2017 and commercially launching the award-winning OMS Platform in late 2018, OMS has experienced rapid growth with deployments spanning more than 100 Healthcare and Academic institutions around the world including Mayo Clinic, Advent Health, Johns Hopkins, the NHS, and the world’s #1 pediatric hospital.

Oxford Medical Simulation is committed to equal treatment and opportunity in all aspects of recruitment, selection, and employment without regard to gender, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, disability, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other category protected under the law. Oxford Medical Simulation is an equal opportunity employer committed to a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.


Who we are

We are Skiers / Boarders, Runners, Rowers, Pilots, Magicians, Weavers, Photographers, Game Heroes, Movie Buffs, and every other variety of people. We are hard working. We are passionate about what we do. We care about the work. We care about each other. We care about pushing the envelope and we care about using our working lives to make the world a better place.

We value these behaviors above all:

  1. Care & Pride - we take care and pride in everything we do

  2. Growth mindset - we push the boundaries so we are adaptive, inventive and always learning

  3. One Team - we are in it together, mucking in and supporting each other with humour and humility

Sound like you?

Benefits

  • Flexible work environment - work from home/ remote first

Other projects support model development and evaluation, mostly driven by automated agentic loops.

You will collaborate closely with ML Engineers, Data Scientists, and fellow Software Engineers to turn new approaches into reliable production systems and in turn help us catch more attacks and improve security investigations while limiting false positives and cost. jobs.description:
📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Als Security Consultant binnen een centrale overheidsdienst voor digitale veiligheid bouw je de dienstverlening rond cybersecurity testing en exposure management uit, beheer je die en ontwikkel je ze verder. De dienstverlening ondersteunt overheidsorganisaties en lokale besturen bij het tijdig identificeren en behandelen van kwetsbaarheden.

Cybersecurity testing omvat onder meer penetratesten, vulnerability disclosure-programma's, bug bounty-programma's en andere vormen van offensieve beveiligingstesten. Exposure management omvat onder meer vulnerability management, attack surface management (ASM) en de bijbehorende processen, methodologieën en oplossingen voor het beheer van kwetsbaarheden en blootstellingsrisico's.

Je vertaalt de behoeften van stakeholders naar een duidelijke productvisie, roadmap en concrete dienstverlening. Daarbij bewaak je de kwaliteit van resultaten en werk je samen met interne teams en externe dienstverleners. Je professionaliseert de dienstverlening, borgt expertise binnen de organisatie en verbetert voortdurend de processen, methodologieën, werkwijzen en ondersteunende oplossingen.

De functie combineert product ownership met diepgaande inhoudelijke expertise. Naast het uitwerken, aansturen en verbeteren van de dienstverlening neem je actief deel aan de dagelijkse werking. Je ondersteunt complexe dossiers, beoordeelt de kwaliteit van activiteiten en resultaten en draagt bij aan de uitvoering van de dienstverlening.

  • Behoeften en uitdagingen van overheidsorganisaties en lokale besturen vertalen naar concrete verbeteringen en verdere ontwikkelingen van de dienstverlening.
  • Activiteiten binnen cybersecurity testing en exposure management organiseren, uitvoeren, coördineren en op kwaliteit bewaken.
  • Stakeholders ondersteunen bij het bepalen van scope, prioriteiten, aanpak en remediaties.
  • Resultaten, rapporten en deliverables reviewen en valideren.
  • Processen, methodologieën en ondersteunende oplossingen binnen het toepassingsgebied beheren en verder ontwikkelen.
  • Sourcing- en aanbestedingstrajecten voorbereiden en begeleiden, met inbegrip van requirements, evaluatiecriteria en kwaliteitsvereisten.
  • Externe dienstverleners aansturen en de geleverde dienstverlening opvolgen via SLA's, KPI's, service reviews en verbeteracties.
  • Toezien op het gebruik van erkende methodologieën en referentiekaders, zoals OWASP, PTES of gelijkwaardige standaarden.

Kennisborging en continue verbetering

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry-leading innovation, With Heart®.


About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Regulatory Affairs Consultant - Advertising and Promotion (Manger, Ad Promo) to join a large dedicated client partnership while working from home in Canada. As a Senior Regulatory Affairs Consultant - Advertising and Promotion (Manger, Ad Promo), you will help ensure that promotional and relevant non-promotional materials are compliant and appropriate for their intended audiences. This position plays a key role in regulatory review, advertising compliance, and cross-functional decision-making. You'll collaborate with Marketing, Medical, Legal, and other partners, follow established review processes, and contribute to the efficient review and approval of materials. Responsibilities include reviewing Canadian promotional, educational, medical, and corporate communications against Health Canada advertising requirements, the Canadian Product Monograph, and applicable PAAB standards, with opportunities to deepen your expertise and influence material outcomes.


You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through regulatory review of Canadian materials, practical guidance on compliant messaging, and support for the Canadian adaptation of global materials. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Senior Regulatory Affairs Consultant - Advertising and Promotion (Manger, Ad Promo) can explore career paths and expand skills across regulatory affairs.


Key Responsibilities

  • Review Canadian promotional, educational, medical, and corporate communications for alignment with relevant regulatory requirements, approved product information, and industry standards.
  • Apply knowledge of Health Canada advertising requirements, the Canadian Product Monograph, and applicable PAAB standards in the assessment of materials.
  • Provide regulatory input on the overall content, messaging, and presentation of materials, identifying compliance considerations and recommending practical solutions.
  • Represent Canadian Regulatory Affairs in Promotional Material Review Team (PMRT) and Medical Review Committee (MRC) discussions, as applicable.
  • Collaborate with Marketing, Medical, Legal, and other partners to facilitate efficient review and approval of materials through established internal processes.
  • Support the Canadian adaptation of global materials and provide guidance on questions related to promotional versus non-promotional communications.
  • Maintain alignment with Canadian Regulatory leadership and the broader Regulatory Ad Promo team and escalate significant regulatory concerns as appropriate.

Candidate Profile

You'll thrive in this role if you bring:

  • Strengths in regulatory judgment, communication, and collaboration
  • Experience in pharmaceutical or biotechnology Regulatory Affairs, with exposure to advertising and promotional review
  • The ability to collaborate across teams and provide clear, solutions-oriented recommendations
  • A commitment to ensuring materials are compliant and appropriate for their intended audiences

  • Working knowledge of Canadian pharmaceutical advertising requirements, Health Canada guidance, and the PAAB Code, with experience participating in cross-functional material review
  • Strong regulatory judgment, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently, manage priorities, and provide clear, solutions-oriented recommendations

Preferred Qualifications

jobs.excerpt: WHO ARE WE? Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company.
jobs.description:
WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

THE ROLE

We're looking for a hands-on Partnerships & BD expert to grow our banking, deposits, and investing partners, and to bring on the ones we haven't met yet. Most of the job, roughly 70 to 80 percent, is growing the partners we already have: bigger budgets, better economics, broader distribution. The rest is net new, mostly warm, with real outreach on the investing side where the relationships don't exist yet.

You'll work alongside our Head of Partnerships, who will continue to focus on our largest strategic partners. On those strategic partners, you'll run the operations. Across the rest of banking, deposits, and investing, you own it fully, operationally and strategically. That's what gives the Head of Partnerships room for the biggest bets, and it's what makes this seat yours.

This isn't a support role, and it isn't customer service. The job is to grow relationships, not just service them.

WHY THIS SEAT

  • A category to own. Banking, deposits, and investing partners outside our largest strategic accounts are yours, start to finish.
  • A partner, not a handoff. Our Head of Partnerships works closely alongside you for your first 90 days, and the goal is full independence by about day 120.
  • Room to shape it. You'll inherit real momentum, but the strategy in these categories is still being written, and you'll help write it.
  • Close to the media. You'll connect what partners need to placements across FinanceBuzz and our publisher network, which is where a good partnership becomes an extraordinary one.
  • Direct exposure to senior leadership on the deals that matter.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Direct experience on the advertiser side of a financial comparison publisher, marketplace, or performance network, managing bank, deposit, or investing partners.
  • A record of growing accounts, not just servicing them. You can walk through a partner whose budget you grew and what moved it.
  • Sales DNA. You open doors and close. Warm relationships are most of it, but you're comfortable with cold outreach, especially to investing apps.
  • Ownership of the details. URL approvals, budget changes, CPA moves, placement and widget coordination: you run them yourself and nothing drops.
  • You figure it out without being pushed, and you pull in account management, product, media, analytics, compliance, legal, and finance to get it done.
  • Fluency in performance economics, including CPA, CPL, CPC, and revenue share, and the business acumen to use performance, revenue, and unit-economic data in a negotiation.
  • Strong communication, relationship building, and negotiation across several partners and opportunities at once.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Publisher experience, or enough of the language to hold the conversation.
  • Experience in wealth management, financial advisory, RIAs, or advisor networks.
  • Existing relationships with banks, fintech companies, investment platforms, or related financial-services companies.
  • Experience selling customer acquisition, media, lead generation, or performance-based marketing.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Existing partners

  • Budget growth, better unit economics, broader product coverage, and a bigger share of wallet with the partners you own.
  • The operations on our largest strategic banking partners, alongside the Head of Partnerships.
  • Partner operations from onboarding through campaign management, reporting, issue resolution, and optimization.
  • Proposals that connect a partner's goals to placements, audiences, and distribution across FinanceBuzz and our publisher network.
  • Accurate pipeline, forecasts, partner updates, and next steps.
  • Launch Potato's presence at industry events and partner meetings.

New partners

  • A pipeline across banking, deposits, investing, and wealth.
  • Reaching the right decision makers through relationships, referrals, events, and outbound.
  • Partner conversations from first outreach through pitch, deal negotiation, contracting, and launch.
  • A clear read on each partner's growth goals, economics, products, and target customers.

WHAT GREAT LOOKS LIKE

  • First 90 days: you're learning the book side by side with the Head of Partnerships and running operations on the partners you'll own.
  • By about day 120: you run your partners independently.
  • By month 6: you're directing internal traffic and connecting partner activity to media opportunity.
  • Year one: larger budgets and stronger economics across existing partners, new banks and investing advertisers live, and the Head of Partnerships focused on our largest, most strategic deals.

THIS ISN'T THE RIGHT SEAT IF YOU

  • Want to hunt, close, and hand the account to someone else.
  • Want someone else to own the operations.
  • Need a playbook handed to you before you move.
  • Would rather service an account than grow it.

TOTAL COMPENSATION

  • Base: $150,000 to $170,000, set by level and expertise based on initial interviews.
  • Annual Bonus: company EBITDA plus personal performance. No commission.

Want to accelerate your career? Apply now!

Since day one, we've been committed to having a diverse, inclusive team and culture. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity company. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion.

We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Job Summary:

You will build the AI runtime, retrieval, guardrails, and evaluation that make the platform's AI features work in production - with cost, latency, and safety treated as first-class engineering constraints. We build on proven commercial models and win on integration, domain knowledge, and evaluation discipline.

You'll report to the Head of AI Platform Engineering and join a small, senior founding team building the platform from the ground up.

The opportunity: ship AI that customers depend on daily in mission-critical workflows - not demos.

Job Description:

Why This Role Is Different

  • Applied, not research. We use proven commercial models and win on integration, retrieval, orchestration and safety validation. Fine-tuning is an optional track, not the goal.
  • Domain-first, not tech-first. Domain knowledge, delivered through retrieval and evaluation, is the moat, not model weights. You will invest early in your customers' domain.
  • Production-first. We ship AI that customers depend on daily. Demos don't count; reliability, cost and safety do.
  • Platform and product. You will build reusable AI capability while enabling products to ship features fast.
  • A founding role. As a found
  • ing AI hire, you will set the patterns and evaluation discipline the team adopts, and help hire the team.
  • Value-based. You will validate with product teams and customers and prioritise by value, building what moves outcomes rather than what is novel.

What You'll Do

AI Runtime and Orchestration

  • Build and operate the runtime, tool calling and orchestration for production agent workflows.
  • Design model selection and tiering, with cost and latency as first-class constraints.
  • Implement and tune retrieval (RAG) and grounding where it measurably improves quality.

Evaluation, Safety and Quality

  • Stand up evaluation harnesses and golden sets, and use them to make ship or no-ship calls and to catch regressions and drift.
  • Design and implement evaluation frameworks for model and agent quality.
  • Build guardrails and safety controls, treating retrieved content and tool outputs as untrusted.

Production Ownership

  • Own the production behaviour of what you ship, including latency, cost, reliability and failure modes.
  • Partner with product to decide when an agent is, and is not, the right tool.

Delivering Value with Product and Customers

  • Work with product teams and customers to validate results and outcomes, prioritising by value.
  • Take a value-based development approach: prove value with the smallest useful slice, then scale what works.
  • Instrument and measure impact, letting evidence rather than opinion drive what ships.
  • Build automated QA, including tests, quality gates and regression checks, into the delivery pipeline.

Building the Team and Ways of Working

  • Help build the team by setting evaluation and safety patterns others adopt, raising the bar in interviews and mentoring.
  • Foster a culture of technical excellence, customer obsession and pragmatic shipping.
  • Partner with product teams across the portfolio who own their own roadmaps.

What You'll Bring

We look at demonstrated experience and scope, not years served, and we don't expect every candidate to tick every box.

  • Production AI: You have shipped software backed by LLMs or ML to real production users, beyond demos and notebooks.
  • Evaluation over vibes: You reason about evaluation, not just prompting.
  • Cost and latency: You treat cost and latency as design constraints from the start.
  • Clear communication: You explain your thinking clearly to engineers, product partners and customers, and bring people along.
  • Value and pragmatism: You focus on outcomes and value, and make pragmatic calls to ship.

Bonus Points

Any of these strengthen an application; none are required.

  • Agents in production: Agent or RAG systems in production, and the failure modes that come with them.

About Us!

At Sourcing Unicorns, we recruit globally across the creative and experiential industry, always on the lookout for exceptional talent to bring bold ideas to life. For this opportunity, we’re proud to collaborate with the team at Fivestone Studios to find the unicorn, the one who will truly make a difference. Together, we ensure a smooth and human-centered hiring experience that reflects the studio’s vision.

About Fivestone Studios!

Fivestone Studios is a Nashville-based creative media agency that an international clientele trust as their creative secret weapon. Our MO is taking on giants and make heroes of our clients through an impressive arsenal of strategy, design, digital media production & interactive technology capabilities.

Our primary goal at Fivestone Studios is to make a space for creative warriors to grow, thrive and take on their own giants. We use our Five Stones as our lens for success and our foundation for a healthy culture: honor, bravery, vision, generosity and excellence. If you have a passion for teamwork, are willing to leave your ego at the door, and have a strong drive for creative excellence, we would love to talk.

Your Mission

We are looking for an experienced Creative Director to lead the creative vision and experience design of immersive, interactive, and technology-driven projects, from initial concept through to final delivery.

This role calls for a senior creative leader with a strong foundation in visual design and art direction, combined with expertise in experience strategy, UX, storytelling, content production, and creative technology.

You will shape compelling user and audience experiences, establish distinctive creative directions, and ensure creative consistency across multidisciplinary productions.

We are particularly interested in someone who is hands-on in visual development, capable of personally creating initial concepts, treatments, and style frames, while directing sophisticated content production and maintaining creative oversight throughout the entire project lifecycle.

You will collaborate closely with creative leadership, producers, designers, content strategists, creative technologists, developers, and other multidisciplinary teams to align creative vision with experience design, technical feasibility, and production requirements. You will also work with clients and stakeholders to translate their objectives and feedback into cohesive, high-quality experiences.

PS.: Candidates must be able to work and collaborate during US business hours (US time zones), regardless of their location.

Key Responsibilities

1. Experience Strategy & Design

  • Define the overall experience vision, creative premise and guiding principles.

  • Translate client objectives and audience needs into compelling, intuitive and engaging experiences.

  • Shape user journeys, interaction models and experience principles, considering usability, accessibility and context.

  • Identify opportunities to make experiences distinctive, meaningful and memorable.

2. Creative & Art Direction

  • Lead the creative direction across projects, defining the visual language, tone and overall approach.

  • Develop and present concepts, mood boards, visual references and creative treatments.

  • Direct visual design, motion, animation, content and storytelling to ensure a cohesive creative vision.

  • Maintain creative consistency and quality across all outputs and disciplines.

3. Creative Leadership & Collaboration

  • Lead and guide multidisciplinary creative teams, providing clear direction, feedback and creative decisions.

  • Work closely with UX/UI Designers, Content Strategists, Creative Technologists, Developers, Animators, 3D Artists, Sound Designers and Producers.

  • Encourage collaboration, experimentation and creative problem-solving.

  • Ensure all disciplines remain aligned with the agreed creative vision and quality expectations.

4. Technology & Production Collaboration

  • Work closely with Creative Technology and Production teams to ensure concepts are technically and operationally achievable.

  • Understand relevant technologies, platforms and physical environments, recognising their opportunities and limitations.

  • Balance creative ambition with technical feasibility, scope, budget and schedule.

  • Identify potential constraints early and develop creative solutions without compromising the core experience.

5. Creative Oversight & Delivery

  • Maintain creative oversight from concept development through to final delivery.

  • Review designs, prototypes and integrated experiences, providing clear and constructive feedback.

  • Make timely creative decisions and guide adaptations throughout development and production.

  • Identify and resolve creative and experience-related issues, ensuring the final work maintains the quality, coherence and intent of the approved vision.

Requirements

Your Journey

Must Have

  • Experience: developing immersive and interactive experiences across physical and digital environments.

  • Senior Creative Direction Experience: Extensive experience leading the creative vision and execution of multidisciplinary projects from concept through final delivery.

  • Visual Design & Art Direction: Strong artistic foundation with the ability to independently establish visual direction and create initial concepts, treatments and style frames.

  • Experience Design: Proven expertise in shaping engaging user and audience experiences, including experience strategy, UX and interaction design.

  • Content Production: Demonstrated experience directing sophisticated and technically complex content production across animation, game engines, film, UI and interactive experiences.

  • End-to-End Creative Ownership: Ability to maintain creative leadership and involvement throughout development and production, ensuring the final experience reflects the approved creative vision.

  • Multidisciplinary Leadership: Experience guiding creative teams across visual design, motion, animation, content, UX/UI, 3D and creative technology.

  • Creative Technology Understanding: Strong understanding of technology-driven experiences, including technical possibilities, limitations and integration considerations.

  • Production Awareness: Ability to balance creative ambition with technical feasibility, production constraints, budgets and schedules.

  • Creative Communication: Ability to present concepts, communicate artistic direction, provide constructive feedback and collaborate effectively with clients and multidisciplinary teams.

Nice to Have

  • Background in brand experiences involving immersive, interactive or technology-driven creative work.

  • Experience directing creative work across a broad range of content formats and production disciplines.

Engagement Opportunity

The collaboration will begin on a freelance basis, with the intention of transitioning into a full-time role if there is a strong mutual fit. This is a remote position.

This opportunity is part of Fivestone Studios' long-term creative needs.

Thank you for applying. We’re committed to an inclusive process and we welcome talent from all walks of life. We aim to review every application. Roles in experiential can be ultra-specialized; if it’s not a fit for this one, we may still flag your profile for future opportunities. Thanks for helping grow the Sourcing Unicorns talent ecosystem.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewNational Debt Relief (NDR) is seeking a Principal AI & ML Architect to design and build the AI and machine learning systems that power our Data Science and Applied AI teams.
jobs.description:
Overview

National Debt Relief (NDR) is seeking a Principal AI & ML Architect to design and build the AI and machine learning systems that power our Data Science and Applied AI teams. Reporting directly to the Vice President of Data and AI, this senior individual contributor serves both teams equally, helping shape shared architecture standards while staying hands-on in code. A core focus of this role is helping design NDR’s agentic architecture: the frameworks, patterns, and platforms that allow AI agents to reason, use tools, and act reliably across both predictive ML and Generative AI use cases. You will partner closely with the Directors of Data Science and Applied AI, as well as Data Engineering and Analytics Platforms, to move solutions from prototype to secure, scalable production. This is a unique opportunity for a technically deep, pragmatic architect who enjoys both whiteboard design and production delivery to shape how AI is built across a mission-driven company. This is a highly collaborative role, and strong teamwork and interpersonal skills are required.

Responsibilities

Essential Duties/Responsibilities

  • Partner with Data Science and Applied AI team members to design NDR’s agentic architecture, including:
    • Agent orchestration patterns (single-agent, multi-agent, and human-in-the-loop workflows)
    • Tool and API integration standards, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) and function calling
    • Memory, context management, and retrieval (RAG) layers
    • Guardrails, evaluation, observability, and cost controls for agents in production
  • Collaborate with both teams on reference architectures and reusable components so they can build AI and ML solutions on a common foundation.
  • Stay hands-on: prototype, write production-quality code, and work alongside engineers and data scientists to deliver high-priority solutions.
  • Contribute to the design of end-to-end ML systems, from feature pipelines and model training through deployment, monitoring, and retraining.
  • Help determine where agents and LLMs should call predictive ML models (and vice versa), combining both into cohesive solutions.
  • Work with Data Engineering and Analytics Platforms to help ensure data, infrastructure, and platform choices support AI and ML workloads at scale.
  • Contribute to build vs. buy evaluations for AI platforms, frameworks, and vendors, prioritizing scalable, secure, and cost-effective options.
  • Help mature MLOps and LLMOps practices, including CI/CD for models and agents, versioning, testing, and production monitoring.
  • Champion robust governance, security, privacy, and compliance for AI systems operating in a regulated financial services environment.
  • Participate in architecture and code reviews, and help document shared standards and best practices.
  • Share expertise with peers across the Data and AI organization, contributing to a culture of continuous learning and innovation.
  • Communicate architecture decisions, trade-offs, and roadmaps clearly to technical teams and executive stakeholders.
  • Stay abreast of evolving AI and ML tools, models, and agent frameworks, and bring forward recommendations on when to adopt them.

Qualifications

Education/Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative field. Master’s or PhD is strongly preferred.
  • 8+ years of experience in ML engineering, data science, AI engineering, or software architecture roles.
  • 3+ years in a senior, staff, principal, or architect-level role setting technical direction across multiple teams.
  • Demonstrated success designing and deploying production-grade ML models and Generative AI applications at scale.
  • Hands-on experience designing and shipping agentic AI systems (LLM agents, tool use, multi-step workflows) to production.
  • Preferred Experience
    • Experience in financial services or a related regulated industry.
    • Familiarity with Salesforce integrations and data workflows.
    • Experience with Amazon SageMaker, Azure Machine Learning, Google Vertex AI, or similar enterprise AI/ML platforms.
    • Experience with voice AI or conversational AI for telephony platforms.

Required Skills/Abilities

  • Expert Python skills and a track record of writing production-quality, well-tested code.
  • Strong SQL proficiency (Snowflake preferred) for data preparation and model enablement workflows.
  • Deep understanding of LLMs, RAG architectures, vector databases, prompt engineering, and agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, or similar).
  • Strong grounding in classical ML, including supervised and unsupervised learning, time series, anomaly detection, and NLP.
  • Experience with MLOps and LLMOps tooling, including model registries, experiment tracking, evaluation frameworks, and monitoring.
  • Experience deploying models and services via APIs using tools such as FastAPI and Docker, with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Experience with version control (e.g., Git) and CI/CD practices.
  • Ability to influence without authority and build consensus across teams with different priorities.
  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to explain complex architecture to executive and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience applying an AI-first approach to development, using AI coding assistants and agentic tools to accelerate delivery.
  • Preferred Skills
    • Knowledge of AI governance, model risk management, and responsible AI practices.
    • Exposure to collaborative tools such as JIRA and Miro.

  • Computer competency and ability to work with a computer.
  • Prioritize multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Punctuality expected, ready to report to work on a consistent basis.

  • Work in a fast-paced, high-volume setting.
  • Use and navigate multiple computer systems with exceptional multi-tasking skills.

  • Take constructive feedback.

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for each position across the US. About National Debt Relief

National Debt Relief was founded in 2009 with the goal of helping an expanding number of consumers deal with overwhelming debt. We are one of the most-trusted and best-rated consumer debt relief providers in the United States. As a leading debt settlement organization, we have helped over 450,000 people settle over $10 billion of debt, while empowering them to lead a healthier financial lifestyle and feel free to live their best life. At National Debt Relief, we treat our clients like real people. Our purpose is to elevate, empower, and transform their lives.

Rated A+ by the Better Business Bureau, our goal is to help individuals and families get out of debt with the least possible cost through conducting financial consultations, educating the consumer and recommending the appropriate solution. We become our clients' number one advocate to help them reestablish financial stability as quickly as possible.

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline and portfolio of medicines to treat heart disease, obesity and obesity-related conditions, rare diseases, inflammatory conditions and cancer. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Director, Study Evidence & Readiness

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will lead the Study Evidence and Readiness function, encompassing TMF Operations and Inspection Readiness, to ensure that clinical studies are continuously able to demonstrate appropriate trial conduct through complete, reliable, retrievable, and inspection-ready evidence.


Responsibilities:

  • Set the strategy and priorities for TMF Operations and Inspection Readiness, aligning day-to-day evidence stewardship with continuous inspection readiness.
  • Lead and develop global teams, including line management of Inspection Readiness Senior Managers and Managers; set clear goals, manage performance and engagement, and build succession and capability plans.

  • Plan and manage departmental structure, capacity, resources, budget, suppliers, training, and business continuity to meet portfolio needs.
  • Lead improvement initiatives that strengthen evidence quality, completeness, retrievability, and readiness; represent the function in process improvement, standards development, and integration work.
  • Develop and maintain effective TMF and inspection-readiness processes, policies, SOPs, work instructions, and related materials, applying current procedures, industry practice, and relevant regulatory expectations.
  • Partner cross-functionally to resolve evidence issues, interpret trends, apply root-cause insights, and drive sustainable improvement.
  • Provide leadership reporting on evidence health, readiness risks, remediation progress, and portfolio trends; contribute to relevant leadership forums and governance committees.
  • Support audits and inspections, including preparation, response support, and lessons learned for TMF and inspection-readiness process areas; build strong relationships with internal and external experts.

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients.

jobs.title: AI Technical Lead
jobs.excerpt: • Employment Type: Full-Time • FLSA Status: Exempt • Pay Type: Salary, Exempt.
jobs.description:
• Employment Type: Full-Time
  • FLSA Status: Exempt
  • Pay Type: Salary, Exempt. $115,000 - $140,000 annual base salary, depending on experience
  • Work Location: Remote. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship. This position is open only to candidates currently residing in the United States.
  • Travel Requirement: Occasional travel for all-team meetings and client workshops

AI Technical Lead

Purpose of this Position

The AI Technical Lead is a seasoned AI practitioner and trusted client consultant who serves as the senior technical voice of VeilSun’s AI Practice. This role is consultant first. Before a model is selected or an integration is built, the Technical Lead has done the harder and more important work. They have learned the client’s business, their data, and their goals, and achieved Radical Alignment on what AI should accomplish and why. Radical Alignment is genuine, documented agreement with the client on what is being built, why it is being built, and what success looks like before development begins.

This role combines hands-on AI engineering depth with the consultative presence to guide enterprise AI roadmaps and AI service package engagements. Their expertise goes well beyond third-party AI tools. It includes models, APIs, MCP servers, and the work of connecting AI securely to client data and schemas.

The AI Technical Lead also carries an internal mandate. They redesign how VeilSun delivers, prove on real projects that AI can compress weeks of technical work into days, and build AI capability across the delivery organization. Low code moves the work. AI makes it intelligent. This role makes that promise real for our clients and keeps VeilSun’s low-code practices competitive and growing.

Business Outcomes

Success in this role means AI engagements deliver measurable client value, VeilSun delivers faster with leaner teams, and AI capability is spreading across the delivery organization. You will be measured on:

  • Engagement quality. AI roadmaps and service package engagements are technically sound, right-sized, and tied to client business outcomes.
  • Client satisfaction. Clients feel heard, informed, and confident. Risks around data, security, and model behavior are surfaced early and worked through together.
  • Acceleration results. Complex work such as data mapping and code generation moves from weeks or months to days. Results are measured, documented, and repeatable.
  • Team enablement. Delivery team members, including PMs and leadership, show measurable growth in AI skills and day-to-day adoption.
  • Knowledge distribution. AI expertise is held by multiple team members, not one person.
  • Commercial discipline. Meets the billable utilization target agreed with AI Practice leadership. Estimates are accurate and margin is protected.

Core Responsibilities

Enterprise AI Roadmapping & Client Consulting

  • Serve as the technical expert on enterprise AI roadmap and AI service package engagements, partnering with the AI Services Lead and the project lead.
  • Lead discovery with discipline. Learn the client’s business, data landscape, and systems before recommending an AI approach.
  • Achieve Radical Alignment on AI use cases, success measures, and boundaries before any build begins.
  • Translate AI possibilities into practical, phased roadmaps that deliver value in small, high-value increments.
  • Advise clients candidly on what AI can and cannot do today. Redirect them away from poorly fit use cases, unsafe data practices, or oversized investments.
  • Educate client stakeholders on tradeoffs among cost, accuracy, security, and speed so they can make informed decisions.
  • Partner with the Solution Engineer during the handoff from sales so technical design and estimates carry into delivery intact.

AI Engineering & Architecture

  • Design and build AI solutions that go beyond off-the-shelf tools, including model selection, API integration, prompt and agent design, and MCP server development.
  • Connect AI to client data and schemas securely, with attention to data quality, access controls, and governance.
  • Integrate AI capabilities with the Quickbase, Mendix, and custom web applications delivered by VeilSun’s other practices.
  • Serve as the primary technical authority on assigned AI engagements. Make and defend architecture decisions with confidence.
  • Establish and document AI development standards, reusable patterns, and evaluation practices for the practice.
  • Validate AI output quality through testing and evaluation. Keep a human in the loop where the risk calls for it.

Delivery Model Modernization

  • Redesign VeilSun’s delivery methods so engagements of $400K to $500K can be run by a project lead and one developer, with QA added when needed.
  • Identify where AI can compress effort across the delivery lifecycle, including requirements, data mapping, code generation, testing, and documentation.
  • Prove new approaches on real client projects. Measure the results and turn what works into repeatable practice.
  • Partner with the PMO and Delivery Team Managers to update estimating, staffing, and quality practices to fit the new model.

AI-Accelerated Development

  • Show the team, on live engagements, how AI cuts complex technical work like data mapping and code generation from weeks or months to days.
  • Build and share the tools, prompts, workflows, and templates that let other developers repeat those results.
  • Protect quality while moving faster. AI-generated work is reviewed, tested, and maintainable before it reaches a client.

Internal Initiatives & Platform Depth

  • Help build and accelerate VeilSun’s internal MCP integration between Claude and Quickbase.
  • Work with the related work group as testers. Gather feedback, prioritize fixes, and move the integration toward production use.
  • Learn and build VeilSun’s depth on RapidMiner AI Studio and AI Graph with existing team members so the expertise does not sit with one person.
  • Apply AI to keep VeilSun’s Quickbase practice competitive and growing through new offerings, faster delivery, and stronger client outcomes.

Team Enablement & Change Leadership

  • Lead workshops, coaching, and hands-on sessions that build AI skills across delivery, including Developers, PMs, and leadership.
  • Drive the change toward AI-first thinking about what is technically possible and how long it should take.
  • Meet people where they are. Tailor enablement to each role and build real confidence, not just awareness.
  • Mentor Developers through pairing, reviews, and direct coaching on AI-assisted development.
  • Contribute to the practice’s knowledge base. Document solutions, patterns, and lessons learned in a form others can use.

Risk Identification & Commercial Discipline

  • Scan engagements continuously for technical, data, security, scope, and client relationship risks. Raise them with enough lead time for the team to act, not react.
  • Escalate architectural and delivery risks to AI Practice leadership before they become delivery problems.
  • Balance billable delivery with enablement and internal initiative work deliberately. Meet the utilization target agreed with AI Practice leadership.
  • Size AI workstreams with practiced accuracy. Recognize when scope expansion warrants a change order and coordinate rather than absorbing it silently.

Business Development Support

  • Identify new AI use cases and account growth within assigned clients. Coordinate with the Account Manager on growth opportunities.
  • Support pre-sales efforts including technical discovery, AI readiness assessments, and proof-of-concept development when needed.

Decision Authority

You have authority to:

  • Make architecture, model, and integration design decisions on assigned AI engagements.
  • Hold or redirect scope on active engagements, in coordination with the project lead or AI Practice leadership.
  • Require rework when AI solutions do not meet quality, security, or architectural standards.
  • Pilot new AI-accelerated delivery methods on assigned engagements, in agreement with the project lead.
  • Recommend AI tools, platforms, and models for delivery and internal use, within VeilSun’s AI governance policies.
  • Escalate technical risks, data concerns, scope issues, or client issues to AI Practice leadership.

Desired Behaviors & Attributes

  • Consultant First. Approaches every engagement as a business consultant who happens to be a deep AI practitioner. Starts with the client’s problem, not the technology.
  • Radical Alignment. Does not build until alignment is real. Re-validates use cases, data assumptions, and success measures throughout the engagement.
  • Deep Technical Fluency. Understands how models, APIs, and data actually work, not just how tools present them. Stays current without being prompted.
  • Proves It. Shows what is possible with working results on real projects, not slides. Measures outcomes and shares them openly.
  • Change Leadership. Moves people toward AI-first thinking with patience and conviction. Challenges assumptions about what is possible and how long it should take.
  • Teacher at Heart. Builds capability in others rather than becoming the bottleneck. Knows the difference between doing the work and building someone’s capacity to do it.
  • Boldness and Directness. Says what needs to be said to clients, teammates, and leadership. Pushes back on unrealistic AI expectations while keeping the relationship intact.
  • Responsible Judgment. Treats client data, security, and AI governance as non-negotiable. Knows when a human must stay in the loop.
  • Composure Under Pressure. Steady when experiments fail, timelines compress, or clients are frustrated. Sets the tone for the team and does not pass stress downward.

Failure Patterns We Avoid

  • Building before Radical Alignment. Starting an AI build before use cases, data, and success measures are agreed is a fundamental failure of this role.
  • Leading with the technology. AI is a means, not the goal. Solutions must tie back to the client’s business outcomes.
  • Overpromising. Unrealistic claims about what AI can do damage client trust and VeilSun’s credibility.
  • Staying at the surface. Relying only on third-party tools when the engagement calls for deeper engineering.
  • Demonstrating without delivering. Proofs of concept that never become repeatable practice do not change how VeilSun works.
  • Hoarding expertise. Knowledge that sits with one person is a business risk, not job security.
  • Trading quality for speed. Faster delivery never excuses unreviewed, untested, or unmaintainable AI-generated work.
  • Ignoring data security and governance. Connecting AI to client data without proper controls is unacceptable.
  • Leaving people behind. Enablement that builds awareness but not skill and confidence does not change behavior.
  • Letting scope drift without surfacing it. Scope integrity is a core responsibility of this role, not the project lead’s alone.

Preferred Capabilities

  • 5+ years of software development or technical consulting experience, including 1+ years of hands-on AI solution delivery.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM APIs such as Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, or Google, including prompt design, tool use, and agent patterns.
  • Experience building or integrating MCP servers and connecting AI to enterprise data sources, APIs, and database schemas.
  • Proficiency in at least one language commonly used for AI integration, such as Python or TypeScript.
  • Experience with data science, analytics, or AI modeling platforms. VeilSun currently uses RapidMiner AI Studio and AI Graph, but experience with similar tools is acceptable, along with the willingness to build depth on ours.
  • Experience with low-code platforms, especially Quickbase or Mendix, is a strong plus.
  • Demonstrated experience leading client engagements from discovery through delivery in a consulting environment.
  • Experience designing and delivering technical training, workshops, or enablement programs.
  • Working knowledge of AI governance, data privacy, and security practices.
  • Familiarity with Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
  • Strong written and verbal communication across technical and non-technical audiences.

The Patient Safety Specialist is a highly visible position with Advocate Health Care that was created as a result of executive management’s desire to mitigate unintentional patient harm, and to reduce liability costs and exposure by reducing clinical risks. Patient safety continues to gain increased importance as a top system priority from the perspective of health outcomes, financial performance, and the need to meet increasing expectations nationally. The Patient Safety Specialist will provide support to the Patient Safety Multi-site Director or Patient Safety Manager in the implementation of a robust patient safety program at select hospital sites. The specialist will provide support to multiple sites within the region of the Multi-suite Director, either both on-site and remotely. This position will review highly confidential data to identify events that require investigation, and assist in the coding and management of the data to support site evaluation of safety program outcomes. The Patient Safety Specialist will conduct event investigations, primarily in the form of Apparent Cause Analyses, in concert with department managers, front line and medical staff. Management of patient safety data will be a major role of the Safety Specialist. This position will assist in the development and execution of complex clinical risk reduction initiatives, in particular those related to nursing or other clinical practice. The nursing or other clinical background of this individual allows breadth and flexibility in this role. The Patient Safety Specialist will collaborate with other key divisions within the organization, including Risk Management, Supply Chain, IT and Clinical Engineering to name a few. The Patient Safety Specialist will also provide education on relevant patient safety topics.


Major Responsibilities:

Patient safety event investigation:

Facilitates the timely investigation of select safety events and near miss events through the implementation of apparent cause analysis (ACA) and use of other investigative tools. Will participate in investigations at sites within their region.
Assists the site safety leaders within their region with completing chart reviews, interviews and review of evidence based literature to support the cause analysis process.
Conducts confidential interviews with those involved in the events in order to document the timeline of events and causal factors.
Effectively facilitates the cause analysis process in a manner that facilitates trust and transparency.
Reviews ACA’s completed by site managers, mentoring leaders to ensure an effective investigation and identification of corrective actions.


Supports a site culture of high reliability through involvement in the site's Patient Safety program:

Supports implementation of the site patient safety program including tools that promote reliability. These include but are not limited to participation in daily huddle, safety rounding, safety recognition, just culture, safety coach and physician champion programs among others.
Teaches the Culture of Safety presentation to new associates in their initial orientation.
Establishes and maintains effective relationships with associates and physicians in order to influence and advance site culture, working to ensure safe practices and behaviors are in practice by the front line.

Maintains alignment of site work with system standards.
Serves as a site patient safety resource to various committees or teams related to care delivery.
Designs and gives presentation to various committees regarding patient safety and high reliability.
Authors articles for newsletters or publication in support of patient safety and high reliability.


Patient safety data and report management:
Reviews reported patient safety events on a daily basis and recommends those that require investigation. May be asked to review reports from multiple sites.
Appropriately codes individual cases to facilitate the collection of aggregate data for purposes of program design and goal setting.
Ensures timely updates to the system safety data repositories in order to facilitate site and system data collection and analysis.
Aggregates site patient safety data to identify trends and actionable items to advance site culture.

Assists in preparing site reports in the form of tracking, trending, graphs or analyses regarding safety program outcomes.

Support of the site’s corrective actions resulting from event investigation:
Serves as a resource to managers on effective corrective action design to minimize event recurrence.
Assists in tracking corrective actions to ensure timely completion and implementation.
Participates in the audits of effectiveness of key corrective actions.

Nurse, Registered (RN) OR Physical Therapist OR Pharmacist, Registered

• Bachelor’s degree in nursing or allied health field • Advanced degree in a health-related field preferred OR equivalent experience Minimum of 4 years clinical experience

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Required:
Sound oral and written communication skills sufficient to interact effectively with and influence associates and medical staff • Sound organizational skills; effectively manages shifting priorities • Demonstrated ability to problem solve and analyze procedure and process changes • Self-directed, works with indirect and (at times) direct supervision • Sound critical thinking and analytical skills utilized in the cause analysis process • Proficiency with MS Office (Word, Excel and Power Point) • Political sensitivity to the dynamic interplay that occurs between departments, physicians, associates and management.

Current RN or Allied Health License

• Candidate must be willing to attend, onsite & offsite, department meetings and educational activities. • Maintain proficiency in department’s software computer program. • Able to travel to other Advocate sites within their designated region, and corporate meetings as appropriate, generally monthly. • Candidate must be able to perform various physical tasks with a high degree of proficiency, such as articulating, hearing, viewing, and walking throughout the hospital. • Flexible hours according to customer needs • Ability to work under stressful and difficult conditions.

Advocate Health is the third-largest nonprofit, integrated health system in the United States, created from the combination of Advocate Aurora Health and Atrium Health. jobs.excerpt: Job DescriptionIntegrated Business Planning (IBP) brings together forecasting and planning across marketing, sales, finance, procurement, manufacturing, and customer service into a unified process.
jobs.description:
Job Description

Integrated Business Planning (IBP) brings together forecasting and planning across marketing, sales, finance, procurement, manufacturing, and customer service into a unified process. This integration ensures alignment across the enterprise, leading to superior customer outcomes.

As one of the CMR/HDX Demand Planners, you will collaborate closely with an IBP data scientist to generate reliable forecasts and coordinate demand reviews. This particular role will be focused on the Cellular Mollecular Research and Health Care Diagnostics sales channels (CMR/HDX). Your role will be crucial in ensuring effective demand schedules, streamlining internal processes, and ultimately enhancing the customer experience.

Responsible for analyzing overall product demand, forecasting future demand and product needs, and providing input into component demand schedules.

Assists in the improvement of demand forecasting accuracy for internal and external customers, working with demand data scientist(s) to determine the appropriate algorithm for statistical forecasts.

The work of the demand planner will enable Agilent to maximize account sales and inventory turns by accurately forecasting demand, managing product history and promotional demand, and identifying historical sales trends and demand patterns.

Works with the demand data scientist(s) to maintain integrity of data for demand model inputs and analyzes internal demand stream information.

Collaborates on Sales & Operations Execution (S&OE) processes to enhance demand sensing and adjustment of long-term view of the Integrated Business Planning (IBP).

Develops reports and leads demand review forums, reporting on attainment of business objectives, adherence to demand forecast schedules and driving consensus on unconstrained demand.

Principle Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Develop Demand Forecasts: Utilize IBP data scientist modeling, market intelligence, and field sales input to create accurate demand forecasts.
  • Coordinate Demand Reviews: Collaborate with sales and marketing stakeholders to conduct thorough demand reviews.
  • Execute Demand Planning: Provide reliable forecasts to ensure effective demand planning.
  • Analyze Historical Sales Trends: Review past sales trends, research demand drivers, and evaluate forecast results to inform future planning.
  • Perform Root Cause Analysis: Investigate key metrics such as forecast accuracy, bias, and value add to identify underlying issues.
  • Derive Consolidated Forecasts: Generate a comprehensive forecast of unconstrained demand.
  • Evaluate IBP Deviations: Discuss and understand the impact of last month's IBP deviations on the current month's plan.
  • Facilitate Best Practices: Proactively facilitate and re-engineer best practices, fostering consensus among functional experts.
  • Drive Improvement Actions: Implement actions for improvement and develop a stakeholder communication plan.
  • Monitor Forecast Consumption: Track forecast consumption and plan attainment to ensure alignment with goals.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree or equivalent.

  • 8+ years relevant experience for entry to this level.

  • Extensive knowledge and specialized expertise in sales, marketing, or finance; experience in forecasting or planning is a plus.

  • Strong executive presence and leadership skills.

  • Demonstrated ability to assess complex business problems and deliver impactful results.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage with different levels of management.

  • Self-motivated and capable of operating independently.
