jobs.excerpt: Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers.
jobs.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

The Portfolio Omnichannel Strategy & Operations Team is seeking a social media expert to manage commercial social execution across the Revolution Medicines oncology portfolio. This newly-created role spans tumor types, branded promotion and unbranded disease state education (DSE), and digital engagement with healthcare professionals (HCPs), patients and caregivers through direct-to-patient (DTP) initiatives.

The Senior Manager, Customer Engagement Social Strategy & Operations will serve as the US Portfolio Omnichannel team’s social subject matter expert, translating approved marketing and engagement strategies into effective paid and organic social programs. This individual will manage social profiles, maintain channel playbooks and execution standards, coordinate social deliverables with agencies and platform reps, and facilitate channel-specific discussions with the Promotional Review Committee (PRC). The role also provides hands-on email expertise, including campaign workbook population, tracking link creation and quality assurance (QA). This role will also act as a SME in regard to the email channel.

Aligned to social strategy, this role will work closely with Portfolio Omnichannel leads, HCP and Patient Marketing Leads, Corporate Communications, Analytics & Insights, IS/IT and PRC partners, this individual will apply and improve established processes, support in-line products and launches, and recommend execution improvements based on performance insights. Brand-aligned Marketing Leads retain ownership of brand and disease state strategy, objectives and core messaging.

The role will work in a matrix with Portfolio Omnichannel Tumor & NPP leads, who own overall customer engagement strategy and priorities for their tumor franchises. With direction from these leads and the hiring manager, the Senior Manager will manage day-to-day social execution, provide channel expertise and recommendations, and escalate decisions on new platforms, capabilities, resources and strategic priorities for alignment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with Portfolio Omnichannel Tumor & NPP leads to execute commercial social programs across tumor types and indications, supporting branded and DSE initiatives for HCP, patient and caregiver audiences.

  • Translate approved brand objectives, audience insights and customer journeys into actionable social execution plans; recommend channels, content formats, paid and organic approaches and targeting in alignment with broader omnichannel priorities, and in partnership with media agencies.

  • Own social profile builds, launches, updates and ongoing maintenance, including profile content, account credentials, access permissions, agency access and account transition or retirement processes.

  • Maintain and update social playbooks and execution standards as platforms evolve, documenting capabilities, creative specifications, PRC guidance and operational workflows. Adapt established templates for new channels in partnership with Portfolio Omnichannel leads and review partners.

  • Coordinate social-specific deliverables with creative (AOR) and media agencies, aligning briefs, timelines and quality expectations with brand marketing and Omnichannel leads. Partner on paid social builds, targeting, flighting and optimization; monitor pacing against approved media allocations and flag variances to budget owners. Coordinate organic publishing and profile activity with marketing and communications partners.

  • Oversee social launch and ongoing QA, confirming creative rendering, links, tracking, profile functionality and alignment with PRC approvals; coordinating asset refreshes and retirement. Partner with Analytics & Insights team and media agencies to review agreed performance measures, support testing and recommend improvements to creative, targeting and customer journeys.

  • Partner with Corporate Communications and Analytics & Insights to assess social listening use cases and support approved pilots or integration into Portfolio Omnichannel operations, sharing relevant audience and conversation insights with commercial teams.

  • Prepare and maintain floor plans for social profiles and ad units for PRC submissions, documenting copy, imagery, disclosures, links and interactive elements. Maintain version control and alignment between approved materials and live executions

  • Join PRC discussions on proposed social channels, platform changes, ad units and creative questions as needed. Gather platform and agency inputs, partner with Medical, Legal and Regulatory reviewers to resolve execution questions, and document decisions in practical channel guidance.

  • Coordinate social moderation and escalation processes with Corporate Communications, PRC partners, applying approved responses and company procedures for monitoring and routing adverse events, product complaints and sensitive inquiries.

  • Identify emerging and innovative social channels, ad formats and platform capabilities that could improve customer engagement. Bring practical recommendations to Omnichannel leads, assess feasibility with agencies and PRC, and support approved pilots with clear hypotheses and success measures; share findings to inform broader adoption.

Email Operations Responsibilities

  • Provide email operational support for HCP and DTP campaigns, populating and maintaining execution workbooks with approved content, audience requirements, deployment details and tracking specifications.

  • Create and validate UTM parameters and campaign links using consistent naming conventions; coordinate with media, analytics and email partners to support reliable measurement across social and email.

  • Lead pre-deployment email and eblast QA, reviewing test sends for copy, personalization, links, tracking, rendering, mobile usability and required footer elements. Confirm approval alignment and coordinate issue resolution and deployment readiness with execution partners.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree required.

  • 6–8 years of progressive marketing experience within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, including oncology and substantial hands-on experience in social media execution and operations.

  • Deep knowledge of paid and organic social media, profile management, audience targeting, creative formats and campaign operations across major platforms.

  • Experience supporting branded and unbranded programs and adapting channel execution to HCP and patient audiences.

  • Experience managing promotional review submissions and working with Medical, Legal and Regulatory partners to address social channel and creative questions in a regulated environment.

  • Hands-on email execution experience, including campaign workbooks, UTM and link creation, test sends and pre-deployment QA.

  • Experience coordinating creative and media agency deliverables, managing project timelines and executing multiple concurrent social campaigns or launches within approved plans and resources.

  • Strong analytical judgment, attention to detail and ability to translate campaign results into practical recommendations.

  • Clear communication, effective cross-functional collaboration and ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority in a growing organization.

Preferred Skills:

  • MBA or relevant advanced degree.

  • Experience launching targeted oncology therapies, Specialty Care or rare disease products and supporting multiple brands, indications or tumor types.

  • Experience maintaining social playbooks, preparing annotated PRC floor plans and applying moderation processes and channel governance standards.

  • Familiarity with social listening tools and translating audience insights into marketing recommendations.

  • Experience with HCP and patient email programs, including headquarters-led email and rep-triggered email (RTE), marketing automation and modular content.

  • Experience in a high-growth, recently commercialized environment.

jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

As a Security Operations Engineer at Samsara, you will join a global team dedicated to protecting our people, systems, and information. You will triage and investigate security alerts, run incident response efforts, and help improve the tools, runbooks, and automated workflows we use to detect and respond to threats.

This role is an ideal next step if you have built foundational experience in a SOC or hands-on security environment and want to develop your technical craft. At Samsara, we view this level as a collaborative apprenticeship: you will develop independent execution skills on discrete investigations, break down incoming alerts into actionable steps, partner with incident stakeholders to remediate findings, and work alongside experienced responders during complex security incidents. You will also explore modern AI tools and insights to simplify routine tasks and optimize your day-to-day workflow.

We are looking for someone who follows the evidence, communicates with intellectual honesty, asks thoughtful questions, and brings a collaborative, pragmatic approach to security operations.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in the United States and in the Pacific Timezone.

You should apply if:

  • You enjoy investigating: You like working through unfamiliar activity, connecting evidence from different sources, and explaining what happened.
  • You want to improve how security operates: You notice repetitive work, unclear instructions or noisy alerts and want to help make them better.
  • You want to develop your craft: You’re looking for hands-on responsibility, feedback from experienced colleagues, and opportunities to grow across incident response and automation.
  • You want your work to have real-world impact: You’re motivated by helping protect the technology behind industries that keep the world moving and help workers return home safely.

In this role, you will:

  • Monitor, triage and investigate security alerts across identity, endpoint, email, SaaS and cloud environments, using our tools, runbooks and escalation procedures.
  • Own routine investigations and incidents through to a documented outcome: gather evidence, establish a timeline, assess the activity and explain your conclusions.
  • Support experienced responders during major security incidents through evidence collection, technical analysis, and agreed containment and recovery actions.
  • Maintain clear investigation records and provide useful updates and handovers to teammates across regions.
  • Improve runbooks, help tune detections, and contribute small scripts or automated workflows with guidance and review from teammates.
  • Participate in post-incident reviews and turn lessons learned into practical improvements.
  • Champion Samsara’s cultural principles: Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, and Win as a Team.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Hands-on experience triaging and investigating security alerts in a security operations, incident response or similar role.
  • Experience using security tools such as a SIEM, endpoint detection and response platform, or email security platform to investigate suspicious activity.
  • An understanding of common threats, such as phishing, account compromise and suspicious endpoint activity, and the networking, operating system and identity concepts needed to investigate them.
  • Ability to query and interpret logs, distinguish evidence from assumptions, and recognise when further investigation or escalation is needed.
  • Some scripting experience: you can read, adapt and write small scripts in Python or another language to support an investigation or simplify repetitive work.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including documenting findings, explaining uncertainty and providing effective handovers.
  • A careful approach to sensitive information, willingness to ask for help, and openness to feedback.

We welcome different routes into security. A particular degree or certification is not required; we’re interested in what you can do, how you approach problems, and what you’re ready to learn next.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience investigating activity in cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP, SaaS applications, or identity systems.
  • Exposure to writing or tuning detections, threat hunting, or investigating activity across multiple data sources.
  • Experience using Python, APIs or automation platforms to improve a security workflow.
  • Familiarity with evidence collection or forensic analysis on macOS, Windows or Linux.

You do not need experience in every area above. Bring a solid operational foundation, curiosity and a willingness to learn.

$95,200—$144,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:You help customers adopt the platform, realise measurable value, and renew and expand with confidence. You pick up where Implementation leaves off, learn each customer's fleet and challenges, and advise on tailoring Samsara to them. You manage 100+ named accounts, using AI tooling to extend your reach and focus your time where it counts. Your understanding of the value customers get earns you the right to lead the ROI conversation, negotiate terms and close renewals that work for both sides, minimising financial attrition. You work with Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together, and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform's capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types, from field services and utilities to long-haul transportation and school buses.
  • Manage a portfolio of 100+ named accounts, using AI tooling to accelerate your engagement, prioritize proactively, and drive efficiency and outcomes across your book of business.
  • Lead the ROI and value conversation into the renewal, negotiate favorable terms, and close renewals that are a win for both the customer and Samsara while minimizing financial attrition.
  • Demonstrate a willingness to understand and explain technical issues to a non-technical audience and to engage the right cross-functional partners to drive resolution.
  • Conduct workshops with customers to understand their current operations and recommend workflow changes to maximize the value of their Samsara products.
  • Work cross-functionally with Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product to strategically solve problems and optimize customer experience and business outcomes.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Business fluency in French (spoken and written).
  • 2+ years in a customer-facing, quota-carrying role (renewals, customer success, account management or sales), ideally in SaaS, technology or logistics.
  • A record of consistent quota over-achievement.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication and presentation skills, and the ability to build trust with executives, users and internal teams.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Gainsight, Gong or similar GTM tools.
  • Comfort in a fast-changing, high-growth environment.
  • A bachelor's degree from a 4-year institution, or equivalent practical experience.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • A strong bias towards action, big-picture thinking and high standards.
  • An AI-first approach: you use AI tooling to drive efficiency and outcomes.
  • Technical depth across a suite of products, with a bonus for hardware-software integration.
  • Industry Knowledge: Experience with routing, navigation, commercial trucking fleets, and logistics.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. About the assignment

We are looking for an experienced Azure Platform Solution Architect and Developer to enable application teams to onboard and operate on a secure, governed Azure platform. The role focuses on developer experience and platform enablement by delivering reusable IaC, policy-driven guardrails, subscription vending automation, and self-service capabilities. The position operates across platform, security, and application teams in large-scale enterprise environments.

Responsibilities

  • Lead onboarding of new application teams to the Azure platform, providing hands-on architectural guidance and ensuring alignment with approved patterns and guardrails

  • Act as a trusted advisor to development teams, supporting solution design decisions with a strong developer-centric perspective

  • Design and evolve reusable IaC templates and platform patterns, embedding Azure Policy and secure-by-default principles

  • Develop and enhance self-service capabilities in Backstage, enabling seamless onboarding, discovery, and consumption of platform services

  • Contribute to and improve the subscription vending solution, integrating IaC templates, governance controls, and automation workflows

  • Enable application teams to self-manage their landing zones, including RBAC, metadata (cost center, ownership), and lifecycle through Backstage

  • Build and integrate API-driven workflows to support platform automation, self-service, and system interoperability

  • Continuously identify and remove friction in the developer journey, improving onboarding experience and driving platform adoption

  • Drive a seamless, secure-by-default onboarding experience where application teams can independently design, provision, and manage their solutions through standardized patterns and self-service capabilities

Requirements

Mandatory

  • Highly skilled Azure Platform Solution Architect with a strong hands-on background, focused on enabling application teams to onboard solutions onto a secure, governed Azure platform.

  • Acts as a trusted advisor, guiding teams in adopting approved patterns while balancing governance, scalability, and flexibility.

  • Brings a developer-first mindset and speaks the same language as application teams, ensuring practical and usable architecture guidance.

  • Experienced in Azure Landing Zones (CAF, Well-Architected Framework), embedding secure-by-default principles into reusable platform patterns and IaC templates.

  • Drives developer experience by building self-service capabilities in Backstage, enabling teams to onboard, provision landing zones, and manage RBAC and metadata independently.

  • Contributes to subscription vending and automation, integrating APIs, IaC, and policy guardrails into a seamless experience.

  • Operates with a code-first, product mindset, delivering reusable, version-controlled platform capabilities designed to reduce friction and maximize adoption.

  • Extensive background working in large-scale enterprise environments (multi-tentant and 300+ subscriptions), enabling standardized, automated, and policy-driven platforms that balance governance, agility, and developer self-service.

  • Azure Platform Expertise (Deep knowledge of Azure Landing Zones, management groups, subscriptions, subscription vending solution, strong networking skills, identity (Entra ID), RBAC, PIM, policy baselines with Azure Policy (with EPAC) in enterprise-scale environments)

  • Solution Architecture (Strong ability to design scalable, secure, and governed cloud architectures aligned with CAF and Well-Architected Framework)

  • Governance & Security (Strong understanding of secure-by-default principles, policy-as-code, compliance, and enterprise guardrails)

  • API & Integration (Experience designing, consuming, and integrating REST APIs to enable automation, self-service workflows, and platform interoperability)

  • Platform Engineering (Ability to design and deliver platform capabilities as reusable products with automation, CI/CD, and strong governance integration)

  • Developer portal / Software development (Experience building and integrating self-service capabilities, templates, and workflows in Backstage (or similar platforms). Typescript, React, Expressjs, .NET)

  • Application Authentication (OAuth2/OIDC flows, client credentials, certificate-based auth, Microsoft Graph API (API permissions (delegated vs application), workload identity federation))

  • Infrastructure as Code & Automation (Bicep, AVM, PowerShell, Python)

  • Cloud services (Functions, Logic Apps, Container Apps, App Services, AKS, Databases (SQL & Cosmos), API management, Key Vault, Log Analytics, Azure Monitor)

  • CI/CD (Github, version control, workflows (YAML), AI-assisted development tools (Github Copilot, Claude Code))

  • Relevant certifications: AZ-305, AZ-204, AZ-400, GH-200, GH-300

jobs.description:
Brunel is partnering with DataAnnotation to connect experienced Mechanical Engineers with an innovative AI training program. This opportunity brings together hands-on mechanical engineering expertise and artificial intelligence to help evaluate and improve how AI models solve real-world engineering problems. Selected experts will contribute their knowledge to the development of high-quality, technically accurate AI systems.

This opportunity is designed for practicing engineers across mechanical design and CAD, structures and materials, thermal and fluid systems, dynamics and controls, manufacturing, automotive, aerospace, HVAC, robotics, energy, and related mechanical engineering disciplines.

The models can already communicate fluently about mechanical engineering concepts. The challenge is teaching them to reliably perform the actual engineering work: sizing components against real load cases, identifying potential failure modes, evaluating CAD assemblies and clearances, analyzing design changes, and understanding downstream impacts. Your engineering judgment will help establish the benchmark against which these AI models are evaluated.

Engagement Details

Engagement
Fully remote, project-based work with a flexible schedule. Around 10 hours per week is the recommended starting point; the project prioritizes engineers who can commit 30–40 hours per week, though part-time availability is considered.

Pay Rate

$40–$125+ USD/hour, paid via PayPal

Location
United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia, and New Zealand

First Step

Skills assessment (1–3 hours)

Responsibilities:

  • Design challenging, closed-ended mechanical engineering problems based on your own professional experience that require genuine engineering reasoning rather than simple information lookup.
  • Derive and verify the correct answers to your problems and develop clear, technically rigorous worked solutions demonstrating your methodology.
  • Test engineering problems against advanced AI models and refine them to appropriately challenge the models’ reasoning capabilities.
  • Evaluate AI-generated mechanical engineering analysis, designs, calculations, and technical documentation for accuracy and real-world applicability.
  • Compare AI-generated solutions and determine which performs better, identifying specific strengths, weaknesses, and technical errors.
  • Identify and document concrete failures, including incorrect assumptions, calculation or unit errors, unrealistic results, overlooked failure modes, improper material or component selection, and misinterpretation of engineering requirements.
  • Review problems and solutions developed by other engineering contributors for technical correctness, ambiguity, rigor, and practical relevance.
  • Apply your expertise across one or more mechanical engineering disciplines, including:
  • Mechanical Design & CAD: geometry, clearances, tolerances, mechanisms, assemblies, and the impact of design changes.
  • Structures & Materials: stress, deflection, fatigue, buckling, material selection, and failure analysis.
  • Thermal & Fluids: heat transfer, thermodynamics, HVAC, pumps, piping, and fluid mechanics.
  • Dynamics & Controls: vibration, kinematics, rotating machinery, and control systems.
  • Manufacturing: DFM/DFA, process selection, GD&T, tolerance stack-ups, and cost and quality trade-offs.

Qualifications:

  • Fluency in English, with the ability to communicate complex technical reasoning clearly in writing.
  • 2+ years of professional mechanical engineering experience in design, product development, manufacturing, thermal systems, structural engineering, automotive, aerospace, HVAC, robotics, energy, or a related discipline.
  • Background in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related engineering field.
  • Strong engineering fundamentals, including knowledge of mechanics of materials, dynamics, thermodynamics, heat transfer, fluid mechanics, and manufacturing processes.
  • Experience with tools relevant to your engineering specialty, which may include CAD platforms such as SolidWorks, Fusion 360, Onshape, Creo, NX, CATIA, or Inventor; FEA/CFD tools; or MATLAB/Python for engineering analysis.
  • Ability to develop precise, technically rigorous, and unambiguous engineering problems and clearly explain the reasoning behind the correct solution.
  • Ability to articulate why an engineering answer or design is incorrect, not simply identify that it is wrong.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify edge cases, incorrect assumptions, and potential failure modes.
  • Working comfort with AI tools, or the ability to learn and use them quickly.
  • A current, in-progress, or completed Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.

Relevant Backgrounds:

This opportunity may be particularly relevant for professionals currently working as:

  • Mechanical Engineer
  • Mechanical Design Engineer
  • Product Engineer
  • Manufacturing Engineer
  • Structural/Mechanical Engineer
  • Thermal Engineer
  • HVAC Engineer
  • Automotive Engineer
  • Aerospace Engineer
  • Robotics Engineer
  • Mechanical Systems Engineer

About the role

The AV APD Adjuster resolves first-party and third-party vehicle damage and property damage claims involving autonomous and driver-assist vehicles. The role moves quickly on repairable and total-loss files, and applies extra care to sensor, camera, and software-dependent components that traditional appraisal does not cover.

What you'll do

  • Investigate and decide coverage, liability, and damages on assigned APD and property damage claims, using vehicle data and video to confirm whether the system or a human was in control

  • Determine who or what was in control at the time of loss: human driver, driver-assist feature, or automated driving system

Digital Strategy & Transformation

We're living through a once-in-a-generation shift in how work gets done. Data, automation, and AI are quickly becoming the center of every business decision - and Alteryx is leading the transformation.

Principal Offensive Security Engineer

Alteryx is searching for a Principal Offensive Security Engineer in the United States. Join a team that values diverse perspectives, technical curiosity, and collaboration to improve the security of our products and enterprise environments.

Position Overview

As a Principal Offensive Security Engineer, you will serve as a senior technical leader within Alteryx’s Offensive Security program. You will lead risk-prioritized penetration testing, red-team engagements, and adversary simulations across product and enterprise environments.

This is a highly hands-on role. You will personally scope and execute complex engagements while setting technical direction, improving testing methods, and mentoring other practitioners.

A key focus of this role will be the practical use of artificial intelligence in offensive security. You will develop and evaluate AI-assisted workflows that improve offensive testing and operational effectiveness.

You will also partner closely with Security Operations, Detection Engineering, Incident Response, Application Security, Cloud Security, IT, and Engineering to validate defensive controls and improve Alteryx’s ability to detect and respond to realistic adversary behavior.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead risk-prioritized penetration testing and offensive security assessments across products, web applications, APIs, infrastructure, cloud, identity, SaaS, and enterprise technologies.
  • Identify, validate, and safely exploit vulnerabilities and demonstrate how weaknesses can be chained into realistic attack paths.
  • Scope, design, and execute red-team campaigns and adversary simulations based on relevant threats, emerging techniques, and business risk.
  • Develop, validate, and incorporate AI-assisted workflows into offensive security activities, such as reconnaissance, campaign development, social engineering, tooling, and analysis.
  • Develop custom scripts, tooling, payloads, and automation to support offensive security engagements.
  • Conduct offensive security and red-team assessments with a primary focus on GCP and modern identity platforms, extending testing to AWS, Azure, and Kubernetes as relevant.
  • Partner with SOC, Detection Engineering, Threat Hunting, and Incident Response teams to plan and execute purple-team exercises that validate telemetry, detections, investigation workflows, and response capabilities.

  • Own the technical direction and execution of the offensive security roadmap in partnership with security leadership. Mature testing methodologies and provide hands-on mentorship and technical pairing to other offensive security practitioners.

jobs.excerpt: The roleGauntlet is looking for an AI Research Engineer to help improve how we build, evaluate and use AI agents across the business.
jobs.description:
The role

Gauntlet is looking for an AI Research Engineer to help improve how we build, evaluate and use AI agents across the business.

We already have agents running in production, including Aria, our in-house generalist agent. They're used across research, engineering and business workflows, and we've learned a lot from seeing how they perform in practice. Some tasks work extremely well; others produce inconsistent results, and changes to models or tooling can introduce unexpected problems. Today, much of that feedback is still subjective. We want to build a more systematic way of understanding what works, what doesn't and why.

A major part of this role will be building the evaluation frameworks that allow us to measure agent performance on real tasks. You'll work with our engineers, quantitative researchers and other teams to understand where agents struggle, turn those observations into measurable experiments, and use the results to improve the systems we're building.

You'll also contribute directly to our existing agents and internal tooling. Initially, the work will be more engineering-focused as you get familiar with our systems, shipping improvements and integrations that teams can use. Over time, you'll take on more open-ended research, helping us develop better approaches to evaluation, agent behaviour and infrastructure.

We're also thinking beyond individual agents. One of our longer-term goals is to build a shared system of knowledge and reusable skills that our agents can draw from and improve over time. You'll play an important role in developing that infrastructure and how we evaluate its effectiveness.

This is an applied research role with a meaningful engineering component. We're looking for someone who enjoys investigating difficult problems, can design good experiments and is comfortable building and shipping the solutions that come out of them.

About Gauntlet

Gauntlet builds the financial systems of the future. While much of onchain finance is focused on point solutions, we operate across the entire stack to offer best-in-class vault products. Today we serve over $1.7B in client TVL across some of the largest fintechs/neobanks, protocols, exchanges, and capital allocators in crypto - and, increasingly, traditional asset management. Our team brings together traditional finance and crypto-native expertise to deliver durable, sophisticated products for institutional clients moving onchain.

Why this role is different

    This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of AI, quantitative research and DeFi, tackling problems where advances in AI can have a direct impact on financial markets and onchain strategies.

    You'll go beyond building individual agents, helping define how they're evaluated, how they learn from real-world tasks and how their capabilities scale across the business. With few established benchmarks in this space, you'll have the freedom to explore new approaches and take your ideas from research through to production, working directly with the teams putting them to use.

What you'll do;

  • Build evaluation frameworks for AI agents, including datasets, sandbox environments and metrics that measure performance on real-world tasks.
  • Design experiments to compare models, agent harnesses, tools and execution environments, identifying regressions and understanding the trade-offs between performance, reliability and cost.
  • Work with teams across Gauntlet to turn qualitative feedback about agent behaviour into concrete research questions, experiments and measurable outcomes.
  • Investigate agent failures, understand whether problems come from the model, harness, tooling or prompting, and develop ways to improve performance.
  • Build and improve agent harnesses, internal tools and integrations, including contributing to Aria and other agents used across the business.
  • Help develop shared knowledge and reusable skills across agents, creating systems that can learn from previous work and improve over time.
  • Work alongside Infrastructure and Security to ensure agents can operate reliably and safely within our production environment.

What we're looking for;

  • Hands-on experience building, evaluating or improving LLM models or agents, whether through professional work, applied research, open-source contributions or substantial personal projects.
  • Strong Python skills and good software engineering fundamentals. You're comfortable writing production-quality code and understand the importance of testing, maintainability and reliability.
  • Experience with applied research, machine learning or data science, including designing experiments, working with datasets and drawing conclusions from results.
  • A good understanding of how LLM agents work beyond prompting, including tool use, harnesses, context management and common failure modes.
  • The ability to take an open-ended problem, break it down into testable questions and work independently towards a solution.
  • Experience building tools or systems that other people use, with an understanding of how to evaluate their effectiveness beyond technical benchmarks.
  • Comfort working across research and engineering, collaborating with different teams and adapting as priorities change.
  • Genuine interest in AI agents and how they can be made more capable, reliable and useful.

Nice to have;

  • Experience building LLM evaluation pipelines, benchmarks, reinforcement learning environments or model testing infrastructure.
  • Contributions to open-source agent frameworks, harnesses, evaluation datasets or benchmarks.
  • Experience with agent frameworks such as Hermes, OpenClaw or similar tools.
  • Experience in applied ML research, model training, fine-tuning or reinforcement learning.
  • An advanced degree or postgraduate research experience in computer science, mathematics, statistics, machine learning or a related field.
  • Experience in financial markets, quantitative research, DeFi or risk modelling.
  • Familiarity with AI security considerations, including access controls, prompt injection and data protection.

    • You don't need prior experience in crypto or DeFi. Strong research and engineering fundamentals matter more, and you'll work closely with people across Gauntlet who understand the financial systems and strategies our agents support.

    We expect strong candidates to have experience working in a professional engineering or research environment, but we're more interested in what you've built and how you approach problems than a specific number of years on your CV.

Benefits

    • Remote first — work from anywhere in the United States

    • Regular in-person company retreats and cross-country "office visit" perk

    • 100% paid medical, dental, and vision premiums for employees

    • $1,000 WFH stipend

    • Monthly reimbursement for home internet, phone, and cellular data

    • Unlimited vacation

    • 100% paid parental leave of 12 weeks

    • Fertility benefits

Location: Bengaluru

Experience: 7–11 Years
Openings: 1
Employment Type: Permanent
Shift: 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced API Gateway Architect to lead an organization-wide migration from Apigee to AWS API Gateway. The role involves designing target-state architecture, establishing API governance standards, and building scalable, secure, and reusable API platform solutions. The candidate will also lead efforts to establish AWS-native alternatives for Apigee capabilities such as analytics, reporting, and developer portal functionality.

Job Description

The architect will assess the existing Apigee environment across multiple teams and services, identify feature gaps, and define the migration strategy to AWS API Gateway. This includes designing standardized API architecture, security patterns, observability frameworks, and reusable infrastructure components.

The role also focuses on developing centralized logging, monitoring, analytics, and reporting solutions to ensure visibility into API traffic, performance, errors, and consumer usage. The candidate will work closely with engineering, security, infrastructure, and platform teams to establish governance standards and ensure a smooth, phased migration with appropriate rollback strategies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assess the existing Apigee environment, including routing, rate limiting, quotas, security policies, and shared gateway capabilities.
  • Conduct feature-parity and gap analysis between Apigee and AWS API Gateway.
  • Define enterprise-wide AWS API Gateway reference architecture and implementation standards.
  • Design API security solutions covering OAuth2/OIDC, JWT validation, mTLS, API keys, and WAF.
  • Establish centralized logging, monitoring, metrics, distributed tracing, and reporting architectures.
  • Develop reusable Infrastructure as Code modules using Terraform, CDK, or CloudFormation.
  • Define API governance standards covering security, versioning, tagging, and cost management.
  • Own migration planning, phased cutovers, canary/blue-green deployments, and rollback strategies.
  • Provide architectural guidance and collaborate with engineering teams throughout the migration.

Required Skills

  • AWS API Gateway
  • Apigee Edge
  • Terraform
  • Strong AWS expertise: Lambda, CloudWatch, IAM, VPC, Route 53, and multi-account strategy.
  • API platform architecture and governance.
  • API security: OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, mTLS, API keys, and WAF.
  • Observability architecture, centralized logging, metrics, and distributed tracing.
  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, AWS CDK, and CloudFormation.
  • API analytics, reporting, and monitoring solutions.
  • Experience designing and governing API platforms across multiple teams or business units.

Mandatory Skills

  • AWS API Gateway
  • Terraform

Preferred / Good to Have

  • Experience leading organization-wide migrations from Apigee or other API management platforms.
  • Experience establishing API governance frameworks and developer enablement practices.
  • Familiarity with distributed tracing tools and centralized log analytics platforms.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should have 7–11 years of experience in API architecture and enterprise API platform management, with strong production experience in Apigee Edge and AWS API Gateway. They should have demonstrated experience leading large-scale API migrations, defining architectural standards, implementing security and observability frameworks, and enabling multiple engineering teams.

Benefits Package

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • A collaborative and inclusive work environment.
  • The opportunity to work on exciting and challenging projects with leading clients.

About Gruve

Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. As a well-funded early-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks.

Position summary:

We are looking for a skilled L2 Cloud Administrator to support day-to-day operations of Azure and AWS infrastructure. The role is responsible for incident resolution, cloud resource administration, monitoring, performance troubleshooting, patching, backup validation, security remediation and infrastructure lifecycle management. The administrator will work closely with L1 operations, L3 Cloud team and cross-functional teams to ensure cloud availability, security, operational efficiency and SLA compliance.

Key Responsibilities:

Azure Cloud Operations

  • Provide L2 support for Azure infrastructure incidents, alerts and service requests.
  • Administer and troubleshoot Azure Virtual Machines, disks, storage accounts and related resources.
  • Monitor Azure resource health, availability, performance and utilization using Azure Monitor and Log Analytics.
  • Troubleshoot VM startup, connectivity, CPU, memory, disk and operating system issues.
  • Support Azure networking, including Virtual Networks, subnets, Network Security Groups (NSGs) and connectivity troubleshooting.

AWS Cloud Operations

  • Administer and troubleshoot EC2 instances, EBS volumes, snapshots and related resources.

  • Perform approved instance provisioning, resizing, patching, backup validation and lifecycle activities.
  • Support AWS Backup, snapshots and disaster recovery procedures.
  • Assist with IAM access reviews, security remediation and compliance activities within authorized scope.

Operations & Service Management

  • Resolve cloud infrastructure incidents and service requests within defined SLAs.
  • Execute approved changes and operational tasks following established procedures.
  • Support cloud patching, vulnerability remediation, backup verification and recovery activities.
  • Investigate monitoring alerts and escalate complex platform, networking, identity and architecture issues to L3 Cloud SMEs.
  • Follow ITIL Incident, Problem, Change and Request Management processes.
  • Maintain runbooks, operational documentation, incident records and shift handovers.
  • Coordinate with Security, Network, Windows/Linux, Storage/Backup and Application teams.

  • Ensure effective APAC–EMEA–NLAM follow-the-sun handovers.

Required Skills:

  • 3-6 years hands-on experience in Azure and/or AWS cloud infrastructure operations.
  • Knowledge of Azure VMs, disks, storage accounts, Azure Monitor and Log Analytics.
  • Knowledge of AWS EC2, EBS, snapshots and CloudWatch.
  • Understanding of cloud networking, including Azure VNets, NSGs, AWS VPCs, subnets, security groups and routing.
  • Experience with cloud VM provisioning, monitoring, troubleshooting, patching and lifecycle management.
  • Working knowledge of Azure RBAC and/or AWS IAM, security controls and access management.
  • Understanding of cloud backup, recovery, disaster recovery and vulnerability remediation.
  • Experience with ITSM tools such as ServiceNow and ITIL-based Incident, Problem and Change Management.

  • Exposure to Azure Automation, Azure Update Manager or AWS Systems Manager.
  • Knowledge of cloud cost management, tagging, capacity optimization and compliance monitoring.
  • Experience with enterprise monitoring, backup and disaster recovery tools.
  • Familiarity with hybrid cloud and on-premises infrastructure integration.

Location / Support Model

Global 24x7x365 support across APAC, EMEA and NLAM, working in a rotational shift-based, follow-the-sun operating model.

Why Gruve

At Gruve, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. If you’re passionate about technology and eager to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - OpenTelemetry Python instrumentation | UK | Remote
jobs.excerpt: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale.
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applications from Germany, UK, Ireland and Spain.

The Opportunity:

Grafana Cloud is our composable observability platform that integrates metrics, logs, and traces with Grafana. It allows our customers to leverage the best open source observability software – including Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, and Tempo – without the overhead of installing, maintaining and scaling their own observability stack

The Observability department is focused on enabling developers to understand the health and performance of their applications and infrastructure in any environment by providing tools to instrument their code, ingest observability data into Grafana Cloud and visualize and explore it.

The OpenTelemetry SDKs team's mission is to make sure our users succeed in instrumenting their software with OpenTelemetry. We work closely with the OpenTelemetry SIGs to make OpenTelemetry SDKs and instrumentation libraries a success. Members of this team are experts in at least one programming language and have a broad knowledge of various other programming languages.

In this role, you will focus on a language-specific implementation of OpenTelemetry in Python, with an emphasis on OpenTelemetry for Generative AI. You will get to work in an upstream-first approach, helping accelerate the OpenTelemetry project while bringing the innovations to Grafana labs products and offerings.

As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a unique perspective to the software. We are looking for Engineers that are passionate about communicating with data and providing seamless experiences for our customers to join our growing team! Engineers at Grafana also have the opportunity to contribute to Open Source communities.

At Grafana Labs, ICs have a dedicated career path and do not have to become managers to progress in their career. Staff Software Engineers at Grafana have a large amount of experience across multiple areas. They are able to estimate, plan, coordinate and deliver large tasks spanning multiple systems. They actively coach and mentor other team members in their team and are able to identify and resolve issues with technology and product processes.

What You’ll Be Doing:

You will bring your software engineering expertise to develop improvements to the OpenTelemetry Python SDK and instrumentation libraries, with a strong focus on AI applications and agent workflows. This is a hands-on role for someone with deep Python expertise and an interest in AI.

  • Collaborate in open-source communities. You will develop and maintain the OpenTelemetry Python SDK and instrumentation libraries, working with maintainers and other vendors on specifications, APIs, and implementation decisions.
  • Build Python instrumentation for AI agents. Build instrumentation that connects agent runs, model calls, and tool execution, including across asynchronous code. Contribute to evolving OpenTelemetry conventions for generative AI, with care for sensitive data and metric cardinality.
  • Improve Python SDK performance. Use profiling and benchmarks to evaluate implementation approaches with the upstream community. Make sound tradeoffs around runtime overhead, compatibility, and maintainability.
  • Be visible as an OpenTelemetry expert. Teach others, promote best practices around OpenTelemetry, semantic conventions, and various technologies and frameworks. Both within Grafana Labs and in the broader OpenTelemetry community.
  • Support the technical direction and vision of the team, and contribute to business conversations on the OpenTelemetry strategy at Grafana Labs. Own projects from an ambiguous problem through design, implementation, testing, documentation, and release.
  • Partner in an open and respectful way. Lend your knowledge and skills to our GTM, Product and Support teams. Join customer conversations, investigate instrumentation issues, and turn what you learn into fixes and practical guidance.

As we are remote-first and our engineering organization is largely remote, we provide guidance and meet regularly using video calls, so high agency and good communication skills are a must.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

At Grafana Labs, Staff Engineers are defined by the impact they have and the people they enable. You take ownership of complex problems, set technical direction, and help others deliver improvements that matter to customers and the OpenTelemetry community.

  • 8+ years of experience in software development, with strong proficiency in Python and experience debugging production software, language internals, libraries, and asynchronous code.
  • An interest in AI applications and agent systems, and curiosity about how to instrument and troubleshoot them. Prior experience building AI systems is helpful, but not required.
  • Experience working in open-source communities. You are eager to become an active member of the OpenTelemetry community, collaborate with maintainers and users, and keep learning across languages, frameworks, and the wider observability ecosystem.
  • Familiarity with observability tooling such as Grafana, Prometheus, and OpenTelemetry, alongside experience with cloud-based software or systems engineering. You understand production environments and can assess operational risks.

Bonus Points For:

  • You have experience working on open source observability projects, ideally in OpenTelemetry or Prometheus.
  • Experience in Python instrumentation techniques, profiling, runtime diagnostics, or asynchronous context propagation
  • Experience in a hands-on technical leadership role, setting technical direction and leading project teams
  • Experience instrumenting AI frameworks or agent workflows, or working with OpenTelemetry semantic conventions for generative AI
  • Experience contributing to or maintaining Open Source projects, with evidence of successful pull requests and community collaboration
  • Rust experience is a plus for exploring potential Python SDK performance improvements, including Rust-backed implementations.

Compensation & Rewards:

In the UK, the compensation range for this role is GBP 107,000 - GBP 134,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

About Us

In 2019, the founders were working as engineers solving complex cross-domain problems within government organisations.

TwinStream was formed to bring together their collective expertise and experience into a single business, focused on delivering technical excellence and high-quality service to clients.

Since then, the company has grown to over 100 team members across the UK, with colleagues working both on-site with clients, hybrid and remotely from home.

Details:

Salary: £75,000 - £90,000 DOE

Location: Fully remote

Eligibility Requirements: Due to the nature of the work, the successful candidate must be UK-based and eligible for DV clearance.

About the role

TwinStream is seeking a Delivery Manager who can operate confidently across both project and programme-level delivery. This role blends agile, flow-based delivery practices with the ability to coordinate multiple workstreams, align stakeholders, manage complex risks, and maintain visibility across broader initiatives.

You’ll work closely with Technical Leads, engineers, and senior stakeholders to ensure that software delivery is predictable, well-governed (lightly), and aligned to programme objectives. This role is ideal for someone who can zoom out to see the bigger picture while still helping teams maintain a healthy delivery flow.

Responsibilities

Programme-Level Coordination & Planning

  • Coordinate delivery across multiple related projects or workstreams to ensure alignment with programme goals.
  • Maintain a clear, high-level view of progress, risks, dependencies, and resource needs across the programme.
  • Support roadmap shaping and programme-level planning with Technical Leads and product/strategy stakeholders.
  • Facilitate alignment discussions across teams to clarify priorities, architectural considerations, and sequencing decisions.

Agile Delivery Management

  • Lead delivery activities using Kanban and flow-based agile practices across one or more teams.
  • Maintain visibility of work-in-progress, blockers, throughput, and upcoming priorities.
  • Support teams in balancing feature delivery, technical debt, architectural improvements, and research/activity spikes.
  • Encourage continuous flow, reducing bottlenecks and ensuring smooth transitions between stages of delivery.

Lightweight Governance & Reporting

  • Provide structured but concise reporting suitable for programme sponsors and senior leadership.
  • Track progress against objectives, milestones, and commitments across multiple workstreams.
  • Capture key decisions, risks, issues, and actions in a lightweight but traceable way.
  • Help define and mature TwinStream’s delivery governance model — ensuring it remains agile and value-driven.

Risk, Issue & Dependency Management

  • Identify and manage programme-level risks, ensuring they are surfaced early and escalated appropriately.
  • Coordinate cross-team and cross-vendor dependencies with clarity and urgency.
  • Use a pragmatic, simple RAID process to maintain visibility and drive mitigation actions.
  • Support teams in resolving blockers that span across technical or organisational boundaries.

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Engagement

  • Act as the central coordination point for engineering, Technical Leads, internal stakeholders, and (when relevant) customers.
  • Communicate delivery updates with clarity, tailored to the audience — technical or non-technical.
  • Align expectations around timelines, scope, assumptions, and emerging risks.
  • Support commercial teams during pre-sales, estimation, and contract/change discussions as needed.

Continuous Improvement & Ways of Working

  • Contribute to improving TwinStream’s delivery framework, tools, and documentation.
  • Help establish scalable delivery patterns as TwinStream takes on more complex and multi-stream programmes.
  • Promote transparency, psychological safety, and a culture of proactive delivery.

Key Skills

  • Experience managing software delivery across multiple teams or workstreams, not just single-project coordination.
  • Strong understanding of flow-based agile delivery and programme-level planning.
  • Proven ability to identify cross-cutting risks, large dependencies, and structural blockers.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills at all levels of the organisation.
  • Confidence operating in environments that value structure but avoid heavy process.
  • A pragmatic, solution-focused mindset and the ability to bring clarity in uncertainty

There are many great reasons to join our team!

Pension Plan

Secure your future with our competitive pension plan that offers an 8% employer contribution.

Private Medical Healthcare

Your health and well-being are our top priorities. Enjoy comprehensive private medical healthcare, which includes dental and optical care for you and your family.

Learning and Development

Your career is in your hands. We empower you to take charge of your own development, giving you the autonomy to shape your growth.

Flexible Working

We understand the importance of balancing work and life. Flexibility is not just a policy for us; it is part of our culture. We are passionate about helping you seamlessly integrate work with your home life.

Electric Vehicle Scheme

Drive sustainability forward with our electric vehicle leasing scheme. You can take advantage of this initiative through a convenient salary sacrifice program.

Holidays

Enjoy annual leave of 28 days, plus bank holidays, allowing you to recharge and spend time on what matters most.

Team Events

We love celebrating our achievements! In addition to our quarterly meetings, you can look forward to our Christmas and summer parties—opportunities to relax, reflect, and have fun as a team.

Additional Benefits

We provide life assurance for your peace of mind and a cycle-to-work scheme to support your health and sustainability goals.

Diversity & Inclusion

We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities.

If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know. We’re here to support you
