jobs.description:
Our Mission

Our mission is to SAVE AND IMPROVE LIVES BY EMPOWERING HEALTHCARE CONSUMERS. Come be part of remarkable.

Overview

How You Can Make a Difference

The Director, CX Data & Customer Analytics is the analytics leader for the Customer Organization, responsible for helping CX leadership understand, explore, define, and deliver scalable analytics and enterprise reporting that enables effective performance management, business growth, operational excellence, and continuous improvement in customer experience.

This role is both a strategic business partner and a hands-on analytics leader. The Director works closely with CX leadership to translate business priorities into measurable outcomes, operating metrics, reporting products, and analytic solutions that improve visibility, accountability, decision quality, and action.

This role leans heavily toward business and strategic impact. The Director serves as an enabler of decision-making for CX leadership, helping shape where the organization focuses and what it does next—not simply reporting on what has already happened. The role is accountable for influencing business outcomes such as customer retention and growth, cost to serve, operational effectiveness, and customer experience.

The Director also partners with Data Engineering, Data Governance, Data Science, AI, and Technology teams to build durable semantic models, governed reporting assets, and reusable data products that support CX analytics at scale, including gold-layer data assets in Databricks.

This is a hands-on leadership role. Hands-on may be needed to advise analysts in their code, decision logic, or performance optimization. The Director is expected to be credible in the work, not only accountable for managing the work.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Serve as the primary analytics and insights partner to CX leadership, helping leaders define strategic questions, customer experience measures, operating metrics, and decision needs.
  • Build a deep understanding of HealthEquity's business model and how client, member, broker, and partner experiences connect to business performance, retention, growth, and operational efficiency.
  • Quantify the value at stake—including retention, revenue, cost to serve, operational risk, and customer experience impact—and use it to build business cases, guide investment decisions, and prioritize the CX analytics roadmap.
  • Translate business priorities into measurable outcomes, analytics strategies, reporting products, and action plans that drive customer and business results.
  • Own the CX analytics roadmap, aligning investments to customer priorities, value at stake, strategic business objectives, executive priorities, operational reporting needs, regulatory and risk considerations, automation opportunities, and measurable business value.
  • Develop scalable analytics, dashboards, scorecards, and enterprise reporting that help the Customer Organization monitor performance, identify risk, evaluate trends, and improve customer experience.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to CX leadership by translating complex analytics into clear business narratives, recommendations, and decision support for executive audiences.
  • Establish intake, prioritization, and delivery practices that focus the team on the highest-value work while communicating tradeoffs in a supportive, transparent, and business-oriented manner.
  • Negotiate competing priorities with stakeholders based on business value, urgency, reuse potential, risk, effort, and strategic alignment, including the ability to say “not right now” without damaging trusted partnerships.
  • Distinguish between ad hoc analysis, repeatable operational reporting, certified analytics, and scalable data products; ensure valuable ad hoc work is converted into operational analytics, semantic models, and engineering-backed data assets when appropriate.
  • Partner with Data Engineering and Technology teams to design, sponsor, and mature semantic models that enable governed, consistent, and performant analytics and reporting at scale.
  • Partner with Data Governance to improve metric definitions, data quality, lineage, stewardship, certification, and trust in CX reporting and customer experience analytics.
  • Use CX platforms, survey data, call center metrics, agent performance data, CSAT, NPS, customer journey signals, contact drivers, quality measures, and operational data to identify trends, root causes, opportunities, and risks.
  • Apply data science fluency to increase pattern recognition, segmentation, driver analysis, predictive modeling, forecasting, anomaly detection, and proactive performance management across the Customer Organization.
  • Partner with Data Science and AI teams to identify, prioritize, and operationalize advanced analytics and AI-enabled use cases, including agentic AI capabilities built against governed semantic models and Databricks gold-layer data assets.
  • Drive report rationalization, automation, dashboard performance improvement, self-service enablement, and retirement of low-value or duplicative reporting assets.
  • Measure analytics effectiveness through business outcomes influenced, decisions changed, stakeholder adoption, reporting quality, reduced manual effort, improved decision speed, customer experience improvements, and measurable business impact.
  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing analytics and reporting team that combines business partnership, technical depth, curiosity, accountability, and measurable impact.
  • Create role clarity, delivery standards, operating rhythms, and development plans that improve team execution, stakeholder trust, and analytics maturity.
  • Manage and carry out personnel actions for direct reports, including hiring, scheduling, coaching, training, performance management, compensation recommendations, and corrective or disciplinary action as appropriate.
  • Provide hands-on guidance to analysts on SQL, Python, Databricks notebooks, dashboard logic, business rules, data validation, query performance, and reusable analytical patterns.

Required Technical and Expertise

  • Deep business acumen with a strong understanding of how customer experience influences retention, growth, customer lifetime value, operational efficiency, and cost to serve.
  • Must be able to write SQL, Python, and Databricks notebooks/workbooks well enough to guide analysts, review logic, validate results, and advise on performance optimization.
  • Deep understanding of analytics engineering concepts, semantic model design, dimensional modeling, metric definition, dashboard design, and scalable reporting patterns.
  • Strong familiarity with customer experience and operational performance measures, including call center metrics, queue performance, handle time, first-contact resolution, abandonment, transfer rates, quality measures, CSAT, NPS, and customer experience trends.
  • Experience with CX survey or Voice of Customer platforms such as Qualtrics or similar tools, and the ability to integrate survey signals with operational and behavioral data.
  • Working knowledge of Databricks, lakehouse architecture, gold-layer data assets, BI platforms, governed metrics, and reusable data products.
  • Data science understanding or hands-on experience in predictive modeling, classification, forecasting, segmentation, recommendation, anomaly detection, and pattern recognition.
  • Understanding of agentic AI, AI assistants, and AI-enabled analytics patterns, including the use of governed semantic models as trusted sources for AI agents and decision-support tools.
  • Ability to partner with engineering teams on data model requirements, performance considerations, reusable logic, testing, data quality, reliability, and production readiness.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and stakeholders without direct authority, using data, insights, business cases, and structured decision support to drive action and results.

Key Success Factors

  • Demonstrated hands-on analytics depth, including direct experience with SQL and Python and the ability to inspect, challenge, and improve analytical logic.
  • Proven ability to partner strategically with CX or operational leadership to translate business objectives into measurable analytics products, insights, and enterprise reporting.
  • Experience making prioritization decisions using business value, urgency, reuse potential, risk, and delivery capacity while maintaining a strong stakeholder experience.
  • Experience moving high-value ad hoc analysis into scalable reporting, governed metrics, semantic models, or data engineering-supported assets.
  • Ability to operate in a resource-constrained environment with a bias toward MVP delivery, iteration, reuse, and measurable business impact.
  • Comfort working across Analytics, Data Engineering, Data Governance, Technology, Data Science, AI, and business leadership teams to deliver trusted analytics at scale.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to frame opportunities and problems in business terms, quantify the value at stake, and prioritize investments based on business impact rather than request volume or urgency.
  • Demonstrated success influencing executive and senior leadership decisions through analytics, insights, storytelling, and fact-based recommendations that drive measurable business outcomes.

What You Will Need to Be Successful

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, Operations, or related field required; Master's degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in customer analytics, CX analytics, business intelligence, customer insights, data science, consulting, strategy, or related disciplines.
  • 5+ years of leadership experience managing analytics, BI, insights, reporting, or analytics engineering teams.
  • Experience leading analytics transformation, reporting modernization, KPI standardization, self-service analytics, dashboard rationalization, customer intelligence programs, or semantic model adoption.
  • Experience supporting senior leaders through operating reviews, performance management routines, executive dashboards, strategic planning, and decision support.

  • Own the full ML lifecycle: experiment tracking, model versioning, deployment, monitoring, and retraining

Description

As a Sales Director at Earnix, you will play a critical role in driving new business growth within the Canadian insurance sector. You will be responsible for owning complex sales cycles end-to-end, developing executive-level relationships, and positioning Earnix’s intelligent decisioning solutions as transformational assets for Canadian insurers navigating digital and operational evolution. This role requires a strategic, highly motivated hunter with deep industry understanding and a relentless drive to win.

What you’ll do

Own the full sales cycle from lead to close, driving pipeline generation, qualification, solution positioning, and deal negotiation using a structured MEDDPICC approach. You will work closely with Canadian insurance prospects to understand their business challenges and articulate how Earnix can deliver measurable value.

Develop and execute territory and account strategies, focusing on expanding Earnix’s footprint within the Canadian insurance market. You will leverage market insights and customer intelligence to identify opportunities and strengthen Earnix’s competitive positioning.

Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers across actuarial, product, underwriting, pricing, IT, and executive leadership. You will lead conversations that help Canadian insurers modernize and transform their operations through intelligent decisioning.

Collaborate with global remote teams in product, marketing, presales, and delivery to ensure a seamless customer journey. You will drive alignment across multiple time zones and functions to deliver an exceptional prospect experience.

Represent Earnix at Canadian industry events, conferences, and customer engagements, delivering compelling presentations and communicating Earnix’s value proposition. You will be a visible ambassador of the brand in the Canadian insurance ecosystem.

Requirements

You’ll do it using

8+ years of proven, successful sales experience in the Canadian P&C Insurance space, ideally gained at a fast-growing startup or scale-up, demonstrating the ability to navigate complex organizations and close strategic deals in a high-growth, less-established environment.

A strong understanding of how Canadian insurers operate today, combined with deep knowledge of the digital transformation challenges and opportunities across the sector. You will use this knowledge to influence strategic discussions and guide prospects toward modern, analytics-driven decisioning.

Hands-on experience running deals through a MEDDPICC (or comparable) qualification methodology, with fluency in metrics, economic buyer identification, decision criteria/process mapping, pain identification, and champion building.

A passion for hunting and new business acquisition, consistently driving pipeline growth, identifying new revenue streams, and generating momentum in the competitive Canadian insurance market.

Experience operating within global, distributed teams, using collaboration tools and communication best practices to ensure cohesion and momentum across regions.

A highly motivated, results-oriented work style, committing to doing what it takes to win while upholding Earnix values and delivering a world-class customer experience.

Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, enabling you to convey complex concepts with clarity and build trust with diverse stakeholders.

Willingness to travel extensively across Canada when required, meeting customers, attending events, and strengthening Earnix’s presence in key markets.

You’ll excel by

Demonstrating exceptional relationship-building and stakeholder management skills, enabling you to engage effectively with Canadian insurance executives and influence high-impact decisions.

Applying MEDDPICC rigor instinctively — qualifying hard, forecasting accurately, and knowing when to walk away from a bad deal.

Communicating with clarity, confidence, and insight, tailoring messages to technical, commercial, and leadership audiences.

Exhibiting strong teamwork and collaboration, even while working independently, by aligning with global colleagues and sharing knowledge and field intelligence.

Showing resilience, tenacity, and a competitive drive, maintaining focus on results and adapting quickly in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Presenting yourself as a trusted advisor, helping Canadian insurance customers navigate change while positioning Earnix as an indispensable strategic partner.

Position Intro

Earnix is the first AI company purpose-built for insurance decisioning, providing the industry with the intelligence, governance, and decisioning agility to drive profitable growth, improve resilience, and operate with speed and precision in a rapidly changing risk environment. A trusted provider of production-grade AI and decisioning technology, Earnix builds on more than 25 years of experience in artificial intelligence risk, pricing, rating, analytics, and decisioning. Earnix brings vertical AI into the workflows and decisions that shape insurance performance across insurers’ pricing, underwriting, claims, customer engagement, retention, and other insurers high-value insurance moments. Earnix’s AIOS enables insurers to orchestrate intelligence across the insurance decision lifecycle and drive governed, real-time decisions that deliver measurable business outcomes. Earnix is headquartered in Boston, MA and has been innovating for insurers and banks since 2001 with customers in over 35 countries across six continents and offices in the Americas, Europe, Asia Pacific, and Israel.

MoneyGram International UK/Europe, USA/Canada, About the role As part of our performance transformation, we're hiring a Senior performance marketing to lead creative strategy, testing and velocity, in close partnership with our creative team, across Universal App Campaigns (UAC) and Performance Max (PMax), alongside Google Ads and Apple Search Ads (ASA), for a portfolio of countries across Europe and further afield. This is a high-impact, hands-on role for a search marketer who lives in the details-someone who knows how to scale campaigns, drive efficient customer acquisition, and run high-velocity creative experiments across UAC and PMax. You'll own daily channel execution, manage complex budgets, build creative testing roadmaps, and scale programs like PMax. You'll collaborate closely with the creative team, product, analytics, and regional growth teams to brief and build a steady pipeline of new creative assets and to ensure paid search plays a central role in our growth engine. This role is built for an all rounder, comfortable working hand in hand with creative partners and who's technical, data-driven, and always pushing for more efficient, scalable acquisition. We use AI extensively across media buying and creative to drive efficiency, and you'll help us take that further. If you've scaled ASA, UAC, or Google Search in fast-moving environments and are ready to build on a global stage-we'd love to talk. What you'll do

Own creative strategy, testing, and velocity across UAC and Performance Max (PMax), alongside Google Search and Apple Search Ads-for a portfolio of high-priority markets with real global scale. Manage channel structure, targeting, bidding, and pacing-balancing growth with CAC efficiency and LTV payback. Build and run a high-cadence creative testing program across UAC and PMax, working hand in hand with the creative team to brief and launch new concepts, formats, and asset variants every week, with clear hypotheses, success metrics, and fast scale-or-kill decisions-alongside keyword, bidding, ad copy, and landing page tests. Track testing velocity and learning rate-tests launched, time to significance, win rate, and creative refresh cadence-and document and share learnings across markets. Report on performance and trends across UAC, PMax, and ASA-developing clear creative-level insights and making strategic recommendations to improve results. Prepare detailed quarterly plans and forecasts-backed by channel expertise, data, and a bias for testing. Collaborate with product and CRO teams to improve conversion paths, app onboarding, and post-click performance. Work directly with platform reps (Google, Apple) to unlock beta access, resolve issues quickly, and stay on the cutting edge of campaign innovation. Partner with regional marketing teams to ensure your campaigns are aligned with local strategy, language, and customer insights. Bring efficiency metrics to the center-owning CAC, CPAs, ROAS, and marginal return analysis to guide smarter spend decisions. Use AI tools to drive efficiency across media buying and creative-from bid and budget optimization to asset generation and variant testing-and share what works with the wider team. Embed AI in your day-to-day management of campaigns to surface growth opportunities faster, and work with the creative team to use AI creative to scale asset production and testing. Stay sharp on search trends-from match-type changes to creative requirements, app promotion updates, and new campaign types.

What we're looking for

5-8 years of hands-on experience in paid search, with deep expertise in Google Ads, ASA, and UAC. Hands-on experience running creative tests and scaling Performance Max is essential. Proven track record of scaling campaigns across geographies and optimizing to aggressive CAC/LTV goals. Comfortable owning both strategy and execution-working with large budgets and fast feedback loops. Deep understanding of app install campaigns and app lifecycle optimization (onboarding, retention, monetization). Able to demonstrate hands on use of Ai to assist with day to day management of campaigns and uncover growth opportunities. Strong understanding of how to apply AI to increase creative velocity and quality - from concept generation to asset production and iteration - in partnership with the creative team. Proven experience running high-velocity creative testing across UAC and PMax-building test plans, managing experiments, and iterating quickly based on creative and audience insights. Cross-functional operator-experienced in working with analytics, product, creative, and regional marketing teams. Strong written and verbal communicator, with the ability to clearly share performance results, tradeoffs, and ideas. Based in the US or UK. Comfortable working independently across time zones. Ambitious and growth-minded-this is an IC role with the potential to grow into leadership.

Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. Position summary:

We are looking for a skilled L2 System Administrator to support enterprise backup and storage infrastructure. The role is responsible for backup administration, storage provisioning, incident resolution, capacity monitoring, backup failure troubleshooting, restore operations and infrastructure availability. The administrator will work closely with L1 operations, L3 SMEs, Server, Database, Virtualization and Application teams to ensure data protection, storage availability and SLA compliance.

Backup Operations

Storage Operations

  • Knowledge of backup policies, schedules, retention, backup failures and restore procedures.
  • Understanding of SAN, NAS, storage provisioning, LUNs, zoning and storage capacity management.
  • Troubleshooting skills across backup agents, connectivity, storage paths, performance and capacity.
  • Knowledge of backup validation, recovery procedures and disaster recovery fundamentals.
  • Experience with enterprise monitoring tools and ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM platforms.
  • Understanding of ITIL Incident, Problem, Change and Request Management.

Preferred Skills & Qualifications:

Job Title: Mathematics Expert (MSc. or PhD)

Compensation: $80–$120 per hour
Location: Global — Fully Remote
Employment Type: Contractor
Workload: Approximately 15 hours per week
Schedule: Flexible, with the option to work on weekdays or weekends, subject to availability requirements.

Job Summary

We are seeking highly skilled Mathematics Experts to contribute to an AI training project focused on advanced mathematical problem-solving, computational mathematics, numerical methods, and Python programming.

The role involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating mathematical tasks using computational and command-line-based workflows. Candidates will translate mathematical problems into executable procedures, implement algorithms, generate reproducible results, test special cases, and verify mathematical and numerical accuracy.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Solve and validate advanced mathematical and computational problems.
  2. Translate mathematical requirements into precise, executable workflows.
  3. Implement mathematical algorithms and workflows using Python and command-line tools.
  4. Automate calculations, numerical experiments, parameter sweeps, and result validation.
  5. Review computational outputs for mathematical correctness, numerical stability, and reproducibility.
  6. Use scientific computing tools and relevant libraries to support complex mathematical analysis.

Required Qualifications

  1. A master's degree or PhD in Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Operations Research, Computational Science, Theoretical Computer Science, or a closely related quantitative field; or
  2. A bachelor's degree in Mathematics or a related quantitative field, along with at least 1–2 years of mathematics-focused professional or research experience at a leading company or institution.
  3. Strong expertise in at least one mathematical discipline, such as:
    • Applied mathematics and numerical analysis
    • Optimization and operations research
    • Probability and statistics
    • Discrete mathematics
    • Algebra and geometry
    • Mathematical modeling and dynamical systems
  4. Strong computational problem-solving and analytical skills.
  5. Ability to implement, test, and validate mathematical solutions using Python or equivalent computational tools.

Relevant Tools & Technologies

Experience with one or more of the following tools is beneficial:

  • Programming and scientific computing: Python, Julia, GNU Octave
  • Mathematical computation: SymPy, SageMath
  • Numerical analysis: NumPy, SciPy
  • Optimization: CVXPY and related optimization libraries
  • Data analysis and visualization: pandas, Matplotlib, Jupyter
  • Statistical modeling and network analysis: statsmodels, NetworkX

Equivalent command-line-accessible mathematical software is also acceptable. No single library is mandatory.

Selection Process

  1. Application: Apply for the role and complete the screening questions.
  2. AI Interview: Complete an interview lasting approximately 30 minutes.
  3. Hiring Manager Review: Undergo a final review of your qualifications and expertise.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based, with payment provided for each task that meets the project's specifications. Task completion time may vary depending on the complexity of the problem, the expert's experience, and the chosen workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply.

Start Timeline & Availability

The hiring process typically takes around 48 hours. Candidates who are ready to begin immediately are preferred.

Ideal Candidate Profile

A highly analytical mathematics professional with advanced quantitative expertise, strong Python programming skills, and the ability to develop reproducible computational solutions to complex mathematical problems.

jobs.description:
Position:

Legal Director, Global Trade Compliance Counsel


Job Description:

The person hired for the position of Legal Counsel Director, Global Trade Compliance will provide subject matter expertise and legal advice to Arrow Electronics and its global trade compliance organization regarding various U.S. and international trade laws, in particular import and export controls, sanctions and antiboycott laws. In addition to providing legal counsel, this person will lead the global trade compliance organization.


Why You'll Love This Role:

  • Monitor U.S. and foreign export regulations for potential applicability to Arrow.
  • Provide advice and counsel on trade compliance matters, including activities relating to U.S. and international sanctions regimes, the Harmonized Tariff Schedule, customs federal regulations, NAFTA, entry processes, valuation, and informed compliance methods.
  • Advise on export licensing and other authorizations, coordinating with the business leadership to identify compliant solutions.
  • Provide guidance on State and Commerce Department export license applications, Commodity Jurisdictions, Advisory Opinions, Commodity Classifications, and other export compliance documents.
  • Respond promptly to requests from internal clients and summarize and clearly communicate legal risks.
  • Collaborate with the various business units, Arrow legal colleagues, external legal counsel, and corporate departments to assure compliance with applicable international trade regulations worldwide, while achieving strategic and operational objectives, by counseling on trade issues, policy, procedures, training, and communications.
  • Conduct general review of business contract terms and conditions concerning trade compliance.
  • Lead a large global team.

Who We Are Looking For:

  • Strategic thinking: capable of providing clear and balanced support on a broad range of strategic and complex management and product issues.
  • Driving results: solutions and results-oriented style with a high degree of analytical ability and proven problem-solving skills.
  • Leading change: ability to thrive and quickly adapt to change, leading others through change in a dynamic, fast-paced industry and work environment.
  • Collaborating and influencing effectively builds strong relationships and partnerships within and outside of the company. Able to effectively navigate within a matrixed corporate structure.
  • Ability to communicate effectively at all levels of the organization with an open, honest and direct communication style that establishes an empathetic and effective relationship with front-line and mid-level personnel.
  • Demonstrated ability in collaborating with various internal constituencies to affect both compliance and effective business operations.
  • Business acumen and a demonstrated ability to provide legal and compliance advice in the context of international trade compliance matters.
  • Ability to provide counsel through clear and concise written and oral communications to the Arrow law and business teams.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications including Excel.
  • This role will perform work covered by International Traffic in Arms
    Regulations. Viable candidates for this position must be eligible for an export license or be a U.S. Person (which includes but is not limited to U.S. citizens or nationals, lawful permanent residents, refugees, and asylees).

Experience / Education:

  • Minimum of five (5) years of combined experience in U.S. export control laws and regulations, embargoes, sanctions, denied parties and/or anti-boycott requirements at a law firm or in-house with a multinational corporation.
  • J.D. from an accredited law school and active membership in at least one U.S. state bar (CO bar or ability for reciprocity preferred)

The Skills That Will Help You Succeed Even More:

  • Experience with U.S. Government contracting rules and regulations (e.g., FAR, DFARS, etc.).
  • Experience working with trade compliance requirements of maquiladoras and Free Trade Zones.

Work Arrangement:

Travel required.

Job is in Centennial, CO or remote.


What’s In It For You :

At Arrow, we recognize that financial rewards and great benefits are important aspects of an ideal job. That’s why we offer competitive financial compensation, including various compensation plans and a solid benefits package.

  • Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance
  • 401k, With Matching Contributions
  • Short-Term/Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • Health Savings Account (HSA)/Health Reimbursement Account (HRA) Options
  • Paid Time Off (including sick, holiday, vacation, etc.)
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Growth Opportunities

About Arrow

We believe new technologies have the power to make life not only different, but better.


At Arrow, we're helping make that future possible. We enable customers and suppliers to design and distribute technology around the world, connecting people, ideas, and innovation to solve real-world challenges.


Guided by our purpose of making the benefits of technology accessible to all, we provide expertise, solutions, and connections that help shape what's next. Redwood Finance Automation Solution Designer, Portugal

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Portugal. Day rate: EUR 450 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its finance operations on Redwood Finance Automation. The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, account reconciliation, journal processing and the reporting that follows, all connected to the organisation's ERP.

You will own the solution design. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineering team can build. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real.

What you will work on

Current-state analysis of the record-to-report processes with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design across close, reconciliation, journals and intercompany, written up as the solution design. Decisions on what standard Redwood capability covers and where an extension is justified. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems. Balance sheet auto-certification rules, controls, approvals and audit trail designed into the solution, so the automated close stands up to audit. Guidance to the engineers through build, and review of what they deliver against the design. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users. A roadmap for the next waves of automation once the first processes are live.

What you bring

Solution design ownership on at least one live Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance) implementation, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. 8 or more years in finance transformation, finance systems or record-to-report process design. A working understanding of SAP FI/CO, or the Oracle equivalent, and how close and reconciliation data flows between the ERP and the automation layer. Experience running workshops with finance users and turning what they say into a design that can be built and tested. The standing to work with senior finance stakeholders and hold a design position when it is challenged.

Useful but not essential:

Hands-on build experience on Redwood, so you know what your design asks of the engineers. BlackLine, Trintech, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. A finance qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or similar). Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood implementation: the finance processes in scope, the ERP it connected to, and which design decisions were yours.

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood Finance Automation people in front of the client.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

The Samsara Tax Department strives to be a best-in-class tax function that manages core tax processes efficiently while continuously adding value across the business. We are looking for a Senior Tax Accountant to join our Indirect Tax team and own day-to-day indirect tax compliance for North America (United States, Canada, and Mexico), manage relationships with our indirect tax advisors, and assist with indirect tax planning.

This role is the first contact for point-of-sale tax questions from across Samsara’s sales organization. You will own our internal tax ticket queue ensuring Account Executives, Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, and other business partners get clear, accurate, and timely answers to point-of-sale tax questions. The ideal candidate is customer service oriented, has a strong work ethic, is eager to learn, and can turn complex tax rules into concise, easy-to-understand guidance for non-tax audiences.

You will work closely with our Tax Technology and Operations team, external tax advisors, and Finance partners. This is a great opportunity to help shape how we scale and automate indirect tax at Samsara! This role reports to the Manager II, Tax Accounting

This is remote position open to candidates residing in the US except Alaska, Austin Metro, Boulder Metro, California, Chicago Metro, Connecticut, Dallas Metro, Denver Metro, Houston Metro, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Rhode Island, Seattle Metro, and Washington, D.C.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You're energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the tax ticket queue end to end: triage, research, resolve, and document indirect tax questions from Sales, Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, and other internal teams.
  • Deliver responsive, high-quality service to business partners, especially Account Executives, with clear and concise answers that keep deals and transactions moving.
  • Escalate deal-specific questions to the Tax Technology and Operations team and policy questions to the Tax Accounting Manager, with well-organized research and a recommended position.
  • Track ticket volume, recurring themes, and turnaround times, and share insights that guide FAQs, self-service content, and automation.
  • Manage US sales and use tax compliance, including data gathering, return preparation and review, and timely filing and payment, in partnership with external compliance providers.
  • Support Canada GST/HST/PST/QST and Mexico IVA compliance, including data gathering and coordination with external advisors.
  • Prepare recurring filings and accruals such as California use tax, Ohio Commercial Activity Tax, and state retail delivery fees (e.g., Colorado and Minnesota).
  • Reconcile indirect tax general ledger accounts monthly and support month-end and quarter-end close.
  • Monitor and resolve tax calculation errors across Vertex, NetSuite, and Salesforce, and partner with systems teams to test product taxability and process changes.
  • Maintain customer exemption certificates and perform the annual exemption certificate review.
  • Support sales and use tax audits and notices: gather documentation, prepare workpapers, and respond to taxing authorities.
  • Support cash tax forecasting and other Tax Department projects as capacity allows, including direct tax projects.
  • Work closely with external tax advisors on research, compliance, and special projects.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 3+ years of indirect tax experience in public accounting, in-house at a company, or a combination of both.
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • Working knowledge of US sales and use tax compliance, including return preparation and multistate filings.
  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, with the ability to work with large data sets.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain tax concepts to non-tax business partners.
  • Customer service mindset and a strong work ethic: responsive, organized, and accountable for follow-through.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and recurring deadlines with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Big 4 experience in a tax compliance or return preparation team.
  • CPA license or active progress toward it.
  • Hands-on experience with Vertex, NetSuite, Salesforce, and Zendesk (or similar ticketing tools).
  • Exposure to Canadian GST/HST/PST/QST and/or Mexican IVA and CFDI requirements.
  • Working knowledge of direct tax concepts.

  • Professional proficiency in Spanish.

jobs.description:
About Emerald

Emerald’s talented and experienced teams grow our customers’ businesses 365 days a year with products that create connections, deliver content, and drive commerce. We produce over 140 annual events, create and deliver content through print and digital channels, and power commerce through our seamlessly integrated in-person and digital platforms and channels. For more information, please visit

Forge (Emerald X) is seeking an experienced Senior Data Platform Project Manager / Agile Scrum Master to lead execution across our enterprise data platform and analytics portfolio. This role will provide project leadership and Scrum facilitation for the teams building and operating Forge's data foundation, including data ingestion and integration, data lakehouse and warehouse capabilities, master data, governance, semantic models, business intelligence, and reporting.

The role will lead initiatives from discovery and backlog definition through design, development, QA, user acceptance testing, deployment, and closeout. The successful candidate will bring structure, transparency, and delivery discipline to a cross-functional team of data engineers, architects, analysts, product owners, business stakeholders, and implementation partners. This is a hands-on delivery leadership role, not a data engineering role, but it requires sufficient technical fluency to understand data pipelines, integrations, cloud platforms, dependencies, and release risks.

The Senior Data Platform Project Manager / Agile Scrum Master will manage multiple concurrent initiatives, facilitate the Agile operating cadence, remove impediments, maintain delivery artifacts, and provide clear communication to both technical teams and senior business leaders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of data platform, integration, analytics, and reporting initiatives from intake and discovery through production deployment and transition to support.
  • Serve as Scrum Master and Agile delivery lead for the data platform team, promoting effective Agile practices and helping the team continuously improve delivery velocity, quality, and predictability.
  • Facilitate backlog grooming, sprint planning, daily standups, technical design reviews, sprint reviews or demonstrations, retrospectives, and release-readiness activities.
  • Partner with product owners and business stakeholders to define priorities, clarify requirements, establish acceptance criteria, sequence dependencies, and maintain a healthy, actionable backlog.
  • Work with data engineers and technical leads to size user stories, plan sprint capacity, monitor progress, identify blockers, and keep commitments aligned with available resources.
  • Build and maintain integrated project plans, roadmaps, milestones, RAID logs, RACI charts, stakeholder registers, decision logs, status reports, test plans, deployment checklists, and lessons learned.
  • Coordinate cross-functional work across data engineering, application teams, enterprise architecture, security, infrastructure, business intelligence, data governance, vendors, and business functions.
  • Manage delivery of cloud data-platform capabilities, including source ingestion, API and file-based integrations, data transformation, master data, data quality, governance, data models, and Power BI reporting.
  • Coordinate structured QA and user acceptance testing, including test planning, business tester readiness, defect triage, evidence collection, sign-off, and readiness for production deployment.
  • Ensure releases follow Forge change-management and deployment-governance requirements, with appropriate approvals, documentation, QA/UAT evidence, communications, and support transition.
  • Identify delivery risks, resource constraints, scope changes, technical dependencies, and decision points early; drive resolution and escalate when necessary.
  • Provide concise, audience-appropriate status reporting to project teams, business stakeholders, technology leadership, and executive sponsors.
  • Promote consistent use of Jira and Confluence for user stories, acceptance criteria, sprint tracking, decisions, documentation, and delivery transparency.
  • Support continuous improvement of Forge's data-delivery and PMO practices, balancing governance and accountability with practical, outcome-focused execution.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of project or program management experience delivering enterprise technology initiatives, including significant experience with data platforms, analytics, business intelligence, integration, or cloud-based systems.
  • Demonstrated experience serving as an Agile Scrum Master or Agile Project Manager for data engineering, software development, analytics, or integration teams.
  • Strong working knowledge of Scrum practices, including backlog management, user stories, acceptance criteria, estimation, sprint planning, standups, reviews, retrospectives, velocity, and impediment removal.
  • Experience managing projects involving data ingestion, ETL/ELT pipelines, APIs or web services, relational databases, data warehouses or lakehouses, master data, data quality, and reporting.
  • Experience coordinating QA, UAT, change control, deployment readiness, production releases, and transition to operational support.
  • Advanced project planning, organization, risk management, dependency management, vendor management, and stakeholder communication skills.
  • Ability to translate between business outcomes and technical delivery details and to communicate

technical information clearly to senior management.

  • Experience collaborating with distributed teams, offshore development partners, consultants, and third-party vendors.
  • Proficiency with Jira and Confluence; experience with complementary planning and reporting tools is valuable.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving environment with multiple concurrent initiatives and evolving priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience delivering initiatives on Databricks, AWS, Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, or comparable modern data and analytics platforms.
  • Experience with medallion or layered data architectures, data lakehouse patterns, semantic models, customer or audience data, master data management, and enterprise data governance.
  • Experience leading data-platform work in a public company, private-equity portfolio company, media, events, or another highly regulated and dynamic environment.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP), SAFe Scrum Master, or equivalent certification.
  • Experience supporting M&A data integration, platform consolidation, or enterprise-wide transformation programs.

Success Profile

The strongest candidate combines disciplined project management with practical Scrum leadership. They can create order from ambiguity, keep a technical team focused without adding unnecessary process, and build trust across business and technology stakeholders. They are comfortable discussing data pipelines, integrations, testing, and release dependencies, while remaining focused on business value, delivery outcomes, team health, and clear accountability.

About Emerald

At Emerald, we strive to foster a diverse and inclusive community. We actively recruit and champion candidates who bring new perspectives from varied professional backgrounds and experiences, and we are intentional about ensuring a positive hiring experience for everyone. Our job postings don’t contain experience inflation, and most don’t require college degrees. Instead, they’re crafted to focus on outcomes and transferable experiences that are assessed in a structured interview process carried out by trained hiring teams.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Target Compensation: $130,000 - $140,000 base plus Bonus

Please note that this range reflects a reasonable estimate of the target compensation for this position. This range may ultimately vary based on a candidate’s qualifications and may be higher where required by applicable law.

We offer a competitive benefits package designed to strengthen our employees’ physical and mental health, including unlimited vacation for exempt employees, flexible working locations, 401(k) plan with a company match, medical/dental/vision coverage with inclusive provisions including transgender services and fertility benefits, parental and caregiver leave, dependent, commuter and FSA benefits, professional development programs like Toastmasters, and mental wellness tools.

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. We have proudly achieved certifications as Great Place to Work and Equidad MX. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.


Medical Advisor – Bone Health (CDMX)

What you will do

Key responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Support development and execution of patient-focused medical strategies that maximize the value proposition of Amgen's therapies including annual strategic planning and goal setting, launch support and lifecycle management, in collaboration with Medical Product Lead and/or Medical TA Head, appropriate cross-functional teams and governance.

  • Lead/support relationships with external healthcare community, including interactions with opinion leaders, payers and societies for scientific exchange, where appropriate.

  • Foster Amgen‘s reputation as a science-based, innovative and patient-focused reliable partner.
  • Develop and/or contribute to execution of advocacy plans and strategies in partnership with internal stakeholders and lead relationships as appropriate.
  • Partner with/support Global Regulatory Affairs and Safety (GRAAS) in risk management/minimization activities and ensure communication of the implications to internal/external stakeholders.
  • Member and Medical representative of relevant leadership, governance and cross functional teams.
  • May develop and manage medical product budget.

  • Provide decision on IME, Donations, medical grants and sponsorships, where appropriate.
  • Utilize global infrastructure for tracking, measuring and evaluating performance and ensure continuous performance improvement.
  • Understand the expectations of key external stakeholders to support appropriate access to Amgen therapies.
  • In partnership with cross-functional team, ensure informed budget/resource trade-offs, as appropriate.
  • Facilitates Investigator Sponsored Studies through Amgen governance and manages study lifecycle (including communicating with investigators, as appropriate and ensuring accurate reporting of key milestone data)
  • Contribute to lifecycle management plan.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The vital attribute professional we seek is a type of person with these qualifications.


Basic Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in health-related discipline (MD, PharmD, RN, BSc, MSc, or equivalent) and 2 years of experience in Medical Affairs, Scientific Affairs, Medical Advisor, or a related function within the biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry Or
  • Bachelor’s degree in health-related discipline (MD, PharmD, RN, BSc, MSc, or equivalent) and 4 years of experience in Medical Affairs, Scientific Affairs, Medical Advisor, or a related function within the biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry.
  • Advanced proficiency in English and Spanish, both written and verbal.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Network of medical and clinical contacts in product/therapeutic area (Bone Health)
  • Demonstrated ability as a medical expert in a complex matrix environment
  • Pharmaceutical product development, product lifecycle and commercialization process knowledge with understanding of other functions; including, but not limited to, Clinical Operations, Commercial, Safety, Regulatory, Value & Access, and Medical Affairs.
  • Experience in regional/local medical practice and healthcare ecosystems.
  • Skilled at engagement, scientific exchange with external medical community.
  • Clinical research experience.
  • In-depth understanding of the scientific method and clinical applications based on medical, scientific and practical rationale.
  • Familiarity with concepts of clinical research and clinical trial design, including biostatistics.
  • Sound scientific and clinical judgement.
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practices (GCP), region regulations and guidelines, and applicable international regulatory requirements.
  • Familiarity of local pharmaceutical industry and legal/health system environment.
  • Skilled at effectively presenting ideas and documenting complex medical/clinical concepts in both written and oral communication.
  • History of solving problems while exhibiting superior judgment and a balanced, realistic understanding of issues.

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers competitive and comprehensive Total Rewards Plans that are aligned with local industry standards.

Apply now and make a lasting impact with the Amgen team.

The Opportunity

Help bring accurate, high-quality materials to the people who need them. As Specialist, MLR Submissions & Production Quality Assurance, you will help move materials through Medical, Legal, and Regulatory (MLR) review and into print production and distribution. Your work will make submissions easier to review and help ensure final materials match the approved content.

You will prepare submissions in Veeva RAPID, organize supporting references, and link and tag claims to source documentation. Working with marketing, medical, review teams, and agency partners, you will perform quality assurance checks in Veeva PromoMats, resolve submission and production gaps, and keep work moving with clear priorities and timely communication.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Prepare complete, accurate submission packages in Veeva RAPID so MLR reviewers have the materials and supporting documentation they need to begin review.
  • Upload and organize supporting references, link and tag claims to the relevant source passages, and confirm that reference annotations are complete and easy for reviewers to follow.
  • Check submission details, document naming, metadata, version history, and required supporting files to ensure materials meet established process requirements.
  • Partner with content owners and agencies to resolve missing references, incomplete annotations, formatting issues, and other submission gaps before review; raise unresolved issues promptly.
  • Support revisions and resubmissions, maintaining accurate claim-to-reference links and confirming that updates and supporting files belong to the correct document version.
  • Perform quality assurance checks on final materials in Veeva PromoMats, comparing production files against MLR-approved content and confirming that required changes have been incorporated.
  • Review copy, references, footnotes, required disclosures, layout, and production details. Identify discrepancies, coordinate corrections with internal teams and production partners, and confirm resolution before release.
  • Complete assigned production approval and release steps for print production and distribution, consistent with established procedures and approval authority.
  • Maintain clear submission and production status, communicate priorities and risks to deadlines early, and recommend practical improvements that reduce avoidable rework and turnaround time.

Qualifications and Key Success Factors

  • Experience supporting biopharmaceutical promotional review, MLR submissions, editorial operations, or medical and marketing production, with examples of delivering accurate work against deadlines.
  • Experience proofreading documents for print production, ensuring accuracy in spelling, grammar, punctuation, formatting, and consistency with final approved content before release to print vendors.
  • Familiarity with preparing submission packages, managing references, and linking claims to supporting source documentation. Hands-on experience with Veeva PromoMats and Veeva MedProduction is required.
  • Experience as an editor or medical editor, including proofreading, reference checking, and reviewing scientific or medical content, is required.
  • Experience with medical production, promotional print production, or final material quality assurance, including comparing production proofs against approved content, is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail, demonstrated through identifying inconsistencies in copy, annotations, document versions, and production files and following corrections through to completion.
  • Sound judgment and strong organizational skills: manage competing deadlines, make priorities visible, and ask for help or escalate issues before they put quality or delivery at risk.
  • Clear, candid communication and a collaborative approach. Take ownership of your work, ask questions when requirements are unclear, and use feedback to improve how the team works.
  • The physical and mental requirements of our roles include but are not limited to regular use of a computer, devices or other office equipment, clear communication, and occasional movement. You'll need comfort with screen work, basic hand coordination, and focus. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.

jobs.title: IAM Continuous Assurance Manager (Brazil based only)
jobs.excerpt: As a leader within the Identity & Access Management (IAM) department of the Experian Global Security Office, you will lead a team responsible for evolving the IAM assurance model from periodic assessments to a continuous, risk-based monitoring approach across critical systems.
jobs.description:
As a leader within the Identity & Access Management (IAM) department of the Experian Global Security Office, you will lead a team responsible for evolving the IAM assurance model from periodic assessments to a continuous, risk-based monitoring approach across critical systems.

You will define the IAM assurance framework and reporting approach, with a particular focus on Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) and Privileged Access Management (PAM) controls, partnering with IAM Engineering teams to automate control testing, validations, and evidence collection.

You will work closely with control owners to investigate access-related risks, coordinate remediation activities, and improve control effectiveness. You will also coordinate assurance activities with Internal Audit, Risk Management, and Compliance teams, ensuring clear accountability and the appropriate level of independence.

By leveraging data, analytics, automation, and approved AI capabilities where appropriate, you will help expand monitoring coverage, identify issues earlier, strengthen compliance, and reduce manual effort. You will lead the IAM Assurance operating model and promote effective identity governance, privileged access controls, and continuous assurance practices across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of IAM Continuous Assurance, including automated control monitoring, risk analysis, exception management, ongoing control validation, and assurance reporting.
  • Establish and continuously assess assurance controls related to IGA and PAM, ensuring identity governance, privileged access, and supporting processes operate effectively and that control deficiencies are identified and remediated.
  • Define and monitor controls related to identity lifecycle management, access requests and approvals, role-based access control, privileged access, segregation of duties, and periodic access reviews.
  • Build repeatable testing and monitoring processes using IAM, HR, IT Service Management, directory, and application data; partner with IAM Engineering to automate control testing and evidence collection through analytics, workflow tools, and approved AI capabilities where appropriate.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert in IGA and PAM assurance, including the evaluation of governance processes, technical controls, operational practices, exceptions, and control evidence.
  • Identify inappropriate or excessive access, control failures, overdue access certifications, orphan accounts, policy exceptions, privileged access risks, and other identity-related risks; perform root cause analysis and coordinate remediation through to completion.
  • Develop risk-based monitoring approaches focused on critical applications, privileged identities, high-risk access, control exceptions, and other material identity-related risks.
  • Lead and develop the IAM Assurance team by setting clear objectives, priorities, and performance expectations while building capabilities in risk, controls, assurance, and data-driven decision making.
  • Define and maintain the IAM Assurance operating model, ensuring clear accountability, appropriate independence, effective governance, and alignment with organizational frameworks.
  • Provide technical and domain leadership in IAM governance, IGA, PAM, access control, and relevant frameworks such as ISO 27001; influence policies, standards, and best practices while remaining current on IAM technologies and industry trends.
  • Partner with Internal Audit, Risk, Compliance, Technology, and business stakeholders; oversee relevant audit engagements, maintain IAM governance metrics and reporting, and support audit readiness and timely remediation efforts.

How Success Will Be Measured

  • IAM control issues are identified early, assigned to clear owners, and resolved within agreed timelines.
  • The effectiveness of IGA and PAM controls is measurable, with increasing automation of monitoring for critical and high-risk controls.
  • Access reviews are completed on time with reliable evidence and proper exception management.
  • Privileged access risks and exceptions are identified through repeatable monitoring processes and managed through defined remediation procedures.
  • Monitoring coverage extends across critical systems and high-risk access, with a continuous reduction in manual gaps.
  • Audit requests are supported by complete, consistent, and traceable evidence.
  • Leadership receives timely reporting that enables effective understanding and management of IAM risks.
  • Control improvements reduce recurring findings, unnecessary access, and avoidable exceptions.

Proven Experience and/or Knowledge In:

  • Advanced English;
  • Experience in IAM, security assurance, IT risk, audit, or a related discipline, including experience leading teams or programs. People management experience is strongly preferred.
  • Experience designing, implementing, or operating Continuous Assurance, Continuous Controls Monitoring (CCM), automated compliance monitoring, or data-driven assurance programs.
  • Strong hands-on or governance experience in Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), including joiner/mover/leaver processes, access certifications, role-based access control, privileged access, and segregation of duties.
  • Strong knowledge of Privileged Access Management (PAM), including privileged account discovery and onboarding, credential management, access approvals, privileged session controls, least privilege principles, and reducing standing privileged access.
  • Experience assessing the design and operational effectiveness of IGA and PAM controls, identifying control gaps, and translating findings into sustainable corrective actions.
  • Experience with IAM platforms such as SailPoint, Okta, CyberArk, AWS, or Microsoft Entra ID, or equivalent technologies.
  • Knowledge of security and risk management frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST, PCI DSS, and Zero Trust, with the ability to translate requirements into effective IAM controls.
  • Experience managing assurance or audit activities, with a strong understanding of accountability, independence, constructive challenge, and remediation practices.
  • Ability to analyze identity and access data to identify exceptions, trends, and control weaknesses; experience with SQL, scripting, or reporting tools is considered an advantage.

Desired Skills

  • Experience implementing, operating, or providing assurance over SailPoint and CyberArk environments is highly desirable.
  • Experience using automation, analytics, workflow tools, or RPA to improve assurance processes; familiarity with approved AI or GenAI use cases is an advantage.
  • Experience defining KRIs, KPIs, control health metrics, exception reporting, and executive IAM risk reporting is considered a plus.
  • Strong communication, project management, and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to provide constructive challenge and explain risk to diverse audiences.
  • CISSP, CISM, or other relevant cybersecurity certifications are considered an advantage.

As a Public Sector Enterprise Core Sales Engineer at Samsara, you’ll be splitting your time across two major focus areas; (1) supporting senior-level sellers in an attempt to grow existing customers, or win new customers, and (2) contributing to the SE Team as a senior resource. There is an expectation that an Enterprise SE is highly accountable for each technical sale, meaning that strong storytelling, objection handling, custom workarounds, advanced integrations, and extensive hands-on experience are requirements to win most deals. Takeaways from these activities should be shared across the SE Team via team meetings, messaging tools, etc.

Additionally, an Enterprise Core Sales Engineer is accountable for carving out time to source and deliver product information, conduct testing of alpha products/features, manage projects, and build process improvements and automation that will scale the broader SE Team. A successful Enterprise Core Sales Engineer will possess excellent time management skills and will maintain a clear focus on retiring quota in addition to these other senior responsibilities.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the West timezone. This position requires travel up to 50% of the time and proximity to an international airport is preferred.

  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focus on winning as a team.

In this role, you will:

  • Conduct product demonstrations and facilitate live proof-of-concept trials for prospective customers, and ensure these prospects understand - and are fully utilizing - the Samsara platform.
  • Work closely with Product Management, and other relevant teams, to help develop the Samsara platform.

  • Be a dynamic contributor on both Sales and SE Team internal communications channels.

  • Bachelor’s of Science degree from a 4-year accredited university
  • 5+ years of experience working with customers in a pre-sales technical role, customer success, or customer/product support capacity (Sales Engineer, Systems Engineer, Solutions Engineer, etc.)

  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences
  • Previous experience managing hardware and/or software product evaluations
  • Basic understanding of electronics and electrical systems
  • Experience with the following concepts: technical consulting, cloud software, cloud-connected hardware, computer networking, business systems integration, automation and control systems
  • Working knowledge of various integration standards and transports (XML, REST, SOAP, EDI, etc.)

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Hobbyist interest in working with things driven by electronic systems (car audio installation/classic car restoration, home automation, building things with raspberry pi, arduino, etc.)

This is the role for the person who understands the world of SecOps teams and Cyber Defence Engineers. You understand why detections fail, why logs arrive late, why queries time out at the worst possible moment, and why investigations stall. You know what's at stake when a security team can't move fast enough.

That understanding is exactly what you'll put to work here.

As a Technical Account Manager at Vega, you sit at the intersection of customer engineering, security operations, and product. You own the post-sales technical relationship for a set of our most important customers, from onboarding through adoption, through the moments that actually matter. In critical situations, you're the person customers call. You help them understand what's happening, why it matters, and what to do next.

This is a hands-on, deeply technical, high-trust role. It's not a support escalation path, it's a strategic one. You'll be our 1st TAM hire in EMEA, you'll shape how customers succeed with Vega, and you'll shape Vega's product by bringing the reality of SOC analysts, detection engineers, threat hunters and incident responders back to our R&D and product teams.

  • Own the post-sales technical and security relationship for a portfolio of customers, acting as their primary trusted advisor.
  • Lead onboarding and implementation, data indexing, detection onboarding and tuning, environment configuration, end to end.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex issues across log pipelines, cloud integrations, detections, automations and permissions.
  • Partner directly with customer security teams, cloud engineers, and security leadership during investigations and escalations.
  • Assist customers with building custom AI skills within the Vega platform to solve their pain points.

Drive real adoption, not just go-lives

  • Conduct technical health checks and lead business reviews with a bias toward action.
  • Monitor customer health proactively, identify risks early, and intervene before they become problems.
  • Help customers unlock the full value of Vega, not just check a deployment box.

Shape the product from the field

  • Translate what you see in the field, real patterns, real friction, real gaps, into product influence.
  • Be the voice of the customer in rooms where roadmap decisions actually get made.

Show up in person when it counts

  • Travel to customer sites for key engagements (~25% of the time).

Requirements

ParentSquare is rooted in the belief that when families are involved, students thrive. We’re founder-led, started in 2011 by a parent who saw firsthand how much stronger classrooms become when schools and families work together, and making that partnership possible for every family is still our mission today.

As the market leader in K-12 family engagement, we help schools reach the parents and guardians of more than 22 million students in 190+ languages through the channels families prefer, including app, text, email, and phone. Our all-in-one platform brings together communications, attendance, forms, payments, and websites to simplify how schools and families connect and take action. ParentSquare Intelligence, the AI and data layer built into ParentSquare, turns engagement and attendance data into insights that guide proactive outreach, so districts can offer families the right support at the right time. Over 42,000 schools in all 50 states use ParentSquare to build trust with families and save staff time, and it consistently ranks among the top five free apps in the U.S.

We’ve been named to the Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing private companies four years running and to Inc.’s Best Workplaces list two years in a row, and we’re just getting started. We’re committed to our customers and our people, and we’d love for you to help build what’s next.

Who we’re looking for:

Every morning, attendance teams across the country open a list of students who are missing too much school and decide which families to reach first. Nearly 1 in 4 students nationwide is chronically absent, and those missed days affect learning, district funding, and long-term student success. ParentSquare Attendance Plus gives those teams tiered attendance insights, family outreach, and intervention tracking in one place, inside the platform their district already uses. It earned Tech & Learning's Best of 2025 and is one of the fastest-growing product lines at ParentSquare.

ParentSquare is seeking a Product Marketing Manager to tell that story and help Attendance Plus reach more districts. You'll own positioning, messaging, and go-to-market for our attendance line, partnering closely with the Attendance product team, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing. You'll become our go-to expert on attendance improvement and chronic absenteeism reduction, and your work will shape both how districts understand and adopt Attendance Plus. Expect about 20% travel to conferences and customer events.

Above all, you'll bring our two permissions to play:

  • Humility. We're heads-down builders who'd rather let the work speak. You listen closely to district leaders, attendance teams and clerks, and our own field teams, and you share every win with the product, sales, and success teams who made it happen.
  • Passion for our mission. The story you tell isn't abstract. When a district adopts Attendance Plus, its team gets the tools to bring students back to class, and you care about getting that story right.

This role will include:

  • Owning positioning and messaging for Attendance Plus, pairing market and customer insight with district pain points into a value proposition that resonates from superintendents to attendance clerks.
  • Build deep expertise in the attendance market, including state attendance-based policies and funding formulas, district budget cycles, buying dynamics, and the competitive landscape.
  • Planning and running go-to-market for new Attendance Plus capabilities, matching the size of each launch to its strategic weight.
  • Defined launch goals and success metrics, then use adoption data, customer feedback, and field insights to shape what comes next.
  • Collaborating with the product team to tell the story of the Attendance Plus roadmap internally and externally.
  • Partnering with Sales Enablement to equip Sales and Customer Success with battlecards, buyer-specific messaging, ROI framing, and objection handling.
  • Running win/loss analysis and customer research, and turn findings into clear recommendations on product, positioning, and go-to-market.
  • Bringing the voice of the market into packaging, pricing, and roadmap conversations with the Attendance product team.
  • Identifying the highest-potential segments and growth opportunities, especially expansion within existing ParentSquare districts.

Our ideal candidate will have the following:

  • 3–5+ years of B2B SaaS product marketing experience, including ownership of positioning and go-to-market for a product or product line.
  • Experience launching or scaling a newer product, including expansion into existing customer accounts. You bring an entrepreneurial mindset and are comfortable building the playbook as you go.
  • Strong storytelling and writing skills, with a knack for turning complex problems and capabilities into simple, differentiated narratives.
  • Hands-on experience with win/loss analysis, customer research, or competitive intelligence, and turning insights into recommendations.
  • A track record of building alignment across product, sales, and customer success teams.
  • Genuine interest in how family engagement drives student attendance and a desire to become our internal expert on it.

Bonus points for:

  • Experience in EdTech or another mission-driven, multi-stakeholder B2B market.
  • Experience marketing to school districts, education agencies, or other public-sector buyers.
  • Familiarity with attendance, student support, MTSS, or intervention tools.

Why Join Us?

At ParentSquare, we believe in winning together and building a product that truly serves schools, educators, and families. We value transparency, collaboration, and an entrepreneurial spirit, and we look for team members who share these values. You'll have the opportunity to shape the story and growth of one of our fastest-growing products, influence a fast-growing company, and make a meaningful impact on K-12 education.

The perks of working for us are great! You'll get your foot in the door as our company continues to grow. We're big believers in work-life balance and provide:

  • An employer-matched 401K retirement savings program from day 1
