jobs.description:
Lumenci is hiring a remote Senior Sales Development Representative (SDR) to build a pipeline for iLumOS, our AI patent intelligence platform, and our IP services. You'll prospect and book opportunities with IP law firms and in-house IP teams, and help shape our outbound playbook. It's a strong fit for experienced SDRs and BDRs from legal tech or IP services.

About Lumenci

Founded in 2018, Lumenci is a full-lifecycle intellectual property platform specializing in patent litigation, expert witness testimony, and patent monetization for leading corporations and global law firms across the software, telecommunications, semiconductor, and emerging technology sectors.

A key part of our model is the integration of deep technical expertise with litigation strategy. Our teams support high-stakes disputes by developing technical narratives, performing rigorous analysis, including reverse engineering and source-code review, and partnering with world-class expert witnesses whose testimony shapes case outcomes in courts and arbitration forums worldwide. Alongside our services business, our iLumOS platform delivers expert-guided AI for patent intelligence, moving clients from portfolio analysis to action in minutes rather than months.

Today we work with more than 200 clients worldwide. We have analyzed over 100,000 patents, tested more than 1,200 products, and supported clients in raising over $200M in IP financing, with more than $3.5B tied to verdicts, settlements, and cost savings. That work is delivered by 150 consultants and more than 100 technical experts with exceptional academic backgrounds.

Three Lumenci leaders are named in the IAM Strategy 300: The World's Leading IP Strategists 2026, and Lumenci ranks #14 in Vault's 2026 Top Consulting Asia-Pacific rankings. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, we deliver end-to-end support spanning technical analysis, expert strategy, valuation, and monetization execution. We are backed by VSS Capital Partners and Century Equity Partners, and we are growing quickly.

The Opportunity

Lumenci is reshaping how it goes to market. As iLumOS grows, we need a seasoned sales development professional to open conversations with the law firms and corporate IP teams who can benefit most from it. You will be the first voice many prospects hear from Lumenci, and you will turn marketing programs into qualified meetings for our sales team.

This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role. Reporting to the SVP of Sales, you will lead outbound and inbound prospecting for iLumOS and identify opportunities for Lumenci's IP services along the way. You will turn Marketing's campaigns, content, and events into conversations, work closely with the sales team on qualified opportunities, help shape our outbound playbook, and bring what you hear from the market back to Marketing and Product.

What You'll Do

Prospecting and Outreach

  • Research, prospect, and engage IP decision-makers at law firms and in-house IP teams, including IP litigation and patent prosecution partners, chief IP counsel, IP directors, licensing leaders, and patent portfolio managers

  • Run personalized, multi-channel outreach across phone, email, LinkedIn, and events to introduce iLumOS and Lumenci's IP services

  • Build account and persona research for priority targets, including stakeholder maps and relevant triggers such as litigation activity, patent filings, and portfolio changes

  • Track and follow up on all inbound and marketing-qualified leads from HubSpot lead scoring, the website, webinars, content downloads, and events

Qualification and Pipeline

  • Run discovery conversations to understand prospects' patent workflows, challenges, and priorities

  • Qualify opportunities against criteria agreed with Marketing and Sales leadership, and book meetings and iLumOS demos for Sales

  • Create prospecting opportunities with clear context and hand them off to Sales so they can continue the conversation without starting over

  • Identify needs that fit Lumenci's services business, such as litigation support, expert witness work, damages, or monetization, and route them to the right team

  • Meet or exceed monthly and quarterly targets for qualified meetings and sourced pipeline

Campaigns and Market Feedback

  • Partner with the Director of Marketing and the SVP of Sales on targeted outreach campaigns, account-based marketing (ABM) programs, and pre-event and event follow-up for priority accounts and buyer segments

  • Use Marketing's collateral, SDR content, and messaging in outreach, and test and refine sequences and call scripts, sharing what works with Marketing and Sales

  • Support and, when needed, attend Lumenci's trade shows and industry events, including key IP events such as AIPLA, IPO, and LES, through pre-event outreach, meeting scheduling, booth coverage, and post-event follow-up

  • Capture prospect feedback and objections and share insights with Marketing, Sales, and Product

  • Help build and document Lumenci's outbound playbook as the sales development function grows

Systems and Data

  • Maintain clean, accurate, and current account, contact, activity, and campaign records in HubSpot

  • Track and report on outreach activity, conversion rates, and pipeline sourced, supporting Marketing's pipeline and ROI reporting

What You Bring

Required

  • 5+ years of B2B sales development, business development, or inside sales experience, with a track record of exceeding quota, meeting, and pipeline targets

  • 3+ years selling into the intellectual property or legal market, such as IP services, IP software, IP information and analytics, legal tech, or litigation support

  • Experience prospecting into senior professional audiences, such as law firm partners, in-house counsel, IP leaders, or technical and R&D leaders

  • Working knowledge of IP services and workflows, such as patent search and analytics, prosecution, litigation support, portfolio optimization, or licensing and monetization

  • Strong discovery and qualification skills, with the ability to understand a prospect's workflow and connect it to clear value

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical and legal concepts in simple, credible terms

  • Hands-on experience with a CRM and prospecting tools, such as HubSpot, Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Apollo, or Outreach

  • Self-motivation and discipline to manage your own pipeline and priorities in a remote environment

  • Ability to build alignment and work well with Marketing, Sales, and global, cross-functional teams across time zones

  • Ability to travel up to 25% for trade shows and industry events. Event work may involve standing for extended periods and setting up booth materials. Reasonable accommodations are available.

Preferred

  • Experience selling software, SaaS, data, or AI products, or outsourced services

  • Experience running outreach campaigns tied to IP industry events, such as AIPLA, IPO, LES, or IPBC Global

  • Familiarity with patent brokerage, licensing, or monetization

  • Experience moving from a sales development role into a closing role, or working closely with account executives through opportunity handoff

  • Experience as an early or founding member of a sales development function, including building playbooks and processes

  • Experience supporting account-based marketing programs and event-driven outreach

  • Existing relationships with IP law firms or corporate IP teams

What Success Looks Like

First 30 days: Learn iLumOS, Lumenci's services, and our ideal customer profiles. Agree with the Director of Marketing and the SVP of Sales on qualification criteria and handoff steps. Build target account lists and begin outreach.

First 60 days: Run consistent outreach across priority segments. Book qualified meetings and demos for Sales. Follow up on inbound leads and event contacts within agreed timeframes.

First 90 days: Consistently exceed agreed targets for qualified meetings and pipeline. Share a summary of messaging, objections, and segment results with Marketing and Sales. Document the first version of Lumenci's outbound playbook.

Why You Will Love Working for Lumenci

  • Be Part of a Global Team: Joining Lumenci means joining a diverse and globally distributed team. You'll collaborate with talented individuals from different backgrounds and cultures, bringing unique perspectives to every project.

  • Growth and Development Opportunities: At Lumenci, we believe in recognizing and rewarding merit. We offer opportunities for merit-based promotions, allowing you to advance your career based on your performance, contributions, and dedication. We are committed to supporting your professional growth and development, providing the resources and mentorship needed to excel in your role and take on new challenges.

Benefits & Total Rewards

  • Retirement Strategy: Lumenci provides a 401(k) program with a competitive employer-matching contribution, enabling employees to build long-term financial security.

  • Culture of Autonomy & Growth: Employees benefit from a flexible, remote-first work environment that favors autonomy and provides structured support for ongoing professional development and career advancement.

Actual base salary within this range will depend on job-related factors, including relevant experience, depth of IP industry expertise, skills, and internal equity.

In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for commission tied to qualified meetings and sourced pipeline, with on-target earnings (OTE) of up to $130,000 per year. This role is also eligible for Lumenci's benefits program, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan, and paid time off.

Duties & Responsibilities:

VIAVI Solutions is seeking a strategic and highly technical Product Line Manager (PLM) to join our Automated Mobility Solutions (AMS) business unit, specifically owning the evolution of the NITRO Mobile product portfolio.


In this role, you will drive the product strategy, roadmap, and commercial success of our next-generation Mobile Core Service Assurance solutions. You will blend deep cellular network domain expertise (4G EPC, 5G NSA, and 5G Standalone Service-Based Architecture) with robust software product management practices. This position bridges engineering, data science, marketing, and sales to deliver cloud-native observability, automated root-cause analysis (RCA), and AI-driven insights (AIOps) to global Tier-1 Communication Service Providers (CSPs).


What you'll be doing:

Portfolio Strategy & Lifecycle Management

  • Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for assigned NITRO Mobile core service assurance modules, from inception and market requirements definitions (PRDs/MRDs) to development, launch, and eventual sunset.
  • Define the multi-year portfolio roadmap, balancing tactical customer commitments with long-term strategic evolution toward automated network operations and network slicing assurance.
  • Champion cloud-native observability paradigms, ensuring NITRO Mobile platforms gracefully handle high-throughput 5G user-plane (UPF) and control-plane telemetry.

Product Architecture & Technical Definition

  • Translate complex 3GPP standards and service-based interfaces into actionable software requirements for data collection, probe ingestion, and analytics dashboards.
  • Drive integration with modern orchestration and data layers, ensuring alignment with industry automation benchmarks such as TM Forum Open APIs.
  • Collaborate with engineering and data science teams to specify and validate machine learning-driven anomaly detection, predictive health indicators, and automated service triage models.

Business & Market Success

  • Manage product line profitability (P&L optimization), pricing strategies, and packaging frameworks as the portfolio shifts toward virtualized, cloud-native subscription and SaaS delivery models.
  • Conduct market analysis to evaluate the Total Addressable Market (TAM), competitive landscapes (including independent software vendors and network equipment providers), and emerging operator pain points.
  • Support high-value pre-sales activities, delivering technical portfolio briefings, leading proof-of-concept (PoC) scopes, and responding to complex RFI/RFP requirements for major global carriers.

Pre-Requisites / Skills / Experience Requirements:


What you'll bring to the role:


  • Cellular Core Architecture: Mastery of 4G Evolved Packet Core (EPC) and 5G Standalone (5G SA) architectures, including comprehensive familiarity with network functions like AMF, SMF, UPF, NSSF, and NWDAF.

  • Protocols & Telemetry: Deep understanding of mobile core protocol stacks (HTTP/2, GTPv2, Diameter, SIP/IMS) and real-time capture infrastructure (DPI, virtual taps, eBPF telemetry).

  • Cloud & Modern Infrastructure: Working familiarity with cloud-native deployment patterns (Kubernetes, AWS/Azure telco clouds), containerized applications, and distributed high-scale data architectures (Kafka, ClickHouse).

  • Standards Compliance: Familiarity with 3GPP performance management/trace specifications and TM Forum automation/service management frameworks.

Business & Market Requirements


  • Product Management Excellence: Minimum of 8 to 10 years of experience as a technical Product Manager, PLM, or Solution Architect in the telecom OSS/BSS, monitoring, or service assurance space.

  • Commercial Acumen: Demonstrated experience managing software product pricing, constructing software subscription models, and generating business cases for major technology shifts.

  • Stakeholder Influence: Proven capability to influence across boundaries, collaborating effectively with software developers, system architects, finance, product marketing, and executive leadership.

  • Communication Skills: Exceptional ability to synthesize highly complex, low-level technical infrastructure challenges into clear value propositions for executive-level (C-suite) operator decision-makers.


If you have what it takes to push boundaries and seize opportunities, apply to join our team today.

Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

Reporting to the Executive Director, Global Commercial Development – Pancreatic Cancer, this role will lead global commercial strategy and lifecycle development for the pancreatic cancer portfolio. This job description is across numerous positions, including daraxonrasib and zoldonrasib and future pipeline candidates, supporting opportunities in first-line metastatic, locally advanced, perioperative, and adjuvant disease, as well as future indications. This leader will translate evolving clinical evidence, patient and biomarker insights, and competitive dynamics into integrated global commercial strategies, portfolio investment recommendations, and stage-appropriate launch readiness. The role requires strong cross-functional leadership and close alignment with existing asset and indication teams.

Specifically, you will be responsible for:

  • Own integrated pancreatic portfolio strategy: Lead global commercial development across therapeutic and pancreatic cancer settings; connect indication strategies to overall portfolio value.

  • Guide indication and lifecycle prioritization: Evaluate clinical and commercial opportunities, unmet need, competitive differentiation, treatment sequencing, and investment trade-offs; present clear recommendations for development and governance decisions.

  • Build treatment-setting strategies: Develop differentiated commercial hypotheses for first-line treatment, locally advanced disease, surgical/perioperative pathways, and adjuvant therapy, recognizing distinct patient journeys, customers, and evidence requirements.

  • Integrate asset and combination positioning: Partner with relevant product teams to shape complementary daraxonrasib and zoldonrasib strategies, including biomarker-defined populations, potential combination approaches, and implications of future portfolio evolution.

  • Lead patient and market forecasting: Develop global epidemiology, treatment-flow and patient-segmentation models, revenue scenarios, sensitivity analyses, and commercial value assessments across the continuum of pancreatic cancer care.

  • Shape clinical development through a commercial lens: Collaborate with Clinical Development, Medical Affairs, HEOR, and Market Access on target populations, meaningful endpoints, duration of therapy, standards of care, and evidence needed for future adoption.

  • Advance biomarker and patient-identification strategy: Work with Precision Medicine and Diagnostics on RAS/KRAS testing, KRAS G12D-defined populations, laboratory and referral workflows, accessibility, and the commercial implications of molecularly guided care.

  • Connect the multidisciplinary ecosystem: Build a unified commercial understanding of oncologists, pancreatic surgeons, gastroenterologists, radiologists, pathologists, multidisciplinary tumor boards, academic centers, and community settings, in partnership with Medical Affairs and existing engagement teams.

  • Align with cross-portfolio leaders: Coordinate with established first-line/metastatic teams, regional affiliates, and global brand teams to share insights and ensure best in class launches.

  • Prepare for future launches and expansions: Develop stage-gated global commercialization frameworks, value propositions, brand positioning, affiliate readiness, access and customer-pathway assumptions, and launch scenarios for the U.S. and global markets.

  • Track market evolution and performance: Monitor scientific milestones, competing programs, diagnostic adoption, treatment patterns, and commercial assumptions; adjust strategic plans and forecasts as evidence and investment decisions evolve.

  • Lead execution and influence: Guide cross-functional working teams, agencies, market research and analytics partners; communicate succinctly with senior leaders and governance forums and apply innovative digital and data-driven approaches.

  • Up to 40% of travel required.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree with at least 15 years, or advanced degree with at least 8 years, of progressive commercial experience in a biotechnology and/or pharmaceutical company, including strategic marketing and ideally sales.

  • Proven success developing global oncology commercial strategies across products, indications, or stages of disease and influencing complex cross-functional product teams.

  • Demonstrated ability to develop patient and revenue forecasts, interpret market and clinical insights, and evaluate strategic trade-offs that inform portfolio investment decisions.

  • Strong leadership, ability to build high-performing teams and partnerships, and ability to influence without direct authority.

  • Excellent organizational and prioritization skills and the ability to deliver high-quality strategic work under evolving timelines.

  • Strong clinical and scientific acumen; ability to translate emerging clinical evidence, trial design, and oncology treatment pathways into commercial implications.

  • Excellent executive communication, presentation, and external stakeholder engagement skills.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset, comfort with ambiguity, and commitment to improving outcomes for people with cancer.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience in pancreatic or other gastrointestinal cancers, including first-line metastatic and earlier-stage treatment settings.

  • Experience with precision oncology, KRAS/RAS-targeted medicines, molecular testing, or biomarker-defined patient populations.

  • Experience developing global commercial strategies for oncology launches, indication expansion, or lifecycle management.

  • Familiarity with oncology care pathways and patient journeys in pancreatic cancer.

  • Experience working in a rapidly growing biotechnology company and partnering with global and regional commercial organizations.

jobs.excerpt: A DAY IN THE LIFEServing as a recognized technical leader within the Major Projects Group, the Lead Controls Engineer drives design quality, consistency, and innovation across concurrent projects spanning the wind, solar, battery energy storage (BESS), and gas business unit segments focusing on Controls and Systems Integration Engineering support in development and/or project execution phases.
jobs.description:
A DAY IN THE LIFE

Serving as a recognized technical leader within the Major Projects Group, the Lead Controls Engineer drives design quality, consistency, and innovation across concurrent projects spanning the wind, solar, battery energy storage (BESS), and gas business unit segments focusing on Controls and Systems Integration Engineering support in development and/or project execution phases. The Lead Controls Engineer is the overall SCADA and Controls systems architect for large scale multi-technology projects, supports cross-department standards and initiatives, and prioritizes “We over Me” — placing collective success and team development above individual contribution. May lead a team of Senior Engineers, Engineer I/II staff, and CAD Designers, providing technical direction, mentorship, and professional development.

STEP INTO THE ROLE

  • Leads and/or is responsible to provide technical support during the controls engineering lifecycle from pre-award development through design delivery, simulation, FAT/SAT, commissioning, and closeout — with emphasis on robust design development, schedule conformance, and financial impact.
  • Owns the control and data contract between the facility energy controller and third-party power plant controllers; defines the objects, fields, units, update rates, and staleness behavior that cross the boundary in each direction.
  • Defines the sequences of operation executed by the facility energy controller — normal operation, generation shortfall, source transitions, blackstart, and emergency shed — along with the degradation behavior for each.
  • Specifies the point maps, interlocks, and constraint classes that vendors build against; prototypes integrations, tests point maps against live devices, and holds vendors to them through factory (FAT) and site (SAT) acceptance testing.
  • Translates between electrical and software disciplines — turns electrical and generation constraints into requirements software can build, and software and data constraints into terms plant vendors and Engineer of Record (EOR) teams will accept.
  • Proves the controls interface in simulation prior to energization, covering every constraint class and mode transition, and carries that work forward into automated commissioning.
  • Serves as the lead controls engineering point of contact to Owners and EOR teams on submittal milestones, review timelines, procurement deliverables, page turns, and Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) outreach.
  • Ensures designs satisfy the facility's design requirements through compliance with local, state, and national codes, Owner contracts, and company best practices. Champions a quality-first culture across the team.
  • Supports Basis of Design (BOD) development and RFI management for assigned projects across wind, solar, BESS, and gas scopes focusing on controls and systems integration.
  • Performs drawing and design reviews, including control narratives, point lists, and network architectures, to ensure designs meet industry standards, Blattner's best practices and standards, and support safe work practices in the field; performs constructability and commissionability assessments on complex projects.
  • Validates controls equipment, I/O, and network material takeoffs; coordinates with electrical, protection, and software leads to establish design schedules, resource plans, and cross-discipline coordination across the project portfolio.
  • Performs contract and subcontract reviews and provides technical recommendations; challenges vendor scope and internal assumptions with data rather than opinion. Escalates high-risk issues to leadership as appropriate.
  • Leads coordination with Integrated Supply Chain (ISC), Estimating, and Construction teams on equipment and material selection and approval; partners with program management so field teams have the plans, point maps, and parameters needed to build and commission.
  • Champions change management discipline — ensures scope changes, point list changes, and design deviations are documented, communicated through change narratives, and resolved at the appropriate level. Leads lessons learned sessions and incorporates findings into future work.
  • Mentors, trains, and onboards Senior Engineers and Engineer I/II staff through coaching, feedback, and work product review; supports managers with hiring and promotion decisions.
  • Drives consistency in designs across projects by establishing and enforcing standard control philosophies, point maps, and design details. Leads department initiatives to enhance processes and standards, and sets goals with direct reports.
  • Communicates deliberately, intentionally, and purposefully with Owners, EOR teams, vendors, software and project engineering staff, and other internal stakeholders across all phases of work.
  • Adheres to the company's cultural basics and the National Society of Professional Engineers' code of conduct. Solves problems using factual evidence and sustainable solutions that are safe, transparent, and documentable.
  • Assists with special projects and performs other duties per supervisor's discretion.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering from an ABET-accredited college required, or relevant equivalent industry experience
  • Professional Engineering (PE) license or master’s degree in engineering is preferred.
  • Eight or more years of progressive engineering and/or engineering supervisory experience in a related energy or construction industry (e.g., electrical engineering firms, utilities, or power generation development with area of expertise in the controls engineering, SCADA, and systems integration domain).
  • Demonstrated experience leading and developing engineers and driving technical standards. Microgrid, behind-the-meter, and utility-scale generation controls experience across wind, solar, BESS, or gas is strongly preferred.
  • Deep knowledge of utility-scale controls and integration equipment across wind, solar, BESS, and gas generation.
  • Working knowledge of the protocols that move data between machines and systems (MQTT, OPC UA, REST APIs), with the ability to justify selecting one over another for a given application.
  • Ability to read one-line diagrams and panel schedules and determine how protection, breakers, and sources will behave under a fault.
  • Experience designing data contracts between systems (objects, fields, units, update rates, stale-value behavior) and writing control narratives where multiple controllers must agree.
  • Fluency in both the controls and software worlds; ability to turn control requirements into something a software team can build, and to push back on designs that will not survive the field.
  • Effective communication skills (oral, written, listening, and presentation) to work with Owners, EOR firms, vendors, employees, and internal stakeholders.
  • Interpersonal skills — the ability to supervise, influence, and persuade people and groups toward common objectives.
  • Knowledge of engineering science and technology in applying principles, techniques, and equipment to the design of generation facilities; uses logic and reasoning to evaluate alternatives.
  • Excellent organizational, scheduling, and prioritization skills; ability to manage multiple concurrent projects with a drive for results and accountability across the team.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and Outlook) and Procore
  • Working knowledge, experience, or interest in AI (Artificial Intelligence).
  • Accounting skills — familiarity with math, record-keeping, and cost tracking to manage budgets.
  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information; may be required to become a qualified individual in pursuit of company contract licensing.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license and an acceptable motor vehicle driving record (MVR).
  • Up to 25% travel required, subject to fluctuations as needs dictate.

WHAT SETS YOU APART

  • Microgrid and behind-the-meter controls (grid-forming BESS, PV plant controllers, turbine and genset dispatch); DNP3, IEC 61850 GOOSE, IEC 60870-5-104, Modbus TCP; OpenAPI/JSON Schema; automated Level 4 and 5 commissioning.

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

Competitive pay

100% employer paid HDHP insurance premiums for employees

401(k) with company match

HSA and FSA options

Dental and Vision insurance

Education Assistance (Tuition Reimbursement)

Work/Life balance

Employee/Family focused culture

Gym on site

And more!

Blattner is not able to sponsor H-1B visas or permanent residency for this or any position. We are able to consider candidates who hold valid, independent work authorization (e.g., U.S. citizenship, permanent residency, or other valid, non-expired work authorization).

With more than 115 years of construction experience, Blattner has played a vital role in building America’s critical infrastructure, ranging from railroads and highways to dams and mines. Since 1997, the company has focused on renewable energy solutions and is responsible for some of the most significant solar, wind and storage projects in the U.S. Today, Blattner has installed over 20% of America’s utility-scale wind, solar and energy storage capacity. jobs.description:
Redwood Finance Automation Solution Designer, Poland

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Poland. Day rate: EUR 450 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its finance operations on Redwood Finance Automation. The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, account reconciliation, journal processing and the reporting that follows, all connected to the organisation's ERP.

You will own the solution design. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineering team can build. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real.

What you will work on

Current-state analysis of the record-to-report processes with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design across close, reconciliation, journals and intercompany, written up as the solution design. Decisions on what standard Redwood capability covers and where an extension is justified. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems. Balance sheet auto-certification rules, controls, approvals and audit trail designed into the solution, so the automated close stands up to audit. Guidance to the engineers through build, and review of what they deliver against the design. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users. A roadmap for the next waves of automation once the first processes are live.

What you bring

Solution design ownership on at least one live Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance) implementation, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. 8 or more years in finance transformation, finance systems or record-to-report process design. A working understanding of SAP FI/CO, or the Oracle equivalent, and how close and reconciliation data flows between the ERP and the automation layer. Experience running workshops with finance users and turning what they say into a design that can be built and tested. The standing to work with senior finance stakeholders and hold a design position when it is challenged.

Useful but not essential:

Hands-on build experience on Redwood, so you know what your design asks of the engineers. BlackLine, Trintech, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. A finance qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or similar). Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood implementation: the finance processes in scope, the ERP it connected to, and which design decisions were yours.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood Finance Automation people in front of the client.

jobs.excerpt: Chronos has closed new business the same way for nine years: the founder takes the calls.
jobs.description:
Chronos has closed new business the same way for nine years: the founder takes the calls. This seat changes that. You'll run discovery and proposal calls on inbound and referral leads, work from a documented playbook, and carry your own number. There is no cold prospecting in this job.

About Chronos

Chronos Agency runs retention marketing (email, SMS, and push) for direct-to-consumer ecommerce brands. We're in our ninth year and have worked with more than 600 brands. Our buyers are founders and marketing leaders in the US, UK, Australia, and Europe. We sell the same way we deliver: we find where a brand's retention setup is leaking revenue, put a number on it, and prescribe the fix.

This is our first dedicated closer seat. The discovery framework, the word-for-word scripts, and the call library the founder built are all documented and ready for you. The CEO keeps the largest and most complex deals. You take the rest, report directly to the CEO, and work daily with our sales operations lead and our marketing team.

What You'll Own
  • Execute discovery and proposal calls using our documented framework and scripts to maintain high conversion standards.
  • Maximize show rates by contacting new bookings within minutes to confirm appointments and build prospect intent.
  • Manage the end-to-end follow-up process in HubSpot, ensuring every call concludes with a clear, dated next step.
  • Drive account expansion by supporting account managers with seasonal upgrade packages and campaign tiers for existing clients.
  • Collaborate on deal scoping and pricing while providing marketing with feedback on lead quality from the front line.

What We're Looking For

  • Proven track record with 2–5+ years closing B2B deals, preferably in agency services or ecommerce SaaS.
  • Expertise in consultative selling and discovery frameworks such as SPIN or Sandler.
  • Exceptional verbal English skills with the ability to communicate effectively with global founders.
  • Availability to work within South African or similar time zones for optimal overlap with UK, US, and AU markets.
  • High coachability and commitment to following a documented playbook while implementing feedback from reviews.
  • Diligent CRM hygiene, maintaining accurate deal stages and data in HubSpot independently.
  • Familiarity with Klaviyo or retention marketing economics is highly advantageous.
How You'll Be Measured

Your job is to turn inbound and warm pipeline into new clients predictably, so closing runs on a system instead of on the founder being in the room. The scorecard is explicit from day one:

  • Targeted close rate on inbound opportunities with a formal performance review at 90 days.
  • Show rate excellence: 15-minute response time for bookings and a minimum 75% attendance rate.
  • Commitment to next steps: All calls ending with a confirmed, dated follow-up action.
  • Data integrity: Real-time accuracy of deal values and sources within HubSpot.
  • Price integrity: Consistent adherence to established pricing tiers and packaging.
Your First 90 Days
  1. Days 1–30: Onboarding & Shadowing — Master sales playbooks, scripts, and HubSpot hygiene. Shadow live calls and assume responsibility for show-rate management. Conduct initial discovery calls with CEO supervision.
  2. Days 31–60: Pipeline Ownership — Execute discovery calls independently and lead proposal sessions. Manage the full follow-up pipeline and participate in weekly performance reviews of call recordings.
  3. Days 61–90: Full Autonomy — Achieve full solo status on all warm and inbound deals. Meet close-rate targets to unlock additional lead sources and expanded quota responsibilities.

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

Your impact on our Mission:

Zocdoc’s mission is to give power to the patient. As a Revenue Enablement Lead, you’ll help our revenue teams build the product knowledge and customer insight they need to create better conversations and deliver more value to healthcare providers.

You’ll own enablement for assigned Zocdoc products and healthcare domains—from launch readiness through ongoing learning. jobs.description:
Introduction

EdgeCortix seeks to hire a talented and experienced Electronic Engineer to join our US based team and lead the design and development of our board level hardware products, including PCBAs and reference designs featuring our proprietary AI Accelerator chips.

About Edgecortix

At Edgecortix we are a deep-tech startup revolutionizing edge computing with artificial intelligence and novel high efficiency silicon on chip design. Originating from multiple years of research, our unique AI hardware & software co-design principle and the Dynamic Neural Accelerator ® AI processor IP are geared towards positively disrupting the rapidly growing artificial intelligence edge hardware space and bring the power of AI and machine learning to all kinds of devices. Our operations are headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, with offices in Singapore, Virginia, and California in the US.

Your Role and Responsibilities:

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Electronic Engineer to lead the design, development, and validation of our next-generation, high-speed PCIe-based hardware products. In this role, you will own the entire hardware development lifecycle, from initial architecture and high-speed schematic design to complex multi-layer PCB layout supervision, signal integrity analysis, hands-on lab bring-up, and transition to full production. You will collaborate closely with firmware, software, and mechanical teams to deliver robust, high-performance electronic products.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Hardware Architecture & Design: requirements specification, component selection, schematic capture, and BOM management. Lead the design and schematic capture of complex, multi-layer digital boards featuring power delivery networks (PDNs), high-speed SerDes and PCIe Gen 4/5/6 interfaces, BMCs, AI Accelerators, FPGAs, CPUs, and high-speed memory (e.g. LPDDR5x).
  • Signal & Power Integrity (SI/PI): Collaborate with simulation engineers or independently utilize tools to analyze and optimize robust data transmission (e.g. eye diagrams, crosstalk, jitter), as well as clean PDNs (accuracy, noise, drop, and thermal performance).
  • PCB Layout Supervision: Work closely with PCB layout designers and thermal mechanical engineers to guide material and stack-up selection, high-speed routing and power delivery constraints, component placement, and thermal management strategies.
  • Bring-up & Validation: Define and lead hands-on board bring-up, debugging, characterization, and validation in the lab.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with firmware and driver teams to ensure proper operation of AI acceleration workloads and integration into deployable systems.
  • Compliance & Testing: Design for and support regulatory compliance testing including EMI/EMC, safety, protocol compliance, and interoperability, as well as validation of environmental reliability requirements.
  • Reference Design Documentation: Create and assemble reference design guides, schematics documentation, layout notes, block diagrams, operational concepts, and validation procedures to enable external customers to recreate and modify our products to do chip-down design of our AI accelerator chips. Support the Marketing team to package these materials into polished, customer-ready documentation and solutions that facilitate customer adoption and accelerate design-in activities.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Experience: 5+ years of proven experience designing complex, high-density, multi-layer (12+ layers) PCBs that implemented high-speed protocols (e.g., 25G/56G/112G Ethernet, DDR4/DDR5, PCIe Gen 3+).
    Direct experience with PCIe board development is highly preferred (Gen 3/4 minimum, Gen5/6 a plus)
  • EDA Tools: High proficiency with major schematic capture and PCB layout tools such as Cadence OrCAD/Allegro, or Altium Designer. Hands-on experience (directly or indirectly) with SI/PI simulation software (e.g., Ansys HFSS/SIwave, or Cadence Sigrity).
  • Lab/Bench Skills: Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills, proficiency with high-speed digital test equipment.
  • Technical Fundamentals: Deep understanding of high-speed data transmission and with power electronics design, including multi-phase buck converters and PMICs for high-power accelerators. Experience with, and appreciation of PCB fabrication, SMT assembly, and PCBA thermal management.

Location:

U.S.-based; remote work permitted. East Coast time zone preferred, with Washington, DC/DMV-area candidates a plus.

What’s in It for You

  • The opportunity to shape the category narrative for next-generation AI infrastructure.
  • The chance to join a company at the forefront of Generative and Agentic AI at the edge.
  • The opportunity to work alongside a world-class global team across engineering, research, product, and business.
  • A critical role in scaling a high-growth deep-technology company.

Benefits and Perks

  • Competitive salary, benefits, and equity participation.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Remote-work options.

jobs.description:
Wir besetzen aktuell die Position als SAP SuccessFactors Consultant (w/m/d) für eine etablierte Boutique-HR-Beratung, die moderne HR- und IT-Kompetenz vereint, um ihre Kunden erfolgreich bei der ganzheitlichen Digitalisierung der Personalarbeit zu begleiten.

In dieser Position bist du maßgeblich dafür verantwortlich, Unternehmen bei der strategischen Umstellung auf SuccessFactors zu begleiten, bestehende SAP-Landschaften zu optimieren, gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen zukunftsweisende HR-Prozesse zu konzipieren, anspruchsvolle Abrechnungs- und Zeitwirtschaftsthemen zu lösen sowie dich je nach deinen persönlichen Stärken aktiv in die Projektleitung oder den Pre-Sales einzubringen.

Wir suchen nach einer engagierten Persönlichkeit, die tiefgehende praktische Erfahrung im Umfeld von SAP SuccessFactors (oder langjährige SAP HCM-Expertise kombiniert mit ersten SuccessFactors-Projekten) sowie sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse mitbringt.

| WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Betreue und steuere als zentraler Ansprechpartner renommierte Firmen bei der strategischen sowie technischen Umstellung auf SAP SuccessFactors.
  • Untersuche und optimiere vorhandene SAP-Systemlandschaften zur Gewährleistung einer zukunftssicheren und skalierbaren IT-Infrastruktur.
  • Konzipiere und implementiere in enger Abstimmung mit den Fachbereichen neuartige, maßgeschneiderte und hocheffiziente HR-Prozesse.
  • Gestalte ganzheitliche Konzepte und Systemarchitekturen für anspruchsvolle Aufgabenstellungen in den Bereichen Payroll und Zeitwirtschaft.
  • Führe Einführungs- und Transformationsprojekte als Projektleiter eigenverantwortlich zum erfolgreichen Go-Live.
  • Wirke aktiv am Pre-Sales-Prozess mit, indem du deine individuellen Stärken für überzeugende Kundenpräsentationen und passgenaue Lösungsdesigns einbringst.

| WHOM WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • Fundierte Praxiserfahrung in SAP SuccessFactors (Schwerpunkt Employee Central, EC Payroll, Time) oder langjährige SAP HCM-Expertise mit ersten SF-Einblicken – unabhängig davon, ob dein Background aus der Beratung, Anwendung oder dem Key-User-Umfeld stammt.
  • Tiefgehendes Fachwissen in mindestens einer der Kerndisziplinen: Entgeltabrechnung, Zeitwirtschaft, Personaladministration oder Organisationsmanagement.
  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit und Freude an der Arbeit mit Menschen, um selbst hochkomplexe Fachthemen zielgruppengerecht und verständlich zu vermitteln.
  • Neugierige Grundhaltung, souveränes Auftreten, hohe Eigenverantwortung und eine konsequente Orientierung an Kundenbedürfnissen.
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie gute Englischkenntnisse für die reibungslose Mitarbeit in internationalen Projekten.
  • Agile Denkweise gepaart mit praktischer Erfahrung im Einsatz moderner Projektmanagementmethoden.
  • Bereitschaft für sporadische Vor-Ort-Termine bei Kunden oder an Unternehmensstandorten (durchschnittlich etwa einmal pro Monat).
  • Von Vorteil sind Vorkenntnisse in angrenzenden Modulen wie SuccessFactors Compensation, Performance & Goals, Learning oder modernen E-Recruiting-Systemen (z. B. SmartRecruiters).
  • Eine gültige SAP SuccessFactors-Zertifizierung in einem der relevanten Fachbereiche ist ein deutliches Plus.

| REMOTE WORK POLICY

In dieser Rolle kannst du fully remote aus dem Office in Deutschland arbeiten. Bereitschaft zu regelmässigen Kunden- oder Team-workshops/-meetings (ca. 1 mal pro Monat) solltest du allerdings mitbringen - deine Reisekosten werden dabei natürlich übernommen.

| WHAT YOU WILL GET

  • Vergütungspaket mit einem Gehalt von bis zu 120.000 € zuzüglich Equity-Beteiligung
  • Eine moderne, konsequent auf New Work ausgerichtete Unternehmenskultur mit nahezu hierarchiefreiem Arbeiten und einem stark kooperativen Führungsstil

  • Herausragende und kontinuierliche Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten zur stetigen fachlichen sowie persönlichen Entwicklung

Wenn Du Dich hier bewirbst, dann schicken wir Dir zusätzliche Infos zum Unternehmen, zur Rolle und zum Gehalt, um Deinen Entscheidungsprozess zu unterstützen.

Wenn Du weiterhin interessiert bist, laden wir Dich zu einem ersten Gespräch ein.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Administrator
jobs.excerpt: Company DescriptionZayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society.
jobs.description:
Company Description

Zayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society. Zayo’s 141,000-mile network in North America and Europe includes extensive metro connectivity to thousands of buildings and data centers. Zayo’s communications infrastructure solutions include dark fiber, private data networks, wavelengths, Ethernet, and dedicated Internet access. Zayo serves wireless and wireline carriers, media, tech, content, finance, healthcare and other large enterprises.

Zayo Group is seeking an experienced and highly motivated System Administrator to join our Network Automation Software Engineering team. Our team develops and maintains the software platforms, microservices, and automation solutions that enable the provisioning, configuration, and management of Zayo's large-scale telecommunications network infrastructure.


In this role, you will be responsible for the availability, performance, reliability, security, and ongoing maintenance of the infrastructure and development platforms that support our network automation ecosystem. These systems are critical to both our software engineering workflows and the operational capabilities of Zayo's network.


You will administer and support a variety of platforms, including Cisco Network Services Orchestrator (NSO), GitLab, Jenkins, Docker, Docker Swarm, and other supporting development, deployment, and automation technologies. Your responsibilities will include system administration, software installation and upgrades, performance tuning, troubleshooting, capacity planning, and proactive maintenance.


The ideal candidate is a highly capable Linux system administrator who enjoys solving complex infrastructure problems, takes ownership of system reliability, and is comfortable working with both traditional Linux infrastructure and modern containerized application environments.

You will work closely with software engineers and network engineering teams to ensure our platforms are stable, performant, secure, and capable of meeting evolving business and technical requirements.


Key Responsibilities

Systems Administration & Infrastructure Management

  • Install, configure, administer, and maintain Linux-based servers and application infrastructure supporting the network automation environment.
  • Manage the availability, reliability, and performance of critical platforms, including Cisco NSO, GitLab, Jenkins, Docker, and Docker Swarm.
  • Perform routine system administration tasks, including operating system maintenance, software installations, package management, configuration changes, and system health checks.
  • Plan and execute software upgrades, patches, and platform migrations while minimizing disruption to development workflows and production operations.
  • Monitor system resource utilization, including CPU, memory, disk, network, and application performance, to identify and address potential issues.
  • Perform system tuning and configuration optimization to improve performance, stability, and resource efficiency.
  • Manage system capacity and resource allocation to support application growth and evolving infrastructure requirements.
  • Maintain accurate system documentation, configuration records, operational procedures, and troubleshooting guides.

Platform Administration & Support

  • Administer and maintain Cisco NSO environments, including software upgrades, patching, configuration management, application health monitoring, and troubleshooting.
  • Support GitLab infrastructure, including repository services, CI/CD runners, application configuration, system upgrades, and performance optimization.
  • Maintain Jenkins servers, agents, plugins, integrations, and build execution environments.
  • Administer Docker hosts and Docker Swarm clusters, including cluster health, node management, service scheduling, networking, storage, and resource allocation.
  • Manage supporting developer tooling and infrastructure services as required by the engineering team.
  • Collaborate with software engineers to troubleshoot application deployments, build failures, infrastructure dependencies, and environment-related issues.
  • Maintain consistent, reliable development, testing, staging, and production environments.

Monitoring, Troubleshooting & Reliability

  • Proactively monitor infrastructure and application health to detect and address potential problems before they impact users or network operations.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex system issues involving Linux, application services, containers, networking, storage, and system dependencies.
  • Investigate service outages, performance degradation, deployment failures, and unexpected system behavior.
  • Analyze system logs, performance metrics, and diagnostic information to identify root causes and implement lasting solutions.
  • Participate in incident response, service restoration, root cause analysis, and preventative improvement efforts.
  • Develop and maintain monitoring, alerting, and health-check capabilities to improve system visibility and reduce operational risk.
  • Identify recurring issues and implement improvements that increase platform stability, recoverability, and maintainability.
  • Establish and maintain backup, recovery, and disaster recovery procedures for critical infrastructure and application platforms.

Security, Maintenance & Lifecycle Management

  • Apply application updates and security patches in accordance with established maintenance practices.
  • Maintain secure system configurations, appropriate access controls, and service account permissions.
  • Support certificate management, secrets management, and secure communication between infrastructure components.
  • Monitor platform versions, software dependencies, and vendor support lifecycles to identify necessary upgrades or replacements.
  • Evaluate the operational impact of proposed changes and coordinate maintenance activities with affected engineering and operations teams.
  • Ensure infrastructure changes are documented, tested when appropriate, and implemented with suitable rollback procedures.
  • Assist with vulnerability remediation and compliance with organizational security policies.

Automation & Continuous Improvement

  • Develop and maintain scripts and automation tools to reduce manual administration tasks and improve operational consistency.
  • Use scripting languages such as Bash and Python to automate system maintenance, monitoring, configuration, and troubleshooting activities.
  • Identify opportunities to standardize system configurations and improve infrastructure management processes.
  • Work with software engineers to improve CI/CD infrastructure, application deployment reliability, and development environment performance.
  • Evaluate and recommend improvements to existing tools, platforms, and operational practices.
  • Contribute to capacity planning, infrastructure modernization, and lifecycle management initiatives.

Collaboration & Operational Ownership

  • Work closely with software engineers, network engineers, security teams, and infrastructure stakeholders to understand system requirements and operational priorities.
  • Serve as a primary technical resource for infrastructure and platform administration within the Network Automation team.
  • Take ownership of infrastructure issues from initial investigation through resolution and follow-up.
  • Participate in team planning, technical discussions, and Agile development activities as appropriate.
  • Communicate maintenance activities, outages, risks, and technical issues clearly to affected stakeholders.
  • Coordinate changes to critical systems to minimize operational disruption.
  • Support production incident response and scheduled maintenance activities, including occasional after-hours work when required.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Systems Administration, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Minimum of eight (8) years of professional Linux systems administration experience, supporting production servers, applications, or infrastructure platforms.
  • Strong Linux expertise is required, including proficiency with the command line, system configuration, service management, package management, networking, storage, permissions, and process troubleshooting.
  • Demonstrated experience installing, configuring, maintaining, upgrading, and troubleshooting applications running on Linux systems.
  • Experience administering Docker or similar container technologies, including container lifecycle management, networking, storage, and resource management.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD platforms and developer tooling, such as GitLab, Jenkins, or similar systems.
  • Experience diagnosing system performance issues and tuning configurations to improve reliability and efficiency.
  • Strong understanding of Linux networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls, and troubleshooting connectivity issues.
  • Experience working with system logs, monitoring tools, and performance metrics to diagnose infrastructure problems.
  • Proficiency with shell scripting, particularly Bash, for system automation and administrative tasks.
  • Experience performing software upgrades, applying patches, and managing system maintenance activities in production environments.
  • Understanding of system security principles, access controls, SSH, authentication, and operating system hardening.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to independently investigate and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, communicate effectively, and collaborate with software engineers and other technical teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience administering Cisco Network Services Orchestrator (NSO), including installation, configuration, upgrades, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
  • Experience supporting GitLab in a self-managed environment, including GitLab Runners, CI/CD execution infrastructure, backups, and upgrades.
  • Experience administering Jenkins, including controllers, agents, plugins, job execution environments, and integrations.
  • Hands-on experience managing Docker Swarm clusters, including manager and worker nodes, service deployment, overlay networking, persistent storage, and cluster troubleshooting.
  • Experience supporting distributed applications and microservices architectures.
  • Proficiency in Python for scripting and infrastructure automation.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code or configuration management tools such as Ansible or Terraform.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with centralized logging and log analysis solutions.
  • Experience with Linux performance analysis tools and techniques.
  • Knowledge of high availability, redundancy, load balancing, backup strategies, and disaster recovery.
  • Familiarity with TLS certificates, PKI, secrets management, and application security practices.
  • Experience supporting development teams and maintaining infrastructure used for software development, testing, and continuous delivery.
  • Understanding of network infrastructure, telecommunications systems, or service provider environments.
  • Familiarity with network automation technologies, including NETCONF, RESTCONF, YANG, or network device management systems.
  • Experience supporting applications that interface with APIs, databases, or external infrastructure services.

What Success Looks Like

  • Maintain high availability and reliable performance of the systems that support network automation and software development.
  • Ensure critical platforms, including Cisco NSO, GitLab, Jenkins, and Docker Swarm, are properly maintained, monitored, and kept on supported software versions.
  • Quickly identify, diagnose, and resolve infrastructure issues while minimizing disruption to engineering activities and network operations.
  • Proactively identify performance bottlenecks, capacity constraints, security risks, and emerging infrastructure problems.
  • Establish effective monitoring, maintenance, backup, and recovery practices that improve the overall reliability of our systems.
  • Reduce recurring operational issues through automation, documentation, and systematic improvements.
  • Become a trusted technical resource for engineers who depend on the infrastructure you manage.
  • Demonstrate strong ownership of system health, operational stability, and continuous improvement.

Why Join Our Team?

At Zayo, network automation plays a critical role in supporting the scale, reliability, and operational efficiency of our telecommunications infrastructure.

Our Network Automation Software Engineering team builds and operates the software systems that enable network provisioning, configuration, and service management across Zayo's network.


As a System Administrator on this team, you will be responsible for maintaining the foundational infrastructure that allows our software engineers to develop, test, deploy, and operate these critical automation capabilities.

You'll work with a diverse technology stack spanning Linux systems, Cisco NSO, GitLab, Jenkins, Docker, Docker Swarm, and modern software development infrastructure, giving you the opportunity to solve meaningful technical challenges and directly influence the reliability of our engineering platforms.


If you enjoy working hands-on with Linux systems, troubleshooting complex infrastructure problems, and keeping mission-critical platforms running smoothly, we'd love to hear from you


Estimated base salary range: $112,800 - $173,600 USD/annually.

Work Authorization Requirement: This position is not eligible for employment-based visa sponsorship. Zayo will not provide, transfer, or assume sponsorship for any employment visa or work authorization for this position now or in the future.

The base pay range shown is a guideline and reasonable estimate for this role. It takes into account the wide variety of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions. Actual compensation offered may vary from the posted range based upon geographic location, work experience, skill level, certifications, and other business and organizational needs. Additionally, this position may be eligible for certain benefits, such as health insurance, life insurance, disability retirement plans, paid time off.

Benefits, Rewards & Wellness

  • Retirement 401(k) Savings Plan

Zayo is an equal opportunity employer to all protected groups, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation as part of the employment selection process, please contact us.

Web Marketing Manager — Spring Education Group Position Summary Spring Education Group is seeking a Web Marketing Manager to own search engine optimization (SEO) execution, conversion rate optimization (CRO), technical web delivery, and directory data quality across Spring’s ecosystem of 200+ sites. Reporting to the Director of Web Product Marketing, this manager owns the day-to-day delivery and health of our websites and our testing program. You'll be the team's link to IT, keep our sites technically sound for search, decide what's worth testing, and coach a UI/UX designer who builds tests. You'll also manage two analysts. This is a hands-on role that manages and mentors a team of Analysts while partnering closely with the Content, Paid Media, Brand, and Email Lifecycle teams. Position Overview The Web Marketing Manager owns search engine optimization (SEO) execution, conversion rate optimization (CRO), technical web delivery, and directory data quality across Spring Education Group’s ecosystem of 200+ sites. This role serves as the team’s primary information technology (IT) interface, translating business needs into technical specifications and coordinating implementation with technical resources. The manager also leads SEO, experimentation, and analytics programs that translate website data into traffic and conversion gains. This is a hands-on role that manages a team of Analysts and partners closely with the Content, Paid Media, Brand, and Email Lifecycle teams. Key Responsibilities Web Project Execution and IT Coordination (about 50%)

Lead web projects from specifications through IT and developer coordination, user acceptance testing (UAT), and implementation across 200+ sites. Own technical SEO health across our sites: audits, sitemaps, site structure and making sure page changes don't hurt search performance. Serve as the team’s primary interface with IT and engineering resources. Partner with the Director, our content lead and an outside SEO consultant on SEO and AI search priorities, and help roll out their recommendations across our brands. Partner with the Content team to brief Marketing partners on keyword, topic, and page-level optimization priorities.

Experimentation and Conversion (about 30%)

Own the CRO and experimentation roadmap from end to end: establish testing priorities and strategy, then direct team execution from test design and development in Optimizely through analysis and rollout of winning variants. Partner with Paid Media and Content teams to align user journeys, calls to action (CTAs), and page experiences with conversion goals. Identify and prioritize the highest-impact funnel and behavioral insights to test, and direct Analyst efforts accordingly. Use GA4, heatmaps and session recordings to find where families drop off. Translate test results and analytics into clear, actionable recommendations for stakeholders and leadership.

Data and Analytics (about 10%)

Extract and analyze performance data from GA4, Google Search Console, Domo, and Google Business Profile (GBP) to inform content, SEO, and CRO decisions.

Team Leadership (about 10%)

Manage and mentor Analysts, overseeing website governance, SEO execution, A/B testing, directory management, and day-to-day execution.

Required Qualifications and Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 5+ years of experience in web management, conversion optimization, experimentation, web analytics. Experience running A/B tests from hypothesis through readout, with a working grasp of sample size, test duration and statistical significance. You should be able to teach test design to someone newer to it. Experience running experiments on websites with low traffic volumes is required. Hands-on analytics skills in GA4 and a business intelligence (BI) tool, such as Domo or a comparable platform. Experience working with IT or developers through specs, prioritization and UAT. Working knowledge of SEO: you've done an SEO audit, worked with an SEO team or fixed technical SEO issues. Strong organizational, project management, cross-functional communication, and collaboration skills. Strong GA4 skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with answer engine optimization (AEO) or AI search. Experience in a multi-brand or multi-location marketing environment. Basic user experience and user interface (UX/UI) literacy sufficient to brief and evaluate external design partners. Testing on lower-traffic sites.

Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day.

Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu, founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.

Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.

Role Overview

As Cresta’s first AI Growth Engineer, you'll own the systems behind how Cresta shows up on the internet. In this role, you will own the technical decisions behind cresta.com and help shape how Cresta puts its own AI agents to work for marketing use cases. You'll architect and build our web platform, create the tooling that lets marketers ship without an engineer in the loop, and develop custom AI agents on Cresta's platform. This position requires strong engineering fundamentals, high agency, and the ability to go deep in an unfamiliar domain quickly. If you are self-driven, AI-native, and eager to own something end to end, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

The web platform

jobs.title: Email & SMS Marketing Strategist
jobs.excerpt: The short version You’ll be second in command of a client pod, sitting directly beside a senior Retention Strategist and learning to do their job while you’re still doing yours.
jobs.description:
The short version
You’ll be second in command of a client pod, sitting directly beside a senior Retention Strategist and learning to do their job while you’re still doing yours.
Most agency roles at this level hand you a brief and expect you to build it. This one expects you to read the brief, understand why it exists, and tell us when it’s wrong.

Why this role exists
We run client work in pods. Each pod has a Strategist who owns the thinking, the client relationship and the revenue outcome; an Activations Specialist who owns the technical build and QA in Klaviyo; plus a designer and a copywriter.
We kept hitting the same gap. The Strategist gets pulled into execution when things get busy. The Activations Specialist can execute anything but hasn’t been trained to think about why. Neither can fully cover the other.

So we’re building the seat in between.

You’re the Strategist’s right hand. When they’re on a client call, you’re moving the pod. When they’re on leave, you hold the account. When the Activations Specialist is buried, you build. You’re the person who knows enough about both sides to keep an account running without either one of them in the room.
That’s a lot of responsibility for a junior seat. It’s also the fastest way we know to make someone a strategist.

What you’ll learn here
This is the part most job posts skip, so we’ll be specific.
You’ll learn to diagnose instead of guess. Klaviyo revenue is down 20% this month. Is that a flow problem, a deliverability problem, a list fatigue problem, or is store revenue just down and email is fine? Most people at your level can’t tell those apart. You’ll learn to, on real accounts, with a senior strategist checking your reasoning.
You’ll learn what actually moves retention revenue. Flow architecture, segmentation, offer strategy, cadence. Not formatting tweaks, not sending more email.
You’ll learn to think in leverage. On any account there are twenty things you could do. Two of them matter. Picking those two is the entire job of a strategist, and it’s a skill you build by being asked the question every week until you have an answer.
You’ll learn to own a client narrative. What happened, why it happened, what we’re doing about it. Delivered clearly enough that a client trusts you in a bad month, not just a good one.
You’ll sit in gameplan reviews, standups and client calls with senior strategists from day one. You’ll be asked for your view. You’ll be wrong sometimes and told why.
Do this well and you’re running your own pod as a full Strategist inside 12 to 18 months. That’s not a vague promise. It’s the path, and we’ve moved people down it.

What you’ll actually do
Execute at a level that never needs checking. Build flows, campaigns, segments and popups in Klaviyo. Triggers, filters, conditional splits, send windows, suppression logic, UTMs. Correct the first time.
Own QA like your name is on it. Rendering across Gmail, Apple Mail and Outlook. Live links. Dynamic content resolving properly. Exclusions actually excluding. A send with an error is worse than a late send, and you’re the last line before it goes out.
Question the brief. This is the part we mean seriously. If a flow doesn’t make sense, if a segment will overlap with something already live, if the timing will cannibalise a campaign — say it before you build, not after. Executing a bad brief perfectly is still a bad outcome, and we’d rather you push back.
Read the numbers and form a view. Pull the data, then tell us what it means. “Browse abandonment RPR dropped 30% after we changed the segment” is worth more than a clean export.
Keep production honest. ClickUp current in real time. Blockers flagged the moment you see them, not the day of the deadline. Nobody should have to chase you.
Step into either seat when the pod needs it. Cover the Strategist on a call or a weekly update. Cover the build when the Activations Specialist is stretched.

Who this is for
You’re already fast in the tools. This part isn’t negotiable.

  • 2+ years hands-on in Klaviyo for an ecommerce brand or agency. Not “familiar with.” You’ve built multi-branch flows, written nested segment logic, debugged a trigger that wasn’t firing, and know exactly where Klaviyo’s date-relative filters trip people up.
  • Working knowledge of Shopify — how the integration feeds Klaviyo, what the standard events and properties are, where the data breaks.
  • Comfortable with the wider stack (reviews, subscriptions, loyalty, SMS, popups) and able to figure out a new tool without a walkthrough.
  • You want to know why, and you ask.
  • You flag what looks wrong even when it isn’t strictly yours.
  • You can explain a decision in one sentence.
  • You manage your own timelines.

You think past the ticket.

You don’t need to be the smartest person in the room. You need to be curious, accurate, and hard to rattle. We’ll teach you the rest.
This isn’t for you if: you want a pure strategy seat and expect someone else to build. In this role you build, and the building is what earns you the strategic seat.

Setup
Fully remote, full-time. A defined portfolio of ecommerce clients, a small pod you’ll work with daily, and direct access to senior strategists and managers. You will not be left to figure it out alone.
