Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.

HR Business Consultant, Senior Manager

Role summary:
Help shape the people strategy for two of athenahealth’s largest and most dynamic organizations. This role serves as a strategic HR partner supporting senior leadership and executive leadership across Customer Success, Sales, and Marketing divisions. The HR Business Partner Senior Manager provides counsel on organizational design, talent planning, leadership effectiveness, and workforce strategy to help leaders deliver business outcomes at scale. This person will report to the HR Business Partner Consultant, Executive Director.


Team summary:
The HR Business Partner Consulting team serves as strategic HR advisors to key areas of the athenahealth business. The team partners closely with business leaders and HR center of excellence team’s to align people strategies with business priorities, helping organizations plan for growth, strengthen leadership capability, evolve team structures, and support long-term organizational health. Through a combination of business insight, talent expertise, and cross-functional partnership, the team helps leaders navigate change, improve organizational effectiveness, and create consistent, scalable people practices across athenahealth.


Essential Job Responsibilities:

  • Partner with senior leadership and executive leadership across Customer Success, Sales, and Marketing to align people strategies with business priorities and operating goals.
  • Lead talent planning activities, including succession planning, talent reviews, and development planning for critical roles and leadership pipelines.
  • Advise leaders on organizational design, team effectiveness, and workforce planning to support scale, delivery, and business performance.
  • Consult on employee relations, performance management, and organizational risk matters with sound judgment and consistency.
  • Analyze workforce data, organizational trends, and talent insights to identify priorities and recommend actions.
  • Collaborate with centers of excellence and HR partners to implement programs, processes, and solutions that support the business.
  • Guide change management planning for business initiatives that affect teams, roles, structures, or ways of working.

Additional Job Responsibilities:

  • Support annual people processes such as performance cycles, compensation planning, and promotion reviews.
  • Contribute to the development and refinement of HR practices, tools, and frameworks that improve manager effectiveness and team operations.
  • Facilitate leadership discussions focused on organizational health, decision-making effectiveness, and role clarity.
  • Identify opportunities to improve workflows and apply technology, including AI-enabled tools, to increase HR efficiency and insight generation.
  • Partner with talent acquisition on hiring strategies for leadership and specialized roles within Customer Success, Sales, and Marketing.
  • Participate in cross-functional projects that support enterprise workforce priorities and organizational initiatives.
  • Document and communicate recommendations, decisions, and action plans with clarity for stakeholders across multiple levels.

Expected Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • 10-15 years of experience in Human Resources, including progressive experience in HR business partnership or related strategic HR roles.
  • Experience supporting Customer Success, Sales, and/or Marketing divisions in a business-facing HR role.
  • Experience supporting senior leadership and executive leadership on organizational design, talent planning, succession planning, and leadership advising.
  • Experience using workforce data and people insights to inform recommendations and decisions.
  • Knowledge of core HR disciplines, including performance management, employee relations, compensation practices, and change management.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a matrixed environment and manage priorities across large, complex organizations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present clear recommendations to varied audiences.
  • Demonstrated curiosity and capability in leveraging AI tools to enhance HR effectiveness, with the ability to identify opportunities for AI application in talent and organizational work.

Expected Compensation

$126,000 - $214,000

The base salary range shown reflects the full range for this role from minimum to maximum. At athenahealth, base pay depends on multiple factors, including job-related experience, relevant knowledge and skills, how your qualifications compare to others in similar roles, and geographical market rates. Base pay is only one part of our competitive Total Rewards package - depending on role eligibility, we offer both short and long-term incentives by way of an annual discretionary bonus plan, variable compensation plan, and equity plans.

About athenahealth

Our vision:In an industry that becomes more complex by the day, we stand for simplicity. We offer IT solutions and expert services that eliminate the daily hurdles preventing healthcare providers from focusing entirely on their patients — powered by our vision to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.

Our company culture:Our talented  employees — or athenistas, as we call ourselves — spark the innovation and passion needed to accomplish our vision. We are a diverse group of dreamers and do-ers with unique knowledge, expertise, backgrounds, and perspectives. We unite as mission-driven problem-solvers with a deep desire to achieve our vision and make our time here count. Our award-winning culture is built around shared values of inclusiveness, accountability, and support.

Our DEI commitment:Our vision of accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all requires addressing the inequities that stand in the way. That's one reason we prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion in every aspect of our business, from attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce to maintaining an inclusive environment for athenistas, our partners, customers and the communities where we work and serve.

What we can do for you:

Along with health and financial benefits, athenistas enjoy perks specific to each location, including commuter support, employee assistance programs, tuition assistance, employee resource groups, and collaborative  workspaces  — some offices even welcome dogs.

We also encourage a better work-life balance for athenistas with our flexibility. While we know in-office collaboration is critical to our vision, we recognize that not all work needs to be done within an office environment, full-time. With consistent communication and digital collaboration tools, athenahealth enables employees to find a balance that feels fulfilling and productive for each individual situation.

In addition to our traditional benefits and perks, we sponsor events throughout the year, including book clubs, external speakers, and hackathons. We provide athenistas with a company culture based on learning, the support of an engaged team, and an inclusive environment where all employees are valued.

Learn more about our culture and benefits here: athenahealth.com/careers

NVIDIA needs a Senior Product Manager to lead our applied research-to-product pipeline for agent optimization. Our applied AI research engineering team invests in multiple areas related to optimizing agents for improved quality, cost efficiency, and safety. Projects include helping developers find important signals in large-scale trace datasets, crafting trustworthy custom evals for production agents, and continual learning to improve harness and model behavior. Manage fast paced research and early partner collaborations into open source tools that impact how agents are diagnosed, evaluated, and improved across the industry!


What you’ll be doing:

  • Drive the product strategy and relevant roadmaps for specific projects in your portfolio. Set priorities, quality bars, and clear product outcomes together with research & engineering teams.
  • Work directly with agent builders, observability and eval tool providers, and other partners to secure early-access engagements, make joint research & integrations successful, and turn market feedback into research directions and stronger product capabilities.
  • Partner with engineering & research to translate new findings and techniques into usable products and features.
  • Define the developer experience and product interfaces for relevant open source tools in your portfolio.
  • Partner with engineering and adjacent product teams to improve reliability, usability, documentation, benchmark coverage, and how multiple tools work together.
  • Build the adoption motion with Product Marketing, Solution Architects, and GTM teams. Identify qualified partners and workloads, guide pilots, and create repeatable adoption playbooks.
  • Establish the messaging and narrative for how our teams talk about agent optimization and continuous improvement loops. Clarify the distinct value of each product in your portfolio together with Product Marketing.
  • Define and inspect the evidence for success across research results, product results, partner outcomes, open source adoption, and publications. Own the outcomes and decide what to scale, change, stop, or incubate next.

What we need to see:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, AI/ML, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 12+ years of product management or closely related experience building technically sophisticated, zero-to-one AI or developer products.
  • A record of turning ambiguous research or emerging technical capabilities into adopted products through a partnership motion, integrations, or open source.
  • Technical fluency in agent architectures, observability, evaluation design, and automated experimentation techniques.
  • Ability to engage mature customers and ecosystem partners independently, recruit design partners, uncover real production constraints, and guide GTM teams through emerging zero-to-one projects.
  • Positive relationship with Engineering and Research teams. Ask sharp questions, convert uncertainty into decisions, and support teams without prescribing implementation.
  • An evidence-driven product approach grounded in reproducible benchmarks, explicit success criteria, and clear judgment about which claims the results support.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, portfolio-level prioritization, and the ability to align senior technical and business leaders around a clear product narrative.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience building agent infrastructure, AI observability, evaluation, optimization, or developer tooling at a frontier AI lab or high-caliber startup.
  • Direct experience designing benchmarks, eval systems, experimentation approaches, or contributing to research publications for AI products.
  • A track record with open-source communities, SDKs, platform integrations, or developer ecosystems.
  • Hands-on familiarity building production agents and successfully improving them on both quantitative and qualitative dimension.

With highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most hard-working and dedicated people on the planet working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our Product Management teams are growing fast. If you’re a creative technologist with a genuine passion for these topics, we want to hear from you.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 208,000 USD - 327,750 USD for Level 5, and 240,000 USD - 379,500 USD for Level 6.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Who We Are

To accelerate the world’s renewable energy transition and create a more sustainable, resilient energy future for everyone.

With our innovative SolBank lithium-iron phosphate battery technology and comprehensive project services, we’re not just building products we’re powering communities and making a difference worldwide.

Position Title: System Performance Analyst
Department: Engineering
Compensation: $80,000 - $120,000 + annual bonus
Reports To: BESS Data Analytics Manager
Location: USA

CS e-STORAGE a subsidiary of Canadian Solar Inc, is looking for a system performance analyst to carry out the in-depth analysis of performance data from battery storage systems. This position is at the crossroads of battery energy storage systems (BESS), engineering, and data analytics.

Responsibilities:

  • Analyze the performance of the BESS; conduct downtime analysis, identify under-performing areas and sub-systems, provide an understanding of system behavior, and direct improvements & updates to improve system availability and capacity.
  • Analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) like BESS Storage Availability, Charge/Discharge Energy, RTE, SoC and prepare reports (dashboards and presentations) to share with internal and external stakeholders.

  • Review monthly performance report form subcontractors for accuracy and prepare client facing performance report.
  • Develop tools and automation (such as scripts, Python codes) to collect and process data for directing system operation and maintenance (O&M) and monitoring BESS plant performance, such as flagging underperforming assets in real-time.
  • Perform modelling and simulations of battery degradations from aging and cycling to establish warranty terms and predict augmentation schedules, using various industry standard and customized programs.
  • Maintain and upgrade such programs to keep abreast with industry trends and emerging technologies.
  • Interface with other personnel in Engineering, Service, Project Execution teams as well as subcontractors and clients.

Required Qualifications and Skills:

  • Science or Engineering degree or equivalent.
  • Familiarity with BESS, solar energy, or power systems.
  • Fluent in Python programing, Jupyter notebook environment and SQL language.
  • Knowledge of AWS cloud would be an asset.
  • Strong computer skills and In-depth familiarity with big data analysis.
  • Problem solving ability, critical thinking, creative thinking skills.
  • Extensive knowledge of Microsoft Office programs (Word, Excel).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and an ability to write clear, concise reports.
  • Strong work ethic, positive team attitude and able to work in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

This role encompasses responsibilities such as the research, creation, and editing of protocols, investigator brochures, clinical study reports, pre-IND briefing books, and IND submissions and updates for clinical trials/research (Phase I-IV). The Contract Medical Writer is also responsible for assisting with the development of corporate practices related to document handling, establishing guidance procedures, and ensuring adherence to corporate standards for clinical writing.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIESinclude the following.

Other duties may be assigned. Employee performs all, part, and/or any combination of the duties listed below.

  1. Collaborate closely with internal and external teams, including Programming, Biostatistics, Regulatory Operations, Quality Operations and Project Management.
  2. Develop and maintain document templates tailored for clinical trials.
  3. Create and maintain writing guides specific to clinical trials.
  4. Lead the development and implementation of study protocols and any protocol amendments.
  5. Provide comprehensive medical writing support throughout the lifecycle of clinical trial studies, including regulatory submissions and various required documents.
    • Initial Investigational New Drug (IND) applications and amendments
    • Protocols and protocol amendments
    • Investigator brochures and updates
    • Interim and final clinical study reports
    • IND annual reports
  6. Ensure all clinical study documentation complies with regulatory requirements.
  7. Proactively coordinate and execute activities in accordance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  8. Manage project timelines and projections proactively.
  9. Ensure project quality through Quality Control of work.
  10. Actively engage in sponsor/project team meetings.
  11. Contribute to departmental and organizational meetings and initiatives.
  12. Maintain open communication with cross-functional groups throughout the project lifecycle and monitor project scope.
  13. Cultivate and maintain key vendor relationships when applicable.
  14. Perform other miscellaneous duties as required.
  15. Participate in corporate initiatives related to SOPs, standardization efforts, methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria for projects, programs, and personnel.

QUALIFICATIONS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

  • BS/BA in a health-related or life science-related field. Master’s degree preferred.
  • A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in medical writing is required.
  • Demonstrates extensive experience in the design, execution, and analysis of clinical studies.
  • Experience in the Contract Research Organization (CRO) industry is preferred.

SKILLS and/or ABILITIES

  • Excellent organizational skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail.
  • Familiarity with industry principles of drug safety, US and international regulatory guidelines, drug development, biostatistics, pharmacology, and clinical trial methodology.
  • Knowledge of clinical research including regulatory requirement GCP/ICH.
  • Strong interpersonal skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and computer skills.

Contractor shall be responsible for their own insurance.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by a contractor to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

While performing the duties of this job, the Contractor regularly reaches with hands and arms. The contractor periodically is required to lift and/or carry up to 10 pounds. Occasionally, contractor stoops, bends, kneels, and crouches; and pushes/pulls filled wheeled carts. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those a contractor encounters while performing the essential functions of this job.

May work in an office or home office environment where the noise level is largely controlled by the contractor. Contractor may be subject to many interruptions; pressure due to meet deadline requirements; and handling multiple tasks simultaneously while performing assigned duties.

SAFETY REQUIREMENTS

In the interest of safety, Lotus Clinical Research contractors should practice safe use of cell phones and other mobile devices while driving on Company business and/or Company time, if applicable.

jobs.excerpt: As a team member in Finance at Nationwide, a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, the opportunities are endless!
jobs.description:
As a team member in Finance at Nationwide, a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, the opportunities are endless! Let Nationwide help create your career journey! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

Position Summary

The Pricing Accountant supports the daily pricing and valuation activities that underpin accurate unit value calculations across the organization. This role offers the opportunity to build broad knowledge of the mutual fund pricing function, financial operations, systems, corporate actions, and audit support.

This is a dual-level opportunity. The position will be filled at the F or G level based on the selected candidate’s experience, capabilities, and readiness. Candidates who demonstrate strong potential but are not yet ready for the G level may be hired at the F level with a development path toward expanded responsibilities and G-level expectations.

The successful candidate will bring strong learning agility, intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, and a willingness to learn all facets of the pricing functions rather than specialize in a single area. This role is also intended to build the breadth of business knowledge, credibility, and leadership capability needed for future people leadership opportunities. As experience grows, the role may take on increasing responsibility for coordinating work, supporting team capability, reinforcing quality standards, and helping improve team processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Gather daily net asset value, dividend-per-share, and capital-gain-per-share information for nearly 8,000 mutual funds from approximately 300 mutual fund companies.
  • Use mutual fund pricing information to support approximately 930,000 unit value calculations each day the New York Stock Exchange is open.
  • Review pricing inputs and processes to help ensure the accuracy of each unit value calculation.
  • Calculate net asset values for approximately 81 fund-of-fund portfolios across three different NRS plans using the MFACT vendor package.
  • Work with the UVC system, the front-end financial operations system supporting the pricing function.
  • Assist with corporate action activities, including mutual fund name changes, mutual fund mergers, unit value calculations, and internal mapping structures.
  • Support internal and external audit requests by providing accurate information and documentation.
  • Develop working knowledge across all areas of the pricing function and contribute to process improvements and team initiatives.
  • Take ownership of assigned work, exercise sound judgment, and identify and resolve issues in a timely manner.
  • Collaborate effectively with partners across teams and positively influence and develop others without direct authority.
  • Coordinate assigned daily pricing activities and communicate priorities, coverage needs, and handoffs to help the team meet nightly deadlines
  • Provide peer coaching, process guidance, and cross-training; help teammates build working knowledge across pricing activities and systems.
  • Support consistent execution by maintaining clear process documentation and communicating updates to affected partners.
  • Partner with the manager and teammates to identify recurring issues and implement practical process improvements.
  • Build the business perspective and organizational knowledge needed to support future expanded responsibilities and leadership opportunities.

Work Schedule

Nightly pricing responsibilities typically continue until approximately 9:30 p.m. and may extend later depending on business needs. The Pricing Accountant must be willing to work a rotating schedule to provide coverage for nightly pricing processes. Certain Nationwide Holidays where the market is open will also need nightly coverage.


Required Qualifications

  • FINRA Series 6 registration. Candidates who do not currently hold the designation must obtain it within one year of their hire date.
  • Experience with Microsoft Office products, particularly Microsoft Access and Excel.
  • Knowledge of mutual funds and related pricing or valuation concepts.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Demonstrated ability to learn new systems, processes, and business concepts quickly.
  • Ability to take ownership, use sound judgment, meet deadlines, and deliver dependable results.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with mutual fund pricing, net asset value calculations, unit value calculations, financial operations, or related investment operations.
  • Experience working with financial systems, vendor applications, corporate actions, or audit requests.
  • Demonstrated interest in learning multiple areas of a function and expanding organizational knowledge.
  • Experience influencing, coaching, mentoring, or developing others without formal supervisory authority.
  • Evidence of leadership potential and a desire to pursue future people leadership opportunities.

 

Success in This Role

Success in this position means delivering accurate and timely pricing results today while continuously expanding knowledge across the pricing function. As responsibilities expand, success also includes helping the team deliver consistently through clear coordination, effective knowledge sharing, constructive peer coaching, timely escalation of quality concerns, and practical process improvements. The ideal candidate will be curious, adaptable, accountable, and collaborative, with the credibility and leadership mindset to influence others and grow into future leadership opportunities.


This position can be staffed remotely for potential applicants with critical industry skills and relevant experience.


This role does not qualify for employer sponsored work authorization. Nationwide does not participate in the STEM OPT extension program.

As a CBRE Sector Lead - Managing Director, you will lead consulting services to several high-profile groups of corporate real estate clients to support the growth and delivery of our advisory services in Workplace and Portfolio Strategy, Occupancy Planning, and Change Management.   • Supervise organizational performance and report on data collected.
  • Manage the annual account resource and workplace technology budget, provide administrative mentorship, and report on account financial health.

Persuade managers and other colleagues to take action while being guided by the organization's functional business plans. Negotiate with external partners, vendors, and customers of divergent interests to reach a common goal.

We believe in a people-first culture, where your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and your contributions truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be part of a diverse, ambitious team that celebrates creativity and collaboration.

Ready to make your mark? Join us and be part of something bigger.


Job Description

Main purpose of the role & responsibilities in the business:

At Kainos, we provide innovative and creative products designed to help Workday customers reduce risk and maximize their Workday investment. Our solutions include Workday testing, compliance, data masking, and document management. As a business with a proven record of year-on-year growth and over 500 customers we have multiple exciting opportunities for Product Owners across each of our growth products.


As a Product Owner at Kainos, you will play a key role in shaping the future of our market leading Workday solutions. You'll own the product backlog across one or more functional areas, ensuring we stay at the forefront of the industry. This means you'll gather and prioritize product and customer requirements, and work closely with our top-notch development, sales, pre-sales, marketing, and professional services teams to surpass customer satisfaction goals and maintain our leading market position.


Your passion for product management will shine through in everything you do. You will relish the challenge of solving complex problems and experience the thrill of seeing your products flourish and make a real difference. This is your chance to make a significant impact and leave your mark on our products and services during this exciting growth phase. As a result you will have ample opportunities to advance into senior roles within the Workday Products business or the wider Kainos organisation. Join us at Kainos and be part of a dynamic team that is shaping the future with innovative and impactful products.


You will be responsible for:

  • Understanding customer needs, personas and why they engage with your product.
  • Becoming an expert in the problems we solve for and “why” they matter.
  • Running structured workshops with customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Defining and building solutions to address customer needs.
  • Defining the benefits your solutions deliver and how to measure success.
  • Know your competition and how to stay ahead of them.
  • Launching products and features including organising and enabling internal teams such as delivery, pre-sales, onboarding to maximise impact etc.

    • Creating actionable user stories for development teams.

    • Identifying and measuring the success criteria for each delivered feature.
    • Defining and communicating release acceptance criteria for each product feature, including the criteria for MVP.
    • Measuring, tracking and improving non-functional aspects of the product.

  • Experience of leading and architecting Workday based solutions
  • Demonstrable experience of delivering as part of an agile team. This should include excellent user story creation skills, articulating the business needs in a format that is easily consumable by the scrum team
  • Excellent communication skills are vital. You’ll need to be a persuasive and effective communicator with strong negotiating skills. It’s not only about talking, you’ll need to be able to listen, understand, and build on other’s viewpoints.
  • You will have an enthusiasm for new technologies and innovation and be prepared to take advantage of the flexibility provided to challenge and be proactive in bringing new ideas to how we work and to the product roadmap.
  • You will need an eye for detail, particularly to interpret supplied information and understand sources and challenge where necessary.
  • Comfort and ability to engage with customers (including internal) to understand requirements, and support functional or technical product discussions.

Desirable:

  • Prior Workday implementation or management
  • Experience with Product Management in a Workday context

At Kainos, we believe in the power of diversity, equity and inclusion. We are committed to building a team that is as diverse as the world we live in, where everyone is valued, respected, and given an equal chance to thrive.   We actively seek out talented people from all backgrounds, regardless of age, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes them who they are.   We also believe every candidate deserves a level playing field.

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT GENERATIONAt Generation, we believe in the power of employment to change lives.
jobs.description:
ABOUT GENERATION

At Generation, we believe in the power of employment to change lives. We are a global nonprofit organization that supports adults to achieve economic mobility through employment. Generation trains and places adult learners of all ages into careers that are otherwise inaccessible, working in partnership with governments, employers, and other system actors. We also conduct original research and share data insights on high-priority global workforce transition topics to inform decision-making by workforce system stakeholders. Launched in 2015, Generation comprises a global hub (Generation You Employed, or GYE) and a network of in-country affiliates. To date, the network has 150,000+ graduates and 23,000+ employers across 50 professions and 17 countries.

When learners join Generation, 91% are unemployed, of which nearly half are long-term unemployed. Three months after completing our program, graduates have a 78% job placement rate, rising to 88% within six months. Of our employed graduates, 79% are hired by repeat employers who have previously hired Generation graduates, and 89% are in jobs directly related to the profession for which we have trained them. Employed graduates immediately earn an average of 3-4X their previous earnings. Two to five years after graduation, 77% of our alumni from upper-middle income countries continue to meet their daily financial needs and 63% can save for the future. To date, Generation’s global graduates have earned more than $1.9 billion in wages. Generation graduates typically have a secondary school background, 52% are female, 28% have dependents, and the majority identify with underrepresented communities in their country.

As part of the BOOST Project, Generation is expanding its network of experienced freelance professionals to support and mentor Digital Marketing graduates as they transition into freelancing and remote work opportunities. Through expert mentorship, practical guidance, and industry connections, Super Agents play a critical role in helping graduates build sustainable freelance careers, secure income-generating opportunities, and achieve greater financial independence.

JOB OBJECTIVES

Generation is seeking experienced freelance Digital Marketing professionals based in South Africa (Johannesburg preferred) to serve as Super Agents and mentors for graduates entering the freelance/gig economy.

As Super Agent, you will play a critical role in guiding, coaching, and supporting graduates as they build freelance careers, secure clients, deliver quality work, and generate sustainable income. This role combines mentoring, technical guidance, accountability coaching, freelance business development support, and practical knowledge sharing.

The ideal candidate is an experienced Digital Marketing freelancer with a successful track record of delivering client work, building freelance income streams, and supporting others to grow professionally.

Most importantly, we are looking for individuals who are passionate about helping young people build skills, confidence, and financial independence through freelancing and remote work.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Mentorship & Coaching

  • Provide ongoing one-on-one and group mentoring sessions for assigned graduates.
  • Support graduates in applying digital marketing skills in real-world client environments.
  • Guide graduates in building confidence, professionalism, and effective work habits.
  • Provide constructive feedback on portfolios, proposals, project work, and client communications.
  • Help graduates identify strengths, overcome challenges, and achieve their professional goals

Freelance Career Development

  • Share practical insights from your own freelance journey and professional experience.
  • Support graduates in understanding the freelance marketplace and how to position themselves effectively.
  • Help graduates identify opportunities for income generation through freelance and remote work.
  • Guide graduates in building sustainable freelance businesses and long-term client relationships.
  • Advise graduates on sourcing opportunities through personal networks, referrals, direct outreach, LinkedIn, and freelance platforms.

Pricing Strategy & Business Development Support

  • Guide graduates in developing competitive and sustainable pricing strategies.
  • Support graduates in packaging and positioning their services effectively.
  • Review proposals and quotations and provide recommendations for improvement.
  • Help graduates understand client discovery, negotiation, and project scoping processes.
  • Provide practical advice on managing freelance income and growing client accounts.

Profile Setup & Optimization

  • Assist graduates in creating and optimizing professional profiles on platforms such as LinkedIn, Upwork, Fiverr, Contra, and other relevant marketplaces.
  • Review graduate portfolios and recommend improvements in line with global recruitment standards.
  • Support graduates in developing compelling personal brands and professional online presence.
  • Advise graduates on improving profile visibility and attracting potential clients.

Project Support & Quality Assurance

  • Provide guidance and support to learners working on freelance and client projects.
  • Review project outputs and provide actionable feedback to improve quality.
  • Help graduates navigate client communications and project management challenges.
  • Encourage high standards of professionalism, client service, and continuous improvement.
  • Conduct regular progress reviews to monitor graduate development and success.

Knowledge Sharing & Community Building

  • Share relevant digital marketing resources, tools, templates, and best practices.
  • Present practical case studies and examples from real-world client engagements.
  • Keep graduates informed about trends and developments within the digital marketing industry.
  • Contribute ideas and recommendations to strengthen the mentoring experience and overall program outcomes.
  • Collaborate with Generation staff and other Super Agents to support learner success.

QUALIFICATIONS

Desired Experience & Qualifications

  • A minimum of 6 years of professional experience in Digital Marketing, with hands-on expertise across key disciplines including social media marketing, content marketing, Design, SEO, SEM, paid advertising, analytics, email marketing, and campaign management, etc...
  • At least 2 years of proven freelancing experience, successfully delivering digital marketing services to clients.
  • Demonstrated success in sourcing, securing, managing, and delivering freelance projects through personal networks, referrals, agencies, freelance marketplaces, or direct client acquisition.
  • Strong understanding of freelance business development, pricing strategies, proposal writing, client relationship management, and project delivery.
  • Excellent communication, coaching, facilitation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to mentor multiple learners simultaneously.
  • Ability and willingness to dedicate a minimum of 10–15 hours per week to mentoring and learner support activities.
  • Must be currently based in South Africa and open to remote ways of working.
  • Strong knowledge of the South African business environment, digital economy, and remote work ecosystem.
  • Commitment to empowering young people from diverse backgrounds to achieve economic independence through freelancing and digital work.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience mentoring, coaching, teaching, or supporting individuals in career development or entrepreneurship.
  • Experience helping freelancers secure clients and build sustainable freelance careers.
  • Certifications in Google Ads, Google Analytics, Meta Blueprint, HubSpot, LinkedIn Marketing, SEMrush, or related digital marketing specializations.
  • Experience using freelance platforms such as Upwork, Fiverr, Contra, , PeoplePerHour, or related job platforms to source gigs.
  • Experience working with international clients and remote teams.
  • Familiarity with online learning platforms, virtual collaboration tools, and community engagement approaches.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for a successful freelance Digital Marketing professional who:

  • Has built a credible and sustainable freelance career.
  • Is passionate about mentoring and developing emerging talent.
  • Enjoys sharing knowledge, practical insights, and industry experience.
  • Can motivate, inspire, and hold learners accountable while providing supportive guidance.
  • Understands the realities and challenges of freelancing and can provide practical advice to help graduates succeed.
  • Believes in the power of freelancing and remote work to create economic opportunities for young people across Africa.
  • Is committed to helping graduates build confidence, secure income-generating opportunities, and achieve long-term financial independence.

To apply, please submit:

  • An up-to-date CV/Resume.
  • A brief cover letter highlighting:
    • Your Digital Marketing experience.
    • Your freelancing experience and achievements.
    • Your experience coaching, mentoring, or developing others.
    • Why you are passionate about supporting young people pursuing freelance careers.
  • Links to your LinkedIn profile, portfolio, freelance profiles, website, or other relevant work samples.

*Generation is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion and welcomes applications from qualified candidates across South Africa who are passionate about creating opportunities for young people through digital work and freelancing.*

About Us

Sanofi focuses on developing specialty treatments for debilitating diseases that are often difficult to diagnose and treat, providing hope to patients and their families.

Sanofi has pioneered the development and delivery of transformative therapies for patients affected by rare and debilitating diseases for over 30 years. The Rare Blood Disorders franchise is a patient-centric organization responsible for delivering the highest quality education and service regarding disease and treatment. The goal of the franchise is to penetrate existing and new markets to meet business goals by educating physicians and healthcare professionals on a portfolio of products while upholding the Company's mission and values.   

About the job

The Corporate Accounts and Precision Medicine Orchestrator is a strategic, cross-functional role that partners with the Precision Medicine Executive (PME), Key Account Manager (KAM), and Corporate Account Director (CAD) field teams to “orchestrate” consistent, high-quality execution of account and precision medicine strategies. Reporting to the Vice President, Corporate Accounts and Precision Medicine, this individual will create field enablement resources, deliver KPI reporting and analysis, and serve as the operational liaison to the Go-To-Market Capabilities (GTMC) organization.

The Orchestrator will translate field and leadership needs into clear requirements for GTMC, coordinate priorities and timelines, and help ensure the PME, KAM, and CAD teams have the tools, data, and resources needed to execute account plans and diagnostic and precision medicine initiatives effectively and in full compliance with company policies.

Responsibilities

Field Enablement (PME, KAM, and CAD Teams)

· Partner with the PME, KAM, and CAD teams and their leaders to identify enablement needs and priorities across account, GPO, and diagnostic and precision medicine activities.

· Create and maintain field enablement resources, including account planning templates, playbooks, process guides, quick-reference tools, and training and onboarding materials for new team members.

· Support the rollout of new tools, processes, and approved resources, including communication, training, and adoption follow-up.

· Gather field feedback on workflows, tools, and barriers, and translate it into practical improvements.

· Identify and share best practices across the three field teams to promote aligned, consistent execution.

· Ensure enablement resources reflect approved content and follow applicable review and compliance processes.

KPI Reporting and Analysis

· Partner with the VP and team leaders to define KPIs and success measures for PME, KAM, and CAD activities.

· Develop, maintain, and distribute recurring KPI reports, dashboards, and scorecards at the team, region, and account level using GTMC reporting and analytics platforms.

· Analyze account, GPO, diagnostic testing, and field activity data to identify trends, performance gaps, and opportunities, and deliver clear insights and recommendations to leadership.

· Prepare data and analysis to support business reviews, leadership meetings, and planning cycles.

· Support account prioritization, segmentation, and target-list refinement using data and field insights.

· Promote consistent metric definitions and data accuracy, and identify and escalate data quality issues.

· Train field teams to use dashboards and reports to support account planning and pre-call planning.

GTMC Operational Liaison

· Serve as the primary operational liaison between the PME, KAM, and CAD teams and GTMC, including the IT and Operations teams that support CRM, reporting, and analytics.

· Translate field and leadership needs into clear business requirements, and submit and track requests for CRM enhancements, report changes, data access, and system issues.

· Coordinate priorities, timelines, and communication so the needs of the three field teams are represented in GTMC planning and release cycles.

· Participate in testing and validation of CRM and reporting enhancements, and communicate changes and available capabilities to the field.

· Maintain a clear intake and tracking process for field requests and issues, and provide regular status updates to field teams and leadership.

· Optimize the use of CRM and related systems to improve data accuracy and streamline field workflows.

Orchestration and Special Projects

· Coordinate operating rhythms across the PME, KAM, and CAD teams, including meeting cadences, planning calendars, and action tracking.

· Lead or support special projects and process improvements that increase efficiency, alignment, and collaboration across the three field teams.

· Partner with Marketing, Market Access, Medical, Sales Operations, and other cross-functional teams to align resources and reduce duplication of effort.

· Leverage analytics and AI tools to generate customer insights and recommendations that support resource allocation and execution.

· Operate in full compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and Sanofi policies and procedures.

About You

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 5+ years of pharmaceutical, biotech, or medical device sales experience, and/or in sales operations, commercial or sales excellence, field operations, account operations, analytics, or other relevant life science or clinical experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience developing field enablement, training, or communication resources for commercial teams.
  • Proven ability to build KPI reports and dashboards and to turn data into clear, actionable insights.
  • Hands-on experience with CRM systems (e.g., Veeva CRM) and reporting tools (e.g., Power BI), with advanced Excel skills.
  • Demonstrated success working cross-functionally and influencing without direct authority.
  • Experience in rare disease, hematology/oncology, or another specialty market.
  • Familiarity with corporate or key account management, GPO and enterprise agreements, or precision medicine and diagnostic testing.
  • Strong project management, organization, and prioritization skills to manage multiple initiatives at once.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex information for field and leadership audiences.
  • Working knowledge of compliance requirements in a pharmaceutical commercial environment.
  • Ability to travel as business needs require, including to field and team meetings.
  • Familiarity with AI and advanced analytics tools to support customer insights and resource allocation.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, curiosity, adaptability, and a customer-centric, patient-focused mindset.

Why choose us?

  • Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.
  • Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.
  • Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.

jobs.excerpt: Yugabyte is the company behind YugabyteDB, the AI-ready, multi-modal, distributed PostgreSQL database for cloud-native apps.
jobs.description:
Yugabyte is the company behind YugabyteDB, the AI-ready, multi-modal, distributed PostgreSQL database for cloud-native apps. Trusted by industry leaders including Shopify, Paramount+, GM, Kroger, Fiserv, and NPCI, YugabyteDB has been deployed in over 100 countries and powers more than 5 million clusters worldwide.

Together, our hard-working team of experts and our industry-leading technology are uniquely positioned to meet the demands of modern workloads: geo-distributed, ultra-resilient, and built to scale without limits.

Our Yugabeings (distributed, like our database) span 12+ countries and multiple time zones, sharing expertise from diverse backgrounds and industries.

Developer Advocate, Community

Location: Remote US

About the role

Yugabyte has redefined the data infrastructure developers use for distributed Postgres applications and multi-agent AI systems. As a Developer Advocate focused on Yugabyte’s rapidly growing community, you will energize the developers building with YugabyteDB, YugabyteDB AMP (Agentic Multitenant Postgres), and Meko, our agent-native data platform that gives multi-agent systems shared memory and knowledge.

You will own community programs end-to-end, including workshops, meetups, hackathons, partner events, and the online spaces where developers ask questions, share what they built, and help each other. Success in this role means more developers showing up, building something real, and coming back. You will work closely with product, engineering, marketing, and the rest of the DevRel team, and you will bring what you hear from the community into the roadmap. Most importantly, you will collaborate with the rest of our Developer Advocacy team to present a unified, global approach to how we work with devs. This is a fun role on a fun team at the most important (and fun) time in our company’s history. Should be fun!

What you’ll do

Grow the community

  • Build and run a community growth plan across YugabyteDB, YugabyteDB AMP, and Meko, with goals for membership, active participation, and contribution.
  • Run and grow the Yugabyte community Slack and Discord, and build an active presence in the channels where developers already gather, including Reddit, GitHub, Stack Overflow, LinkedIn, Bluesky, and X.
  • Launch programs that recognize and reward participation, such as a community champions program, contributor spotlights, and regular office hours.
  • Turn active community members into speakers, authors, sample app contributors, and meetup hosts.

Run hands-on events

  • Design and deliver workshops that take developers from first install to a working app, including labs on building agent memory with Meko and multi-tenant Postgres applications on YugabyteDB AMP.
  • Launch and scale Yugabyte-run meetups in key developer hubs, and support community-led chapters with playbooks, content, and swag.
  • Organize virtual and in-person hackathons, including AI agent hackathons built on Meko and YugabyteDB.
  • Represent Yugabyte at developer conferences such as KubeCon, PGConf.dev, Linux Foundation events, and AI engineering conferences, running demos, workshops, and booth sessions.
  • Contribute community programming to Yugabyte’s Distributed SQL Summit, such as hands-on labs, community tracks, and DevRel sessions.

Build with partners

  • Co-host workshops, meetups, and hackathons with cloud, AI framework, and open source ecosystem partners.
  • Create sample apps, integrations, and tutorials that show YugabyteDB, AMP, and Meko working alongside the agent frameworks, developer tools, and cloud platforms developers already use.
  • Build relationships with user groups and open source projects in the Postgres, Kubernetes, and AI agent communities.

Create content the community uses

  • Produce demos, tutorials, sample apps, blogs, livestreams, and webinars, both live and recorded.
  • Package workshops into reusable kits and starter templates that community leaders and partners can run on their own.
  • Hold developer-facing content, quickstarts, and getting-started paths to a high bar for clarity and accuracy.

Be the voice of the developer

  • Collect feedback from community channels, events, and hackathons, and bring it to product and engineering in a form they can act on.
  • Track and report community health, including growth, engagement, event attendance, and conversion to active usage.
  • Help shape the DevRel strategy, processes, and tooling, including community platforms and event tech stack.

What you bring

  • 5+ years in developer relations, developer advocacy, or developer community management, including programs you built from the ground up.
  • A track record of growing an online developer community on Slack, Discord, or a similar platform.
  • Experience planning and running in-person events such as meetups, workshops, or hackathons.
  • Hands-on technical skills, including building demos and sample apps and working comfortably with SQL and Postgres.
  • Familiarity with, and creative ideas for AI agent development, LLM frameworks, vector search, or a demonstrated ability to get up to speed fast.
  • Experience in open source communities as a contributor, maintainer, or community organizer.
  • Confidence presenting and facilitating, both live and on camera.
  • An active social presence and following in a relevant developer community.
  • Comfort working autonomously in a fast-moving startup. B2B SaaS or infrastructure experience is a plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have

  • Experience with distributed databases, Kubernetes, or cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience running ambassador or champion programs.
  • Experience running co-marketing or joint events with technology partners.

Success in year one, in conjunction with our DevRel team

  • Community membership across Slack and other channels grows to 10X
  • Dozens of workshops, hackathons, and meetups delivered
  • At least a dozen hackathons run, focused on AI agents built with Meko.
  • Ten partner co-hosted events delivered.
  • A champions program launched with 50+ active members.

We feel strongly about equal pay for equal work, and transparency in compensation is one way to help achieve that. The cash compensation for this role is market competitive, with a range of $160,000-$215,000, as well as equity (when applicable), and benefits including health plans, retirement plans, and unlimited paid time off (PTO). The pay range for this position is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. The actual pay will vary based on factors including experience, qualifications, and skill level.

jobs.description:
About Kasa

Kasa is the leading tech-enabled hotel and apartment hotel brand and manager. We partner with owners of multifamily and boutique hospitality properties to deliver stylish, professionally managed accommodations to business and leisure travelers alike. We took the best that hotels and short-term rentals had to offer and created a new class of hospitality that is well-priced, reliable, and offers a large selection of great locations.

Unlike traditional hotel operators, we prioritize automation, AI-driven pricing, and data-driven decision-making to optimize revenue and improve guest experiences. Behind the scenes, we build technology that combines with our innovative operations to grow a globally scalable offering that delivers high-quality stays to guests. Our guests enjoy seamless check-ins, caring service, and attractive amenities — and if anything comes up, our on-site and remote guest experience team is available throughout their stay, ensuring our hospitality is rarely seen but always felt.

Role Overview

Kasa is seeking a People Program Manager to own a defined and evolving slate of People programs, including but not limited to performance scorecards, manager training and enablement, career tracks, the annual performance cycle, and engagement measurement. This role translates strategic organizational priorities into practical, well-run programs.

This role sits within Kasa’s People team and reports to the Director of People & Performance. It’s an individual contributor, program-ownership role: hands-on, analytically strong, and comfortable building repeatable systems end to end. This People Program Manager will work closely with our Senior People Business Partner, and the two roles are intended to work in close partnership with clear swim lanes. The priorities of this role are to:

  • Build programs that run without being chased. Own the systems behind how we evaluate, develop, and grow people, and use AI and automation to keep them repeatable and scalable.
  • Equip managers to lead well. Give our people managers the tools and training to coach their teams, give useful feedback, and grow talent.
  • Give leaders a clear view of team health. Turn People data into insights and recommendations that help us spot trends and retention risks early and act on them.

Key Responsibilities & Deliverables

Performance Scorecards & Manager Enablement

  • Build performance scorecards that give managers ongoing visibility into team health and impact
  • Design and run manager training and enablement programs that help managers set clear expectations, coach their teams, and grow as leaders
  • Build manager capability through training, resources, and job aids on the performance process

Career Tracks

  • Own the career tracks framework end-to-end, including leveling, competencies, and progression criteria across functions
  • Partner with functional leaders to define what good looks like at each level and keep tracks current as roles and the org evolve
  • Make progression transparent for employees through clear criteria, examples, and self-assessment tools so people know what's next and how to get there
  • Connect career tracks to performance, promotion, and compensation decisions so leveling stays consistent and defensible

Performance Review Cycle

  • Own the annual performance cycle end-to-end, including timeline, communications, calibration, and tooling
  • In partnership with key members of the People team, design the review process itself, including rating scales, self and peer input, and how performance connects to promotion and compensation decisions
  • Equip managers and employees with clear guidance, resources, and job aids so the process feels useful rather than administrative
  • Measure how the cycle lands through completion rates, quality of feedback, and manager and employee sentiment, then improve it each year

Engagement Measurement

  • Own our engagement measurement approach, including the engagement dashboard, as an early-detection system for retention risk
  • Turn engagement data into clear, actionable recommendations for leaders

Data Analysis & Reporting

  • Use People data and analytics to identify trends, track key metrics, and make data-driven recommendations
  • Translate quantitative and qualitative insights into concrete actions that improve the employee experience and business outcomes

Automations

  • Use AI tools to scale People programs, drafting and iterating on manager coaching materials and documentation templates that would otherwise take hours to produce manually
  • Build reusable, AI-assisted workflows for repetitive tasks so processes scale without added headcount. Examples include candidate tracking, employee onboarding, and benefits management

Success Metrics

More precise targets will be set with the Director, People & Performance in your first 90 days.

ThemeGeneral MetricsPerformance Scorecards & Manager Enablement

• 100% of managers and individual contributors using scorecards on a monthly or quarterly basis

• Higher team member satisfaction scores for training and enablement programs

Career Tracks• Career tracks established and routinely referenced for all job familiesPerformance Review Cycle• Our performance review process is fair, efficient, and useful in helping our team members grow and stay engagedEngagement Measurement• Engagement dashboard live and routinely used to understand engagement and retention risks across rolesRetention• Reduction in voluntary attrition (trailing 12mos), driven by manager training, career tracks, and engagement insightsData Analysis & Reporting• People data report (monthly or quarterly) delivered on scheduleAutomations• Measurable hours saved each month through reusable, AI-assisted workflows

Qualifications

Skills, Experience, & Expertise

  • Bilingual in English and Spanish
  • 3-5 years of HR generalist and/or program management experience, with a track record of owning programs end-to-end
  • Experience building performance/engagement scorecards or People Analytics dashboards, and comfort partnering with Programs and Data teams
  • Experience in a high-growth, distributed, or tech-enabled environment is a strong plus
  • Experience with core People systems: HRIS, performance management platform, and engagement survey tools, and comfort working across multiple People tech tools.

How You Work

  • You're a reliable and highly accountable owner, and you know how to take a program from a concept to a repeatable system, without needing to be chased
  • You communicate with clarity and empathy, whether you're training a room of managers or writing a policy document
  • You build systems and processes that outlast your involvement: repeatable, documented, and scalable
  • You're deeply curious about the employee experience and proactive about improving it
  • You flex easily across program work and generalist support as priorities shift
  • You see AI as leverage, not a threat to the human side of the job, and you use it to move faster on repeatable work so you have more time for the judgment calls and conversations that need a person
  • You have genuine interest in modernizing traditionally manual People workflows, consistent with Kasa's broader operating philosophy

Why This Role Is Different

You will have real ownership over the programs that give Kasa's leaders visibility into team health and the tools to lead well - performance scorecards, manager training, engagement measurement, and more. You will build and measure the infrastructure our People team has been wanting to invest in, with real autonomy over how you run it and a team that values your perspective.

Curious about the Kasa experience? Save when you book on !

Benefits

  • Remote Work: With flexibility as a core value, and over three-quarters of the team working remotely, Kasa employees can work from anywhere, including our Kasa’s across the country!
  • Kasa Travel Credit: We love to travel! Kasa employees get an allowance of free stays with us in any of our locations, plus a discount on any night for friends and family.
  • The Pay: The starting base pay range for this role is between $76,000 and $85,000 and is set based on multiple considerations, including business needs, market demands, talent availability, experience, and unique skills and attributes. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified. This role may also be eligible for equity, bonus, perks, benefits, and Kasa Travel Credits.
  • Generous Stock Option Plan: At Kasa, our compensation philosophy is to offer a total compensation package that over-indexes on equity to encourage our team to think like owners (by being owners) and benefit from the value growth that our collective hard work creates.
  • Flexible PTO: Full-time exempt Kasa employees are encouraged to take time off as they need and see fit, ensuring that it’s not disruptive to their work.
  • 401(k) Plan: As you invest in yourself and your future, Kasa invests in you too.
  • Health Coverage: We’ve invested in comprehensive health insurance options to help when you need it most.
  • Other Perks: Qualifying full-time roles are eligible for a wi-fi stipend, cell-phone reimbursement, home office stipend, and more!

jobs.description:
Als Digital Sales Engineer (m/w/d) bist Du im Homeoffice für die Betreuung und den Ausbau eines definierten Vertriebsgebiets verantwortlich. Mit Hilfe digitaler Vertriebswerkzeuge identifizierst Du neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten, gewinnst Neukunden und pflegst langfristige Beziehungen zu Bestandskunden. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit europäischen Vertriebsteams setzt Du gezielte Kampagnen um, präsentierst innovative Lösungen und überzeugst Kunden von deren Mehrwert. Dabei zeichnen Dich Deine ausgeprägte Hunter-Mentalität, Deine Kommunikationsstärke sowie Dein Interesse an Technologie und Vertrieb aus. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

In dieser Rolle bist Du für folgende Aufgaben verantwortlich:

  • Du bist verantwortlich für die Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Vertriebsstrategien, um nachhaltiges Umsatzwachstum in Deinem Vertriebsgebiet zu erzielen.

  • Du identifizierst und gewinnst neue Kunden durch den gezielten Einsatz digitaler Vertriebskanäle und baust langfristige Geschäftsbeziehungen auf.

  • Du betreust bestehende Kunden, erkennst deren Anforderungen frühzeitig und entwickelst passgenaue Lösungen zur Ausschöpfung weiterer Geschäftspotenziale.

  • Du planst und führst Vertriebs- und Marketingkampagnen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit europäischen Vertriebsteams durch, um die Marktpräsenz auszubauen.

  • Du setzt Dein technisches und kommerzielles Verständnis ein, um Kunden kompetent zu Produkten, Anwendungen und Lösungen zu beraten.

  • Du analysierst Vertriebskennzahlen, Marktpotenziale und Kundenbedarfe, um neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren und den Vertriebserfolg nachhaltig zu steigern.

Dein Profil:

Du erkennst Chancen und Entwicklungen frühzeitig und setzt diese gezielt ein, um nachhaltige Verbesserungen zu erzielen. Bei deiner Arbeit orientierst du dich an den Anforderungen des Unternehmens sowie an den Bedürfnissen der verschiedenen Interessengruppen. Du kommunizierst klar, strukturiert und zielgerichtet und schaffst es, andere für gemeinsame Ziele zu begeistern. Durch deine offene und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise förderst du die Zusammenarbeit im Team und bringst unterschiedliche Perspektiven erfolgreich zusammen. Du handelst verantwortungsbewusst, denkst vorausschauend und leistest einen wertvollen Beitrag zur Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen, Strukturen und Beziehungen.

Für diese Rolle benötigst Du:

  • Technische Ausbildung oder Studium mit technischem Hintergrund erforderlich.

  • Mindestens drei Jahre nachweisbare Vertriebserfahrung.

  • Interesse an der Neukundenakquise sowie der Identifikation und Entwicklung neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten.

  • Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung sowie die Fähigkeit, nachhaltige Kundenbeziehungen aufzubauen und zu pflegen.

  • Strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise sowie ein hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative.

  • Erfahrung in einem technischen oder technologiegetriebenen Umfeld.

  • Sehr gute Englisch-, Französisch- und Deutschkenntnisse.

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen, die dich auszeichnen:

  • Hohe Resilienz und die Fähigkeit, auch in herausfordernden Situationen professionell und zielorientiert zu agieren.

  • Lernbereitschaft, Anpassungsfähigkeit und Interesse an neuen Technologien und Vertriebsansätzen.

Unsere Kultur & unser Versprechen an dich:

Bei Emerson legen wir Wert auf einen Arbeitsplatz, an dem jede/r Mitarbeiter/in geschätzt und respektiert wird und an dem er/sie sich weiterentwickeln kann. Wir fördern ein Umfeld, das Innovation, Zusammenarbeit und unterschiedliche Perspektiven begünstigt - denn wir wissen, dass großartige Ideen von großartigen Teams kommen. Unser Engagement für eine kontinuierliche Karriereentwicklung und die Förderung einer integrativen Kultur stellt sicher, dass Du die Unterstützung erhältst, die Du benötigst, um erfolgreich zu sein. Ob durch Mentoring, Schulungen oder Führungsmöglichkeiten - wir investieren in Deinen Erfolg, damit Du einen nachhaltigen Beitrag leisten kannst. Wir sind davon überzeugt, dass vielfältige Teams, die zusammenarbeiten, der Schlüssel zum Wachstum und zur Erreichung von Geschäftsergebnissen sind.

Wir wissen, wie wichtig das Wohlbefinden unserer Mitarbeiter/innen ist. Wir legen Wert auf Zusammenarbeit und Teamwork und sorgen dafür, dass sich unsere Mitarbeiter/innen in allen Bereichen des Lebens unterstützt fühlen. Als Arbeitgeber glauben wir daran, dass man gemeinsam durchs Leben gehen kann - wir feiern die schönen Momente und geben Kraft in schwierigen Zeiten. Wir sind da, um die Meilensteine des Lebens mit finanzieller Unterstützung zu begleiten - sei es die Aufnahme eines neuen Familienmitglieds, eine Weiterbildung oder eine Heirat - und um eine helfende Hand zu reichen, wenn es schwierig wird, durch zusätzlichen Urlaub, Versicherungsschutz und aufmerksame Gesten. Unsere Leistungen gehen über das Wesentliche hinaus – wir bieten Lohnfortzahlung im Krankheitsfall, Fahrradleasing und psychologische Unterstützung durch unser Employee Assistance Program, das durch lokale Mental Health First Aider ergänzt wird. Um unser Team bei Kräften zu halten, bieten wir außerdem eine hauseigene Kantine, frisches Obst und eine Auswahl an kostenlosen Getränken.

jobs.description:
Company Overview

Our client is a marketing team that works inside businesses with many locations, such as senior living communities, med spas, dental and healthcare groups, cannabis retailers, and schools. Its clients are in the US and Canada, and they pay a flat fee instead of a percentage of ad spend.

The company runs on Claude and has built its own operating system and client portal. AI agents do most of the production, so a small team can run a lot of client work.

Your Role

As Account Director, you're the final decision-maker on 6 to 10 client accounts, across paid media, websites, CRM, and creative. Agents and teammates bring you options, and you pick one, approve it, or send it back with the exact fix.

You report to the CEO and work as a peer to the founders. You'll start by taking over the approval queue on every active account. By day 90, delivery runs without the CEO in the loop, and you've built the tool or process that lets the team take on 5 more accounts with the same people.

Part of the job is building. You'll release features to the internal platform by directing Claude Code: you write the spec, test it on staging, and merge it. You don't need to be an engineer, but you do need to know exactly what you want and check that you got it.

This isn't an account manager role. If you've mostly passed the calls on spend, creative, or pricing to someone else, or you'd rather delegate to a team of specialists, it probably isn't the right fit.

You'll

  • Run the client relationship with owners, executive directors, and sales teams

  • Approve Google Ads and Meta builds before launch

  • Adjust budgets and bids, and cut the search terms that bring no leads

  • Own conversion tracking across GTM, GA4, and offline imports from the CRM

  • Direct WordPress rebuilds, then own go-live, redirects, and Search Console

  • Connect CRMs, call tracking, and forms so each lead can be followed to the sale

  • Approve client pricing changes, promotions, and policy pages

  • Sign off on weekly and monthly client reports before they go out

You Bring

  • 7+ years running marketing or growth for clients or at an agency

  • Final say on a client's ad spend, creative, or pricing, and you can name the decision

  • Google Ads and Meta campaigns you built and managed yourself

  • Daily work with Claude or a similar tool, and something real you released through it, like a site, an ad build, an automation, or code

  • The habit of checking AI output before it goes live

  • Comfort with tag managers, CRMs, DNS, and webhooks

  • Near-native English, and confidence saying no to a client on a call

  • The drive to grow with the company as it takes on more accounts

Bonus Points

  • Marketing work in senior living, med spas, dental, healthcare, cannabis retail, or education

  • Experience with industry CRMs such as ALIS, Pagoda, or Dutchie

  • Advertiser verification, A2P 10DLC registration, or HIPAA and cannabis ad rules handled yourself

  • WordPress beyond the editor, like themes, plugins, or a staging-to-production deploy

  • SQL, GitHub pull requests, or Supabase

What's Offered

  • Fully remote, full-time contractor role from LATAM

  • Working hours on US business hours

  • Paid in USD as a contractor. Share the range that fits your level and we'll go from there

  • Unlimited PTO, used responsibly, and you choose which holidays to take

  • A direct line to the CEO, with the founders as your peers

  • Room to grow as the company takes on more accounts

Interview Process

1️⃣ First Call: A 30-minute conversation with atomic✳HR
2️⃣ CEO Interview: The accounts you've run and the decisions that were yours
3️⃣ Co-founder Interview: How you'd work as a peer, and the final decision
4️⃣ Work Test: Possibly a short exercise, and you'll know how it's judged first
