jobs.excerpt: Présentation de l’organisation Fondée en 1952, la Fondation des maladies du cœur et de l’AVC du Canada (Cœur + AVC) est un organisme de bienfaisance canadien voué à la prévention des maladies du cœur et de l’AVC, à la sauvegarde de vies et à l’amélioration du rétablissement des personnes touchées par ces maladies.
jobs.description:
Présentation de l’organisation

Fondée en 1952, la Fondation des maladies du cœur et de l’AVC du Canada (Cœur + AVC) est un organisme de bienfaisance canadien voué à la prévention des maladies du cœur et de l’AVC, à la sauvegarde de vies et à l’amélioration du rétablissement des personnes touchées par ces maladies. Par le financement de la recherche, la sensibilisation du public, la défense des intérêts et le développement de partenariats, l’organisme contribue à faire progresser la santé cardiovasculaire et cérébrale et à améliorer la santé de la population canadienne.

Cœur + AVC soutient la recherche scientifique et l’innovation médicale afin de faire avancer la prévention, le diagnostic, le traitement et le rétablissement des personnes atteintes de maladies du cœur ou ayant subi un AVC. L’organisme travaille également à sensibiliser la population aux facteurs de risque, à encourager l’adoption de saines habitudes de vie, à améliorer l’accès à des soins rapides et efficaces et à promouvoir des politiques publiques favorables à la santé. Pour réaliser sa mission, il mobilise des chercheurs, des professionnels de la santé, des décideurs publics, des organismes communautaires, des bénévoles, des donateurs et des personnes ayant une expérience vécue de ces maladies.

Présent à l’échelle nationale et engagé depuis plus de 70 ans dans le soutien à la recherche médicale, Cœur + AVC a contribué à d’importantes avancées dans la prévention et le traitement des maladies cardiovasculaires et de l’AVC. Depuis sa création, l’organisme a investi plus de 1,7 milliard de dollars dans la recherche sur les maladies du cœur et l’AVC, grâce à la générosité de ses donateurs et à la mobilisation des communautés partout au Canada.

Cœur + AVC se distingue par :

  • Plus de 70 ans d’expérience consacrés à l’avancement de la santé cardiovasculaire et cérébrale par la recherche, l’éducation, la défense des intérêts et la sensibilisation du public.

  • Des investissements majeurs dans la recherche médicale qui favorisent les découvertes scientifiques et contribuent à améliorer la prévention, le diagnostic, le traitement et le rétablissement des personnes touchées par les maladies du cœur et l’AVC.

  • Une mission d’envergure nationale visant à réduire les répercussions des maladies cardiovasculaires et de l’AVC et à améliorer la santé de la population canadienne.

  • Un vaste réseau de chercheurs, de professionnels de la santé, de partenaires communautaires, de bénévoles et de donateurs qui unissent leurs efforts autour d’objectifs communs en matière de santé.

  • Une volonté de transformer les découvertes scientifiques en solutions concrètes, de sensibiliser davantage la population, de contribuer à l’amélioration des systèmes de soins de santé et de réduire les obstacles à un accès équitable aux soins.

  • Une solide tradition philanthropique reposant sur les dons de particuliers et d’institutions, les campagnes de financement et le développement de relations durables avec les donateurs, qui permettent de soutenir les priorités de l’organisme en matière de recherche et d’amélioration de la santé.

Responsabilités

Relevant de la vice-présidence principale, Québec, la personne titulaire du poste de vice-président(e), philanthropie – Québec assurera la direction stratégique et la gestion du développement philanthropique à l’échelle de la province. Ce rôle combine la direction de l’équipe de développement du Québec et la gestion directe d’un portefeuille de donateurs majeurs et de donateurs potentiels, avec pour objectif d’obtenir des dons importants et de soutenir les priorités de la Fondation.

Cette personne contribuera également à l’élaboration de la stratégie organisationnelle de la Fondation et à sa performance régionale, à titre de membre de ses instances de haute direction. En étroite collaboration avec la vice-présidence principale, Québec, le conseil consultatif provincial du Québec, les bénévoles et les équipes internes, elle veillera à développer et à renforcer les relations avec les donateurs, à repérer de nouvelles occasions de financement et à favoriser la croissance des revenus philanthropiques

Planification stratégique et développement philanthropique

  • Élaborer des stratégies philanthropiques pluriannuelles alignées sur les priorités de la Fondation.

  • Participer à la préparation des budgets annuels liés aux dons majeurs et assurer le suivi des résultats financiers et des prévisions.

  • Développer un solide bassin de donateurs potentiels et de partenaires.

  • Repérer les occasions de collaboration entre les dons majeurs, les dons planifiés, les collectes communautaires, les intermédiaires et les événements organisés par des tiers.

  • Travailler avec les équipes régionales et nationales pour maximiser les occasions de financement.

  • Renforcer le rôle stratégique de la philanthropie au sein de l’organisation.

Dons majeurs et relations avec les donateurs

  • Gérer personnellement un portefeuille de donateurs majeurs et potentiels, de la sollicitation à la fidélisation, en collaboration avec la vice-présidence principale.

  • Concevoir des approches personnalisées selon les intérêts et les priorités des donateurs.

  • Préparer des propositions de financement adaptées avec les équipes internes.

  • Identifier et qualifier de nouveaux donateurs potentiels grâce à la recherche, aux réseaux professionnels et aux recommandations.

  • Collaborer avec les équipes de collecte communautaire et de dons planifiés pour développer de nouvelles possibilités de dons majeurs et de dons combinés.

  • Diriger les relations avec les grands donateurs francophones, particulièrement au Québec.

  • Négocier et conclure les ententes de dons, tout en assurant la reconnaissance et la fidélisation des donateurs.

Mobilisation du conseil consultatif provincial du Québec

  • Soutenir la vice-présidence principale dans la mobilisation du conseil consultatif pour les activités philanthropiques.

  • Encourager la participation des membres aux initiatives de philanthropie d’entreprise, de commandite et de dons individuels.

  • Entretenir des relations de confiance avec les membres du conseil.

  • Présenter régulièrement les résultats et les progrès de l’équipe de développement philanthropique.

  • Appuyer la vice-présidence principale et la présidence du conseil dans le recrutement et la planification de la relève.

Relations avec les donateurs, les partenaires et les parties prenantes

  • Identifier et qualifier de nouveaux donateurs et partenaires en collaboration avec les équipes de développement philanthropique.

  • Présenter la mission, les orientations stratégiques et les priorités de financement de la Fondation.

  • Mobiliser les chercheurs, les cliniciens et les experts internes pour élaborer des propositions de financement convaincantes et soutenir les rencontres avec les donateurs.

  • Définir les stratégies de sollicitation et orienter les démarches de l’équipe auprès des donateurs potentiels.

  • Coordonner les efforts de financement autour des priorités de la Fondation.

  • Élaborer et superviser le plan annuel de communication et de fidélisation des donateurs.

  • Maintenir des relations durables avec les donateurs, les bénévoles et les partenaires.

Gestion des opérations et efficacité des activités de financement

  • Participer à la qualification, à l’attribution et au suivi des donateurs potentiels afin de faire progresser les démarches de sollicitation.

  • Assurer la consignation des interactions avec les donateurs, les sympathisants et les bénévoles dans la base de données dans un délai de 48 heures.

  • Coordonner les renseignements nécessaires aux activités de développement philanthropique.

  • Maintenir une connaissance approfondie des priorités de financement de la Fondation.

  • Collaborer avec les équipes centrales à la recherche de donateurs, à la gestion de l’information, à la préparation des propositions et aux activités de fidélisation.

  • Veiller au respect des politiques, des procédures et des normes professionnelles de la Fondation.

  • Participer à la planification annuelle, au suivi budgétaire et à l’évaluation des résultats philanthropiques.

Leadership, développement des équipes et collaboration

  • Diriger l’équipe de développement philanthropique du Québec, définir les priorités et optimiser l’utilisation des ressources.

  • Accompagner les membres de l’équipe dans leur développement professionnel et établir des objectifs de rendement clairs.

  • Favoriser la collaboration entre les équipes et les différentes fonctions de l’organisation.

  • Veiller à ce que l’équipe maîtrise les programmes, les travaux de recherche et les priorités de la Fondation afin de les présenter efficacement aux donateurs.

  • Soutenir les bénévoles engagés dans les activités de financement.

  • Collaborer avec les ressources humaines au recrutement et au développement des talents.

  • Mettre son expertise philanthropique au service des collègues et des bénévoles.

  • Participer aux instances de haute direction et contribuer aux orientations stratégiques ainsi qu’à la performance régionale de la Fondation.

Profil recherchéz

Qualifications et expérience professionnelles

  • Diplôme universitaire.

  • Minimum de 10 ans d’expérience en collecte de fonds dans un environnement bilingue.

  • Succès démontré dans la sollicitation et l’obtention de dons majeurs de 100 000 $ et plus.

  • Expérience dans la gestion des relations avec les donateurs, de l’identification à la sollicitation et à la fidélisation.

  • Expérience en planification philanthropique, en élaboration de budgets et en suivi de la performance financière.

  • Expérience en recrutement, en formation et en mobilisation de bénévoles ou de professionnels de la collecte de fonds.

  • Expérience dans la direction d’une campagne de dons majeurs, un atout.

  • Excellente maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.

  • Certification CFRE et participation à une association professionnelle pertinente, des atouts.

  • Connaissance des codes d’éthique, des politiques et des procédures de l’AFP, de l’ACPDP (CAGP) et de l’APRA.

Compétences, connaissances et qualités recherchées

Organization Summary
Founded in 1952, Heart & Stroke is a Canadian health charity dedicated to preventing heart disease and stroke, saving lives, and improving recovery for people affected by these conditions. Through its research funding, public education, advocacy and partnerships, the organization works to advance cardiovascular and brain health and improve health outcomes across Canada.

Heart & Stroke supports scientific research and medical innovation aimed at improving the prevention, diagnosis, treatment and recovery of heart disease and stroke. It also works to raise public awareness of risk factors, promote healthier lifestyles, improve access to timely and effective care, and advocate for policies that support better health outcomes. Its work brings together researchers, healthcare professionals, policymakers, community organizations, volunteers, donors, and people with lived experience.

With a national presence and a long-standing commitment to medical research, Heart & Stroke has contributed to significant advances in cardiovascular and stroke care. Since its founding, the organization has invested more than $1.7 billion in heart disease and stroke research, supported by the generosity of donors and the engagement of communities across the country.

Heart & Stroke’s work is characterized by:

Job Summary

We are seeking an Experienced Corporate Counsel, M&A to serve as a critical strategic advisor to our executive leadership team and lead executioner for our corporate development initiatives. Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer (CEO), you will quarterback complex buy-side and sell-side transactions from inception to integration, directly safeguarding and expanding our multi-million dollar federal revenue portfolio.

In this high-impact, in-house role, you will be responsible for translating complex legal risks into clear, actionable business intelligence for members of the C-Suite, enabling data-driven, strategic decision-making. Operating at the intersection of corporate law and federal procurement, you will navigate the unique regulatory complexities of a Large Business federal contractor, including FAR/DFARS compliance, SBA affiliation risks, and contract novations. If you are a seasoned transactional attorney with a sharp business acumen and a proven track record of successfully executing GovCon deals, this role offers the platform to directly shape our growth strategy and corporate footprint.

As with any position, additional expectations exist. Some of these include, but are not limited to, adhering to normal working hours, meeting deadlines, following company policies as outlined by the Employee Handbook, communicating regularly with assigned supervisor(s), staying focused on the assigned tasks, and completing other tasks as assigned.

Job Description

Reporting Structure & Collaboration

  • Direct Report: Reports directly to the Chief Executive Officer (CEO).
  • Executive Advisory: Prepares and delivers comprehensive M&A transaction summaries, legal risk assessments, and financial exposure details to members of the C-Suite (COSS, COSD and CSO) for strategic decision-making purposes.

Main Duties

  • Transaction Execution: Lead internal deal teams through all phases of buy-side and sell-side GovCon transactions.
  • Contract Risk Mitigation: Review target companies' existing federal contract portfolios, evaluating Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS) compliance, subcontracting plans, and active industrial security requirements.
  • Novation Strategy: Author, coordinate, and submit complex novation agreement packages to Administrative Contracting Officers (ACOs) to legally transfer acquired federal contracts without breaching anti-assignment statutes.
  • Internal Business Advisory: Partner directly with the Executive Team, Corporate Development, and Business Unit leads to assess the strategic fit and regulatory risks of potential acquisitions.
  • Outside Counsel Management: Direct and manage external law firms and specialized GovCon consultants to control legal spending and ensure transaction deadlines are met.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Deal Velocity & Efficiency: Time-to-close metrics on targeted acquisitions, ensuring legal milestones are met without causing project friction or deal fatigue.
  • C-Suite Reporting Accuracy: Quality, clarity, and timeliness of executive briefs and executive-level transaction risk matrices provided to the CEO and C-Suite.
  • Regulatory Compliance Post-Closing: Zero post-transaction compliance penalties or contract losses stemming from undisclosed FAR, DFARS, or SBA affiliation risks.
  • Novation Success Rate: Average time required to obtain signed novation agreements from federal Administrative Contracting Officers (ACOs) following a transaction closing.
  • Legal Budget Efficiency: Management of outside counsel spend relative to the established legal budget for each individual M&A transaction.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Education: Juris Doctor (JD) degree from an accredited law school.
  • Licensure: Active member in good standing with a state bar; eligible for local In-House Counsel Licensure if relocating.
  • Experience: 8 to 12+ years of corporate transactional experience, blending initial training at a major law firm ("BigLaw") with meaningful corporate in-house experience at a large federal contractor.
  • Core Knowledge: Advanced fluency in the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR), Small Business Administration (SBA) size affiliation rules, Cost Accounting Standards (CAS), and organizational conflicts of interest (OCI).
  • Security Clearance: Ability to obtain or maintain an active U.S. Security Clearance (Secret or Top Secret) based on the company's classified contract pipeline.
  • If applicable: If you are or have been recently employed by the U.S. government, a post-employment ethics letter will be required if employment with VSolvit is offered

Company Summary

Join the VSolvit Team! Founded in 2006, VSolvit (pronounced 'We Solve It') is a technology services provider that specializes in cybersecurity, cloud computing, geographic information systems (GIS), business intelligence (BI) systems, data warehousing, engineering services, and custom database and application development. VSolvit is an award winning WOSB, CA CDB, MBE, WBE, and CMMI Level 3 certified company. We offer a customizable health benefits program that best meets the needs of its employees. Offering may include: medical, dental, and vision insurance, life insurance, long and short-term disability and other insurance products, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Account, 401K Retirement Plan options, Tuition Reimbursement, and assorted voluntary benefits. Our goal is to grow together and enjoy the work that we do as a team.

VSolvit LLC is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer and will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Our Customer Success Managers pick up where our Implementation team leaves off, working closely with our top customers to understand their fleet and unique challenges, advising on how to customize Samsara for their needs, and becoming their long-term partner.

Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering, and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a hyper-growth company from within.

This role is open to candidates residing in Canada.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Be on the front lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our IoT platform.
  • Compose joint success plans with customers, outlining their objectives, metrics, and timelines, and effectively removing any barriers to achieving business value.
  • Orchestrate executive business reviews with our customers’ decision-makers and our executive leadership where we look back at past successes and align on upcoming goals.
  • Conduct workshops with customers to understand their current operations and recommend workflow changes to get the most out of their Samsara products.
  • Support French-speaking customers implementations.
  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform’s capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types - field services, utilities, long-haul transportation, school buses, and many more.
  • Serve as a mentor to the wider Customer Success and Support teams.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for this role:

  • 2 - 4+ years of experience in a senior Customer Success, account management, or strategic consulting role. SaaS experience preferred.
  • This is a demanding position with high internal visibility, that requires strong priority management and high emotional intelligence.
  • English and French fluency.
  • Customer travel is expected. Up to 0-15%.
  • Experience supporting or working with technical products.
  • Solutions-oriented with strong problem-solving skills.
  • Proven track record of building trust and communicating effectively with a wide variety of stakeholders: executives, Product and Engineering leadership, day-to-day users of our software.
  • Passion for going above and beyond the call of duty, taking initiative, and thriving in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment.
  • Diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through customer issues.
  • Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Strong bias for action, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards.
  • Experience serving and supporting large-scale business solutions at Fortune 500 companies.
  • Thrives in an unstructured, fast-paced, and change-heavy environment.
  • French Fluency is a plus.

Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual OTE Salary
$78,412—$101,475 CAD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. Belonging at Samsara

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Are you a senior QA engineer who writes the test automation that keeps enterprise ERP software reliable?

At Sparkrock, we help social benefit organizations, such as nonprofits, school boards, and government agencies, reach their full potential through technology. Every day, over 150,000 people use our ERP and product platforms to work more efficiently, freeing up time and resources to focus on the good they want to achieve. When our software works reliably, those people spend their time on their mission instead of on workarounds.

We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer to strengthen how we test our ERP products. You will own quality from business requirements to release: planning test cycles, designing and writing test cases, building and maintaining automated tests and frameworks, and tracking defects to resolution. You will work closely with development, product management, and operations.

Reporting to the Director of Platform Development, you will shape how QA works across our products and be measured on what you deliver: complete, relevant test coverage, clear test cases, and automated tests that run reliably and are easy to maintain.

If you enjoy complex enterprise systems and keep improving your work through metrics and new tools, we would love to hear from you.

Responsibilities

  • Analyse business requirements to understand the testing needs and keep testing aligned with business goals.
  • Design test cases and strategies that cover all functionality and scenarios.
  • Plan test cycles and schedule them around development phases and project timelines.
  • Write clear, concise test cases and scripts.
  • Run tests manually and with automation to find issues and bugs.
  • Develop and maintain automated test scripts and frameworks to make testing more efficient.
  • Report test results, give a clear view of software quality, and recommend improvements.
  • Track defects from identification to resolution and make sure they are fixed on time.
  • Maintain the QA testing environment and tools that keep testing efficient.

Requirements

  • 5 years or more of experience in QA automation.
  • Hands-on experience writing and maintaining automated test code and frameworks.
  • Experience testing ERP or other enterprise SaaS products in production.
  • Experience turning business requirements into test plans and test cases.
  • Experience managing defects from identification to resolution.

*Experience working in Agile teams.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field, and an ISTQB, CSTE, or similar testing certification.
  • Fluent, professional English, spoken and written

Nice to have

  • Experience with Microsoft Business Central is a huge advantage
  • Experience with writing AL-based tests for Microsoft Business Central is an even greater advantage
  • Daily use of AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Claude Code.

Benefits

We don’t call them perks; they’re just part of what makes working at Sparkrock great.
  • We are 100% remote and global. Live your best life, wherever that may be, and never lose out on career opportunities because of it.
  • Flexible work hours. We work asynchronously and don’t care when you’re online, just that you deliver great results.
  • Dedication to development. We focus on career paths for each and every one of our employees and help provide training to advance at every stage of their careers.
  • Introductions to thought leaders in the space and webinars on cutting-edge tech hot topics
  • Stipend to help set up your ideal home office
  • Focus on culture. Coffee chats, happy hours, cooking classes, book clubs, and more!
Sparkrock is an equal opportunity employer and encourages applications from traditionally underrepresented groups. POSITION SPECIFICATION

Position:Associate Director, Industry & Infrastructure (I&I) Electrical

Department:Utilities & Central Energy (UCE)

Reporting Relationship:Director, UCE

COMPANY BACKGROUND

KFI Engineers is a recognized industry leader in facility infrastructure design and performance. Since 1996, our culture of collaboration and unique capabilities have allowed us to make a difference in the way infrastructure and processing projects are delivered.

Headquartered in St. Paul, MN, with numerous regional offices throughout the United States, and a team of hundreds of professionals, we offer opportunities to continue your career with mentorship programs, career growth support, and continued education. With KFI, we find a way to provide creative solutions to unique projects while providing the same care we would expect if we were the client. For more information about KFI Engineers and our culture, please visit.

POSITION OVERVIEW & RESPONSIBILITIES

The Associate Director is responsible for the day-to-day tactical management with a heavy focus on electrical engineering within the Utilities & Central Energy (UCE), Industrial, Process & Agribusiness (IPA), and Manufacturing (MFG) Groups, and the effective execution of department strategy. This role translates strategic priorities into actionable plans, coordinates resources, monitors performance, and ensures teams are aligned around operational goals, project commitments, quality expectations, and client needs. Working closely with the Director of UCE, the Associate Director provides leadership to managers and team members, supports consistent delivery practices, and helps remove barriers that may impact project execution, team effectiveness, or business performance.

The Utilities & Central Energy (UCE) group specializes in large central plant work, particularly for district energy serving cities, universities, hospitals, and manufacturing campuses. Our expertise covers both energy production and distribution. We have expertise in sustainable energy production, simple and combined cycle, combined heat and power, and medium voltage power.

This position requires strong operational leadership, sound judgment, and the ability to balance daily priorities with longer-term departmental objectives. The Associate Director uses communication, coaching, project management, and analytical skills to guide work across teams, manage competing demands, support resource planning, and drive accountability for results. The role also contributes to continuous improvement by identifying gaps in processes, tools, communication, and delivery practices, then partnering with leaders and team members to implement practical solutions that support department performance and client satisfaction.

Specific responsibilities will include, but not be limited to, the following:

Strategy Execution

  • Translate department strategy into actionable priorities, workplans, goals, and operating rhythms for managers and team members.
  • Partner with the Director of UCE, IPA, and MFG to communicate strategic priorities, align department activities, and monitor progress against goals.
  • Support business planning by providing operational insight, performance updates, staffing considerations, and recommendations to improve department execution.
  • Identify and escalate risks, resource needs, and execution barriers that may impact department performance, project delivery, or client service.
  • Contribute to department initiatives that improve quality, efficiency, consistency, employee engagement, and client outcomes.
  • Take an active role in department resource planning, strategy, hiring, growing the group, and process improvement as a member of the UCE department leadership team.

Leadership

  • Manage staff and provide day-to-day leadership, coaching, and direction to managers, project leaders, engineers, and consultants within the department.
  • Set clear expectations, reinforce accountability, and support consistent communication across teams and project groups.
  • Facilitate goal setting and performance reviews, and conduct regular one-on-one meetings with staff as needed.
  • Develop and coach the talent needed to meet current and future organizational goals by providing feedback, identifying growth opportunities, and building leadership capability within the department.
  • Foster a collaborative, respectful, and high-performing team environment that supports engagement, retention, and shared ownership of results.
  • Advocate for staff development and growth opportunities while promoting cross-disciplinary collaboration and holding partner disciplines accountable for commitments that affect electrical team members.
  • Promote proactive coordination to obtain the information electrical teams need for timely, accurate design decisions.
  • Build collaborative relationships and coordinate priorities with the Directors of Utilities and Central Energy, Industrial Process and Agribusiness, and Manufacturing to support aligned staffing, project execution, and client service.
  • Partner with Electrical Senior Technical Specialists to develop standards, strengthen mentorship, and identify team technical strengths and priority areas for capability development.
Operations and Project Oversight
  • Oversee daily department operations, including workload planning, staffing coordination, project priorities, utilization, quality expectations, and issue resolution; allocate resources to support effective staff utilization and development.
  • Actively manage assigned projects through completion using effective delegation, timely follow-up, and personal execution of work as needed.
  • Monitor project execution, budgets, schedules, resource allocation, delivery risks, and the accuracy and timeliness of invoicing and billing activity to support successful project delivery.
  • Make sound operational decisions by balancing client commitments, team capacity, financial performance, quality control, and department priorities.
  • Partner with project leaders to ensure engineering designs and consulting services meet applicable safety, environmental, ethical, regulatory, and quality standards.
  • Track key operational metrics and provide regular updates, insights, and recommendations to department leadership.
  • Support change management, process improvement, and implementation of department standards, tools, and practices.

Business Development and Client Support

  • Serve as client manager for select client relationships.
  • Combine hands-on project delivery with client relationship development and pursuit support when required.
  • Ensure new opportunities are properly defined and scoped, and actively contribute to proposals, customer meetings, and other aspects of the business development process.

Technical Support

  • Serve as the technical lead engineer on selected projects within the Associate Director’s area of expertise, as required by project complexity, staffing needs, or client commitments.
  • Provide hands-on technical support when needed to balance team workload, including calculations, specifications, equipment procurement, report writing, and field work.
  • Provide ongoing technical leadership in areas of expertise through design guidance, technical review, problem-solving, and knowledge sharing with the team.
  • Oversee and participate in department project engineering to ensure KFI quality, customer satisfaction, and financial objectives are achieved.
  • Apply scientific and engineering principles to designs and technical problems while supporting other departments and disciplines.

Other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Electrical, or related field) from an accredited institution.
  • Professional Engineering (PE) license or EIT/FE holder with willingness to obtain PE.
  • Minimum of 15 years of progressive experience in engineering consulting, operations, project delivery, or related leadership roles, preferably within the industrial, energy, manufacturing, or utilities industries.
  • Demonstrated experience managing daily operations, project execution, resource planning, and cross-functional priorities within a technical or professional services environment.
  • Experience supporting business development activities, client relationships, proposal development, scoping discussions, and contract execution.
  • Deep knowledge of the industrial, energy, manufacturing, or utilities sectors, demonstrated through active engagement in relevant conferences, trade shows, professional organizations, and client visits.
  • Project experience with performing technical electrical engineering work on one or more of the following: high hazard environments, 480V design, instrumentation, medium voltage, relay protection and control.
  • Proven leadership experience coaching, developing, and managing direct or indirect reports.
  • Strong business acumen with experience monitoring project financials, utilization, budgets, and operational performance metrics.
  • Strong background in business development and client relationship management within the industrial, energy, manufacturing, or utilities sectors.
  • Superior verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to collaborate with others.
  • Knowledge of computer technology and specific areas of application , including MS Office.
  • Travel: May include up to 25% domestic travel.

Preferred

  • Certification in Project Management (PMP) or equivalent.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of applicable electrical, utility, industrial, and commercial facility codes, standards, and regulatory requirements, including relevant NFPA, NEC, IEEE, and ASHRAE provisions.

Working Conditions

  • Some work locations will feature the tough terrain typical of construction sites or require lifting or moving field testing equipment.

CORE BEHAVIORS

Accountable

  • Demonstrates persistence in the achievement of goals.
  • Acts with a sense of urgency.
  • Takes responsibility for own actions.

Business Focus

  • Demonstrates agility, adapts well to changes.
  • Works well under pressure.
  • Meets commitments to internal/external customers.

Project Execution

  • Plans projects well, managing last-minute rushes and disruptions.
  • Balances Speed and Quality.
  • Looks for improvement in our delivery, tools and processes.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Demonstrates Respect for Others

  • Keeps others adequately informed.
  • Exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views.
  • Adapts communication style and method based on audience and situation.

Team Player

  • Balances team and individual responsibilities.
  • Shares expertise with others.
  • Inspires respect and trust.

Managing People

  • Develops employees’ skills and encourages growth.
  • Consistently provides timely feedback to employees.
  • Delegates effectively, providing clear direction and authority to act.

Benefits:

jobs.description:
Who We Are
Mission: At Clever Digital Marketing, we are on a mission to empower large-scale home improvement companies by fueling their top-line revenue through innovative digital marketing strategies. By bridging the gap in the industry for a highly profitable digital lead vendor, we've created a unique space where growth isn't just supported — it's catalyzed.
Product: Clever Digital Marketing delivers outcome-driven paid advertising and strategic advising solutions. We don't focus on clicks and impressions — we focus on net sales. Our customized, data-driven strategies are tailored to each client's unique needs, ensuring measurable impact and scalable profitability across Google, Meta, and Microsoft ad platforms.
Scale: Recognized by the Globe and Mail as the #1 Fastest-Growing Company in the Marketing & Advertising category and #42 across all of Canada, we are the growth engine behind some of North America's most ambitious home improvement brands — companies on track to generate over $500 million in combined revenue in 2026. With a team of 100+ across North America, $74M in digital ad spend managed, and 400,000+ leads generated, we've built something rare: a system where scale isn't luck. It's engineering.
Impact: As trusted subject matter experts in the home improvement space, we are redefining what it means to deliver value. Our commitment to authenticity, collaboration, and continuous improvement ensures we remain a powerhouse of growth and measurable results for every client we serve. We don't do lead generation — we do revenue generation.
The Honest Truth About This Role
Our Data & Technology group has outgrown informal coordination. The group spans the Data Integrations & Engineering teams (our GCP-native Data Platform 2.0 and Google/Meta/Bing ad platform integrations), IT Security, and Compliance — including our SOC 2 readiness program and IT Security Plan. These workstreams compete for the same small set of technical hands, and today there is no dedicated delivery owner. Priorities collide, dependencies surface late, and important-but-not-urgent security and compliance work slips behind feature delivery.
You'll fix that. You won't inherit clean systems — you'll build them. So let's be direct about who we're looking for: a superb communicator & hands-on builder who has run technical programs before, not someone who needs a playbook handed to them.
One boundary to be clear about up front: you own the how, you facilitate the what. Delivery process, tracking, cadences, and risk management are yours to design and drive. What gets prioritized — roadmap and resourcing calls — you frame clearly for the leaders who decide. If you need roadmap authority to feel effective, this isn't your role. If making complex decisions easier and business-critical delivery more predictable is what energizes you, keep reading.

Key Responsibilities

What You'll Do
Own Portfolio Visibility and Delivery
  • Build and maintain a single source of truth for status, dependencies, risks, and resourcing across data platform, integrations, IT security, and compliance workstreams
  • Run portfolio-level planning: sequence work across projects, surface conflicts before they become fire drills, and keep leadership informed without meetings-as-status-reports
  • Flag slippage, resourcing conflicts, and scope creep early — with options attached, not just alarms
Drive Security and Compliance Programs
  • Own delivery of SOC 2 readiness: evidence collection, control implementation tasks, access reviews, vendor risk assessments, policy work, and audit milestones — coordinated with internal subject matter experts, our compliance partners, and auditors
  • Drive execution of the IT Security Plan: turn it into sequenced, owned, tracked work, and keep it moving alongside feature delivery competing for the same engineers
  • Operate with a least-privilege mindset: you'll touch access-adjacent process (access reviews, onboarding/offboarding checklists, vendor intake) and are expected to flag scope-of-access questions rather than route around them
Run Right-Sized Agile Process
  • Adapt process to team size — we’re a small, senior unit, not a 200-person scaled-agile org
  • Own delivery cadence for the technical team — planning, standups, retros, backlog hygiene — process that serves delivery, not ceremony for its own sake
  • Protect the team's focus: manage intake so mid-sprint asks get triaged, not silently absorbed
  • Architect how the technical portfolio runs in Asana: templates, custom fields, dependencies, and portfolio views that give leadership visibility without asking
Facilitate Prioritization and Intake
  • Turn ad hoc requests from leadership, client services, and vendors into scoped, sequenced backlog items with effort, dependencies, and tradeoffs made explicit
  • Prepare prioritization decisions for the VP and leadership: frame the options, quantify cost-of-delay, and drive to a decision — the call itself sits with the decision-makers
  • Translate stakeholder needs into actionable requirements and specs the engineering team can build against
Coordinate Cross-Functional and External Work
  • Align internal stakeholders (client services, leadership, operations) and external parties (vendors, contractors, client-side technical contacts) on scope, timelines, and dependencies
  • Drive vendor- and contractor-delivered workstreams to completion: clear deliverables, tracked commitments, escalation before deadlines break
  • Diagnose root causes behind missed deadlines — capacity, prioritization, unclear scope, or workflow design — and fix the system, not the symptom

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

What We Are Looking For
  • 3+ years of program or project management for technical teams (data, software, platform, or IT/security work) with real delivery accountability — you've owned outcomes, not just tracked tickets
  • Exposure to security or compliance work (audits, access reviews, policy rollouts) — and you treat it as real delivery, not overhead
  • You've built delivery systems from scratch — walked into a team with no structure and created the workflows, tooling, and habits that made it run
  • Working fluency in agile practices — enough to run the process well and enough judgment to know when to bend it
  • Technical literacy sufficient to be credible with engineers: you understand what a data pipeline is, why a schema change carries risk, what "blocked on API access" means, and why an access request's scope matters — and you're honest about what you don't know
  • Strong Asana skills at the architecture level, not just the user level
  • Demonstrated ability to influence without authority — driving delivery across people and vendors who don't report to you
  • Exceptional written communication: status reporting, requirements, and decision framing are core deliverables of this role, not overhead
Who You Are
  • Extreme Ownership — you take responsibility for whether work ships, not just whether the board is updated
  • A builder, hands-on and high-output — you build the system, roll it out, and iterate; you don't architect from 30,000 feet and delegate the details
  • A facilitator, not a bottleneck — you make decisions easier for decision-makers and work easier for builders
  • Direct and candid — you deliver honest status even when it's unwelcome, and push back on vague asks
  • Kaizen-driven — messy starting points energize you, and you leave every process better than you found it
Nice to Haves
  • Experience driving a security or compliance program (SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar), working with compliance automation platforms (e.g., Vanta, Drata), or alongside an external audit/compliance partner
  • Exposure to cloud data platforms (GCP, BigQuery) or modern data engineering workflows
  • Agency or multi-client environment experience
  • Product management exposure: PRDs, discovery, acceptance criteria
  • Formal certifications (PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, CISA, Security+) — useful signal, not required
What You Will Not Do
  • Own roadmap or prioritization authority — you design and run the delivery system; what gets prioritized within it is facilitated by you and decided by leadership
  • Manage people — this is an individual contributor role with broad influence
  • Deliver hands-on engineering work — you'll be close to the technical work, but you won't write production code or SQL
  • Run client-facing account or campaign management
What Success Looks Like
  • At 30 days: You've taken over delivery tracking for the Technology portfolio. You know the state of every active workstream, where SOC 2 readiness and the IT Security Plan actually stand, and what you'll fix first.
  • At 60 days: The technical team's delivery cadence is running. SOC 2 and IT Security Plan work is sequenced, owned, and tracked against target dates. Intake has a single front door.
  • At 90 days: Leadership can see portfolio status without asking. Security and compliance milestones are landing on schedule rather than slipping behind feature work. You present a view of what comes next — process, tooling, and risks.

Benefits

What We Offer
  • An incredible team and culture — high-performance, feedback-oriented, and data-driven, where everyone is empowered to succeed. Our culture thrives on collaboration, extreme ownership, and Kaizen. This is more than a workplace — it's a place where you'll grow, learn, and thrive alongside passionate teammates who are as invested in your success as you are
  • Real ownership of production systems within a platform being built from the ground up — with a clear runway to grow your scope as you prove it
  • Be part of the #1 fastest-growing marketing company in Canada, redefining performance marketing for the home improvement industry
  • A modern, GCP-native stack with AI embedded in daily workflows — Claude and Gemini are tools you'll use every day, not novelties
  • Exposure to AI/NLQ, MMM modeling, and ML optimization layers as the proprietary platform matures
  • Fully remote work environment with the flexibility to work from anywhere in Canada
  • 3+ weeks of paid time off annually, with the freedom to use them as you see fit
  • Comprehensive group benefits including health, dental, and vision
  • Company-provided MacBook Pro and home office budget to help you create your ideal workspace
  • A work abroad policy to support you when you need a fresh perspective
  • Merch deliveries and opportunities to connect with teammates at meetups and company-wide events
  • A defined growth path toward Senior Data Engineer for those who demonstrate consistent ownership, quality, and impact
Other
  • Job-Type: Full-Time Permanent
  • Standard business hours: 9am – 5pm ET
  • Working Arrangements: Remote within Canada — Occasional in-office collaboration opportunities. Candidates must be legally eligible to work in Canada.
  • Base Salary: $100,000 – $125,000 CAD per year
  • This posting is for an existing vacancy

jobs.description:
About Kreato Global

Founded in 2020, Kreato Language Group LLC provides business process outsourcing and professional language services that help organizations overcome communication barriers across healthcare, legal, financial, customer service, and social service settings.

Our services include Over-the-Phone Interpretation (OPI), Video Remote Interpretation (VRI), On-Site Interpretation, and American Sign Language (ASL). We are committed to delivering accurate, reliable, and culturally sensitive communication while building a supportive environment for our remote professionals.

About the Role

We are looking for experienced English-Portuguese interpreters based in Latin America to join our remote team in a blended Over-the-Phone Interpretation (OPI) and Video Remote Interpretation (VRI) role starting in October 2026.

As an interpreter, you will facilitate clear and accurate communication between English- and Portuguese-speaking individuals across medical, social service, customer care, and financial settings. You will use consecutive interpretation techniques to ensure that all parties understand one another while maintaining professionalism, impartiality, confidentiality, and accuracy.

Important: A minimum of six months of verifiable professional experience in remote OPI and/or VRI interpretation is mandatory. Candidates without the required experience will not be considered.

Why Join Kreato Global?

  • Guaranteed Pay: Get paid for each eligible logged-in hour, including time spent handling calls and waiting in the queue, subject to the applicable program terms.

  • Sign-On Bonus: Earn an additional bonus in accordance with the program's eligibility requirements.

  • Performance Bonuses: Be rewarded for meeting established performance and quality standards.

  • Schedule Adherence Bonuses: Earn additional incentives for maintaining reliable attendance and schedule adherence, subject to program requirements.

  • Overtime Opportunities: Increase your earnings through available overtime shifts.

  • 100% Remote Work: Work from home with no daily commute.

  • Structured Workweek: Work five days per week, with two scheduled days off.

  • Supportive Team Environment: Join a professional team that values accuracy, reliability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Bonus amounts, eligibility criteria, and applicable program terms will be communicated during the recruitment process.

Key Qualifications

  • Required Experience: At least six months of verifiable professional experience providing remote English-Portuguese OPI and/or VRI interpretation.

  • English Proficiency: Advanced English fluency at a minimum C1 level, with strong spoken and written communication skills.

  • Portuguese Proficiency: Native or native-level Portuguese fluency, with excellent comprehension and active listening skills.

  • Interpretation Skills: Ability to deliver accurate, complete, impartial, and professional consecutive interpretation.

  • Specialized Terminology: Strong knowledge of medical, financial, and social service terminology.

  • Confidentiality and Compliance: Understanding of patient privacy, confidentiality, and HIPAA-related requirements.

  • Professionalism: Excellent attention to detail, active listening, emotional composure, and the ability to remain neutral in sensitive situations.

  • Reliability: Commitment to attendance, schedule adherence, quality standards, and established operating procedures.

  • Remote Work Readiness: Ability to work independently in a quiet, professional environment with a reliable wired internet connection.

Technical Requirements

All candidates must meet the following technical requirements to be eligible for onboarding.

Internet Connection

  • A stable, reliable internet connection.

  • An Ethernet cable connected directly to the router or modem.

  • Wi-Fi is not permitted.

Approved USB Headsets

Only approved, client-compatible USB headsets are accepted. Bluetooth headsets, mono headsets, and built-in microphones are not permitted.

Approved models include:

  • Logitech H390

  • Jabra GN series / Jabra Evolve series

  • Microsoft LifeChat LX-6000

  • Plantronics Blackwire C3220

  • Dell Plantronics

  • HP Stereo USB Headset G2

The exact headset model must meet the client's technical specifications and approval requirements.

Computer and Video

  • Processor: Intel Core i5, 6th generation or newer.

  • Webcam: 720p or 1080p resolution.

  • Browser: An updated version of Chrome, Safari, Microsoft Edge, or Firefox.

  • Work Environment: A quiet, distraction-free space suitable for confidential interpretation sessions.

Start Date

November 2026

Selected candidates must be available to complete the recruitment, technical verification, and client onboarding requirements before their assigned start date.

Ready to Apply?

If you have at least six months of remote OPI/VRI interpretation experience, meet the English and Portuguese proficiency requirements, and have the required technical equipment, we encourage you to apply.

Join Kreato Global and help bridge language barriers through meaningful, high-quality communication.

Apply today to be considered for our November 2026 intake!

Job Title

Senior Provider Auditor

Job Summary

The Provider Auditor is responsible for conducting Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) and other financial analysis, limited and full desk reviews, and in-house and on-site field audits to ensure proper reimbursement for health care providers for the Medicare programs. These positions are the face of Noridian interacting with providers/facilities management through the audit process which requires an advanced level of professionalism. Reviews assigned portions of audit programs, determines compliance with policies and procedures, recommends corrective action plans, and prepares/submits reports on the results of audits.

Essential Functions

Key Duties/Responsibilities/Accountabilities

  • Possesses and maintains a high level of working knowledge in Medicare rules, regulations (e.g, Code of Federal regulations, Provider reimbursement Manual) to ensure reimbursement principles are properly applied to the Medicare Cost Report so that Medicare reimbursement is accurate.
  • Mentors staff at all levels by training, coaching, and providing constructive and positive feedback.
  • Assists with new and existing employee training on department techniques, desk review and audit methodologies, policies and procedures.
  • Provides professional judgement, strategic insight, and guidance to Provider Auditor I and II’s using their knowledge, experience, and research to ensure quality control is adequate and minimize risk for the team and organization.
  • Performs less complex supervisory level reviews and coaches staff with feedback to strengthen their knowledge and skills to perform job functions effectively and efficiently.
  • Enhances and maintains strong, professional working relationships with providers.
  • Requires extensive knowledge of documentation requirements from audit testing through preparation of audit workpapers.
  • Provides training to internal staff and participates in external outreach and education to the provider community.
  • Must obtain a minimum of 80 CET hours every two years.

Non-Essential Duties and Functions

  • Other duties as assigned

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Business, Finance, or equivalent work experience
  • 3 years' Medicare auditing experience
  • Knowledge of accounting theory and practices
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint)
  • Advanced knowledge of Medicare rules, regulations (e.g., Code of Federal Regulations, Provider Reimbursement Manual) to ensure the reimbursement principles are properly applied to the Medicare Cost Report so that Medicare reimbursement is accurate.

Preferred Qualifications

Above requirements and the following:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Business or Finance
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Excellent organizational skills
  • Ability to coach, advise, and develop others
  • Demonstrated understanding of industry and enterprise objectives
  • Excellent presentation skills

Environment and Cognitive/Physical Demands

  • Office Environment
  • Ability to read, hear, speak, keyboard, reason, communicate effectively and problem solve
  • Requires prolonged sitting and telephone use
  • Requires the use of office equipment such as computer terminals, telephones, copiers and printers
  • Infrequent lifting to 15 pounds
  • Infrequent stooping

Every employee is responsible to perform their duties and responsibilities in accordance with Noridian values, policies and procedures, including but not limited to: Segregation of Duties Principles, HIPAA, Security and Privacy, CMS requirements, the Noridian Compliance Program and any other applicable laws, rules and regulations.

jobs.title: Director, Cloud Infrastructure
jobs.excerpt: Who We Are Accommodations Plus International (API) is a technology and services company focused on driving innovation across the travel and transportation industry.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Accommodations Plus International (API) is a technology and services company focused on driving innovation across the travel and transportation industry. We partner with organizations in the airline, cruise, and rail sectors to deliver solutions that improve layover operations, enhance customer experience, and support long-term growth.

Our mission is to make layovers simpler and more efficient for crew members—and we bring that to life through deep industry expertise and a practical, results-driven approach.

Today, API’s platform powers over 18 million crew room nights each year for 100+ airlines and travel operators worldwide. Our Global Reach ensures that airline crews are rested, transported, and connected so global aviation runs on time.

At API, we’re building a culture rooted in succeeding and thriving together. It’s a place where people are encouraged to take ownership, develop their skills, and contribute to work that matters.

If you’re looking to grow your career in a company that values steady progress, real impact, and long-term development, we’d like to meet you!

Summary/Objective

The Senior Director of Cloud Infrastructure & Technical Operations is the senior technical authority for the reliability, scalability, performance, and security of API's cloud-based platform and infrastructure. This is a hands-on, player-coach role: an expert AWS architect and network engineer who also leads people. Operating globally, the Senior Director will set and review AWS architecture, including multi-account design, hybrid and multi-region networking, and security controls, while developing distributed cloud, network, SRE, and DevOps teams. The role owns AWS governance, system reliability, and service continuity, and serves as the primary bridge between technology operations and the business. The ideal candidate combines deep, current AWS and cloud networking expertise with strong people leadership, financial acumen, and executive partnership skills.

Essential Functions:

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead, mentor, and develop globally distributed technical operations teams, building a collaborative, high-performance culture across time zones and cultures
  • Define team structure, roles, and career paths for cloud engineers, network engineers, SREs, and DevOps practitioners across both locations
  • Serve as the technical escalation point and mentor for cloud and network engineers; take part directly in architecture reviews, major incident response, and root-cause analysis
  • Set goals, KPIs, and performance expectations for the organization; conduct regular reviews and provide ongoing coaching
  • Partner with HR and talent acquisition to recruit and retain top technical talent across our global locations
  • Collaborate with product engineering, security, data, and business teams to integrate operational requirements into the software development lifecycle

Cloud Infrastructure & AWS

  • Serve as the senior technical authority for API's global AWS environment and own its governance and operations, including multi-account strategy (Organizations, Control Tower), security controls, compliance posture, and cost management
  • Drive cloud cost optimization, including Reserved Instance and Savings Plans management, rightsizing, tagging governance, and FinOps practices
  • Establish and enforce AWS security best practices including IAM least-privilege access, SCPs, GuardDuty, Security Hub, AWS Config, and CloudTrail audit logging across all environments
  • Oversee multi-region and multi-AZ strategies that meet disaster recovery objectives, minimize RTO/RPO, and maintain continuous availability for global customers
  • Evaluate new AWS services and infrastructure technologies and present adoption recommendations to senior leadership
  • Define infrastructure as code standards (Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK), CI/CD-driven change, and Well-Architected reviews

Cloud Network Architecture & Engineering

  • Architect and hold final technical accountability for AWS network design, including multi-account/multi-VPC topologies, CIDR planning, segmentation, Transit Gateway routing, PrivateLink, and centralized egress and inspection
  • Own hybrid connectivity between AWS, API's global offices, and partners, including Direct Connect, Site-to-Site and Client VPN, and BGP routing and failover design
  • Design and operate DNS, edge, and traffic management, including Route 53, CloudFront, Global Accelerator, and Elastic Load Balancing
  • Define network security architecture, including security groups, NACLs, Network Firewall, WAF, Shield, zero-trust access, and segmentation of PCI-scoped workloads
  • Establish network observability and resilience using VPC Flow Logs, Reachability Analyzer, and CloudWatch/Datadog; lead troubleshooting of complex cross-region and hybrid incidents and validate network failover during DR testing

System Reliability & Service Continuity

  • Define and own SLAs and uptime commitments for all production systems; set reliability targets with product engineering and report performance to executive stakeholders
  • Oversee monitoring and observability (CloudWatch, Datadog, Grafana, or equivalent) for proactive detection and rapid response
  • Drive capacity planning so infrastructure scales efficiently with growth without compromising performance or cost targets
  • Own the IT disaster recovery and business continuity plan; lead tabletop exercises and failover testing to validate recovery

Strategy, Governance & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Develop and execute the multi-year technical operations roadmap aligned with product strategy and growth objectives
  • Provide regular reporting to the SVP of Infrastructure Engineering and Technical Operations and executive leadership, including infrastructure health, cost, and initiative progress
  • Lead vendor relationships for cloud, infrastructure tooling, and managed services, including contract negotiations, SLA management, and performance reviews
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory and data privacy requirements (SOC 2, GDPR, PCI-DSS, ISO 27001) as they apply to infrastructure; partner with security on audit readiness
  • Manage the technical operations budget, including headcount, tooling, and cloud spend, with accurate forecasting and variance analysis

Competencies

  • Proven ability to build, scale, and retain high-performing technical teams across multiple geographies and time zones
  • Executive presence; able to translate complex infrastructure concepts into clear narratives for C-suite and board audiences
  • Strategic mindset balanced with operational discipline, from multi-year vision to day-to-day excellence
  • Expert-level, current, hands-on command of AWS architecture, cloud networking, and security, sufficient to design and critique solutions and lead deep-dive troubleshooting in major incidents; not a people-management-only role
  • Strong financial acumen managing multi-million-dollar cloud budgets and driving cost optimization without compromising reliability
  • Skilled at leading globally distributed teams across multiple time zones
  • Data-driven; uses metrics, SLOs, and KPIs to prioritize investments and communicate operational health
  • Commitment to engineering excellence, blameless culture, and continuous learning
  • Experience with AI based automation capabilities for system self-healing, stability and security.

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work

This is a full-time position (exempt where applicable) based in the United States or Canada. This position can be remote or hybrid. Standard hours are Monday through Friday during core business hours. Given the global nature of this role, flexibility in scheduling is expected to accommodate regular collaboration with the Pune, India team across significant time zone differences. Occasional evening availability for major deployments and scheduled maintenance windows may be required.

Travel

This position may require occasional travel within the United States and Canada, and possibly to India, to support vendor meetings, industry conferences, cross-functional leadership engagements, and business unit initiatives.

Required Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field; Master's or MBA preferred; equivalent experience considered
  • 15+ years in technology operations, infrastructure engineering, or cloud operations, including 8+ years of hands-on production AWS design and operations and 5+ years leading technical teams in a director, senior director, head-of, or equivalent senior leadership role, regardless of title
  • Experience managing distributed teams across multiple countries; experience overseeing staff in India strongly preferred
  • Expert knowledge of AWS services including compute (EC2, ECS, EKS, Lambda), storage (S3, EFS, EBS), databases (RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB, ElastiCache), and security (IAM, GuardDuty, Security Hub, WAF, Shield, Network Firewall)
  • Deep expertise in cloud and enterprise networking, including TCP/IP, DNS, BGP, IPsec VPN, load balancing, and TLS, with experience designing hybrid connectivity (Direct Connect, VPN) and multi-VPC/multi-account architectures at scale (VPC, Transit Gateway, PrivateLink, Route 53, CloudFront)
  • Hands-on proficiency with infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK), CI/CD, and scripting (Python, Bash, or equivalent)
  • Proven track record overseeing highly available, multi-region production systems with aggressive uptime and performance SLAs
  • Experience managing cloud budgets, implementing FinOps, and presenting forecasts to executive leadership
  • Experience with cloud security and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, GDPR, or PCI-DSS
  • Experience owning observability platforms (Datadog, CloudWatch, Grafana, or equivalent) and driving a metrics-driven approach to operational health
  • Experience owning disaster recovery and business continuity programs for cloud infrastructure, including regular testing and executive reporting
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional (or equivalent) required; Advanced Networking – Specialty and Security – Specialty strongly preferred

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading technical operations at a SaaS or cloud-native company supporting enterprise customers with high availability and data security requirements
  • Database reliability engineering experience, including RDS/Aurora tuning, failover testing, and backup/recovery validation
  • Experience with enterprise network architecture beyond AWS, including SD-WAN, MPLS, next-gen firewalls, and ZTNA
  • Familiarity with change management; ServiceNow or Jira Service Management a plus
  • Experience in travel technology, hospitality, or other high-volume, customer-facing SaaS
  • Exposure to ML/AI infrastructure, including data pipeline reliability and model serving on AWS

Compensation

The good faith compensation for this position is

United States: $160,000 - $180,000 USD

Compensation is determined based on several factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and skill set, geographic location, as well as internal alignment and external benchmarks.

Other Duties

Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time according to business needs.

The performance of additional responsibilities if you are designated as a Data Protection Champion (DPC), Senior Information Risk Owner (SIRO) or Information Assurance Accounting Officer (IAAO).

Work Environment

This position operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to stand, walk; use hands to finger, handle or feel; and reach with hands and arms.
