jobs.description:
ABOUT BAD MARKETING:

We're a team of 130+ passionate leaders and creatives who have worked diligently to make BAD Marketing one of the largest and most robust Growth Marketing Agencies in the world. At the core of our philosophy is the belief that excellence stems from a united team working toward a common objective: to not only help our clients grow profitably but also to provide them with an experience they can’t find anywhere else.

We specialize in local lead generation, e-commerce, and information marketing, catering to clients that span from auto and local shop owners to online consumer product brand owners, online gurus selling courses or coaching, and more.

Our approach to success involves more than just Bold And Disruptive strategies. We invest in our team through extensive training, continuous support for growth and learning, and the cultivation of a happy and confident company culture. For us, finding fulfillment in your career is just as crucial as excelling in it.

ABOUT THIS POSITION:

We're looking for a Tracking and Attribution Specialist - someone who can own the measurement layer across our info/coaching division and make sure every number our media buyers optimize against and our strategists report to clients is actually true.

You'll serve all pods across 20-30 clients, each with a different setup, across mostly paid platform (some email) traffic. We run on Meta, Google/YouTube, and TikTok, and on whatever platform a client needs next. Client reporting runs through our custom dashboards/system, and our clients use a mix of third-party attribution tools (Hyros primarily, but some other similar platforms). You report to the Director of Operations, who owns the overall systems architecture. You own the tracking and attribution domain within it.

This is a specialist role within our martech function. You'll work alongside our MarTech team, who also handle tracking work, but tracking and attribution is your specialty and your domain. You're the person the division comes to when something about tracking is unclear, broken, or new. When we launch a client on a paid platform nobody here has used, you're the one who investigates it, learns it, and comes back with how we should set up the tracking. When Meta, Hyros, and Stripe all show different purchase counts, you're the one who can explain why and which number to trust.

Tracking breaks quietly. An event stops firing after a page edit, deduplication fails, a UTM gets mistyped on an email. You're not waiting for a media buyer to notice two weeks later - you've built the monitoring that catches it first. And because you're working across 20-30 clients, every setup, fix, and change you make gets documented so anyone on the team can pick it up.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:

  • Media buyers and strategists trust the data because you've verified it - not because they assumed it was right
  • Broken events get caught by your monitoring, not by someone wondering why performance dropped
  • New launches go live with verified tracking, and you keep verifying it after launch as pages, platforms, and integrations change
  • Every client has a current tracking record in their funnel bible - what's installed, how it's configured, what changed, and why - clear enough that someone else could troubleshoot from it
  • UTMs are consistent across paid and organic, so organic traffic is actually attributable
  • When platform and attribution numbers don't line up, you explain the gap in plain language a strategist can repeat to a client
  • When we move onto a new platform, you've already figured out how to track it
  • You fix the same problem once. The second time, it becomes a checklist, a template, or an automated check

A DAY IN THIS ROLE:

Morning: Review what your automated event health checks flagged overnight across clients - broken events, deduplication issues, Event Match Quality drops, unexpected volume changes. Triage by business impact. Check the ClickUp queue and Slack for anything urgent from media buyers or strategists.

Throughout the day:

  • Implement and fix tracking - GTM tags and triggers, Meta CAPI (including the CRM-side setup an integration needs), Google enhanced conversions, GA4, TikTok and YouTube conversion tracking, attribution platform connections
  • Run tracking checks on new launches before they go live, and on live funnels when something changes
  • Work through your audit rotation - take a client's full setup and come back with what's broken, what's at risk, and what to fix first
  • Explain discrepancies to strategists and media buyers, and push back when a requested setup is going to produce bad data
  • Update each client's tracking record as you make changes - not at the end of the week

Weekly rhythm: Cross-client event health review, UTM hygiene checks on new campaigns and emails, and a watch on platform tracking changes that could affect our setups. Monthly, you reconcile platform, attribution, and source data for each active client.

End of day: You can answer: Did I act on every monitoring exception? Is every change I made today documented? Does anyone need a status update from me?

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 2+ years in a marketing technology, marketing operations, or technical marketing role, with tracking and attribution as your core strength - ideally at an agency or across multiple accounts
  • Deep Meta tracking knowledge - Pixel vs. Conversions API, standard vs. custom events, deduplication, Event Match Quality, Events Manager diagnostics
  • Google Tag Manager - you build and debug containers, data layers, and triggers yourself
  • GA4 and Google Ads conversion tracking, including enhanced conversions
  • Tracking experience on at least one platform beyond Meta and Google (TikTok, YouTube, or similar)
  • Working knowledge of Hyros and at least one other third-party attribution platform (Triple Whale, Northbeam, or similar)
  • UTM strategy, click IDs, and cross-domain tracking - you understand how parameters pass from click to CRM to report
  • Reporting literacy - you understand how tracking data becomes a report and can spec what a report needs
  • Comfortable reading documentation and figuring out unfamiliar platforms independently
  • Clear written communication. You operate in Slack and ClickUp, not meetings, and you need to explain technical issues so non-technical people can act on them

Strongly preferred:

  • Experience in direct response, info/coaching, or performance marketing environments
  • SQL and BigQuery familiarity/working knowledge
  • CRM integrations for server-side events (HubSpot, GoHighLevel, or similar)
  • GoHighLevel or ClickFunnels experience

YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF:

  • You want to own a domain/specialty
  • You document by default - you'd rather write it down once than explain it three times
  • You build systems, not one-offs. Solving the same problem twice bothers you
  • You understand how a broken event affects campaign optimization and the numbers clients see, not just the tag itself
  • You're energized by figuring out platforms you've never used
  • You use AI heavily for audits, documentation, debugging, and monitoring; you're open about how, and you know where it gets tracking wrong

THIS MAY NOT BE FOR YOU IF:

  • You think this role is mainly CRM implementation, email automation, or workflow building - those are part of martech, but in this role they're the exception, not the job
  • Your tracking experience is mostly installing pixels and tags someone else configured - you haven't set up or debugged Conversions API, GTM, or server-side events yourself
  • You haven't had to reconcile numbers across ad platforms and attribution tools, or you're not interested in why they disagree
  • You'd rather fix things as they're reported than build monitoring that catches them first
  • Documentation feels like extra work
  • You need training or detailed instructions before you can work in an unfamiliar platform
  • You'd rather keep your AI use quiet than show us your workflow
  • Written async communication isn't your strength

Project Highlights

What this project involves

We're looking for physicians (MD/DO) with an active, unrestricted US medical license to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation project. General and internal medicine are the main focus. Each task is a written clinical case, assessed against the project's acceptance criteria. Contributors may:

  • Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor "trap" answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
  • Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
  • Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales.

Each case receives three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You're improving the AI tools you'll eventually use yourself.

What we look for

This project is a good fit for US-licensed physicians looking for a flexible, time-limited project they can fit around their other commitments. Ideally, contributors will have:

  • Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified at onboarding and re-checked monthly);
  • Board certification or completed residency training, with direct patient care experience (attending-level preferred). Practising or retired physicians welcome;
  • Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine);
  • Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines;
  • Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus);
  • Strong written English (C1+).

This project is not suitable for medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join the project → Complete tasks → Get paid for approved tasks

Flexibility

You decide whether, when, and how much to contribute. There are no minimum hours, set schedules, or required availability. Task availability varies with project phases. Tasks are submitted through the platform and are approved when they meet the project’s acceptance criteria.

Earnings

Earnings are paid only for completed and approved tasks. Each task type has a fixed rate. There is no time tracking and no hour logging. There are no tiers or speed adjustments to the rate. QA and adjudication tasks have a higher per-task rate.

jobs.description:
Job Purpose

Job Purpose

We're looking for a leader to build and scale our Global Readiness Assurance Center of Excellence, extending RWS's proven testing capabilities into a broader, higher-value assurance offering. You will take an established strategic direction, shape it into a differentiated market proposition, and orchestrate the people, partners and delivery models needed to make it real. This is a role for someone who is energized by adapting a vision to make it a reality. They will also be leading some of the key strategic opportunities as a subject matter expert with a commercial hat. This is a dual-mandate role: half the job is building the internal engine (solution design, value optimization, market positioning, orchestrating sales to delivery working with partners etc.,), and half is being the face of the practice to clients — winning trust, consulting, sharing thought leadership, and turning pilots into repeatable revenue. Reporting to the Global Head of Testing, this position is an anchor role in designing the DNA and identity of RWS in global markets.

About RWS

The NASA Transform unit is part of the RWS Group, a unique, world-leading provider of technology-enabled language, content, data and intellectual property solutions. Through content transformation and multilingual data analysis, our unique combination of technology and cultural expertise helps our clients to grow by ensuring they are understood anywhere, in any language.

Our purpose is unlocking global understanding. We work with over 80% of the world’s top 100 brands, more than three-quarters of Fortune’s 20 ‘Most Admired Companies’ and almost all of the top pharmaceutical companies, investment banks, law firms and patent filers. Our client base spans Europe, Asia Pacific and North and South America. Our 65+ global locations across five continents service clients in the automotive, chemical, financial, legal, medical, pharmaceutical, technology and telecommunications sectors.

Founded in 1958, RWS is headquartered in the UK and publicly listed on AIM, the London Stock Exchange regulated market (RWS.L).

For further information, please visit: RWS

Job Overview

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and execute the CoE strategy, roadmap, and operating model for the testing offering
  • Build and maintain testing methodology, automation frameworks, accelerators, and reference architectures — with particular attention to Global Readiness given RWS's brand and offering
  • Own the tool stack point of view (build vs. buy vs. partner) and manage vendor/alliance relationships
  • Establish estimation models, staffing pyramids, and quality benchmarks (defect leakage, coverage, cycle time)
  • Partner with pre-sales/solutioning on RFP responses, effort estimation, and proposal development for GRA/testing engagements
  • Convert pilot engagements into referenceable case studies and expand relationships into recurring revenue
  • Develop case studies derived from exciting and ongoing client engagements
  • Drive the shift from traditional QA toward modern quality engineering practices, including AI-enabled testing where relevant
  • Own certification and career-path frameworks for the practice's talent pool
  • Engage in client facing sales activities to secure new business wins and coordinate with Marketing as appropriate.
  • Positively promote RWS services and products at all times.
  • Work with RWS marketing to inform and steer appropriate campaigns.
  • Adhere to corporate branding guidelines in all proposals, emails and general communications.

Objectives

  • Establish CoE: Build off of existing knowledge, capabilities and offerings to establish a GRA/Testing offering for RWS.
  • Thought leadership: Develop and deliver new innovative solutions and market-leading offerings for clients.
  • Expand Solution Offerings: Identify opportunities to introduce new services or products that address evolving client needs and bring ideas to reality through innovation & entrepreneurial approach.
  • Innovation in value proposition: Connects dots across disciplines (localization, AI, QA, compliance, CX) to create propositions competitors can't easily copy.
  • Develop pipeline working with GTM teams: Partner with sales leaders and account managers to develop market-ready solutions in the evolving world of requirements
  • Ensure Client Satisfaction: In complex engagements, develop and deliver solutions that deliver expected business outcome to clients.
  • Collaborate Across Departments: Work closely with sales, marketing, and product teams to align efforts and deliver integrated solutions to clients.
  • Stay Informed on Industry Trends: Keep abreast of market developments, competitor activities, and emerging opportunities to provide strategic value to clients.
  • Represent RWS in public forums: Be the expert in the room and deliver RWS’ vision, capabilities and value proposition with conviction and clarity.

Skills & Experience

  • 12+ years in product/software/globalization testing, with 3+ years in a practice-building, CoE, or client-facing leadership role
  • Proven track record standing up or scaling a Testing CoE or similar capability function
  • Experience with Globalization/localization/linguistic QA or content-heavy testing domains
  • Entrepreneurial spirit in taking idea to outcomes
  • Exposure to AI/ML-driven testing tools and quality engineering transformation
  • Experience with test automation frameworks and modern QA tooling (Selenium, Tricentis, Applitools, or equivalent)
  • Strong client relationship management experience — comfortable in front of senior stakeholders
  • Ability to present in public forums and large internal groups about GRA
  • Ability to develop proposals and business case for clients/internal needs
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (or equivalent experience)
  • Must value the customers success as much as your own.
  • Willingness to travel as needed to meet objectives.

Benefits

At RWS, we believe great people do their best work when they feel supported, empowered, and able to thrive both professionally and personally. That's why we offer:

    • Generous time away from work – Start with 25 days of paid time off (15 vacation days and 10 sick days), plus company holidays, a birthday day off, and paid time for volunteering in your community.
    • Comprehensive parental leave – Enjoy 100% paid parental leave, giving you the time and support you need during life's most important moments.
    • Retirement savings support – Plan for your future with our 401(k) retirement plan and company match.
    • Flexible ways of working – Benefit from our company-wide agile work policy, designed to support flexibility, trust, and work-life balance.
    • Growth and development opportunities – Access ongoing learning, professional development programs, and opportunities to expand your skills and career.
    • A collaborative and inclusive culture – Join a team of talented, supportive colleagues in a global environment that values diverse perspectives, innovation, and continuous learning.

Base Pay

$160,000 - $225,000 / year

Actual rate of pay may vary based on factors including, but not limited to: position offered, location, education, training, and/or experience. Total compensation may also include variable incentives, bonuses, benefits, and/or other perks, as outlined in any formal offer made.

*Candidates must reside in State advertised to be considered

Life at RWS

Life at RWS - If you like the idea of working with smart people who are passionate about growing the value of ideas, data and content by making sure organizations are understood, then you’ll love life at RWS.

Our purpose is to unlock global understanding. This means our work fundamentally recognizes the value of every language and culture. So, we celebrate difference, we are inclusive and believe that diversity makes us strong. We want every employee to grow as an individual and excel in their career.

In return, we expect all our people to live by the values that unite us: to partner, putting clients fist and winning together, to pioneer, innovating fearlessly and leading with vision and courage, to progress, aiming high and growing through actions and to deliver, owning the outcome and building trust with our colleagues and clients.

All employment decisions at RWS are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, religion, nationality, ethnicity, sex, age, disability, or sexual orientation. RWS Values

Get the 3Ps right – Partner, Pioneer, Progress – and we´ll Deliver together as RWS.

Company Overview

Planview has one mission: to close the gap between strategic intent and business outcome, providing the intelligence organizations need to act decisively.

As the global leader in Strategic Portfolio Management, Planview helps organizations of all sizes achieve their business goals, faster and smarter. Our comprehensive platform bring initiatives, investments, and resources into a continuous, connected model of the business: the actionable understanding leaders need to move decisively, keep teams and AI in lockstep, and know how their initiatives are performing.—now powered by Planview Anvi, our next-generation enterprise AI that delivers expert guidance, intelligent recommendations, and actionable insights, turning complex data into decisive action from strategy through execution.

Recognized as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Strategic Portfolio Management for the fifth consecutive year, we proudly serve more than 3,000customers globally, including 45% of the Fortune 100—and more than 3 million users worldwide.

Why Join Planview?

At Planview, our people’s connections drive our innovation and success. Our global team of 1,500+ employees work remotely and across offices in Austin, Vancouver, Hod HaSharon, Bangalore, Sydney, and Stockholm. We've built a world-class, connected culture rooted in shared values that empowers our teams to thrive and succeed from anywhere. When you join Planview, you're not just joining a company, you're joining a movement to transform how the world works.

Discover more about our portfolio at planview.com, and connect with us on LinkedIn,Instagram, and X.


The Opportunity

The Sr. Director/Director of AI and Subscription Services Delivery is a leadership role within the Professional Services Americas organization, accountable for the end-to-end delivery, quality, and P&L contribution of Planview's portfolio of subscription-based service offerings—including AI-enabled and Planview Anvi services—across the Americas. The Sr. Director will assess, develop, and expand the existing team into a high-performing, scalable delivery organization—one capable of driving consistent, measurable customer outcomes across all subscription service lines, with particular emphasis on practical AI adoption and value realization through Planview Anvi.

Acting as both a strategic business partner and a hands-on operational leader, this individual will connect professional services strategy to real customer results — partnering closely with the CIC delivery leadership, Sales (License & Services), Customer Value, Product, and Finance to protect and grow recurring revenue, deepen customer health, and expand Planview's footprint within the Americas customer base.


What You'll Do

SUBSCRIPTION SERVICES PORTFOLIO

Planview 360
Planview360 enables our customers to continuously realize value through strategic alignment, value realization, administrative assurance, expert partnership and proactive optimization.

Planview Adopt
Get the most from your Planview investment by accelerating user adoption and ensuring your teams are using the platform effectively.

Planview Advisor
Provide advanced portfolio analytics, scenario planning, and predictive insights to optimize investments, resources, and business outcomes.

Planview Anvi
Innovate and accelerate decision making through Planview Anvi and its AI-powered capabilities.

Guide customers in identifying high-value use cases, prioritizing agents, and embedding Anvi into their operating model for measurable business outcomes.

Remote Advisory

AI Strategy & Enablement

  • Help customers define practical AI strategies for portfolio, project, and work management use cases.
  • Assess readiness, prioritize value opportunities, and establish responsible adoption, governance, and change enablement practices.

AI Services Delivery

  • Design and deliver AI-related professional services—from use-case discovery and value assessment through Anvi enablement, agent and workflow configuration, and adoption.
  • Provide ongoing optimization and expert support as customer AI capabilities mature and expand.

STRATEGIC LEADERSHIP & P&L CONTRIBUTION

  • Define and execute the vision, operating model, and growth strategy for the Subscription Services Delivery practice in alignment with Professional Services and company-wide financial objectives.
  • Own and actively manage this function's contribution to the Professional Services P&L — driving revenue attainment, margin improvement, and resource utilization across the subscription portfolio.
  • Partner with CIC Delivery, Sales and Customer Value to develop go-to-market packaging, pricing, and positioning for subscription service offerings that improve attach rates and expand recurring revenue.
  • Provide regular financial and business performance updates to the VP of Professional Services — Americas, with clear visibility into bookings, revenue recognition, headcount costs, and margin trends.
  • Influence product roadmap and service innovation by synthesizing delivery insights, customer feedback, and market signals into actionable recommendations for Planview Anvi, AI capabilities, Product, and Center of Excellence leadership.

TEAM LEADERSHIP & ORGANIZATIONAL DEVELOPMENT

  • Lead and evolve the existing subscription services team—conducting a rapid assessment of team strengths, skill gaps, capacity, and structural alignment, while building capabilities in AI strategy, Planview Anvi enablement, and AI services delivery.
  • Develop a team-building roadmap that outlines hiring priorities, role definitions, and organizational design needed to scale delivery capacity and AI-services expertise in support of growth targets across the Americas.
  • Recruit, develop, and retain a high-performing team of delivery managers, consultants, advisors, and technical specialists across the subscription services portfolio.
  • Build a team culture grounded in accountability, customer obsession, continuous learning, and inclusive collaboration.
  • Establish career development frameworks, skills matrices, and mentoring programs that support growth, retention, and internal mobility.

DELIVERY EXCELLENCE & OPERATIONS

  • Oversee delivery quality, capacity planning, resource allocation, and utilization across the full subscription services portfolio in the Americas.
  • Establish and continuously improve scalable delivery frameworks, playbooks, and methodologies that ensure consistent, repeatable customer outcomes—including repeatable approaches for Planview Anvi adoption and AI-related services delivery.
  • Define and own KPIs for the practice—including customer health scores, Anvi adoption, AI use-case activation, time-to-value, on-time delivery, CSAT/NPS, margin performance, and renewal/expansion rates—and lead the team to meet or exceed targets.
  • Drive operational rigor through robust forecasting, pipeline management, and cadenced business reviews with the VP of Professional Services — Americas and cross-functional leadership.

CUSTOMER OUTCOMES & VALUE REALIZATION

  • Architect and drive customer value realization strategies that ensure subscribers achieve defined business outcomes at each stage of their engagement lifecycle, from AI use-case discovery through Planview Anvi adoption and ongoing optimization.
  • Collaborate with Customer Value on customer health scoring, risk identification, and proactive intervention strategies that protect and grow the renewal base across the Americas.
  • Lead the delivery of AI-related professional services with appropriate governance, change management, and adoption practices—translating emerging AI capabilities into practical customer outcomes and measurable value.
  • Serve as a trusted executive advisor to key strategic accounts — participating in EBRs and QBRs and maintaining senior-level relationships across the customer portfolio.
  • Champion the voice of the customer internally — translating delivery experience into service improvements, product enhancements, and commercial expansion opportunities.

What You'll Bring

REQUIRED

  • 5+ years in a senior leadership role managing multi-functional delivery teams and complex service portfolios.

  • Deep understanding of the SaaS customer lifecycle — from onboarding through renewal, expansion, and advocacy.
  • Experience managing executive-level customer relationships across the Americas region.
  • Strong commercial acumen with a demonstrated ability to connect services strategy to bookings and recurring revenue outcomes.
  • Excellent communication, executive presence, and cross-functional influencing skills.

  • Ability and willingness to travel approximately 30% across the Americas.
PREFERRED
  • Experience with portfolio and project management, work management, or enterprise transformation software.
  • Familiarity with Planview's product portfolio or competitive landscape.
  • Background leading AI, automation, advisory, or product-enabled services teams—particularly in a subscription or managed services model.
  • Experience with Planview Anvi or a comparable AI, agent, or intelligent-workflow platform, including use-case prioritization, enablement, governance, and adoption.

Now is a great time to join our team. If you are looking for a place to grow your career, innovate with best-in-class solutions, and build the future of connected work, Planview is the right place for you!

jobs.description:
Chief Digital Officer (CDO) – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Chief Digital Officer (CDO) is responsible for developing and executing the organization's digital strategy, leading enterprise-wide digital transformation, and leveraging technology to improve operational efficiency, customer experience, innovation, and business growth across insurance and investment operations.

The CDO will oversee digital platforms, technology-enabled business transformation, automation, data-driven innovation, and digital product development. Working closely with executive leadership and business units, the role will ensure that digital capabilities support the organization's strategic objectives, enhance competitiveness, and deliver secure, scalable, and customer-centric financial services.

2. Key Responsibilities

Digital Strategy & Transformation

  • Develop and implement the organization's enterprise-wide digital strategy and transformation roadmap.
  • Identify opportunities to modernize business processes through technology, automation, and digital innovation.
  • Align digital initiatives with corporate strategy, business growth, operational priorities, and customer expectations.
  • Lead large-scale digital transformation programs across insurance, investment, finance, and corporate functions.
  • Establish digital governance frameworks, transformation priorities, budgets, and performance measures.

Digital Platforms & Product Development

  • Oversee the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of digital platforms, customer portals, mobile applications, and online service channels.
  • Drive digital insurance solutions, including online policy applications, premium payments, claims submissions, renewals, and policy servicing.
  • Support digital investment platforms for account management, portfolio reporting, transactions, and client engagement, where applicable.
  • Collaborate with product, technology, and business teams to develop innovative digital financial products and services.
  • Ensure platforms are scalable, accessible, user-friendly, and aligned with customer and business requirements.

Technology Innovation & Emerging Solutions

  • Identify and evaluate emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, cloud computing, robotic process automation (RPA), blockchain, and advanced analytics.
  • Promote technology adoption to improve underwriting, claims processing, customer service, risk assessment, investment operations, and reporting.
  • Lead proof-of-concept initiatives and evaluate the commercial value of new technologies.
  • Establish partnerships with fintech companies, insurtech providers, technology vendors, and digital solution providers.
  • Monitor digital industry trends and translate relevant innovations into practical business opportunities.

Data & Analytics

  • Develop a data-driven organizational culture through effective data governance, analytics, and business intelligence.
  • Oversee digital analytics capabilities to support customer insights, business performance, risk assessment, and strategic decision-making.
  • Collaborate with data teams to develop dashboards, predictive models, and reporting systems.
  • Improve data accessibility, quality, accuracy, and consistency across business units.
  • Ensure responsible data use and compliance with applicable privacy and data protection requirements.

Operational Automation & Efficiency

  • Identify opportunities to automate manual and repetitive business processes.
  • Drive workflow digitization across underwriting, claims, policy administration, investment operations, finance, HR, and compliance.
  • Improve process efficiency, service turnaround times, productivity, and cost effectiveness.
  • Promote integration between enterprise systems, CRM platforms, policy administration systems, and financial applications.
  • Measure the operational impact and return on investment of digital transformation initiatives.

Cybersecurity, Data Protection & Digital Risk

  • Work closely with IT, information security, risk, and compliance teams to ensure secure digital operations.
  • Promote cybersecurity awareness and responsible technology practices.
  • Ensure digital platforms comply with applicable financial services regulations, privacy laws, and data protection standards.
  • Support business continuity, disaster recovery, and technology resilience initiatives.
  • Establish appropriate controls for third-party technology providers and digital service partners.

Digital Customer Experience

  • Improve customer journeys through seamless digital onboarding, self-service, communication, and service delivery.
  • Collaborate with the Chief Experience Officer, marketing, and business teams to improve digital customer engagement.
  • Use customer feedback, analytics, and usability testing to enhance digital platforms.
  • Expand digital access to insurance products, investment services, and financial information.
  • Promote consistent experiences across websites, mobile applications, branches, and other customer touchpoints.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Lead digital transformation, digital product, data, and technology strategy teams.
  • Establish digital performance objectives, budgets, governance structures, and delivery accountability.
  • Collaborate with the CIO, CTO, CISO, COO, CXO, and business leaders to coordinate technology priorities.
  • Manage relationships with technology vendors, implementation partners, consultants, and strategic digital partners.
  • Present digital strategy, transformation progress, investment requirements, and performance results to the CEO and Board.

3. Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Master's degree in Technology Management, Digital Transformation, Business Administration, or a relevant discipline preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in digital transformation, technology leadership, IT strategy, digital product development, or technology-enabled business innovation.
  • At least 5 years in a senior leadership or executive technology/digital management position.
  • Experience in insurance, banking, investment management, wealth management, fintech, or other regulated financial services.
  • Proven track record of leading enterprise-wide digital transformation and technology modernization initiatives.
  • Strong knowledge of digital platforms, cloud technologies, enterprise systems, automation, data analytics, and emerging technologies.
  • Experience managing technology budgets, digital projects, vendor relationships, and cross-functional teams.
  • Understanding of cybersecurity, data governance, regulatory compliance, and technology risk management.
  • Strong strategic thinking, commercial awareness, communication, and stakeholder management capabilities.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Progress against the enterprise digital transformation roadmap.
  • Digital adoption and active usage rates across customer channels.
  • Percentage of business processes digitized or automated.
  • Reduction in operational costs and manual processing time.
  • Digital customer acquisition and onboarding rates.
  • Digital platform availability, reliability, and performance.
  • Customer satisfaction with digital products and services.
  • Return on investment (ROI) of digital initiatives.
  • Data quality, analytics adoption, and reporting effectiveness.
  • Cybersecurity incidents and digital risk mitigation performance.
  • Delivery of digital projects within approved budgets and timelines.
  • Revenue generated or supported through digital channels.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role:

Let’s be honest: 2026 is a strange time to be in Talent Acquisition. Most recruiters are currently looking at their own internal dashboards with a sense of unease. They’re seeing the pivots, the shrinking req loads, and the ‘doing more with less’ memos. If you’re currently at a startup that’s struggling to find its footing, or a business where the hiring bar has dropped just to fill seats, you know exactly how fragile that ‘growth’ story feels.

Samsara is the exception. We are a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $2B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy.

And we aren't just stable—we’re expanding. Our UK Mid-Market team grew 70% year-over-year last year, and we need the talent engine to match that velocity. We aren't looking for someone to manage inbounds; we’re looking for a recruiter who wants to move from a shaky seat into a high-conviction, high-growth environment where the fundamentals actually make sense.

The Challenge:

  • Self-Sourced: You own your destiny. You will be expected to find, engage, and convert your own pipeline using best-in-class tools like HireEZ, Juicebox, and LinkedIn Recruiter.
  • The High Talent Bar: We aren't looking for CV pushers. You will be expected to act as a rigorous gatekeeper, ensuring that only the top 1% of gritty, A player sales hunters make it into our process.
  • Technical Assessment: You aren't checking vibes. You will be conducting deep-dive sales assessments, evaluating discovery mechanics, and ensuring every candidate has a structured methodology for success.

In this role, you will:

  • Execute & Deliver: Your mission is to fuel the Sales Account Executive engine. You will deliver high-quality, targeted pipelines at pace across EMEA, including the UK, France, Germany, and the Netherlands.
  • Own the Data: You are the CEO of your funnel. You will have total ownership of your response rates, passthrough rates, and talent market mapping. We make decisions based on data, not gut feel.
  • Partner with Sales Heavyweights: Work directly with our Sales VP and GTM leaders to align on hiring strategies that move the needle. You are a consultant, not an order-taker.
  • Master the Craft of Strategic Talent Acquisition: We hire for execution but develop for mastery. You will be mentored by some of the most sophisticated talent leaders in SaaS, learning how to move beyond execution to becoming a strategic talent partner who can influence the trajectory of an entire region.

Strong Backgrounds successful in this role:

  • The Agency Foundation: You started your career in a fast-paced recruiting agency. You still have that hunter DNA and the resilience to handle a relentless quarterly pace.
  • In-House Impact: In-house SaaS sales recruiting experience within a high-talent bar GTM organisation. You've proven you can translate agency grit into internal success.
  • EMEA Experience: You’ve successfully closed reqs in the UK and at least one other European market.
  • Technical Acumen: You can speak the language of sales. You know the difference between an order-taker and a territory owner. You have experience hiring for a scaling playbook environment and understand how to identify the elite within this market from the B players.

The Ideal Candidate is:

  • Foundational Mastery: The goal is to bridge the gap between execution and influence. You are here to build the bulletproof foundations of an exceptional recruiter—learning how to own a region, influence high-level stakeholders, and use data as a weapon.
  • Focused & Structured: You understand that structuring your inputs—sourcing volume, message personalization, and rigorous screening—is the only way to get consistent output.
  • Data-Minded: You study your own conversion rates and market talent availability to stay ahead of hiring needs.
  • Continuous Process Iteration: You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You iterate on your outreach and your screening questions based on what the data tells you.

What’s in it for you?

  • Build the Foundation for Leadership: We believe leadership is a set of skills, not just a job title. In this role, you will develop the data literacy to lead a boardroom with metrics, the strategic insight to advise VPs on market conditions, and the technical acumen to assess elite GTM talent.
  • Elite Exposure: You will be exposed to a broad range of international roles and learn from some of the best sales and recruiting leaders in the industry.
  • The Fortress Stability: NYSE-listed, GAAP profitable, and essential to the global economy. We are building for the long term, which means your career development here is backed by real revenue, not just a VC’s hopes.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer, we don't just keep industry moving, we help some of the world's most critical sectors operate more efficiently, reliably and sustainably. With a heritage spanning almost 200 years, more than 13,000 employees worldwide and operations serving customers across over 160 countries, Sulzer is a global leader in fluid engineering and services. As Senior Commercial Contract Manager, you will work directly alongside senior leadership to drive commercial excellence across complex global projects, claims, contracts and customer relationships. You will act as a commercial co-pilot to the business, translating contractual positions into practical commercial outcomes that protect margin, unlock revenue opportunities and strengthen customer partnerships.


This role is an individual contributor position initially, but offers a significant opportunity for growth. As the function expands, the successful candidate will play a key role in shaping the team, influencing strategy and positioning themselves for future leadership opportunities.


For the right person, this is a rare chance to join early, make a visible impact and grow with the business.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to project teams, helping drive commercially sound decisions throughout project delivery
  • Identify, negotiate and deliver change orders, variation claims and revenue opportunities
  • Support the prevention and resolution of commercial disputes, claims and contractual challenges

  • Influence stakeholders across regions and functions to maintain momentum and deliver outcomes
  • Protect Sulzer's contractual position while maintaining strong customer relationships

  • Contribute to continuous improvement, commercial governance and modern digital ways of working

We're looking for a commercially minded professional who can see beyond the contract and focus on the business outcome.

You will likely bring:

  • Significant experience in commercial contract management, claims management, project commercial management or a similar discipline
  • Experience within engineering, industrial, manufacturing, EPC, energy, oil & gas or related sectors
  • Strong negotiation and dispute resolution skills
  • A track record of managing commercial risk while identifying opportunities for value creation
  • Experience influencing senior stakeholders across complex organisations
  • Strong commercial judgement and business acumen

Who Will Thrive Here?

This role would suit someone who is ready for more responsibility, influence and long-term career progression.

You'll enjoy this role if you:

  • Like solving commercial challenges rather than simply administering contracts
  • Enjoy working across functions, projects and international teams

  • Take ownership and make things happen
  • Can balance customer relationships with strong commercial discipline
  • Want to help build something rather than inherit a fully established structure
  • Aspire to move into more senior leadership positions in the future

This role is unlikely to suit someone seeking a highly structured environment with clearly defined boundaries and predictable day-to-day activity.


Location & Travel

  • UK-based remote role with flexibility for hybrid working from any Sulzer location
  • International travel as required, typically less than 15%

  • Defined pension contributions.
  • Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.
  • Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.
  • Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco membership.
  • Discounted personal car leasing for you your family and friends.
  • Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.
  • Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.
  • As a Silver Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we welcome and support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers with policies for training, camps and deployment, plus a growing internal military network.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Director, Business Development, Feedstock
jobs.excerpt: At Mobius Renewables, we’re helping lead the global energy transition by transforming waste into renewable energy and measurable decarbonization.
jobs.description:
At Mobius Renewables, we’re helping lead the global energy transition by transforming waste into renewable energy and measurable decarbonization. We’re a fast-growing team of expert innovators, engineers, and problem-solvers committed to advancing global sustainability, fueling a circular economy, and creating a cleaner future for all. Join us and help shape the future of renewable energy.

Mobius Renewables is seeking a commercially driven Business Development professional focused on sourcing industrial organic feedstocks for host-site anaerobic digestion and co-digestion opportunities. The role will identify, qualify, test, and help secure feedstock streams that can increase methane production while remaining compatible with each host site's process, infrastructure, operating limits, permits, and feedstock acceptance requirements.

This is a targeted industrial-feedstock origination role. The focus is on source-separated residuals and by-products generated by industrial production companies. Mobius is not seeking post-consumer food waste or material that requires DE packaging.

Core Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain a pipeline of industrial production companies that generate consistent, source-separated organic residuals or by-products suitable for anaerobic digestion or co-digestion.
  • Develop a strong network across food and beverage manufacturing, protein and agricultural processing, dairy processing, breweries and distilleries, and other industrial sectors with potentially digestible organic residual streams.
  • Originate opportunities directly with generators and establish relationships with plant, operations, environmental, sustainability, procurement, and waste-management decision-makers.
  • Collect the operating and commercial information needed to screen each opportunity, including feedstock type, source, expected volume, consistency, seasonality, current disposition, transportation considerations, contamination risks, and commercial expectations.
  • Coordinate representative sampling and laboratory testing of prospective feedstocks to determine whether the material is likely to provide a measurable methane-production benefit.
  • Work with Engineering, Operations, EHS/Environmental, and Project Development to evaluate feedstock compatibility with the receiving host site, including storage and handling, pretreatment needs, digester process impacts, permit constraints, and the site's ability to safely and reliably accept the material.
  • Do not advance a feedstock solely because it is available. Establish a clear technical, operational, and economic rationale for why the feedstock should be accepted at a specific host site.
  • Coordinate follow-up testing, trial loads, or site-specific validation when required before commercial scale-up.
  • Lead or support commercial discussions with feedstock generators, including supply terms, quality specifications, volume commitments, logistics responsibilities, pricing or tipping-fee structure, and remedies for off-spec material.
  • Maintain an organized funnel of prospective feedstocks and provide clear status reporting from first contact through testing, site approval, commercial negotiations, and onboarding.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure potential feedstocks support Mobius production, reliability, financial, and host-site objectives.

Feedstock Qualification Approach

  • Source qualification: Confirm the material is generated by an identifiable industrial production process and is available in a sufficiently consistent, controllable stream.
  • Material qualification: Obtain representative samples and coordinate appropriate analytical testing, including methane-potential testing when applicable, plus characteristics needed by the receiving site to assess compatibility.
  • Site fit: Match each feedstock to a specific host site based on the site's process design, receiving capability, operating envelope, existing feedstock mix, permits, and acceptance criteria.
  • Value validation: Demonstrate that expected incremental methane or other operating benefit justifies transportation, handling, testing, pretreatment, commercial, and operational requirements.
  • Controlled onboarding: Support documented approval and, where appropriate, a controlled trial before establishing recurring deliveries.

Target Feedstock Profile

  • Industrial production residuals and by-products with meaningful biodegradable organic content and methane-production potential.
  • Preference for pumpable liquids, slurries, or other materials that can be received and handled within the capabilities of the applicable host site.
  • Predictable, source-separated streams with traceable origin and reasonably consistent composition and volume.
  • Materials that can be economically transported to an appropriate Mobius host site.
  • Excluded focus: post-consumer food waste, packaged consumer waste, and materials requiring depackaging.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Agribusiness, Environmental Science, Engineering, Supply Chain, Food Science, or a related field preferred; relevant industry experience may substitute for degree requirements.
  • 5+ years of business development, industrial sourcing, organics/feedstock procurement, food or beverage manufacturing, agricultural processing, waste/by-product management, anaerobic digestion, renewable natural gas, or a related field preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to prospect, build relationships, and develop a network of industrial production companies and decision-makers.
  • Commercial judgment with the ability to understand supply terms, transportation economics, quality specifications, and long-term supply reliability.
  • Ability to work effectively with technical teams and translate laboratory, operational, and site-acceptance feedback into commercial sourcing decisions.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, organization, CRM/pipeline management, and follow-through skills.
  • Comfort working independently in a remote, cross-functional environment and managing multiple feedstock opportunities at different stages.
  • Ability to travel less than 20%, primarily for generator visits, host-site evaluations, sampling, trials, and strategic industry meetings.

Success Measures

  • Qualified industrial feedstock pipeline aligned to specific host-site needs.
  • Feedstock opportunities supported by representative testing and documented site acceptance review.
  • Incremental methane-production potential and commercial value established before recurring supply is implemented.
  • Reliable supply relationships with clear specifications, logistics responsibilities, and accountability for off-spec material.
  • Consistent coordination among Business Development, Engineering, Operations, EHS/Environmental, Project Development, and host-site stakeholders.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a high-energy originator who enjoys building industrial relationships but is disciplined enough to qualify opportunities technically before pursuing volume. This person understands that successful feedstock development is not simply finding waste; it is finding the right material, proving its value, matching it to the right host site, and developing a dependable supply relationship that improves methane production without compromising site performance.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

  • Performs site qualification, site initiation, interim monitoring, site management activities and close-out visits (performed on-site or remotely) ensuring regulatory, ICH-GCP and/or Good Pharmacoepidemiology Practice (GPP) and protocol compliance. Uses judgment and experience to evaluate overall performance of site and site staff and to provide recommendations regarding site-specific actions; immediately communicates/escalates serious issues to the project team and develops action plans. Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes.
  • Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient, as required/appropriate. Demonstrates diligence in protecting the confidentiality of each subject/patient. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues.
  • Per the Clinical Monitoring/Site Management Plan (CMP/SMP): Assesses site processes. Conducts Source Document Review of appropriate site source documents and medical records. Verifies required clinical data entered in the case report form (CRF) is accurate and complete. Applies query resolution techniques remotely and on site, and provides guidance to site staff as necessary, driving query resolution to closure within agreed timelines. Utilizes available hardware and software to support the effective conduct of the clinical study data review and capture. Verifies site compliance with electronic data capture requirements.
  • May perform investigational product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security. Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned.
  • Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations.
  • Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs and Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and assigned action items to resolution.
  • For assigned activities, understands project scope, budgets, and timelines; manages site-level activities / communication to ensure project objectives, deliverables and timelines are met. Must be able to quickly adapt to changing priorities to achieve goals / targets.
  • May act as primary liaison with study site personnel, or in collaboration with Central Monitoring Associate. Ensures all assigned sites and project-specific site team members are trained and compliant with applicable requirements
  • Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face to face meetings. Participates in global clinical monitoring/project staff meetings (inclusive of Sponsor representation, as applicable) and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements.
  • Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow-up actions.
  • Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes; completes assigned training as required. For Real World Late Phase, the CRA II will use the business card title of Site Management Associate II. Additional responsibilities include:Site support throughout the study lifecycle from site identification through close-out. Knowledge of local requirements for real world late phase study designs.Chart abstraction activities and data collection
    Collaboration with Sponsor affiliates, medical science liaisons and local country staff. The SMA II may be requested to train junior staff. Identify and communicate out of scope activities to Lead CRA/Project Manager. Proactively suggest potential sites based on local knowledge of treatment patterns, patient advocacy and Health Care Provider (HCP) associations.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training and experience
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
  • Must demonstrate good computer skills and be able to embrace new technologies
  • Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to manage required travel of up to 75% on a regular basis
  • US ONLY: As part of your employment with Syneos Health, you may be deployed to Sites that require certain medical and other personal information to gain facility access. Pursuant to our Employee Privacy Notice, Syneos Health can provide the Sites with the information necessary for you to gain such access. Further, a Site may ask you for additional information beyond that which Syneos Health has in its possession. You are required to comply with any such Site requests as a condition of your employment with Syneos Health. Please note that failure to provide requested information may result in a Site barring you from entry, which could put your ongoing employment at risk.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

jobs.excerpt: AECOM is seeking an experienced Secure Facilities Technical Engineering - Mission Critical & Secure Facilities to support our national Mission Critical and Secure Facilities practice, providing technical leadership for the design and execution of secure and classified facilities for U.
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking an experienced Secure Facilities Technical Engineering - Mission Critical & Secure Facilities to support our national Mission Critical and Secure Facilities practice, providing technical leadership for the design and execution of secure and classified facilities for U.S. federal, Department of War, and Intelligence Community clients.

This role is focused on the technical implementation of ICD 705, SCIF, SAPF, Open Storage Secret (OSS), TEMPEST, and related security requirements, translating security criteria into coordinated, constructible architectural and engineering solutions, construction documents, specifications, and technical details.

The successful candidate will serve as a technical liaison between government security stakeholders and multidisciplinary project teams and possess a strong understanding of how physical and technical security requirements integrate with architectural, engineering, telecommunications, audiovisual, electronic security, and other building systems. The position will support projects throughout both CONUS and OCONUS locations.

Key Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Serve as a technical lead for secure facility design and execution, interpreting and applying ICD 705, SCIF, SAPF, OSS, TEMPEST, and related physical and technical security criteria.
  • Translate security requirements into coordinated design criteria, construction documents, specifications, technical details, and constructible solutions.
  • Lead multidisciplinary coordination with architects, engineers, technology and security specialists, contractors, and government stakeholders, including SSMs, SSOs, CTTAs, and Accrediting Officials.
  • Develop and review technical solutions for secure perimeter construction, doors and openings, penetrations, acoustic protection, access control, intrusion detection, and other physical security requirements.
  • Coordinate TEMPEST and RF mitigation strategies, including RF shielding, non-conductive breaks, waveguide-below-cutoff penetrations, power and signal filtering, grounding/bonding, and related countermeasures.
  • Conduct existing-condition surveys, facility assessments, and feasibility studies for new construction, renovation, conversion, and upgrade of secure environments.
  • Perform technical design, interdisciplinary coordination, quality-control, and constructability reviews to ensure security requirements are appropriately incorporated into project documentation.
  • Provide technical support during construction, including review of submittals, RFIs, shop drawings, field conditions, inspections, testing, and resolution of security-related issues, and support accreditation/certification and project closeout as applicable.
  • Support development and implementation of secure facility standards, specifications, details, tools, and best practices, while maintaining awareness of evolving government security criteria.
  • Support proposal development, technical approaches, scopes of work, and strategic growth opportunities for the Mission Critical and Secure Facilities practice.

Successful candidates will demonstrate the following critical qualifications and capabilities:

  • Demonstrated experience interpreting and implementing ICD 705, SCIF, SAPF, OSS, TEMPEST, and related secure facility requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate security requirements into construction drawings, specifications, technical details, and multidisciplinary design solutions.
  • Knowledge of secure perimeter construction and RF/TEMPEST mitigation techniques, including penetrations, shielding, non-conductive breaks, waveguide-below-cutoff protection, and power/signal filtering.
  • Strong understanding of multidisciplinary building systems and their interaction with physical and technical security requirements.
  • Experience with secure facility assessments, technical design reviews, and construction-phase support.
  • Strong technical leadership, coordination, written communication, and presentation skills.
  • Ability and willingness to travel periodically in support of CONUS and OCONUS projects.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related building design or technical discipline and 10+ years including two years of leadership, of professional experience, including significant experience with federal secure, classified, or mission-critical facilities or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
  • Professional registration appropriate to the candidate's discipline, such as Registered Architect (RA), or comparable professional credential.
  • Ability to pass drug, and background checks to work on Federal grounds, military installations, and school grounds.
  • This position requires U.S. citizenship due to federal contract/security requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 15+ years of professional experience, including 5+ years focused on SCIF, SAPF, TEMPEST, OSS, or comparable secure/classified facilities.
  • Advanced experience with the design, documentation, construction, inspection, and accreditation/certification of secure facilities.
  • Completion of recognized training related to ICD 705, SCIF/SAPF design and construction, TEMPEST, RF shielding, or related secure facility criteria.
  • Experience working directly with SSMs, SSOs, CTTAs, Accrediting Officials, and other government security authorities.
  • Experience developing secure facility standards, specifications, standard details, design guides, or quality-control procedures.
  • Experience supporting secure facility projects in both CONUS and OCONUS locations.
  • Experience with Autodesk Revit and BIM-based multidisciplinary coordination.
  • Active U.S. Government security clearance, or demonstrated ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance.

Ми у ProjectorInstituteстворюємо курси, які допомагають спеціалістам робити якісний стрибок у професії. Працюємо з практиками з індустрії й будуємо навчання навколо реального досвіду, а не теорії.

Для цього курсу ми шукаємо не просто сильного маркетолога. Нам потрібен/на CMO, Marketing Director, VP Marketing, Head of Growth або стратегічний маркетинг-лідер/ка, який/яка проходив/ла через масштабування маркетингової функції, захист бюджету перед CEO/CFO, перебудову команди, впровадження AI, складні рішення щодо brand/performance балансу, атрибуції, MarTech і впливу CMO на бізнес-стратегію.

(на створення курсу передбачено 2–3 місяці, далі — запуск і проведення)

Кого ми бачимо перед собою, коли уявляємо ідеальногоавтора/ку курсу “CMO Advanced”
  • ти маєш досвід CMO / Marketing Director / VP Marketing / Head of Growth на рівні, де маркетинг відповідає не лише за ліди, охоплення чи кампанії, а за бізнес-результат
  • працював/ла з компаніями на етапі росту або масштабування і знаєш, що маркетингова система, яка добре працювала на одному етапі, може почати ламатися на наступному
  • вмієш говорити з CEO, CFO і board мовою revenue, unit economics, інвестицій, ризиків, сценаріїв і стратегічних ставок
  • ти маєш досвід побудови або перебудови маркетингової функції
  • розумієш AI не як “ще один інструмент для контенту”, а як фактор, який змінює процеси, ролі, продуктивність, структуру команди і конкурентну перевагу бізнесу
  • можеш пояснити, як будувати marketing system design
  • ти маєш власні кейси — не лише успішні, а й складні
  • готовий/ва працювати з аудиторією сильних студентів: CMO, Marketing Director, Head of Marketing
  • вмієш фасилітувати peer-level середовище
Просто чудово і буде перевагою, коли ти також:
  • маєш досвід роботи у tech, product, SaaS, e-commerce, marketplace або іншому бізнесі, де маркетинг напряму пов’язаний із revenue, unit economics і масштабуванням
  • працював/ла з міжнародними ринками, новими сегментами або географічною експансією
  • проходив/ла через AI-трансформацію маркетингової команди
  • маєш досвід роботи з marketing analytics, attribution, incrementality, MMM, BI або MarTech-аудитом
  • можеш показати, як CMO працює з кризами: репутаційними, продуктовими, бюджетними, командними
  • викладав/ла, менторив/ла або консультував/ла senior-аудиторію і вмієш давати фідбек людям, які самі мають великий досвід
Тому якщо коротко, то загалом будуть 2 основні задачі:
  1. Написати програму курсу разом із командою Projector Institute:сформувати логіку навчання, теми, практичні завдання, кейси, домашки, формат фінального проєкту і критерії оцінювання.
    Курс має провести студентів від стану “я вже CMO, але моя система не встигає за бізнесом, AI і вимогами до revenue” до стану “я маю board-ready маркетингову стратегію, розумію, як перебудувати команду, захистити бюджет, впровадити AI і посилити роль маркетингу в бізнесі”.
  2. Провести курс: вести заняття, давати фідбек, розбирати реальні кейси студентів, модерувати складні дискусії, допомагати групі рухатися від окремих проблем до системних рішень і підготувати фінальний CMO Review у форматі, близькому до board review.

Бути частиною команди — це:
— працювати з сильною продюсерською командою
— мати свободу у створенні курсу, але з підтримкою методистів

— працювати з мотивованою аудиторією дорослих студентів
— розвивати свій публічний профіль як експерта

Нам важливо створити курс, після якого CMO не просто забере кілька нових фреймворків, а зможе по-іншому подивитися на свою роль, перебудувати маркетинг як growth engine і впевнено говорити з бізнесом мовою результату.
