jobs.description:
Documo is on a mission to help businesses digitize and streamline their document workflows. As a fast-growing B2B SaaS company, our platform makes it easier to handle unstructured files like faxes and forms through tools like Intelligent Document Processing - turning messy paperwork into structured, usable data. We believe great products start with great people. That’s why we invest in top talent, value strong culture, and prioritize customer success and design excellence.

If you’re excited to do impactful work and want to grow with a team that values innovation, collaboration, and purpose - we’d love to meet you!

About Documo

Documo helps healthcare organizations turn information into action. Referrals, records, and authorizations still arrive as faxes and forms, and someone has to read, sort, and key in every page. We automate that manual document work. Our platform combines HIPAA-compliant cloud fax, Direct Secure Messaging, and AI-powered document and workflow automation, so critical work moves faster and care teams get time back for patients.

We’re a small team, so everyone has real ownership and can see the impact of their work. We hire people who care about customers, sweat the details, and want to build something that matters in healthcare. If that sounds like you, we’d love to meet you.

The role

This is a pipeline generation role. You will decide who we target, when, why and with what message, then run integrated campaigns that carry that plan across our channels. Those channels include BDR outreach, events, LinkedIn and social, partner marketing, marketplaces, review sites, email, the website and paid media.

The job is campaign strategy and execution, not just channel management. You will need enough digital skill to work hands-on across web, email, social and paid, and you will help manage our paid media agency. You will work daily with the BDR team and sales, and with content, product marketing and SEO. Your ultimate KPI is pipeline.

What you'll own

Integrated and account-based campaigns

  • Own the integrated campaign calendar: one theme and offer per campaign, sequenced across outbound, website, events, email, LinkedIn, paid media (with our agency) and content.
  • Build and run our ABM program with sales: target account list, tiers (1:1 for top enterprise accounts, 1:few clusters by EHR or segment, 1:many for the broader ICP), and a play for each tier.
  • Launch a go-to-market campaign for each new EHR integration: buy and enrich lists of that EHR's customers, target the right ICP titles and specialties, and brief content on EHR-specific messaging and assets.
  • Build automated sales enablement that gives BDRs and AEs timely reasons to reach out to prospects and open opportunities, such as intent signals, EHR and technology fit, hiring, funding and event attendance.
  • Brief content, product marketing and web on the assets and landing pages each campaign needs.
  • Track engagement and pipeline at the account and buying-group level, not just leads.

BDR programs and outbound campaigns

  • Be marketing's partner to the BDR manager: you build the lists and messaging, they run the team and the daily outreach. You work side by side on what each segment needs.
  • Build target segments by ICP, EHR, specialty, organization size and buying trigger, with sales and the BDR manager.
  • Source, enrich and maintain prospect lists using Salesforce, HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, enrichment tools and intent data; keep data clean and routed.
  • Write messaging and multi-touch sequences (email, phone, LinkedIn) for each segment with the BDR manager; test, measure and retire what doesn't book meetings.
  • Run campaign sprints with the BDRs: account lists, talk tracks, offers and event follow-up plays.
  • Report weekly on meetings booked, meeting-to-opportunity conversion and pipeline by segment.

Inbound lead programs

  • Work with the website manager on campaign offers and CTAs, so each campaign's landing experience matches its segment and message.
  • Run nurture for leads that aren't ready to buy, and track MQL-to-SQL-to-pipeline conversion with sales.

Events

  • Own pipeline generation for every event on our calendar: industry shows such as HIMSS, EHR and partner events such as PointClickCare, and category events. Event selection, logistics and booth setup are run by our Content Marketing Manager.
  • Before the show: build target attendee and account lists, and run pre-event outreach with the BDRs to book meetings.
  • At the show: staff the booth, run booked meetings and capture leads (roughly 25% travel).
  • After the show: run follow-up sequences with the BDRs within days, and track meetings and opportunities to close.
  • Report meetings, pipeline and cost per meeting for each event, and recommend which events to keep, add or drop.

Paid media partnership

  • Help manage our paid search and paid social agency: shape campaign ideas, set targeting and offers, and review results against pipeline.
  • Align paid retargeting and ABM audiences with outbound and event target lists.

Reviews, marketplaces, partner marketing and LinkedIn

  • Own our G2 profile and presence on other review sites (Capterra, TrustRadius, KLAS where relevant); keep listings, categories and screenshots current.
  • Run an always-on review program with CS and sales: ask timing, incentives and quarterly targets; use reviews in campaigns and sales materials.
  • Manage marketplace listings with EHR and technology partners and keep them generating leads. Support partner marketing with those partners: co-branded campaigns, joint webinars and partner events, and partner lead follow-up with the BDRs.
  • Use LinkedIn (company page, Sales Navigator, employee and executive posting, events) as a pipeline channel, not just an awareness channel.

How we'll measure success

Pipeline is the measure that matters. Supporting indicators:

  • Marketing-sourced and influenced pipeline against target, by campaign, segment and channel.
  • Engagement, meetings and pipeline in target ABM accounts.
  • Meetings and sales-accepted opportunities from BDR outreach, events and inbound, including MQL-to-SQL conversion.
  • Pipeline per dollar for each event and campaign.
  • Review count, rating and G2 category position, and leads from marketplaces, partners and LinkedIn.

What you bring

  • 4–6 years in B2B SaaS marketing with direct ownership of field/event marketing and outbound or SDR programs.
  • A record of running integrated, multi-channel and account-based campaigns, and of building lists and messaging that measurably increased meetings and pipeline.
  • Hands-on with Salesforce and HubSpot. Required: building and enriching lists with LinkedIn Sales Navigator and data or enrichment tools such as Seamless.AI, ZoomInfo, Clay or Apollo.
  • Experience driving pipeline from trade shows: pre-show outreach, booth work and post-show follow-up.
  • A collaborative working style: you will share ownership of outbound with a BDR manager and must work well as a peer. Clear, concise writing for outbound email, LinkedIn and event invites.
  • Comfort using AI tools to speed up research, list work and copy testing.
  • Digital marketing fluency across web, email, social and paid, and comfort reporting on pipeline, not just activity.

Bonus points

  • Healthcare, health IT or EHR-ecosystem experience (HIMSS, EHR user groups, KLAS).
  • Experience running a G2 or review program.
  • Experience with partner or app marketplaces.

The annual base salary range for this remote, US-based role is $110,000.00 to $120,000.00 USD. Actual compensation within this range will depend on relevant experience, skills, and qualifications, with consideration for internal equity.

In addition to base salary, this role offers bonus potential and benefits.

Associate Counsel Italy (Fixed-term)

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring together talented experts across a broad spectrum of business critical corporate functions. Every role plays an essential part in enabling our customers to achieve their goals. Our teams are agile, collaborative, and committed to delivering—for each other, for our customers, and ultimately for the people who rely on the services we support.
Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

Syneos Health is seeking a talented, commercially minded and proactive attorney to join its EMEA Employment Legal team. The successful candidate will provide practical, business-oriented legal support to business leaders, Human Resources, and functional stakeholders across Europe, with primary responsibility for Italy and support for nearby European jurisdictions.

The Associate Counsel will advise on a broad range of labor and employment matters, including employee relations, workplace investigations, disciplinary actions, performance management, restructurings, reductions in force, separations, employment litigation, labor disputes, and related risk mitigation. The role will also provide commercial contracting and corporate legal support for regional business needs, partnering with Procurement, Finance, Compliance, Privacy, HR, and operational stakeholders as needed.

This position requires an attorney qualified to practice law in Italy who possesses strong legal judgment, excellent drafting and negotiation skills, and the ability to provide practical, risk-balanced advice in a fast-paced, multinational environment.


Job Responsibilities

Labor & Employment

  • Serve as a trusted legal advisor to Human Resources and business leaders throughout Italy and designated EMEA jurisdictions.
  • Provide day-to-day legal advice regarding employment law, employee relations, performance management, disciplinary actions, accommodations, leaves of absence, workplace conduct concerns, and separations.
  • Advise on workforce restructurings, reorganizations, reductions in force, outsourcing initiatives, and business transformation projects.
  • Support labor relations matters, including employee representative bodies, works councils, collective consultation requirements, and union-related issues where applicable.
  • Draft, review, and update employment-related agreements, policies, handbooks, procedures, templates, and guidance materials.
  • Monitor and advise on developments in employment legislation and regulatory requirements throughout assigned jurisdictions.
  • Prepare and provide employment law training sessions and materials for Human Resources, managers, and business stakeholders.

Litigation, Claims & Investigations

  • Manage employment litigation, administrative proceedings, employee claims, labor disputes, agency charges, and pre-litigation matters.
  • Conduct legal risk assessments and recommend practical dispute resolution strategies that balance business objectives and company risk.
  • Coordinate and manage external counsel in accordance with outside counsel guidelines, budget expectations, and legal management direction.
  • Support internal investigations involving employee misconduct, discrimination, harassment, retaliation, ethics concerns, and other workplace matters.
  • Assist with responses to government agencies, labor authorities, regulators, and other third-party inquiries.
  • Provide regular reporting and strategic updates regarding legal matters, litigation trends, and risk areas.

Commercial Contracts & Corporate Legal Support

  • Draft, review, negotiate, and advise on a variety of commercial agreements, including vendor agreements, professional services agreements, consulting agreements, confidentiality agreements, procurement-related contracts, and other operational agreements supporting EMEA business needs.
  • Partner with Procurement, Finance, Compliance, Privacy, HR, Business Technology, Quality, and operational stakeholders to ensure agreements are consistent with applicable legal requirements, corporate policies, and business objectives.
  • Provide pragmatic day-to-day and strategic advice to minimize legal risks while advancing business goals and initiatives.
  • Guide the business on the appropriate management of contract, vendor, customer, and operational risks and disputes.
  • Support the development and improvement of standard forms, contracting processes, policies, playbooks, and legal workflows.
  • Support corporate due diligence, integration activities, and cross-functional legal projects as assigned.

Compliance, Governance & Risk Management

  • Support corporate compliance initiatives and governance activities throughout the region.
  • Collaborate with Legal, Compliance, Privacy, Human Resources, and business teams to identify and mitigate legal and regulatory risk.
  • Assist in the development, implementation, and maintenance of legal policies, procedures, and best practices.
  • Work collaboratively across the Legal department, including with regional attorneys and global subject-matter experts, to build consensus and drive process improvements.
  • Support the Syneos Health Mission, Vision, and Values.
  • Perform other work-related duties as assigned.

Qualification Requirements

Required

  • Qualified attorney admitted to practice law in Italy and in good standing with the applicable Italian bar association.
  • Significant experience practicing labor and employment law in Italy, including advising on employee relations, separations, restructurings, litigation risk, and workplace investigations.
  • Experience managing employment disputes, litigation, administrative proceedings, employee claims, and pre-litigation matters.
  • Experience drafting, reviewing, and negotiating commercial agreements.
  • Strong understanding of Italian labor and employment law and familiarity with European employment law principles applicable to multinational organizations.
  • Ability to communicate clearly, concisely, and professionally with all levels of management regarding complex employment and commercial legal issues.
  • Fluent written and spoken Italian and English.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, manage multiple priorities, and partner effectively with stakeholders across regions and functions.
  • Ability to collaborate with colleagues and take a business-oriented approach while identifying and balancing risks and providing succinct, accurate, and pragmatic advice.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting multiple European jurisdictions, particularly countries neighboring Italy.
  • In-house legal experience within a multinational company.
  • Experience in the healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceutical, CRO, or professional services industries.
  • Familiarity with European labor relations, works councils, collective consultation requirements, benefits, immigration, and employment regulatory frameworks.
  • Additional European language capabilities.

Critical Success Factors

  • Judgment: Demonstrates expertise and sound judgment; understands how assigned responsibilities support Syneos Health’s business objectives; and provides practical, risk-balanced advice based on a thorough understanding of the scope of an issue, internal resources, and external legal developments.
  • Collaboration: Works effectively with Legal, HR, business teams, and functional stakeholders; integrates information from multiple sources; capably navigates a matrixed environment; and works well in a team to achieve optimal business results.
  • Independence: Able to independently handle complex matters with appropriate supervision and escalation; understands when to escalate issues to senior management for awareness or decision.
  • Communication: Demonstrates excellent interpersonal, strategic thinking, negotiation, communication, and organizational skills, with the ability to explain complex legal issues in a concise and practical manner.
  • Client Service: Partners with clients to achieve outcomes that make business sense, including identifying opportunities for effective process improvements and client-friendly solutions while managing company risk.

Travel

Occasional travel within Europe and internationally may be required based on business needs.

Bask is the best telehealth platform on the market. Our mission is to empower entrepreneurs and businesses to launch a DTC telemedicine company quickly and easily, abstracting away the complexities of the industry into an easy-to-use platform. With hundreds of features to meet the unique needs of telehealth, we put all the tools in our customers' hands for success. A look into the day to day:

  • Building and updating pricing models for Bask's pharmacy products, from medication and fulfillment costs to service fees
  • Watching drug acquisition and supplier costs, and flagging margin impact before it hits revenue
  • Answering pricing questions from sales, pharmacy ops, and customers, and turning them into clear recommendations

We're Looking For

A self-starter who loves numbers and knows how pricing drives a business. You take pride in getting the details right and explaining what they mean. You think outside of the box, excel at creative problem-solving, and are comfortable taking on projects that you have potentially never done before! You are a people-person: curious, self-aware, low ego, and extremely positive. You are comfortable working in a small collaborative team where you'll wear many hats. You are passionate and proficient in written and spoken communications.

Revenue Operations at Bask Health is AI-first and customer-obsessed. Work starts in an LLM to clarify intent and context, moves into research and analysis, is validated against real cost, margin, and customer data, and is continuously refined as we learn. AI and self-serve research are default parts of the workflow, not side experiments.

We are looking for Revenue Operations people who take full ownership of pricing, treat AI as a real collaborator, and care deeply about getting the numbers right for our customers and their patients.

What You'll Do

  • Work AI-first: Use LLMs as your starting point to build models, structure pricing problems, and draft analysis. Apply your own judgment to check the output and make it decision-ready.
  • Validate with real data and real customers: Test pricing assumptions against actual costs, margins, and customer behavior. Use what you learn to improve pricing before issues become patterns.
  • Make pricing legible and trustworthy: Help customers and internal teams understand how Bask prices its products and why. Communicate clearly and proactively to build trust while keeping pricing simple.

Share AI-native workflows: Document prompts, models, and workflows that work. Share them across Revenue Operations so we raise the bar together.

In this job, you will:

  • Work closely with the pharmacy team to build and maintain pricing models for pharmacy products
  • Stay on top of medication and supplier cost changes so our pricing stays consistent and reliable for customers
  • Analyze market pricing to keep Bask's offerings competitive and accessible
  • Recommend pricing for new products, partner programs, and promotions, backed by clear analysis
  • Keep pricing information accurate and consistent across our systems and materials
  • Build dashboards and reports on pricing trends and cost changes for leadership
  • Support the team with forecasting and ad hoc analysis
  • Find comfort in working in a fast-paced startup environment
  • Believe no task is too small and no task is too tall

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in pricing, revenue operations, FP&A, or a similar analytical role
  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills: pivot tables, lookups, and building models from scratch
  • Strong grasp of margin, unit economics, and cost-plus pricing
  • Experience in healthcare, pharmacy, or telehealth pricing is a plus

  • Creative problem solver with a determination to succeed
  • Independent and motivated, with the wisdom to seek help where needed

  • Highly organized, with the ability to juggle multiple projects in a fast-paced environment

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline and portfolio of medicines to treat heart disease, obesity and obesity-related conditions, rare diseases, inflammatory conditions and cancer. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Local Study Operations Manager (LSOM), Director

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will provide strategic and operational leadership for the country LSOM organization and is accountable for the quality, timeliness, cost, and compliant execution of the country clinical study portfolio. The role achieves results through LSOM Senior Managers and their FTE and FSP teams, translating global clinical development strategy into country operating priorities. The role directs portfolio delivery, resource and capacity strategy, financial planning, quality and risk management, vendor performance, and inspection readiness from feasibility through study close-out. As a member of the country leadership team, this role influences study placement and portfolio decisions, leads the resolution of significant operational issues, develops organizational capability and succession plans, and represents LSOM operations in country, regional, and global governance forums.


Accountabilities

  • Lead the successful delivery of the country study portfolio through the LSOM management organization, ensuring alignment with global clinical development priorities.
  • Provides strategic direction and leadership to LSOM country organization across the full study lifecycle, including feasibility, study execution, and study close-out.
  • Establishes portfolio-level oversight of delivery, quality, risk, timelines, and performance, directing timely escalation and resolution of critical issues for LSOM management organization.
  • Manage LSOM and LSOM vendor performance to guarantee high-quality study execution, serving as the primary escalation point for local study challenges, driving solutions, and ensuring portfolio targets are met within the country.
  • Build leadership capability within the LSOM organization through targeted coaching, development, and succession planning, preparing LSOMs to lead increasingly complex trials and programs.

  • Partners closely with CRAs, CSPO, Quality, and FSP partners.

  • Lead, coach, and develop LSOM Sr Managers, including performance management, succession planning, and leadership bench development.

  • Foster a high-performing, inclusive, accountable, and patient-focused culture across geographically distributed teams.
  • Lead organizational changes and enable adoption of new operating models, technologies

  • Accountable for country level oversight and delivery of clinical trials.
  • Manage the performance of LSOM Senior Managers and their teams
  • Holds line management authority for regional and country operations leaders, including performance management, talent development, succession planning, and capability building.
  • Sets regional delivery goals, operating expectations, and performance standards across study start-up, site engagement, monitoring, execution, and closeout.
  • Capability build, talent and performance management, and acting as a liaison for cultural differences within region.

Outputs

  • Oversee resource allocation and workload balance across LSOMs.

jobs.title: Enterprise Select Implementation Consultant (West)
jobs.excerpt: Who we areSamsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara’s Select Customer Success team advises and guides our largest customers, ensuring they adopt Samsara and continuously gain business value from our products. We are the trusted point of contact for Samsara’s strategic customers throughout their lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, advocacy, and renewal.

In this role, you will be part of our Implementation team, responsible for helping Enterprise customers deploy and adopt our IoT solutions for their fleet and industrial assets. Picking up where our sales teams leave off, you will own the customer relationship and ensure a successful deployment of Samsara's solution. Your customers span the entire range of businesses that power our economy, including trucking and transportation, food and beverage, passenger transit, utilities, school buses, and many others. All the while building relationships with the customer, helping them learn our system, and overall ensuring a successful customer relationship.

Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a fast growing company from within.

This role requires exceptional customer-facing communication skills, the ability to quickly understand a customer's business, and comfort explaining technology products to both executives and day-to-day users. In addition to this, you will champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

Candidates can be from either PST or MST time zones and will be required to work in their local time zone hours.

May require travel to customer sites up to 10% of the time, including overnight stays.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Be on the front-lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our IoT platform.
  • Manage the deployment of Samsara technology to large-scale customers, enabling customers to achieve quick time to value in their investment.
  • Create launch plans and a roadmap to increase product usage.
  • Track implementation progress, participation, product adoption, and account health.
  • Run training sessions, demonstrate Samsara’s technology, and work through challenges with executives and day-to-day users of the system across numerous use cases.
  • Juggle multiple customer engagements in parallel and work cross-functionally to deliver an exceptional experience for our customers.
  • Serve as a mentor to the wider Customer Success and Support teams.
  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform’s capabilities and explain them to customers of all types.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 6+ years of experience in a senior Customer Success, account management, or strategic consulting role. Enterprise SaaS experience preferred.
  • This is a demanding position with high internal visibility, that requires strong priority management and high emotional intelligence.
  • Experience supporting or working with technical products.
  • Solutions-oriented with strong problem solving skills.
  • Excellent consultative skills with experience in end to end system implementations.
  • Proven track record of building trust and communicating effectively with a wide variety of stakeholders: executives, Product and Engineering leadership, day-to-day users of our software.
  • Passion for going above and beyond the call of duty, taking initiative, and thriving in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment.
  • Diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through customer issues.
  • Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Strong bias for action, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards.
  • Experience serving and supporting large-scale business solutions at Fortune 500 companies.

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$100,406—$151,875 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

The Services

Based in Brazil, the independent contractor will provide senior-level digital video and graphic production services for designated Cineflix YouTube channels.

The services will include developing and testing video formats, thumbnails and other digital assets that support channel growth, audience engagement and monetisation. The contractor will use their own professional judgement and methods while meeting agreed briefs, deliverables, specifications, quality standards and timelines.

  • Coordinate project deliverables with Cineflix contacts and other collaborators, applying agreed standards for creative output, workflow, delivery and quality.

  • Refine and scale production systems, templates, review processes and delivery standards across video and graphic assets.
  • Track production performance against KPIs and use audience data to improve creative decision-making.
  • Benchmark competitor channels and market trends to identify creative opportunities and high-performing formats.
  • Provide agreed progress updates, production performance analysis and creative recommendations to designated Cineflix contacts.

Required Professional Qualifications and Experience

  • Strong conversational written and spoken English.
  • Comfortable collaborating remotely with Cineflix contacts, using designated systems and agreed communication and delivery schedules.

  • Experience managing production workflows, review cycles, version control and delivery schedules across multiple projects.

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to interpret project briefs and translate them into clear production requirements for graphic designers and video producers/editors.

Additional Experience of Interest

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara's AI has helped prevent accidents that would have harmed an estimated 380,000 people per year. Every model we ship runs in the real world, on real roads, protecting real drivers.

Every Samsara dash cam, gateway, and industrial sensor runs AI at the edge. These models detect distracted driving, prevent collisions, and keep workers safe, all in real time on constrained hardware. As Engineering Manager, you'll own how AI moves from a trained model to firmware running reliably on devices in the field across Samsara's customer fleet.

You will drive Samsara’s edge AI strategy while mentoring engineers and delivering high-impact solutions. You will oversee the deployment of next-generation intelligent safety features and video processing by integrating high-performance camera systems and real-time edge computing into Samsara’s fleet and industrial products. In addition, you will establish the technical strategy, cross-functional relationships, and operational cadence required to launch low-latency, high-quality hardware programs at scale.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

Scale: Millions of AI dash cams, 100B+ miles/year (~99% of U.S. roads), 25T+ data points.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are a life-long learner: We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go.
  • You believe customers are more than a number: Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes.
  • You are a team player: Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we’re all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win – together.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead a team of ~5 firmware and ML engineers. Your team builds, optimizes, and deploys AI models on Samsara's fleet and industrial devices. Your work directly affects whether a driver gets a warning before a collision, not after.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership. Lead from the front technically, contributing directly to the design, implementation, and optimization of high-performance production systems.
  • Set the technical bar for edge ML and embedded systems. You'll guide architecture decisions on latency, power, memory, and model performance, and mentor engineers to go deep on problems most teams never touch.
  • Turn new AI capabilities into shipped products. You'll partner with Product, Hardware, and Full-stack teams to take features from concept to deployment on devices. You'll also keep improving the ones customers rely on every day.
  • Shape the roadmap. You'll work with leadership on quarterly plans that balance product ambition with engineering health, and make the tradeoffs that deliver the most customer impact.
  • Build a team people want to join and stay on. You'll create a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement, with a high bar for execution quality and room for people to grow.
  • Scale Samsara's culture as we grow globally. You'll champion and role model our principles as the team expands across new offices: Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, and Win as a Team.
  • Hire and develop top talent. You'll grow an inclusive, engaged, high-performing team, and help define what great edge AI engineering looks like at Samsara.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 3+ years of hands-on execution-oriented technical management experience.
  • 8+ years of experience in embedded systems and edge machine learning development.
  • Proven track record managing a team of engineers that has shipped a mass production product.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work well in a diverse fast paced customer-focused environment.
  • Experience deploying CV/ML models on edge devices in real-world applications.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience working on products from concept to mass production.
  • Proficiency in C/C++, Rust, or similar programming languages.
  • Proficiency in gstreamer, Google MediaPipe, or similar edge AI/Media frameworks.
  • Experience with data analysis using tools such as Databricks, SQL queries, Tableau.
  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or equivalent field.

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do. 

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline and portfolio of medicines to treat heart disease, obesity and obesity-related conditions, rare diseases, inflammatory conditions and cancer.  As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives. 

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career. 


DIRECTOR STUDY EVIDENCE AND READINESS


What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will lead the global Study Evidence & Readiness function, shaping departmental strategy and overseeing operational delivery across Trial Master File (TMF) Operations and Inspection Readiness. You will ensure clinical studies maintain complete, reliable, and high-quality evidence, supporting regulatory compliance, operational excellence, and continuous inspection readiness.

  • Define and execute the strategy for TMF Operations and Inspection Readiness, ensuring alignment with clinical portfolio priorities and regulatory requirements.
  • Lead, develop, and inspire global teams, driving performance, talent development, succession planning, and operational excellence.
  • Oversee TMF quality and inspection readiness across the study portfolio, identifying evidence gaps, managing risks, and driving timely remediation.
  • Manage functional operations, including resources, budgets, capacity planning, suppliers, training, and business continuity.
  • Drive continuous improvement of TMF processes, standards, SOPs, and systems to strengthen evidence quality, accessibility, and compliance.
  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to resolve complex evidence issues, address root causes, and implement sustainable improvements.
  • Establish performance metrics and provide strategic insights to senior leadership on evidence quality, inspection readiness, risks, and portfolio trends.
  • Provide strategic oversight of audits and regulatory inspections, ensuring effective preparation, response coordination, and implementation of lessons learned.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. What we seek in you as an experienced professional, are these qualifications and skills:

  • Degree educated
  • Proven experience in life sciences or a related field, including biopharmaceutical clinical research (pharma, biotech, or CRO).
  • Proven leadership experience managing and developing teams, including management-level professionals.
  • Strong expertise in TMF Operations, inspection readiness, regulatory inspections, and external vendor oversight.
  • In-depth knowledge of global GCP requirements, clinical trial documentation, regulatory compliance, and risk-based oversight.
  • Experience managing cross-functional projects, budgets, resources, timelines, and quality metrics within a matrix organization.
  • Strong strategic leadership, stakeholder management, change management, and communication skills.

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

jobs.description:
Overview

BerryDunn’s Healthcare Analytics Practice Group (HAPG), Data Management and Strategy (DMS) team is seeking a Technical Project Manager / Scrum Master to lead and deliver complex data management and system technology initiatives. This role requires a blend of strong project management leadership, technical expertise, and Agile delivery capabilities to successfully manage multiple concurrent projects in a hybrid Agile environment.

The ideal candidate brings deep experience leading technical teams, strong subject-matter expertise in healthcare data and systems, and the ability to operate at the intersection of project management, business analysis, and data engineering collaboration.

Location: This position can be remote within the United States or based in one of BerryDunn’s office locations.

Travel Expectations: Up to 25% travel may be required depending on client needs and project demands.

You Will

  • Engage in discussions with the team, clients, and project sponsors to define project objectives, success criteria, and priorities
  • Lead and deliver multiple concurrent projects using a hybrid Agile (Scrum) and traditional project management approach
  • Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, status reports, and delivery roadmaps
  • Manage project risks, issues, dependencies, and resources across projects
  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, stand-ups, backlog refinement, retrospectives, and demos
  • Provide technical oversight across the full Systems Development Lifecycle (SDLC) for assigned projects
  • Collaborate with data engineers on data pipelines, warehousing, reporting, and integration solutions
  • Elicit, document, and manage business and system requirements
  • Translate business needs into clear functional and technical specifications
  • Serve as a liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams
  • Perform and oversee SQL-based data analysis, validation, and quality assurance activities
  • Have a strong understanding of the System Development Lifecycle (SDLC) and be able to grasp complex technical topics
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, stakeholders, and team members
  • Provide clear, consistent communication and deliver presentations
  • Use Artificial Intelligence tools to enhance productivity and improve project deliverables
  • Provide guidance and mentorship to junior team members, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement
  • Keep abreast of the latest trends and technologies in data engineering, healthcare analytics, data science, and AI to ensure BerryDunn remains at the forefront of the industry
  • Ensure all data solutions comply with industry standards, regulations, and security protocols, particularly those specific to healthcare

You Have

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience leading enterprise data management, data integration, or data analytics technical projects
  • Experience managing projects in Agile/Scrum or hybrid delivery environments
  • Experience developing, maintaining, and managing project artifacts, schedules, risks, issues, dependencies, and resource plans
  • Strong background managing system implementation, data engineering, analytics, reporting, data warehousing, or data modernization initiatives
  • Experience with business analysis, requirements elicitation, process mapping, and requirements management
  • Working knowledge of SQL, relational databases, and data analysis concepts sufficient to effectively collaborate with technical teams and validate project deliverables
  • Hands-on experience with managing/administering projects in Jira
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and leadership skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities
  • A team-oriented mindset with a friendly and professional demeanor, coupled with the ability to remain flexible amid changing needs and priorities
  • Ability to work effectively with coworkers and diverse clients through periods of both intense interaction and self-directed work
  • A bachelor's degree in a related field; Advanced degrees or relevant certifications are a plus

We welcome professionals at various experience levels to apply. Level of hire will be commensurate with experience level.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare, Medicaid, public health, or human services data ecosystems
  • Scrum Master certification (CSM, PSM) or PMP
  • Consulting experience in data analytics, integration, or data management engagements
  • Familiarity with cloud technologies and cloud-based data platforms
  • Knowledge of HIPAA and data governance
  • Experience administering an Atlassian (Jira) instance
  • Ability to support teams and clients across multiple time zones, as needed.

Compensation Details

The base salary range targeted for this role is $90,000 to $140,000. This salary range represents BerryDunn’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation at the time of posting. If an applicant possesses experience, education, or other qualifications in excess of the minimum requirements for this posting, that applicant is encouraged to apply and a final salary range may then be based on those additional qualifications; compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. The salary of the finalist selected for this role will be based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, years of experience, depth of experience, seniority, merit, education, training, amount of travel, and other relevant business considerations.

BerryDunn Benefits & Culture

Our people are what make BerryDunn special, and in return we strive to support our employees and help them thrive. Eligible employees have access to benefits that go beyond what’s expected to support their physical, mental, career, social, and financial well-being. Visit our website for a complete list of benefits and a look into our culture: Experience BerryDunn.

BerryDunn is the brand name under which Berry, Dunn, McNeil & Parker, LLC and BDMP Assurance, LLP, independently owned entities, provide services. Job Overview:

Work from home! We will teach you everything you need to know in this role.

Are you looking for a high tech challenge but also to have some fun and work with cool, genuine and super smart people? Headquartered in beautiful Bend, Oregon, RecruitingDash () is the largest provider of services and proprietary software for Oracle Taleo Business Edition (TBE) - a recruiting system that thousands of companies worldwide use.

In addition to our very successful market leading Taleo Consulting practice, RecruitingDash sells our proprietary Taleo metrics, reporting and analytics dashboard software as a service (SaaS) technology, and our Taleo Inbox product, to customers worldwide.

We are launching our third software product in 2023 which will also take our product and services to new platforms beyond the Taleo recruiting system market - it's an exciting time for us!

This is where you come in:

We are looking for a smart, hard-working, well-spoken individual with great presentation skills that we can train in every aspect of product management. We have had a great track record of success teaching smart and hard working people to be successful at our company. A recent college graduate seeking to learn all aspects of software product management may be an ideal fit.

As the RecruitingDash Product Manager, you will work closely with our CTO, founder, and head of software development to manage RecruitingDash's existing software products (ReportingDash and Taleo Inbox) as well as participate in every aspect of the design, development, testing and go to market of new software products which are currently in the earliest stages of product development.

Almost all of the skills for this position you will learn on the job by working closely with the founders of RecruitingDash. The incumbent who served in this role for over 9 years was able to learn the necessary skills to be successful through time in this position, and was instrumental in launching our two existing, very successful, SaaS software products. Therefore, we know that this role is a perfect fit for someone who wants to learn new skills, understand on a deep level how software works and is designed, developed, tested and brought to market, and someone who thrives on solving tough problems, being intellectually challenged and working hard.

Oversee and Manage NEW Software Product Development in Collaboration with the RecruitingDash Chief Technology Officer

The RecruitingDash Product Manager is responsible for the success of our software products - this is both a strategic and tactical role. If you have an interest in learning every aspect of software product management, from defining specifications to development through testing and launch, this is the role for you.

  • Drive the product and business-planning process through the software product development lifecycle
  • Use an iterative process and customer discovery best practices to analyze customer needs and translate them into prioritized product features and benefits
  • Assess current competitor offerings, seeking opportunities for differentiation
  • Develop, implement, and maintain production, testing, and go-to-market timelines across multiple disciplines such as software development, customer discovery, beta testing, product testing, marketing, product release/go-to-market activities and customer support
  • Develop the new customer onboarding and implementation protocols, process, tools and procedures
  • Develop product positioning and messaging to be used comprehensively for the new product, such as on mico-websites, in sales and marketing collateral, and other marketing channels.
  • Execute post launch marketing activities to support sales efforts
  • Manage bug escalations, customer feedback, and feature requests as required
  • Partner with the RecruitingDash sale team to support their efforts in selling the product(s)
  • Develop and drive the documentation process for any new product(s)
  • Design, develop and implement customer support operations as the customer base for the new product(s) grows

Oversee and Manage the Portfolio of EXISTING RecruitingDash Software Products

  • Become an expert in both ReportingDash and Taleo Inbox products so that you:
    • Have a broad overview of how each of the products work technically
    • May effectively onboard and implement the SaaS products for new customers and provide basic sales support to the RecruitingDash sales executives who continue to sell the products
    • Assist with overseeing comprehensive customer support for the existing portfolio of SaaS software products
    • Provide day to day product management for exception handling and escalations, with our CTO and Co-founder as the escalation point
  • RecruitingDash continues to do development for these products so there is a small amount of time focused on the following:
    • Managing, exploring and validating existing customer feature requests
    • Writing up JIRA issues, which is our bug and issues management system, for bug fixes and new releases/feature ideas
    • Doing regression testing for new releases / features
  • Provide "State of the Union" overviews of each of the existing products, periodically and as needed to the RecruitingDash founders
What We're Looking For...
  • Smart people, who have a penchant for learning something every day.
  • Problem solver.
  • A self-motivated results-driven go-getter that works hard.
  • Demonstrated success at a top college with an undergraduate degree.
  • Highly effective communication skills are required to interface with high-level client executives and the RecruitingDash founders.
  • Excellent presentation skills.
  • Highly organized with strong project management skills.
  • Previous knowledge of recruitment & HR or software development is a bonus, but not required.
  • Flexibility - we go the extra mile for our customers, who are located all over the world (at times this may not be a 9 to 5 job).
What Will Grab Our Attention...
  • College degree from a top tier school is strongly preferred.
  • Initiative - we will give you as much responsibility as you can handle.
  • Problem solving & practical thinking - every customer and technology system is unique, and we often have to get creative to craft the right solution to a particular problem.
  • Attention to detail.
  • Strong writing and grammar skills.
  • Strong project management skills.
  • Self-direction - we all work hard to get stuff done and be efficient without micro-management.
  • Planning & organizing skills galore.
  • Personal learning - "Never make the same mistake twice..."
  • Customer focus - you gain personal satisfaction from turning customers into raving fans.
  • Great judgment & common sense - you make the right call at the right time.
  • Calm under pressure - we are growing fast - at times it can be crazy.
  • Drive for results - you love to deliver, on time, even when it's tough.

Working at RecruitingDash...

RecruitingDash is one of the most innovative recruiting technology companies in the industry. Get ready to learn, build, teach and grow fromanywhere in the worldwith the Dashers where our teamwork creates value beyond the sum of our parts.

  • RecruitingDash is a completely remote company – work out of your home, a hotel, or a beach, anywhere you have internet and a phone!
  • We seek to continually simply and improve processes, procedures and activities.
  • We always deliver the best solution.
  • We treat everyone with respect and dignityat all times.
  • We always do the right thing.

About The Opportunity

Netrix Global is looking for a client-facing DevOps Engineer to design, automate, and operate reliable delivery environments across Azure cloud, on-premises infrastructure, and modern application platforms. The role focuses on CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, infrastructure operations, deployment automation, and production readiness.

The engineer will support cloud and on-premises server administration, networking fundamentals, identity and access management, secrets management, monitoring, and release troubleshooting. The role also requires working knowledge of database administration concepts to coordinate deployments, backups, connectivity, access management, and operational diagnostics with application and data teams.

The ideal candidate brings strong operational ownership and can deploy traditional applications, Microsoft platform solutions, and AI workloads securely and repeatably. Success in this role means stable environments, automated delivery pipelines, clear observability, controlled releases, and faster recovery from incidents.

How You Will Make An Impact

  • Assess client environments and define practical source-control, branching, pull-request, CI/CD, release, and environment-management standards.
  • Build and maintain Azure DevOps YAML pipelines and GitHub Actions workflows for applications, infrastructure, data, and AI solutions.
  • Automate provisioning and configuration using PowerShell, Python, and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Bicep or Terraform.
  • Administer and troubleshoot Azure resources, Windows/Linux servers, on-premises environments, hybrid connectivity, and core networking components.
  • Implement secure secrets management, certificates, service connections, managed identities, role-based access controls, and release approval processes.
  • Support database operational needs, including connectivity, access management, deployment scripts, backup and restore coordination, monitoring, and basic performance diagnostics.
  • Deploy and operationalize AI solutions, including dependent APIs, containers, model endpoints, agent services, configuration management, monitoring, and rollback controls.
  • Establish monitoring, alerting, and diagnostics using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, and platform telemetry.
  • Coordinate environment readiness, deployment validation, capacity planning, incident response, root-cause analysis, and recovery planning.
  • Communicate infrastructure risks, release status, dependencies, and remediation plans to clients and internal stakeholders.

What You Will Bring To The Table

We are looking for a professional who combines technical ownership with strong client partnership. Success in this role requires curiosity, accountability, practical judgment, and the ability to move work forward while keeping stakeholders informed.

  • Communicate clearly with clients and internal stakeholders, including during discovery, delivery updates, risk discussions, and project handoffs.
  • Take ownership of outcomes, follow work through to completion, and escalate risks early with supporting evidence.
  • Use documentation, experimentation, and collaboration to solve unfamiliar problems rather than waiting for step-by-step direction.
  • Adapt to evolving technologies, priorities, and responsibilities while maintaining quality and security standards.
  • Contribute to a supportive engineering culture through peer reviews, knowledge sharing, and professional client interactions.

Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of relevant professional experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD, YAML pipelines, GitHub Actions, and branching/pull-request strategies.
  • Practical Azure cloud experience covering compute, networking, storage, identity, monitoring, and security, along with Windows/Linux server support across cloud, on-premises, or hybrid environments.
  • Experience with PowerShell or Python automation, secrets management, release troubleshooting, and infrastructure-as-code fundamentals.
  • Working knowledge of networking concepts including DNS, TCP/IP, firewalls, routing, load balancing, VPN/private connectivity, and certificates, along with basic DBA knowledge covering connectivity, permissions, deployments, backup/restore, and monitoring.
  • Ability to work directly with clients and cross-functional teams, take ownership of incidents, and communicate technical risks clearly.
  • Experience with Bicep or Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes/AKS, Key Vault, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights.
  • Experience deploying AI services, Azure OpenAI/Foundry solutions, APIs, containers, Copilot Studio integrations, or agent workloads.
  • Experience with Power Platform ALM, CI/CD, data-platform deployments, security scanning, quality gates, and disaster recovery practices.
  • Exposure to SQL Server administration, hybrid infrastructure, VMware or comparable virtualization platforms, and enterprise network operations.
  • Automated and repeatable deployments across Azure, on-premises, and hybrid environments.
  • Stable infrastructure with controlled access, comprehensive monitoring, backup, and recovery practices.
  • Production-ready AI and application deployments with traceable configuration management and rollback paths.
  • Faster incident diagnosis, reduced release risk, and clear operational ownership.

Work Schedule: This is a client-facing role. The successful candidate will be expected to participate in client meetings, discovery sessions, demonstrations, delivery reviews, and issue-resolution discussions during the assigned shift.

Standard Shift: 1:00 PM to 10:00 PM India Standard Time (IST), equivalent to 2:30 AM to 11:30 AM Eastern Standard Time (EST). During U.S. daylight saving time, the equivalent schedule is 3:30 AM to 12:30 PM Eastern Daylight Time (EDT).

jobs.title: Marketing Campaign & Strategy Leader
jobs.excerpt: Campaign Conductor: You’re a strategic marketing leader who knows how to turn a campaign from a loose idea into a fully coordinated revenue machine.
jobs.description:
Campaign Conductor: You’re a strategic marketing leader who knows how to turn a campaign from a loose idea into a fully coordinated revenue machine. You’ve planned offers, mapped customer journeys, briefed channels, aligned stakeholders, watched the numbers, and made smart optimizations when performance demanded it. Fluent in the full funnel, you know paid media, ecommerce, email, loyalty, creative, customer service, and analytics all need to work together — or the customer feels the cracks. If that sounds like you, here’s your next big opportunity:

AlgaeCal is searching for a top-tier Marketing Leader (Campaigns) to join our team and propel our revenue growth to new heights.

Small print here ⇒ We’re an eCommerce company. So, we want you to have eCommerce experience. Lots of it. So if you don’t love digital marketing the way cats love cream, you probably shouldn’t read any further.

Still here? Okay then…

This job will give you ALL the feels:

At AlgaeCal, we’re driven by a single idea. To end the fear of bone loss. In the United States, an estimated 54 million people have low bone density.

The good news? AlgaeCal has the world’s only clinically-backed natural solution to this problem. We give hope to everyone worried about bone loss. If that excites you, you’ll find no better place to continue your career than at AlgaeCal.

This job might be for you if you’ve got…

  • 2+ years of marketing leadership experience planning and executing D2C campaigns in an eCommerce environment. You’ve led campaigns from the first messy idea through briefing, approvals, launch, optimization, reporting, and “okay, what did we learn?” You know campaigns don’t magically happen because someone made a promo calendar. They happen because someone owns the moving parts.
  • A track record of managing six-figure monthly marketing budgets. You've worked with substantial media investments, understand how budget allocation impacts overall business performance, and know that maximizing profit matters more than simply maximizing spend.
  • A Yoda-like ability to make strategic, data-driven decisions. When we look at your resume, we’ll see proof that you know how to turn campaign performance data into smart decisions. CPA, ROAS, revenue, customer segments, contribution margin, EBITDA - these numbers don’t make your eyes glaze over. They make your brain start whirring.
  • A full-funnel brain that sees the whole customer journey. Paid media, email, ecommerce, loyalty, organic social, affiliates, influencers, customer service, marketplaces - you understand these channels don’t live in separate little kingdoms. They all touch the same customer. And if the journey feels disjointed, confusing, repetitive, or poorly timed, performance suffers.
  • Strategy that converts like a tent revival. You’ve planned campaigns that engage, educate, and motivate people to take action. You understand offer strategy, timing, landing pages, upsells, cross-sells, bundles, coupons, discount logic, and the tiny campaign mechanics that can quietly make or break revenue. You know when evergreen ads, emails, popups, organic posts, or automations need to pause, shift, suppress, or get out of the way so a live campaign can do its job.
  • A brain the size of a small planet! In this role, you’ll need to think imaginatively and act strategically. You’ll balance company priorities, finance approvals, product logistics, creative capacity, compliance, customer service needs, and channel constraints without melting into a puddle.
  • A results-driven approach to paid media and campaign budget. You’ve worked closely with Paid Media teams, helped allocate spend across campaigns, and know how to look beyond surface-level ROAS. Revenue is nice. Profitability is nicer. You understand unit economics, contribution margin, and why a campaign can look good in one dashboard and less thrilling in another.
  • A track record of leadership, mentorship, and cross-functional coordination. You’ve worked with channel owners, project managers, analysts, creatives, and senior leaders to get campaigns out the door without everyone needing therapy afterward. You guide, influence, pitch, negotiate, and push back when needed - without turning into a tiny workplace dictator.
  • The ability to put on the Customer Hat at all times. You think through what a new prospect sees, what a returning customer receives, how reward points affect the offer, what happens if someone talks to Customer Service, and whether the whole experience actually makes sense to a real human being.
  • Experience designing and executing customer journeys. From first click to final purchase, from campaign email to landing page, from retargeting ad to checkout, from BAU content to live promo, you know how to make every touchpoint feel connected, intentional, and easy to follow.
  • A thick portfolio that demonstrates your mastery of all-things eCommerce. Sorry, but if you have to Google what a heatmap is, don’t know why site speed matters, or think an A/B test is just “trying a different headline,” this probably isn’t the job for you.
  • A detective’s eye for revenue leakage. Coupon abuse, conflicting emails, poorly timed popups, expired offers, unclear bundles, bad suppression logic, clunky checkout journeys, ads running to the wrong page - you can spot the problems before they quietly drain sales.
  • An encyclopedic knowledge of today’s martech, adtech, attribution, and analytics landscape. You don’t blindly trust one dashboard because it has a pretty graph. You understand tools like Triple Whale and GA4 can disagree, and you know how to contextualize performance instead of taking any single source as gospel.
  • A strong grasp of testing strategy. A/B testing, multivariate testing, UX tests, offer tests, funnel tests, creative tests - you know how to plan tests that align with bigger roadmaps instead of throwing spaghetti at a wall and calling it “experimentation.”
  • A solid understanding of UI/UX. This isn’t essential, but it’s a definite plus. You don’t need to be a designer, but you should understand how UX and UI choices affect customer behavior, conversion, trust, and campaign performance. And yes, we might swoon if you have it.
  • A healthy respect for compliance, claims, and disclaimers. We work in the health space, which means “close enough” is not close enough. You’ll need to understand marketing claims, product basics, customer service considerations, and legal disclaimers well enough to keep campaigns accurate, compliant, and trustworthy.

Now, time to be honest: is this really you? If you’re nodding your head and feeling that flutter of excitement, then we can’t wait to meet you.

Other Qualities You’ll Need

At AlgaeCal, we’re going to insist that you have these 3 qualities:

  • You’re humble–you put the team and others’ needs ahead of your own
  • You’re hungry to learn more
  • You’re people smart–in the sense that you’re a great teammate

The truth is, if you don’t have these qualities, you won’t last long at AlgaeCal. So if you’re missing one of them, be honest. Save yourself a lot of headaches and skip to a job posting that is a better fit for you.

What Will You Earn?

We believe in rewarding top talent. So let’s talk about salary once we’ve had the chance to get to know you better. Rest assured, we’re generous and offer above-market pay for the right person. If you bring the skills and experience, we’ll make sure the compensation reflects that.

You’ll also enjoy the following benefits:

  • A generous healthcare package
  • Monthly team events and activities
  • Flexible Stat Holidays with the option to bank days for later use
  • Weekly team lunches
  • Casual dress code
  • Incredible dog-friendly, Yaletown office one block from SkyTrain
  • Remote working is okay with us too.

And above all, you’ll join a team that you’ll never want to leave. Culture is everything to us. Yes, we work extremely hard to change as many people’s lives as possible. But we know how to have fun and reward ourselves too.

How To Apply

So, do you have what it takes to become the next member of team AlgaeCal?

Job opportunities like this don’t come along often, and we’ve got a lot to offer our successful applicant. So, to make sure our future Marketing Leader (Campaigns) Lead is the real deal, will be a great fit, and will thrive at AlgaeCal, we ask a little more than your run-of-the-mill job application:

If this sounds like a position for you, please respond to this advertisement with your resume and cover letter. Please, read carefully:

1. Write a cover letter addressing:

  1. Why are you the best Marketing Leader (Campaigns) for this role? Give quantifiable examples of related achievements.
  2. Describe why you fit perfectly with our values. Read them here:
  3. What's the toughest challenge you’ve ever overcome in your life? How did you overcome it?
  4. What are the last three books you’ve read?
  5. What do you do for fun?

2. Explain what you’re doing now for a job:

  1. If you don’t have one, explain why.
  2. If you have one, explain why you’re looking elsewhere.

3. Upload your cover letter and resume

  1. Ensure that your cover letter and resume are saved and sent as one file.

Yes, our hiring process is challenging, but it’s our way of selecting the best–and your way of ensuring your AlgaeCal teammates are tops.

Click the “Apply Now” button on this page and upload your cover letter and resume.

***Note: Please include your cover letter WITH your resume in one document. Applications without a cover letter will not be read!***

We are looking to hire as soon as we find the right person, so act quickly, and you can also expect a prompt response.
