Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

This role, in a nutshell:

Our international business has moved past the proving stage. The teams, the sales motion and the early wins are in place across EMEA, but still very much being built out in META (Middle East and Africa) and APJ. The operational foundation now needs to scale with them. We are hiring a Senior Revenue Operations Manager to be the hands-on operator behind planning, forecasting, territory design, reporting and process quality for these regions.

This is an individual contributor role with a broad remit. You will work directly with regional sales leadership, report into the Senior Director of Revenue Operations EMEA, and apply global standards and systems to the realities of selling across multiple countries, segments and time zones. You will also be the person who raises it when a global standard does not fit a region, with a proposal for what to do about it.

What you will do

Planning and territory design

  • Support annual and in-year territory design for EMEA, META and APJ, using account potential, segment, language, legal entity and market maturity to build territories that are equitable and defensible.
  • Support capacity and coverage modeling: headcount plans, ramp assumptions, quota allocation and productivity targets tied to the company financial plan. Set different assumptions for markets at different stages, such as an established EMEA business and an earlier-stage APJ business.
  • Support sales compensation execution with global Sales Operations and Finance, including plan rollout, quota letters and accurate, on-time attainment reporting.

Forecasting and reporting

  • Support in running the forecast cadence for the regions you support: weekly pipeline inspection, forecast calls, roll-up accuracy and the written narrative for global sales and finance leadership.
  • Drive the operating reporting rhythm: weekly performance, monthly business reviews, QBRs and regional inputs to Board materials.
  • Own pipeline health and funnel analytics, including conversion by stage, segment, region and country, source and campaign contribution, and win/loss patterns. Identify what is driving each result and recommend what to change.

Partnership with regional leadership

  • Act as the revenue operations partner to regional sales leaders and their teams, joining leadership meetings and QBRs with data and recommendations that support fast decisions.
  • Support leaders at different levels of business maturity and with different priorities, and give each the same standard of analysis and attention.
  • Serve as one of the EMEA, META and APJ voices within global Revenue Operations, and keep regional requirements visible in global planning.

Systems, data and process

  • Maintain data integrity in Salesforce and the wider GTM stack, including account ownership, hierarchy, segmentation and the reporting fields that executive reporting depends on.
  • Work with global GTM Operations on system and process changes, making sure regional needs are represented without fragmenting the global architecture.
  • Maintain rules of engagement across regions, segments and teams, and resolve coverage and credit questions fairly and promptly.
  • Bring region-specific requirements into process and reporting design, including data residency, GDPR and APAC privacy regimes, and local entity and currency considerations, working with Legal and Finance.
  • Partner with Marketing, BDR, Customer Success, Finance and Legal to remove friction from the regional go-to-market process.

What we are looking for

Required

  • 7+ years of Sales, Revenue or GTM Operations experience in high-growth Enterprise B2B SaaS.
  • Experience with multi-country territory design, quota allocation and capacity planning. EMEA experience is essential, and exposure to META or APJ is a strong plus.
  • Expert-level Salesforce skills, including reporting, data models and process design, and sound judgment about what belongs in the CRM and what does not.
  • A record of running a forecast process that sales leaders trust, with measurable improvement in forecast accuracy.
  • A strong analytical foundation: you can break an ambiguous problem into its parts and reach a recommendation you can defend.
  • Clear communication across levels, from a front-line manager's pipeline question to an executive summary, without changing the underlying facts.
  • Experience as a trusted operations partner to senior revenue leaders, including giving them unwelcome news when the numbers call for it.
  • Comfort working inside a globally managed function: adopting global standards, pushing back where they do not fit, and avoiding regional fragmentation.
  • Working knowledge of the modern GTM stack (for example Salesforce, Outreach, Gong, HubSpot, CPQ, and Sigma, Tableau or Looker) and the ability to learn new tools quickly.
  • Comfort with international complexity: multiple currencies, legal entities, languages and privacy regimes, and a working day that spans several time zones.
  • Willingness to travel across the regions and to the US for QBRs and planning cycles (1 - 2x per quarter)

Nice to have

  • Experience supporting public sector or regulated-industry go-to-market teams.
  • SQL skills or experience building data models directly.
  • Experience mentoring or informally leading analysts or junior operations staff.

How success is measured

  • Forecast accuracy improves and leadership relies on the regional roll-up.
  • Territories and quotas are in place on time each planning cycle, with few disputes after launch.
  • Regional leaders get reporting and recommendations without having to ask for them.
  • Salesforce data in the regions meets agreed hygiene standards.
  • Regional requirements are reflected in global system and process decisions.

About the Role

Through the channel, a great product only wins when the partner knows how to sell it. At Abnormal, we want every partner ready to lead with the whole platform.

Abnormal is a channel-first company: nearly all of our transactions run through partners, which makes partner readiness a direct driver of revenue. As Channel Enablement Manager, you will own how our reseller, distributor, and referral partners learn to position, sell, and support the full Abnormal platform, and how our internal sellers work alongside them. We are expanding from email security into a multi-product behavioral platform spanning Identity, Insider Risk, and AI Security, so partners need to lead with the platform and grow every customer over time. You will be the person who makes that possible.

This is a high-visibility individual contributor role on the Sales Enablement team, working closely with Channel Leadership, Channel Account Managers (CAMs), and Channel SEs. You will build scalable, role-based partner enablement and certifications, deliver training people remember, and use data to prove that enabled partners generate more pipeline and win more deals. It is a role for someone who loves the craft of helping others succeed and wants to bring AI to the center of how enablement scales.

The Opportunity

FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead Foundry, an AI-Native Recruiting Agency currently in build at FutureSight. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.

Recruiting has run on the same model for decades: firms charge a fixed percentage of a hire's first-year salary for work that is largely manual, sourcing, screening, and outreach done one candidate at a time. That pricing made sense when the work required a person doing it by hand. It doesn't anymore.

Market Context

Foundry is an AI-native recruiting firm built around a simple idea: use AI agents to handle sourcing, screening, and candidate evaluation, and keep a small human team focused on what still requires a person: building trust with clients and candidates, exercising judgment on close calls, and closing the placement. That shift in who does the work lets us offer clients a fee that's a fraction of what traditional firms charge, without cutting corners on quality.

This is where we believe recruiting is headed. AI-native service firms are starting to emerge and prove the model works, and we're building toward that shift deliberately.

About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.

You’ll co-create with a proven studio team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.

  • Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception

  • Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one

  • Investor and advisor network across vertical AI and early-stage capital markets

  • A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight's cross-functional team as your partner

What you'll own

As Co-Founder & CEO, you will set the venture's direction and lead its execution.

  • Strategy — Refine the ICP, pricing model, and product positioning

  • Customer Development — Lead pilot placements with design-partner companies, convert them to paid retained relationships, and build the go-to-market motion

  • Product — Partner with the FutureSight product and engineering team to ship V1 and iterate on user feedback

  • Capital — Lead the seed raise, supported by FutureSight's network and traction

  • Team — Recruit and lead the founding team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

  • Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent

  • Clear-eyed understanding of the risks and demands of co-founding a venture-backed company

  • Deep domain expertise in recruiting, staffing, or talent acquisition, as a builder operator or agency leader

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

We are hiring a Multimedia Storyteller to join our team. This remote U.S.–based role reports to the Director of Content.


Position Summary


We are seeking a highly creative, social-first storyteller who can turn ideas, insights and brand moments into compelling written, visual and video content. This role blends storytelling, social media, writing, visual content creation and video to develop engaging content that strengthens our brand and connects with audiences.


The ideal candidate is a versatile creator who thinks beyond a single format. They can identify the story, develop the concept and bring it to life through the medium that will make the greatest impact — whether that is a social post, graphic or carousel, short-form video, infographic, written story, customer content or integrated digital campaign asset.


This individual will have a strong understanding of social platforms, digital culture and audience behavior, with the creative judgment to translate complex B2B technology topics into content that feels relevant, accessible and engaging. They will bring a fresh perspective to both established and emerging content formats, finding new and unexpected ways to tell stories, evolve how we show up across digital channels and help Rimini Street stand out in a crowded and constantly evolving market.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Develop original, social-first content concepts that bring the Rimini Street brand, people, customers and thought leadership to life across digital channels
  • Create compelling stories across multiple formats, including social posts, graphics, carousels, short-form video, infographics, written content, customer stories and campaign assets
  • Own the creative process from idea through execution, including concept development, copywriting, visual storytelling, basic design, scripting, video creation and editing
  • Bring fresh thinking to established content channels and formats, identifying creative opportunities to reimagine how stories are told and differentiate Rimini Street in a crowded market
  • Write engaging, concise copy tailored to social and digital audiences, adapting voice, tone and format by platform and audience

  • Maintain a strong understanding of social media trends, platform capabilities, audience behaviors and emerging content formats, bringing fresh ideas and experimentation to the organization
  • Support content capture and storytelling opportunities at events, company activities and other locations as needed
  • Use performance insights and engagement data to understand what resonates with audiences and continuously evolve content approaches
  • Leverage AI and emerging creative technologies to accelerate ideation, content development and production while maintaining quality and brand integrity
  • Ensure content consistently reflects Rimini Street's brand identity, messaging, voice and visual standards

Experience


  • 4–7 years of experience in social media content creation, digital content, brand storytelling, creative marketing or a related field
  • Experience creating content for B2B technology, enterprise software, SaaS, IT services or similarly complex industries preferred
  • Demonstrated portfolio of creative work across multiple formats, including social, written, visual and video content

Qualifications & Skills


  • Exceptional storytelling instincts with the ability to recognize a compelling story and determine the best format for telling it
  • Strong social media fluency and understanding of platform-specific formats, trends, audience behaviors and best practices
  • Excellent writing, editing and copywriting skills, particularly for concise and engaging digital and social content
  • Strong visual eye with demonstrated ability to create graphics, social assets, carousels, infographics and other digital content
  • Working proficiency with creative tools such as Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, Figma, Adobe Express or similar platforms
  • Ability to concept, script and edit short-form video content; experience with Premiere Pro, CapCut, Camtasia or similar video editing platforms
  • Ability to translate complex or technical topics into accessible, creative and engaging content
  • Strong understanding of brand storytelling and how content can build awareness, engagement and audience connection
  • Ability to bring a fresh perspective to existing mediums and established approaches, identifying opportunities to make content feel distinctive, relevant and differentiated
  • Familiarity with social and digital content performance metrics and the ability to use insights to improve future content
  • Experience leveraging AI-powered tools such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT or similar technologies to support ideation and content development
  • Highly creative, curious and comfortable experimenting with new formats, platforms and approaches
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to move multiple creative projects from concept through completion
  • Collaborative, proactive and comfortable working across teams and with stakeholders at varying levels of the organization
  • Willingness and ability to travel as needed to support content creation, events and other business needs

Location


Remote, US

Job Title: Structured Finance Attorney

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote

Job Summary

We are seeking experienced Structured Finance Attorneys to contribute specialized legal expertise to an AI training project. The role involves reviewing complex financial transaction documents, analyzing structured finance legal frameworks, and evaluating AI-generated content to ensure legal accuracy and alignment with industry standards. Prior AI experience is not required.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Review, analyze, and annotate legal contracts and transaction documents related to asset-backed securities (ABS), mortgage-backed securities (MBS), collateralized debt obligations (CDOs), and other structured finance products.
  2. Draft, review, and evaluate sample legal documents, contractual clauses, and transaction frameworks.
  3. Assess hypothetical legal scenarios and AI-generated content for accuracy, clarity, and legal sufficiency.
  4. Explain structured finance terminology, regulatory requirements, and common transaction structures.
  5. Contribute to training datasets that reflect current legal standards and best practices in structured finance.
  6. Collaborate remotely with project coordinators and subject matter experts to maintain high-quality legal content.
  7. Provide insights into evolving market practices, common transaction risks, and regulatory developments.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Juris Doctor (JD) or international equivalent, with active admission to practice law in at least one jurisdiction.
  2. Typically five or more years of experience advising on structured finance transactions, including drafting and negotiating transaction documents.
  3. Strong knowledge of securities laws, regulatory compliance frameworks, and relevant financial market regulations.
  4. Excellent legal research, analytical, and written and verbal communication skills.
  5. Experience reviewing prospectuses, term sheets, offering memoranda, and other financial transaction documents.
  6. Ability to explain complex legal and financial concepts clearly for diverse audiences and technology applications.
  7. Strong attention to detail and the ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Ideal Candidate Profile

A detail-oriented legal professional with substantial structured finance experience, strong knowledge of securities regulations, and the ability to deliver precise, well-supported legal analysis for technology-driven projects.

jobs.excerpt: Job Summary: You will build the foundations the whole team stands on - cloud landing zones, infrastructure-as-code, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and observability - and establish the reliability practice that lets us ship safely.
jobs.description:
Job Summary:

You will build the foundations the whole team stands on - cloud landing zones, infrastructure-as-code, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and observability - and establish the reliability practice that lets us ship safely. Our customers run 24/7 mission-critical operations, so reliability is a feature, not an afterthought.

You'll report to the Head of AI Platform Engineering and join a small, senior founding team building the platform from the ground up.

Job Description:

Why This Role Is Different

  • Production-first. Reliability is the product for customers who rely on us 24/7. You will ship safe, repeatable delivery, not experiments.
  • Platform and product. You will build the foundations that the whole team and portfolio stand on. One solid platform multiplies everyone's velocity.
  • Domain-first, not tech-first. You will learn the domain well enough to know what "reliable" means to customers running mission-critical operations.
  • A founding role. As an early hire, you will establish the delivery and on-call culture and help raise the bar as we grow.
  • Pragmatic build or buy. You will make pragmatic build or buy decisions on infrastructure and tooling, without gold-plating.

What You'll Do

Foundations and Delivery

  • Build and own cloud landing zones, infrastructure-as-code and the Kubernetes foundations the team builds on.
  • Own CI/CD as a product: fast, safe, repeatable delivery.
  • Automate away toil, and codify operational knowledge into tooling and runbooks.

Reliability and Observability

  • Establish observability (metrics, logs and traces), SLOs and alerting, so the platform is measurable and debuggable.
  • Set up and mature on-call and incident response, and drive reliability improvements from postmortems.

Deployment and Cost

  • Support deployment into both cloud and customer-managed environments, and manage version and configuration drift.
  • Optimise cost and capacity, including for AI workloads.

Delivering Value with Product and Customers

  • Work with product teams and customers to validate results and outcomes, prioritising by value.
  • Take a value-based development approach: prove value with the smallest useful slice, then scale what works.
  • Instrument and measure impact, letting evidence rather than opinion drive what ships.
  • Build automated QA, including tests, quality gates and regression checks, into the delivery pipeline.

Building the Team and Ways of Working

  • Help build the team by establishing on-call and reliability culture, and mentor as we grow.
  • Foster a culture of technical excellence, customer obsession and pragmatic shipping.
  • Partner with product teams across the portfolio who own their own roadmaps.

What You'll Bring

We look at demonstrated experience and scope, not years served, and we don't expect every candidate to tick every box.

  • Production infrastructure: You have built and run production cloud infrastructure and owned its reliability.
  • Operations as engineering: You treat operations as engineering, not ticket-driven ops.
  • On-call maturity: You have carried real on-call for what you built.
  • Clear communication: You explain your thinking clearly to engineers, product partners and customers, and bring people along.
  • Value and pragmatism: You focus on outcomes and value, and make pragmatic calls to ship.

Bonus Points

Any of these strengthen an application; none are required.

  • Kubernetes and IaC: Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code in production.
  • Azure depth: Landing zones, networking and identity on Azure.
  • Customer-managed environments: Shipping software into environments the vendor does not fully control.
  • Regulated delivery: Delivery into regulated or restricted environments.
  • Compute cost: Cost optimisation for GPUs or other expensive compute.
  • Languages: Comfortable in Python, C#/.NET or Go for tooling and automation.
  • Architecture: System and platform design, and trade-off judgement such as one-way versus two-way doors.
  • Enterprise scale: Experience building or operating enterprise-scale software, and its reliability, security and integration demands.
  • AI-assisted engineering: You use AI coding assistants productively and supervise their output with judgement.

New to some of this? If you bring the essentials above and are excited by the problem, we'd still like to hear from you.

Senior Director, Client Partner

Are you a strategic, relationship-driven leader who can build trusted executive partnerships and uncover new opportunities within complex enterprise accounts?

Do you excel at identifying client challenges, connecting those needs to broader solutions, and turning strategic conversations into measurable growth?

About the Role

The Senior Director, Client Partner is responsible for going beyond managing today’s business to build the trust, access, and insight needed to uncover opportunities outside the current scope. This role develops deep executive relationships, understands the client’s broader business strategy and challenges, and connects those needs to Conduent capabilities to create measurable growth.

The ideal candidate is a curious strategist and trusted advisor who does not wait for an RFP or formal buying process to begin. You will engage clients in meaningful discovery conversations, identify important business problems and emerging needs, and bring the right Conduent expertise into the conversation early.

Responsibilities

• Leading strategic discovery conversations with senior executives to understand enterprise priorities, transformation agendas, financial pressures, operational challenges, technology roadmaps, and emerging needs beyond current delivery.

• Translating client challenges into solution hypotheses and growth opportunities and engaging the appropriate Conduent solutions, product, sales, and operational experts before a formal buying process begins.

• Building authentic, mutually valuable executive relationships so clients seek your perspective and involve Conduent early in strategic and problem-solving discussions.

• Developing relationships across functions, business units, geographies, and executive levels to create broad organizational trust rather than relying on a single sponsor.

• Identifying whitespace growth opportunities by mapping the client’s broader business needs to Conduent capabilities beyond current contracted services.

• Shaping a multi-year growth thesis for each strategic account, including client priorities, addressable problems, executive sponsors, competitive positioning, and revenue pathways.

• Creating opportunities proactively rather than relying solely on client-generated RFPs, renewals, or Sales Executive-led pursuits.

• Developing qualified whitespace and expansion pipeline and creating opportunities across multiple Conduent capabilities to grow revenue beyond the original scope.

• Building meaningful relationships across executives, functions, and buying centers and opening doors for Conduent leaders and subject-matter experts.

• Earning early involvement in strategic discussions and emerging challenges before requirements or RFPs are fully defined.

• Maintaining a clear account growth thesis, progressing opportunities with discipline, forecasting accurately, and mobilizing resources around high-value problems.

Requirements

To be successful in this role, you will:

• Demonstrate success leading executive-level discovery conversations that uncover needs outside the current contracted scope.

• Bring a documented track record of creating new opportunities within existing enterprise accounts, not only managing or renewing existing revenue.

• Convert complex business problems into solution hypotheses and mobilize solutions, product, sales, and operational resources to address client needs.

• Demonstrate strong commercial curiosity and the ability to understand client business models, industry dynamics, competitive pressures, strategic priorities, and financial drivers.

• Establish trusted relationships in which senior executives seek your advice, perspective, and problem-solving support.

• Challenge client thinking constructively and help shape future priorities rather than simply responding to stated requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

• Executive relationship builder who develops genuine trust rather than transactional relationships.

• Curious strategist who understands the client’s business well enough to ask insightful questions that clients find valuable.

• Opportunity creator who identifies important business problems and opportunities before there is an RFP.

• Solution orchestrator who knows how to bring the right Conduent capabilities and expertise into the conversation.

• Commercial closer who converts trust, insight, and access into pipeline, expansion, retention, and revenue.

Flexible Working

At Conduent, we value individuality and flexibility in how our associates work and deliver their best. In this role, you can expect the following working conditions:

  • Remote work: Enjoy the flexibility of working from home, optimizing your work-life balance.

The role can be remote, but candidates who live within 50 miles of our Florham Park, NJ; Atlanta, GA; or Fort Lauderdale, FL offices would be expected to work a hybrid schedule.

Working For You:

Perks and rewards designed for you:

  • Health and Welfare Benefits: Tailored to fit your and your family's needs, effective from day one.
  • Retirement Savings: Supportive plans to help you secure your financial future.
  • Employee Discounts: Access a broad array of discounts on merchandise, services, travel, and more.
  • Career Growth Opportunities: A variety of opportunities to advance your career within a global company.
  • Paid Training: Earn while you learn with access to award-winning learning platforms.
  • Paid Time Off: Attractive packages designed to help you enjoy your life outside of work.
  • Great Work Environment: Join an award-winning culture recognized for diversity and inclusion efforts.

Join Us:

At Conduent, we are united by a single mission. We know that our success is tied to the success of our associates. We strive to create an environment where you can:

  • Bring your authentic self to work every day.
  • Grow and thrive both personally and professionally.
  • Make a meaningful impact with our clients, in our communities, and for the millions of people we serve.

When you join Conduent, you are part of a future-oriented team – shaping both the company's and your own future. With more than 54,000 associates in 24 countries, you'll have opportunities to grow with people who inspire you to be your best.

In addition to base pay, this position, based on business need, may be eligible for a bonus or incentive. In addition, Conduent provides a variety of benefits to employees including health insurance coverage, voluntary dental and vision programs, life and disability insurance, a retirement savings plan, paid holidays, and paid time off (PTO) or vacation and/or sick time. The programme

An established organisation is automating its finance operations on Redwood Finance Automation. The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, account reconciliation, journal processing and the reporting that follows, all connected to the organisation's ERP.

You will own the solution design. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineering team can build. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real.

What you will work on

Current-state analysis of the record-to-report processes with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design across close, reconciliation, journals and intercompany, written up as the solution design. Decisions on what standard Redwood capability covers and where an extension is justified. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems. Balance sheet auto-certification rules, controls, approvals and audit trail designed into the solution, so the automated close stands up to audit. Guidance to the engineers through build, and review of what they deliver against the design. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users. A roadmap for the next waves of automation once the first processes are live.

What you bring

Solution design ownership on at least one live Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance) implementation, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. 8 or more years in finance transformation, finance systems or record-to-report process design. A working understanding of SAP FI/CO, or the Oracle equivalent, and how close and reconciliation data flows between the ERP and the automation layer. Experience running workshops with finance users and turning what they say into a design that can be built and tested. The standing to work with senior finance stakeholders and hold a design position when it is challenged.

Useful but not essential:

Hands-on build experience on Redwood, so you know what your design asks of the engineers. BlackLine, Trintech, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. A finance qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or similar). Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood implementation: the finance processes in scope, the ERP it connected to, and which design decisions were yours.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood Finance Automation people in front of the client.

The SOC Service Delivery Manager serves as the primary customer success leader for assigned Managed Security Services customers and is accountable for service performance, security governance, customer health, adoption, incident communications, and value realization. Customer Success, Relationship and Health Management

Has discussions with external physicians by phone to gather additional clinical information or discuss determinations regularly, and in some instances, these may require conflict resolution skills. We design, build and service highly engineered products in fluid and motion control applications. We focus on five market sectors: Industrial Automation, Process Automation, Climate Control, Life Science and Fluid Control, and Transport.

Climate Control offers hydraulic solutions for water-based heating and cooling systems to achieve a perfect indoor climate with minimal energy consumption. Our leading brands have been used in over 100,000 building projects worldwide and offer products and solutions in three key areas: Pressure maintenance and water quality, regulation, control and actuators, and thermostatic control.

Join our Engineering Service Consultant and use your engineering knowledge to help design efficient heating and cooling solutions for projects across international markets.

The Senior Engineering Services Center (ESC) consultant provides specialist technical support to IMI Hydronic Engineering teams and customers. Working with technical drawings and project requirements, you will develop solutions for the balancing, control and pressure maintenance of HVAC systems, using IMI Hydronic Engineering products and engineering tools.

This is a great opportunity for an engineer who enjoys combining technical calculations, HVAC system design, problem-solving and customer interaction in an international environment.

  • Review project plans, specifications and tender documentation and recommend suitable technical solutions.
  • Prepare calculations, equipment selections and product lists using Excel and other engineering tools.
  • Develop alternative technical solutions based on project and customer requirements.
  • Build strong knowledge of IMI Hydronic Engineering's products, HVAC systems and applications.

  • Explain and discuss your proposed solutions with internal and external customers.
  • Build strong relationships with the customers and markets you support, communicating proactively and ensuring work is delivered on time.
  • Collaborate with other ESC engineers and specialists, and occasionally coordinate work across the team.
  • Support technical training, demonstrations and selected on-site activities, including system balancing.

As your experience grows, you may also have opportunities to deliver technical training, represent the ESC at events and provide support to the Team Leader.

What We're Looking For

Essential

  • A BSc or equivalent engineering qualification, ideally in Mechanical, Building Services, Energy or another relevant engineering discipline.
  • An interest in HVAC, building services, energy systems or hydronic engineering.
  • Experience using 2D AutoCAD.
  • Good working knowledge of Excel.
  • Comfortable communicating in English in an international working environment.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • A structured and accurate approach to technical work.
  • Curiosity and willingness to learn new products, engineering tools and HVAC applications

Nice to have

We would be particularly interested if you already have experience with:

  • HVAC or building services engineering
  • Heating and cooling system design
  • Hydronic calculations
  • Valve sizing or pressure maintenance systems
  • Technical project support or application engineering
  • Working directly with customers or engineering consultants
    German language skills

You do not need to know every IMI product or ESC system when you join. Structured technical training will help you develop this knowledge in the role.

What you can expect

You'll join a specialist engineering team where you can develop your technical expertise while working on real HVAC projects across international markets.

The role offers the opportunity to build expertise in hydronic engineering, HVAC system design, technical consulting and customer-facing project work, with increasing responsibility as your knowledge and experience grow.

Personal Attributes

  • Highly accurate and detail-oriented.
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently.
  • Strong learning agility and curiosity for technical subjects.
  • Customer-focused mindset.
  • Team player with excellent communication skills.
  • Willingness to continuously expand technical expertise.

Why Join IMI?

At IMI, you'll become part of a global engineering organization focused on creating sustainable and efficient HVAC solutions. We offer:

  • International project exposure.
  • Professional development and technical training.
  • Collaboration with experienced engineering professionals.
  • Access to innovative HVAC technologies and software tools.
  • A supportive and inclusive culture built on teamwork, innovation, integrity, and customer focus.
  • Opportunities for career growth within a global organization.

If you're looking to apply your engineering expertise in a dynamic, international environment while helping customers deliver high-performance HVAC systems, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now and help shape the future of climate control solutions with IMI.

jobs.title: Retirement Plan Administration Support Specialist
jobs.excerpt: We are excited to speak to you about this opportunity.
jobs.description:
We are excited to speak to you about this opportunity. If you are interested in joining our growing team, please apply to this link directly.

Who we are

At Aquila, we invest in category-defining B2B/B2G software companies globally, acting as a thought-partner, striving for the success of our companies in the long term. We are a well-managed, profitable company that operates like a startup with the financial backing of a parent company. For our people, this means limitless possibilities.

We are unapologetically unique, pivoting to respond to the needs of the multiple markets we operate in. We have ambitious goals, and we are looking for genuine contributors with integrity, energy, flexibility, and loyalty. We are investing in building future leaders who can take an idea and make things happen.

About CalcAir

CalcAir, a Gemini Group company within Aquila, provides retirement plan administration software to third-party administrators and benefits professionals across the United States. With more than 50 years of industry experience, we help our customers manage complex retirement plans, navigate changing regulations, and deliver accurate, efficient administration services.

Who we need

Reporting to the Director of Customer Experience, we are hiring a Retirement Plan Administration Support Specialist. You will apply your knowledge of retirement plan administration to help customers resolve complex questions related to plan calculations, software functionality, and regulatory requirements. You will work closely with our development team to investigate issues, identify opportunities for improvement, and test software changes, helping ensure our solutions deliver accurate results and meet the needs of the retirement plan professionals who rely on them.

This is a fully remote role based anywhere in the United States. You will work an eight-hour shift within our customer support hours of 8:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. Central Time.

What’s in it for you

A new direction for your career. You will have the opportunity to bring your retirement plan administration expertise into a software company that serves the industry you know. You will build on your knowledge in a customer-facing role, developing new skills in software support, troubleshooting, and product functionality while helping retirement plan professionals make the most of the technology they rely on.

Broader exposure and impact. You will work with a diverse range of third-party administrators and benefits professionals across the United States, gaining insight into different approaches, challenges, and retirement plan requirements. You will expand your industry knowledge while helping customers solve complex problems and improve how they work. Through your collaboration with the development team, you will also have a voice in how our software evolves, sharing feedback and helping test improvements that benefit customers across the industry.

Career growth and opportunity. You will join a team where your industry knowledge is valued and where there are opportunities to develop your career in new directions. You will gain exposure to different aspects of the software business, with potential pathways into senior support, product, or other customer-facing roles. As part of Aquila's broader portfolio of software companies, you will also have access to a wider network of businesses and potential opportunities to grow your career over time.

As our new Retirement Plan Administration Support Specialist you will

  • Guide and support customers. You will respond to questions from retirement plan administrators and other industry professionals through phone, email, and our support ticketing system. You will help customers navigate software functionality, understand results, and work through issues involving their day-to-day administration activities. You will provide clear explanations and follow through on questions that require further investigation.

  • Solve complex administration questions. You will draw on your understanding of qualified retirement plans, including calculations, compliance testing, contributions, distributions, and regulatory requirements, to investigate customer questions. You will look beyond what the software displays to understand the underlying administration process, research unfamiliar scenarios, and determine the correct result.

  • Collaborate on software improvements. You will identify and document software issues, communicate bug reports and enhancement requests, and work with our development team to help resolve them. You will also bring your perspective as an experienced administrator to discussions about new features and changes driven by evolving legislation.

  • Test and validate changes. You will help test software fixes, new functionality, and regulatory updates before releasing them to customers. Using your knowledge of retirement plan rules and calculations, you will evaluate whether the software produces the expected results across different administration scenarios and provide feedback when further changes are needed.

  • Share knowledge with customers and colleagues. You will contribute to release notes, written resources, training materials, and webinars that explain software functionality, regulatory changes, and common administration questions. You will make complex information accessible and help customers get more from the software they use.

You bring

  • The retirement plan administration experience. You have hands-on experience administering U.S. qualified retirement plans and understand the processes, calculations, and compliance requirements involved. You know how administration tasks are performed, what results to expect, and how to investigate discrepancies. Your experience may come from a third-party administrator, insurance company, investment firm, or an organization that manages retirement plans internally.

  • The industry knowledge. You have a strong understanding of qualified retirement plans, including compliance testing, contributions, distributions, and plan documentation. You are familiar with ERISA and regulatory developments such as SECURE 2.0. You bring knowledge of defined contribution plans, and experience with defined benefit or cash balance plans is an asset. You know where to find reliable information when regulations change or unfamiliar questions arise.

  • The software experience. You have used retirement plan administration software in your work and understand how it supports calculations, compliance, and day-to-day administration. You may have experience with CalcAir, DATAIR,Relius, ASC, FT Williams, or similar platforms, including internally developed systems. You are comfortable working with spreadsheets to review calculations and validate results.

  • The analytical and problem-solving skills. You can work through complex questions, investigate unexpected results, and identify the source of an issue. You take a methodical approach to reviewing information, testing assumptions, and finding answers. You know when to involve others and can clearly explain what you have found and how to resolve it.

  • The customer focus and communication skills. You can explain complex retirement plan concepts and software functionality in a way that is clear and helpful to customers with different levels of knowledge. You listen carefully, ask thoughtful questions, and take ownership of resolving issues, keeping customers informed along the way. You are comfortable working independently and collaborating with support and development colleagues to find solutions.

  • The curiosity to keep learning. You are interested in technology and how software can improve retirement plan administration. You are open to learning new software, contributing to product testing, and exploring ways to improve customer support. Familiarity with ticketing systems such as TeamSupport is an asset, as are industry designations such as QKA, QPA, APA, or ERPA, although these are not required.

Why join?

CalcAir and Aquila are part of Constellation Software Inc., one of Canada's largest and most successful software companies and its most successful technology stock over the last 10 years [TSE: CSU].

Our entrepreneurial culture, lean environment, and people come together to form a dynamic organization where purpose drives our growth. This is a place where high performance and hard work are rewarded, where leaders are grown, and where the best ideas win. With the autonomy to be creative and curious, we collaborate and iterate to achieve real impact in the communities we support.

We spend our days asking questions and challenging the status quo, manipulating our structure, roles, and internal operations in order to stay ahead in a competitive landscape.

If you share our growth mindset, relationship-focused approach, and high moral fibre, you will thrive at Aquila.

Apply now.

Diversity and inclusion are not mere words on paper to us. We welcome and appreciate candidates with a range of backgrounds and experiences. If you have 70% of the qualifications we are looking for and want to play an integral role in changing an industry, apply to express your interest.

What you can expect from our interview process:

  • A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor to discuss your interest in joining the company and in the role. The conversation will be recorded using BrightHire, an AI-powered video interview tool. More details will be shared when you are invited to interview.

  • A virtual interview with the Director of Customer Experience to explore your retirement plan administration experience, knowledge of regulations and calculations, familiarity with industry software, and approach to investigating and resolving customer questions.

  • A virtual interview with a senior member of the Customer Support team to further discuss your practical experience, approach to customer support, and how you would contribute to software testing and continuous improvement.

  • A final virtual interview with the General Manager to learn more about CalcAir, discuss your interest in the opportunity, and explore how your experience and career aspirations align with the direction of the business.

We promote equal employment opportunities for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, national origin, veteran status, marital status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities and accommodations are available on request.

These tools help our recruitment team document conversations and maintain a consistent interview process. All candidate evaluations and hiring decisions are made by people, not AI.

About the Opportunity

At Ellucian, we believe in the transformative power of education, and our cloud solutions are central to powering that transformation for colleges and universities around the world. The FinOps team supports the development, scalability, and financial sustainability of Ellucian's cloud solutions through effective governance, financial transparency, and cross-functional collaboration.

The team helps establish organizational accountability for technology consumption and costs while maximizing the business value of cloud and other consumption-based technology investments. Success is measured through predictable and scalable costs, effective governance, improved financial visibility, and measurable optimization outcomes.

As a FinOps Analyst, you will help drive financial accountability, governance, and optimization across Ellucian's cloud and technology investments. You will independently own assigned FinOps initiatives, analyze technology consumption and spending, identify opportunities for improvement, and partner with technical and business stakeholders to translate financial and operational data into actionable decisions.

Where You Will Make an Impact

  • Own and drive FinOps initiatives within assigned areas of responsibility, improving visibility, accountability, governance, and optimization across cloud and technology consumption and spend.

  • Help evaluate and establish financial governance for emerging technologies and consumption models, including SaaS, observability, data platforms, and AI services as organizational needs evolve.
  • Identify opportunities to improve FinOps processes, controls, reporting, and operational effectiveness through automation, improved analytics, and standardized practices.
  • Support improvements in automated reporting, consumption monitoring, and cost anomaly detection to increase efficiency, data accuracy, and visibility into optimization opportunities.
  • Contribute to the continued maturity of FinOps practices by improving cost allocation, forecasting, governance, and financial accountability across technology investments.

What You Will Bring

  • 2+ years of experience in FinOps, cloud financial management, cloud operations, observability/platform operations, technology governance, technical program/project management, financial/business analysis, or a related discipline.

jobs.description:
About the Role

We are searching for a deep Citrix expert — someone who has lived and breathed Citrix for years, knows the logon process inside and out, and gets genuinely excited about finding the hidden cause of a 30-second login when it should be 8. As our Expert Systems Engineer, you will be the technical anchor of our Citrix Customer Experience team, responsible for the most complex performance investigations, the development of our diagnostic methodology, and the technical mentorship of the broader team.

You will work directly with data, AI-assisted analysis tools, Wireshark traces, Citrix Director deep dives, Power BI dashboards, and your own hard-won expertise to identify — and eliminate — the root causes of poor Citrix logon performance across a large and varied customer base. Your findings will not stay with one customer; you will be the engine that turns individual discoveries into org-wide improvements.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of deep, hands-on experience with Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (XenApp/XenDesktop), including complex multi-site enterprise deployments, performance tuning, and advanced troubleshooting
  • Expert-level understanding of the Citrix logon process — able to analyze each phase (Session Startup, Brokering, HDX, Authentication, GPO, Profile Load, Interactive Session) and interpret all key VDA and client-side metrics (SSCD, SCCD, NRWD, LPWD, GPVD, PCVD, DMVD, COVD, CAVD, etc.)
  • Deep expertise in Windows Group Policy (GPO) — including design, troubleshooting, and optimization of GPOs in Citrix VDA environments; able to identify settings that impact logon performance and application behavior
  • Proficiency with Citrix Director for in-depth session analysis, logon phase breakdowns, and real-time troubleshooting
  • Experience with Wireshark or equivalent packet capture tools for network-layer logon diagnostics
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to correlate data from multiple sources (Power BI, Logic Monitor, Azure Log Analytics, event logs, Citrix Director) to identify root causes that are not immediately obvious
  • Demonstrated experience documenting complex findings clearly and transforming them into actionable, repeatable processes and runbooks
  • Experience mentoring less senior engineers and elevating the technical capability of a team

Preferred Qualifications

  • FSLogix deep expertise — container configuration, profile management, optimization, and troubleshooting
  • Experience with Azure cloud infrastructure, including Azure-hosted Citrix deployments, Azure Log Analytics, and Azure AD integration
  • Working knowledge of Citrix StoreFront and Workspace App architecture, including configuration best practices and common performance pitfalls
  • Hands-on experience with proxy settings, WPAD, and auto-proxy detection in enterprise environments and their impact on Citrix session behavior
  • Familiarity with Optimus/OptimistDB or similar Windows configuration audit frameworks
  • Scripting proficiency in PowerShell and/or Python — able to write or direct automation for GPO auditing, configuration comparison, and data extraction
  • Experience using AI/LLM tools (e.g., Copilot, Gemini, ChatGPT) in an operational context to analyze configuration data, surface recommendations, and cross-reference knowledge bases at scale
  • Citrix certification at the CCE-V level or equivalent demonstrated expertise
  • Healthcare IT or managed services experience — particularly environments running Allscripts/Altera applications (Sunrise, Paragon, TouchWorks, Denali) — is highly desirable
  • Exposure to double-hop Citrix architectures and associated performance implications

Key Responsibilities

Advanced Logon Performance Analysis & Diagnostics

  • Lead the most complex and ambiguous Citrix logon performance investigations, going beyond surface metrics to identify true root causes across all logon phases: HDX/Session Creation (SCCD), Brokering (NRWD, LPWD), Authentication (CAVD, COVD), GPO Processing (GPVD), Profile Load (PCVD), Drive Mapping (DMVD), and Interactive Session
  • Perform deep-dive analysis of customer logon data — comparing high-performing and low-performing environments, drilling into subnet-level variations, user-level inconsistencies, and machine-specific outliers to isolate contributing variables
  • Conduct packet-level analysis using Wireshark to identify network-layer contributors to logon delays — including DNS resolution timeouts, drive mapping failures, proxy/WPAD misbehavior, and ICA session establishment delays
  • Analyze Azure Log Analytics for error patterns (e.g., 4908 errors, drive mapping failures) and correlate with logon timeline data to build a complete causal picture
  • Interpret and act on data from Citrix Director, Logic Monitor, Power BI (Citrix All dashboard, GPO dashboard, scatter plots), and other data sources to identify systemic patterns not visible to less experienced engineers
  • Leverage AI tools to ingest large volumes of Citrix configuration data, policy exports, and knowledge articles, extracting actionable recommendations and cross-referencing against current customer environments

GPO Analysis & Best Practice Engineering

  • Serve as the subject matter expert on GPO configuration for Citrix VDA environments — including CTX VDA Configuration settings (SeamlessFlags, LogoffCheckSysModules, USERProcessHandleQuota, and others), Citrix session policies, Windows Component settings (IE, File Explorer, Remote Desktop Services), and security/audit configurations
  • Identify GPO misconfigurations, overlapping policies, legacy drift, and missing best-practice settings across the customer base, with particular focus on settings that directly impact logon time
  • Develop and maintain the GPO best practice library and Citrix policy standards that serve as the reference for all customer environments — including both Azure-hosted and Sunrise/on-premises environments
  • Investigate and resolve complex proxy/WPAD/auto-proxy configuration issues through GPOs and their downstream impact on session and application performance
  • Review Optimus reports and other automated audit outputs for Citrix and Windows server configuration gaps (IAS app pools, SSRS standards, network configurations) and drive remediation

Profile Management & Session Optimization

  • Analyze and optimize Citrix user profile configurations — including FSLogix container settings, mandatory profiles, local profile management, and profile size bloat — to reduce profile load times (PCVD) across the customer base
  • Evaluate and tune HDX policy settings for performance — including EDT protocol behavior, virtual channel configurations, and session reliability settings — with a focus on reducing Session Creation Client Duration (SCCD)
  • Investigate Double Hop scenarios and identify registry-level remediation (e.g., SlowHPCPolling) and architectural improvements to reduce CPU overhead and HDX latency
  • Assess StoreFront vs. Citrix Workspace App usage across customers and recommend architectural improvements to reduce brokering and session startup times

Methodology Development & Knowledge Transfer

  • Design and continuously refine the team's diagnostic playbook — a step-by-step, tool-by-tool guide that enables engineers at all levels to systematically diagnose logon performance issues in a structured, repeatable way
  • Develop training materials, recorded sessions, and runbooks covering the full diagnostic toolchain: Logic Monitor, Citrix Director, Power BI (Citrix All, GPO dashboard, scatter plot), Azure Log Analytics, Wireshark, Citrix policies, and GPO auditing
  • Create and maintain a library of "lessons learned" — specific, documented findings from customer investigations that can be evaluated and applied across the entire install base
  • Mentor Systems Engineers, reviewing their diagnostic approaches, providing guidance on complex cases, and building their technical depth over time
  • Conduct knowledge-transfer sessions and training surges so that the team's collective expertise grows faster than any individual's

AI-Assisted Analysis & Tooling

  • Lead the team's use of AI for large-scale analysis — including ingesting Citrix configuration exports, GPO data, ServiceNow knowledge articles, and public Citrix best practice documentation to generate actionable insights and surface configuration gaps at scale
  • Develop or guide the development of scripts (PowerShell, Python) to automate GPO auditing, data extraction, and comparison across customer environments
  • Work with internal tooling teams to refine and productionize AI-based GPO audit capabilities and Citrix policy analysis pipelines

What Success Looks Like

Within 60 days, you have completed a formal assessment of logon performance across the highest-priority customers, produced a ranked list of root causes with specific remediation recommendations, and delivered the first iteration of the team's diagnostic playbook. Within 6 months, multiple customers have measurably improved logon times directly attributable to your analysis and the team's execution, at least two systemic improvements have been propagated across the full install base, and the Systems Engineers on your team are noticeably more capable diagnosticians than when you arrived.

About the Role: pawlicy.com/careers

Location: Remote, US-based (any time zone in the 48 contiguous states). Full time. Travel expected at up to 30%.

Every day, pet owners walk out of a vet's office having just said no to a treatment their pet needed, not because they didn't care, but because they couldn't afford it. Pawlicy Advisor exists to eliminate this problem. Pawlicy Advisor is a profitable venture-backed startup building the infrastructure that connects pet owners to the right financial protection for their pets, starting with the most trusted pet insurance marketplace in the US, distributed through thousands of veterinary practices nationwide. We help pet owners make better financial decisions for their pets. The company has delivered over 1 million unique quotes, has raised $19M+, has found product-market fit, and is now scaling.

Veterinary teams are one of its largest growth channels: thousands of practices use Pawlicy Advisor's programs nationwide to help clients find coverage. The Veterinary Affairs Manager owns how new clinics find Pawlicy Advisor in the field: conferences, webinars, and partnerships in the veterinary space. The role reports to the Chief Medical Officer/Head of Veterinary Affairs and partners closely with Veterinary Success, Marketing and Data teams.

What You Own

Partnerships in the veterinary space

  • Own maintenance of veterinary partnerships end to end: campaign execution, reporting and renewal
  • Build and manage relationships with veterinary associations, industry partners and practice consultants who recommend Pawlicy Advisor to clinics
  • Decide which partnerships to grow based on results

Conferences and events

  • Plan and run Pawlicy Advisor's presence at national and regional veterinary conferences and events
  • Own booth strategy, staffing, lead capture and same-week handoff to the onboarding team
  • Track cost and clinics onboarded per event and recommend what to keep, cut or add
  • Maintain veterinary assets used in the field

Webinars and education

  • Run Pawlicy Advisor’s webinar presence within the veterinary space
  • Build content that veterinary teams value and that leads to clinic signups

Market focus and measurement

  • Run focused programs in priority metro markets with local events and targeted outreach
  • Own the field budget and report monthly on spend, clinics onboarded and clinic quality by source

What Success Looks Like

First 90 days

  • First national conferences planned and executed
  • A full calendar of regional events, webinars and partnership campaigns booked for the first half of the year
  • Source tracking live for every channel activation

First 12 months

  • Veterinary Affairs channels are a consistent, measurable source of new clinics
  • Every partnership has clear terms, owners and reported results
  • A clear, data-backed recommendation on which channels to scale next year

Requirements

  • 4+ years in veterinary industry roles: professional relations, field marketing, industry sales
  • Previous experience owning partnerships in the veterinary space end to end, from first conversation to results and renewal
  • Direct experience planning and running conference presence, with lead results you can quantify
  • Existing relationships across veterinary associations, practice consultants or industry partners
  • Comfort owning a budget and reporting results in numbers (cost per clinic, conversion by source)
  • Strong written and verbal communication with veterinarians, practice managers and technicians
  • Mandatory travel up to 30% of the time (conferences and events)
  • Authorized to work in the US without sponsorship

Strongly Preferred: credentialed veterinary technician, CVPM or practice manager background; pet insurance or veterinary software experience; CRM and BI tools (Pipedrive, Tableau, Mixpanel).

How you work

  • Self-starter who sets the calendar, not one who waits for it
  • Data first mentality: Measures every event and partnership against what it returns
  • Builds trust with veterinary teams because you understand the work they do
  • Organized across many moving parts; uses digital task management and AI tools
  • Treats every budget dollar as an investment with clear ROI

AI and the Hiring Process

We embrace AI at Pawlicy and our work still relies on what the humans bring to it.

So please leave the AI out of interviews. Prep with it all you like, but in the room, we want your thinking, your questions, your judgment. These stages exist so we can get to know you and how you'd work with our team. We're hiring you, not a model and it is you we want to see.

To be concrete: no AI assistants or chatbots on any device during interviews, and nobody else feeding you answers. Spell-check, autocomplete and notes you wrote yourself are all completely fine.

If it turns out AI was used where we've asked you not to, it may end your candidacy.

If any part of our process is a barrier because of how you read, write or communicate, email before that stage and we'll talk through the options. The skills we're assessing stay the same; what changes is the format. Asking has no bearing on how we assess you.

  • Startup equity grant

Job Title: Certified Inpatient Medical Coder

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote, United States

Job Summary

We are seeking a Certified Inpatient Medical Coder to contribute to an AI training project focused on improving medical data accuracy and integrity. In this role, you will apply your expertise in inpatient coding, clinical documentation, and coding guidelines to review medical records and evaluate AI-generated clinical content. Your knowledge will help improve the accuracy and reliability of AI systems.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Review inpatient medical records to ensure accurate ICD-10-CM and ICD-10-PCS coding in accordance with current guidelines and best practices.
  2. Assess clinical documentation for accuracy, completeness, and coding integrity.
  3. Identify principal and secondary diagnoses, sequence codes according to official guidelines, and assign Present on Admission (POA) indicators.
  4. Validate MS-DRG assignments, identify Complications and Comorbidities (CCs) and Major Complications and Comorbidities (MCCs), and flag Hospital-Acquired Conditions (HACs) and patient safety indicators.
  5. Evaluate AI-generated clinical notes and summaries against real-world documentation and coding standards.
  6. Code AI-generated diagnostic and procedural information using ICD-10-CM and ICD-10-PCS classification systems.
  7. Identify and resolve diagnosis and procedure coding discrepancies to maintain accurate record abstraction and data capture.
  8. Provide clear, detailed feedback on coding errors and complex cases to improve AI model performance.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Active coding certification, such as CIC, CCS, RHIA, RHIT, COC, or another relevant AHIMA or AAPC credential.
  2. Hands-on experience with inpatient ICD-10-CM and ICD-10-PCS coding.
  3. Access to current official ICD-10-CM/PCS coding references and Coding Clinic guidance.
  4. Current experience in inpatient medical coding, clinical documentation improvement (CDI), or a closely related documentation role.
  5. Availability to commit at least 10 hours per week.

jobs.description:
Location: Remote, United States (must be US-based)
Hours: ~10 hours/week (25%), flexible, with room to grow as volume grows
Engagement: 1099 contractor or part-time W-2 employee, your choice
Pay: $30–40/hour, depending on experience

About Joint Academy

Joint Academy is a digital musculoskeletal care company operating in the US, UK and Sweden. We did $40M in revenue last year and are profitable. In the US we run two things: an AI Care Platform that lets physical therapy clinics deliver and bill Remote Therapeutic Monitoring (RTM) to their own patients, and a virtual physical therapy service contracted directly with health plans. Both are growing fast, and billing is becoming a service we offer, not just a back-office function.

The role

We're looking for a hands-on biller who knows physical therapy billing inside out and wants to build and own a billing service for a company that's scaling across the US. Your first job is billing on behalf of our clients: PT clinics using our platform for RTM. Your second is billing for our own contracts with insurance companies as we add health plans. You're not buried in the back office. You'll sit in on client meetings, be the person our clinic partners call with billing questions, and help us turn "we bill for you" into a real, paid offering.

What you'll do

  • Bill RTM on behalf of our PT clinic clients: prepare, submit, track and reconcile claims (CPT 98975, 98977, 98980, 98981), review documentation against payer rules, and catch errors before they become denials
  • Join client onboarding and check-in calls as our billing liaison, alongside our Customer Success lead
  • Submit, track and reconcile claims for Joint Academy's own virtual PT services with commercial health plans
  • Work denials, appeals, ERAs/EOBs and payment posting; keep AR clean and aging low
  • Help with payer enrollment and credentialing admin (NPI/PECOS, CAQH, commercial payer setup) as we add health plans
  • Build simple, repeatable billing processes and tell us what we should automate

You should have

  • 3+ years of physical therapy billing experience (outpatient PT, CPT 97xxx codes, modifiers, 8-minute rule, plan-of-care rules)
  • Commercial payer experience and comfort with clearinghouses, ERAs and payer portals
  • Experience working denials and appeals end to end
  • Comfort talking to clinic owners and office managers; you explain billing clearly and calmly
  • Self-directed; you'll be our only biller, so you need to run the function, not wait for instructions

Bonus points

  • RTM or RPM billing experience (98975–98981, 99453–99458)
  • Credentialing/payer enrollment experience across multiple states
  • Experience at a billing company or managing billing for several clinics at once
  • Familiarity with telehealth billing rules and place-of-service codes

What we offer

  • $30–40/hour, 1099 or W-2, your choice
  • Fully remote, flexible schedule, ~10 hrs/week to start with a clear path to more hours as our clinic and health plan business grows
  • A chance to build a billing service from the ground up, with your work directly visible to clients and leadership
  • Direct exposure to RTM and health plan billing at national scale

How to apply

Apply with your resume and 3–4 sentences on the PT billing setup you're most proud of fixing. No cover letter needed.

jobs.description:
ICF is seeking experienced emergency management professionals to join our Disaster Response Finance/Administration Section Reservist Cadre. This is an On-Call position supporting disaster preparedness, response, recovery, and resilience missions across the United States. Assignments are activated based on project and disaster operational needs and may involve deployments to Emergency Operations Centers (EOCs), Joint Field Offices (JFOs), Disaster Recovery Centers (DRCs), client sites, field locations, or remote environments. Deployment opportunities are not guaranteed and may vary in duration, location, and frequency.


Reservists are typically activated for disaster events, emergency exercises, planning projects, and surge support requirements. Candidates should be prepared to deploy with limited notice, work flexible schedules that may include evenings, weekends, and holidays, and support incident operations in dynamic and fast-paced environments.


About On-Call Employment with ICF

Due to the seasonal or project-specific nature of our disaster and emergency management work, ICF hires professionals as "On-Call" employees. On-Call employees are scheduled for work as it becomes available, with the freedom to accept or decline assignments. Individuals may work on concurrent projects outside of their ICF assignments, provided there is no conflict of interest.


Key Responsibilities – What You Will Be Doing

  • Support financial management activities including budgeting, cost tracking, expenditure monitoring, forecasting, analysis, and financial reporting for emergency management and disaster recovery operations.
  • Assist with disaster recovery grants, reimbursement programs, funding eligibility reviews, cost documentation, compliance monitoring, and program implementation activities.
  • Provide procurement, purchasing, contracting, vendor coordination, resource acquisition, and contract administration support while maintaining financial accountability and compliance documentation.
  • Perform administrative functions including personnel tracking, timekeeping, travel coordination, deployment administration, records management, reporting, and program documentation.
  • Maintain accurate financial, operational, and program records to support audits, reimbursement requests, compliance reviews, and organizational accountability requirements.
  • Coordinate with finance, logistics, planning, and operational teams to support emergency response, disaster recovery, preparedness, continuity, and resilience initiatives.
  • Support compliance with federal, state, local, organizational, contractual, and grant requirements while identifying and escalating documentation or compliance concerns.

Please attach a reverse chronological, bullet-point concise resume (1 to 3 pages) addressing minimum and preferred qualifications, including job title, employer, dates of employment. Separate list of completed coursework/trainings and deployments may be requested.


Minimum Qualifications

Candidates must possess qualifications commonly applicable across FEMA Finance/Administration Section Chief and Unit Leader positions.

  • 3+ years of professional experience supporting financial management, budgeting, cost tracking, forecasting, financial reporting and expenditure monitoring activities.
  • 2+ years of professional experience supporting procurement, purchasing, contracting, or vendor coordination.
  • Completion of FEMA/NIMS ICS online courses: 100, 200, 700, 800 prior to offer.
  • Must have a valid U.S. driver’s license and successfully pass a Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check.
  • Must be willing and able to travel, both flight and vehicle, with short notice; inclusive of deployment nationally, hours including evenings and weekends in rapidly changing operational environments.

Preferred Qualifications (these will set candidates apart)

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Public Administration, Economics, Emergency Management, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Experience working within an Emergency Operations Center or similar environment.
  • Experience in supporting finance, timekeeping, purchasing, and similar in a government setting.
  • 2+ years of professional experience working with personnel tracking, timekeeping, travel coordination and records management to maintain accurate financial, operational and program records in support of audits, compliance reviews and accountability requirements.
  • 2+ years of professional experience in grants management, disaster recovery funding programs, reimbursement processes inclusive of regulatory compliance requirements.
  • Experience working with federal, state, tribal territorial or local government partners.
  • Completion of FEMA/NIMS ICS courses: 300, 400.
  • Finance/Administration Section Chief level role: Deployment experience in the FSC role and ICS Training, including ICS 400, E/G/L 0191 and E/L 0973, Type 1-3 experience.

Professional Qualifications (bring these with you day one)

  • Excellent time management and prioritization skills, with the ability to balance multiple concurrent projects and short-turn deliverables.
  • Proactive, collaborative, team-oriented approach; seeks input early and communicates risks/issues quickly.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
  • Proven track record of supporting a team and accomplishing successful business results.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, emotional intelligence, critical thinking skills, and integrity and ethics.
  • Team player with the demonstrated ability to build organizational capability, motivate teaming partners/staff to ensure high levels of engagement, and work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Project Management Software). 

Why Join ICF?

At ICF, our work helps communities prepare for, respond to, and recover from some of their most challenging moments. As a Disaster Response Finance & Administration Section Reservist, you'll have the opportunity to contribute your expertise on meaningful projects that support federal, state, territorial, tribal, and local governments as they navigate complex emergencies and disaster recovery efforts.


Whether developing incident action and contingency plans, supporting situational awareness, tracking critical resources, documenting response operations, or coordinating recovery transitions, your work will directly contribute to informed decision-making and successful mission outcomes. You'll collaborate with experienced emergency management professionals, gain exposure to large-scale response and recovery operations, and play a key role in helping communities build resilience for the future.
