jobs.excerpt: About ToptalToptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand.
jobs.description:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

Toptal is an innovative organization that is disrupting the global professional services and talent market. In response to our clients’ overwhelming demand for exceptional talent in new areas, we are expanding the breadth and depth of our Technology Services offerings, including Hybrid Cloud and DevOps, to fuel the next phase of growth. As a Practice Director for Toptal’s Cloud Services practice, you will lead and develop the team of solution architects who design, sell, and deliver hybrid cloud and DevOps solutions for our clients.

You will set the technical vision and standards for the team, shape the solutions it takes to market, and be empowered to work across organizational lines to build a world-class architecture practice. This leader will be a proven expert in hybrid cloud infrastructure and modern DevOps practices, and a proven people leader who has built and managed teams of solution architects or senior technical consultants. The right candidate will understand target buyers, their priorities, and the trends impacting them. Their knowledge will inform which solutions the team builds out, how we scope and package what we do, and how we create a competitive value proposition now and in the future to meet changing market needs.

This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

You will be responsible for leading Toptal’s Cloud Services Team. This includes:

  • Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and grow a team of solution architects. Set clear goals, give regular feedback, and build a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous learning.
  • Hiring Talent: Recruit, onboard, and retain top solution architects, and ensure the team has the right skills in the right capacities (e.g., hybrid cloud, Kubernetes, Infrastructure-as-Code, CI/CD, SRE, security) to meet market demand.
  • Architecture Standards: Define reference architectures, design patterns, and best practices for hybrid cloud and DevOps solutions, and review the team’s solution designs for quality, security, scalability, and cost-efficiency.
  • Pre-Sales Leadership: Partner with Sales to assess client needs, define solution approaches, and shape proposals and technical presentations. Ensure architects are matched to the right opportunities, and lead key client conversations yourself.
  • Solution Development: Work with practice and delivery leadership to turn repeatable solutions into scalable offerings, such as hybrid cloud architecture and migration, landing zones, container platforms, Infrastructure-as-Code, CI/CD and DevSecOps, SRE and observability, and FinOps.
  • Delivery: Partner with Delivery to ensure designs are implemented successfully. Guide engineering teams through complex technical decisions, and step in directly on critical engagements.
  • Capacity and Performance: Plan team capacity, manage workload and utilization across opportunities and engagements, and track key team metrics such as pipeline support, win rate, and client satisfaction.
  • Partnerships: Build relationships with key technology and cloud partners (e.g., AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, VMware/Broadcom, Red Hat, HashiCorp) and keep the team’s certifications and partner alignment current.
  • Thought Leadership: Stay current on hybrid cloud, platform engineering, and DevOps trends; contribute to marketing content that builds the team’s reputation with clients and in the market.
  • Hands-On Contribution: Remain hands-on by owning architecture for strategic accounts and building proofs of concept, modeling the standard you expect from the team.

This role is highly collaborative and will work extremely closely with our Marketing, Sales, Delivery, and Talent Operations teams to fulfill the above responsibilities.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal; meet your colleagues and the Solution Architects on your team.
  • Learn about Toptal’s history, culture, and vision, with a focus on the state of our industry, Toptal’s operating model, and the core messages important to Toptal.
  • Shadow critical teams throughout the organization to learn Toptal’s core operations and capabilities.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Begin developing relationships with key leaders and stakeholders across the organization.
  • Dive deeper into the operations of key teams (e.g., Sales, Talent Operations) across the company.
  • Conduct a comprehensive review of current demand in your practice area, talent that already exists in the network, active engagements, and any work we may already be doing or have done.
  • Assess the skills, strengths, and development needs of your Solution Architects.
  • Articulate a hypothesis about how to grow the team’s impact (priorities, structure, and standards) and design experiments and execution approaches to get there.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Be a well-integrated member of the organization with positive relationships in Sales (Enterprise/SMB), Marketing, and Talent Operations.
  • Be in front of clients on a regular basis to hear from them firsthand.
  • Define the team’s operating model, architecture standards, and pre-sales engagement process.
  • Build your team and begin positively impacting revenue growth.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Have moved from purely planning to execution.
  • See an impact from your involvement in early initiatives, including repeatable solutions in market and a growing pipeline supported by your team.
  • Establish key partner relationships and a clear hiring and talent plan for the team.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Feel like you made the best decision of your career.
  • Increase the growth rate of Toptal materially.
  • Have a high-performing, fully staffed Solution Architect team recognized for Hybrid Cloud and DevOps expertise.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required; an MBA is preferred.
  • 15+ years of experience in cloud, infrastructure, or DevOps engineering and architecture, with at least 5+ years leading teams of solution architects or senior engineers within cloud or technology services.
  • 3+ years managing a business or team, preferably with P&L or budget responsibility, and a proven track record of overseeing financial performance, identifying areas for improvement, and driving profitability and growth.
  • Proven experience leading and developing teams of solution architects or senior technical consultants.
  • Proven ability to build and scale hybrid cloud and DevOps service offerings in a consulting, managed services, technology services, or enterprise environment.
  • Deep expertise in hybrid and multi-cloud architecture across AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including connectivity, identity, governance, and workload placement across on-premises, private cloud, and public cloud environments.
  • Strong experience with data center and virtualization platforms (e.g., VMware, Nutanix, Hyper-V) and hybrid cloud technologies (e.g., Azure Arc, AWS Outposts, Google Distributed Cloud).
  • Deep knowledge of cloud-native technologies, including containerization and orchestration (Kubernetes, OpenShift, Docker), serverless computing, and microservices architecture.
  • Strong experience with Infrastructure-as-Code and configuration management tools such as Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, or Pulumi.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, GitOps, and automation frameworks (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Argo CD).
  • Expertise in DevOps and platform engineering practices, including DevSecOps, site reliability engineering (SRE), observability, and the use of delivery metrics (e.g., DORA) to drive improvement.
  • Experience with cloud migration and application modernization strategies, disaster recovery, and business continuity in hybrid environments.
  • Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks and practices (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2, CIS), including identity and access management, encryption, and policy-as-code.
  • Knowledge of FinOps and cloud cost optimization, and of emerging trends such as AI-enabled infrastructure and operations, and edge computing.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., AWS, Azure, or GCP Architect; CKA/CKAD; Terraform Associate) are a plus.
  • Ability to develop strong relationships with enterprise clients and executives to drive hybrid cloud and DevOps consulting engagements.
  • Proven ability to lead collaboratively and operate in a high-growth environment.
  • Skilled in articulating a strategy with a strong, agile execution plan.
  • Comfortable with rolling up your sleeves to do the work, demonstrating traction, and building a team over time.
  • Demonstrated success in making data-driven decisions and defining key metrics to measure progress.
  • Ability to walk in the shoes of your audience in order to understand their challenges, develop and execute an approach to solve them, and articulate the solution in a clear and compelling way.
  • Strong ability to translate complex technical concepts into actionable business strategies for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Refined relationship development and leadership skills with a track record of building credibility across all levels of an organization. You can develop positive relationships across the business to partner on key initiatives and gain consensus on processes and strategies.
  • Confidence in your analytical abilities, with proven success in delivering results in ambiguous and sophisticated project efforts.
  • Skilled in the art of communicating (written and verbal) with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Why Valtech? We’retheexperience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.

The opportunity

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

We are proud of:

  • The work we do and the innovation we drive
  • Our values of share, care and dare
  • A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy
  • Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

The role

We are looking for an experienced Lead Developer to take technical ownership of the engineering delivery of an enterprise Sitecore-to-Contentful migration, covering both content and application migration.

You will lead the development team, establish engineering standards and ensure successful delivery of a scalable, maintainable Contentful-based solution.

Ideally you are also an AI-first technical leader who can embed AI-native and spec-driven development practices into everyday engineering, using emerging tooling to improve delivery efficiency while maintaining technical quality, security and accountability.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership and Migration Delivery

  • Lead the technical implementation of the Sitecore-to-Contentful migration across content, applications and integrations.
  • Work with architects to shape migration options, Contentful implementation patterns and technical decisions.
  • Guide the migration and modernisation of existing applications, including React frontends and supporting services.
  • Define approaches for content modelling, transformation, migration automation and validation.
  • Coordinate engineering activities, resolve complex technical challenges and manage dependencies and delivery risks.
  • Remain hands-on where required, particularly for complex implementation, technical spikes and critical problem-solving.

AI-First Engineering Leadership

  • Champion an AI-first engineering mindset, encouraging the team to proactively use AI to improve software delivery.
  • Establish practical spec-driven development approaches, ensuring clear, testable specifications guide implementation and validation.
  • Identify opportunities to apply AI to Sitecore analysis, content mapping, migration automation, code modernisation and testing.
  • Guide developers in the effective use of AI coding assistants and automated engineering workflows.
  • Establish appropriate review, security and quality practices for AI-generated code and migration outputs.
  • Drive experimentation, knowledge sharing and measurable improvements in team productivity through AI adoption.

Engineering Quality and Stakeholder Engagement

  • Own engineering quality, implementation consistency and technical delivery outcomes.
  • Establish standards for code quality, automated testing, CI/CD, migration validation and release readiness.
  • Lead technical planning for migration, cutover, rollback and post-migration support.
  • Provide technical direction, mentoring and coaching to developers.
  • Act as a trusted technical contact for client stakeholders, architects and delivery teams.
  • Communicate technical risks, trade-offs and recommendations clearly, aligning decisions with business objectives.

Essential Skills and Experience

  • Significant engineering experience, including technical leadership of complex digital platform deliveries.
  • Proven experience with enterprise CMS migrations, replatforming or major headless CMS implementations.
  • Strong practical knowledge of Contentful, Sitecore and associated migration and integration challenges.
  • Strong understanding of React, TypeScript, API-driven architectures and application modernisation.
  • Experience leading engineering teams, making technical decisions and assuring delivery quality.
  • Practical experience with AI-assisted software development and the ability to drive adoption of AI-native, spec-driven engineering practices.
  • Strong knowledge of automated testing, CI/CD, release processes and technical risk management.
  • Strong stakeholder communication, consultancy and technical leadership skills.

Desirable Experience

  • Previous technical leadership of a Sitecore-to-Contentful migration.
  • Experience with Next.js, Sitecore JSS and composable architecture.
  • Experience using AI to accelerate complex migrations, legacy application modernisation or engineering workflows.
  • Experience with multilingual, multisite or enterprise content platforms.

What Success Looks Like

  • Successfully leads delivery of the Contentful migration across content and applications.
  • Establishes clear technical direction, engineering standards and accountability within the team.
  • Embeds AI-native development practices that demonstrably improve delivery efficiency and quality.
  • Proactively manages technical risks and builds confidence with stakeholders.
  • Develops team capability through technical leadership, coaching and continuous improvement.

C5 Expectation: A technical leader accountable for engineering delivery, technical quality and team effectiveness, working closely with Architects while driving implementation and technical decisions across the development team.

If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.

Commitment to reaching all kinds of people

We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.

The benefits

  • Private health insurance
    We hope you will never need it, but nevertheless, we offer private health insurance to all our employees.

  • Education program
    We never stop learning, that’s why we offer our employees an educational program with training and certification.

  • Wellbeing program
    We all deserve to live a healthy and well-balanced life. It's not an option, it's a necessity!

  • Free beverages
    Enjoy free coffee, drinks, and snacks at work, or join one of our famous company dinners.

    We enjoy spending time together, not only at work. Ski trips, carting, laser-tag, wine tasting, picnics, cooking classes… you name it – we’ve done it! There are plenty of cool events to join and to get to know your colleagues.

  • Challenging projects

  • Cool colleagues

  • Honest feedback
    Honesty, openness and respect are among our core values. We encourage an open feedback culture in order to build trust and grow together.

Your application process

Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. Your CV should cover key information on relevant experiences and expertise. We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential.

⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud!

We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.

About Valtech

Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.

About Legion

Let’s be real, AI isn’t magic; Legion was built to move beyond AI hype—delivering secure, reliable systems that work alongside the people tackling the world’s most critical challenges.

Born from a Department of Defense partnership and trusted by leaders across government and enterprise, Legion embeds intelligence inside complex systems, unlocking data, accelerating human workflows, and strengthening mission-critical systems. We don’t replace workflows—we optimize them, ensuring quality, efficiency, and reliability inside the platforms our partners already use.

With world-class collaborators like Palantir, Nvidia, HPE, and Oracle, we’re building intelligent infrastructure that enhances human capability and drives impact at the edge and across a range of enterprises.

We’re looking for bold thinkers and doers to join us in shaping the future of AI that’s secure, grounded, and built to work.

Location: US - remote with travel (up to 50%).

Clearance: Active US Department of War (DoW) or Intelligence TS required.

Legion Intelligence is the agent workspace where national security work comes back done. Legion runs on the systems and networks mission teams already use, including classified networks and places with no connection at all.

Each Legion Pack is set up for a specific job, so the reports, plans, and work orders teams build by hand arrive finished and ready to approve. People decide who can act, on what data, and when. Agents do the work. You stay in charge.

We’re looking for a Staff DevSecOps Engineer who will set technical direction across Platform DevOps and customer delivery. You will shape the engineering systems and practices that take Legion from development to dependable operation, enabling teams to deliver improvements faster and customers to realize mission value sooner.

Job Description:

This position requires a US DoW or Intelligence TS/SCI clearance.

As a Staff DevSecOps Engineer on the Mission Engineering team, which also owns Platform DevOps, you will provide technical leadership across internal build and release systems, platform operations, and customer deployments. You will work directly with customer mission owners, IT teams, and security stakeholders to understand their needs, achieve technical alignment, and deliver Legion into their operating environments. You will define the architecture and improvement roadmap for this domain and lead complex initiatives from problem definition through deployment, adoption, and measured results. Your scope includes internal CI/CD, observability and alerting, vulnerability posture, deployment automation, and production reliability. You will translate mission needs and operating constraints into technical decisions, resolve tradeoffs across teams, and turn recurring delivery barriers into durable improvements to Legion. You will remain hands-on in delivering the platform to customers while guiding engineers and establishing practices that make the whole team more effective.

Responsibilities:

  • Set and drive the technical roadmap for Platform DevOps and customer deployment engineering. Identify the constraints that most limit delivery of mission value, build the case for investment, and lead improvements with clear outcomes for delivery speed, reliability, and security.
  • Own technical alignment with customer stakeholders throughout delivery. Lead architecture and readiness discussions with mission owners, IT teams, and security reviewers; agree on deployment approach, integration requirements, responsibilities, and acceptance criteria; and resolve technical disagreements and dependencies with clear decisions and follow-through.decisions, integrations, and accelerate implementation.
  • Define the architecture and standards for repeatable deployment and lifecycle automation across internal and customer environments. Lead adoption of reusable approaches for provisioning, configuration, upgrades, backups, and patching using Kubernetes, Flux, Terraform, Helm, Docker, and related technologies.
  • Lead the architecture for integration with customer identity and access systems. Resolve complex authentication and authorization requirements with customer and product engineering stakeholders, and establish patterns that future deployments can reuse.
  • Own the technical direction and effectiveness of internal CI/CD and release infrastructure. Lead improvements to build reliability, automated validation, artifact integrity, and release promotion so engineering teams can deliver changes safely and consistently.
  • Own the technical strategy for vulnerability posture across platform infrastructure, deployment artifacts, and third-party containers and dependencies. Establish risk-based prioritization, remediation expectations, and visibility into outstanding exposure; drive fixes with engineering and security owners and verify their closure.
  • Provide technical leadership during complex incidents and investigations. Guide diagnosis across system boundaries, coordinate customer and engineering stakeholders, and ensure root-cause findings lead to lasting architectural and operational improvements.
  • Lead the technical approach to deployment authorization and security evidence. Translate Authorization to Operate (ATO), Certification to Field (CTF), and Risk Management Framework (RMF) requirements into engineering work, and establish repeatable ways to produce and maintain the required evidence.

Qualifications:

  • An active US DoW or Intelligence TS/SCI clearance.
  • A BS degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or related fields.
  • CompTIA Security+ Certification.
  • 6+ years of experience in DevOps, DevSecOps, or software engineering, with demonstrated technical leadership of complex initiatives. Ability to set architectural direction, guide engineers across teams, and translate customer and engineering needs into delivery priorities and measurable outcomes.
  • Proven experience engaging directly with customer technical and mission stakeholders, explaining architectural tradeoffs, achieving agreement on delivery plans, and taking hands-on responsibility for deploying software into customer environments.
  • 4+ years of experience deploying software and/or managing software deployments in US Government classified networks.
  • Strong working knowledge of cloud infrastructure and infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform), including networking, load balancing, IAM, compute, and storage in those environments.
  • Deep production experience with Kubernetes, Linux, and Helm. Ability to lead diagnosis and architectural decisions across cluster networking, storage, RBAC, operators and CRDs, upgrades, availability, and resource constraints.
  • Experience designing and evolving GitOps delivery systems using tools such as FluxCD and Kustomize, including reconciliation, environment configuration, release promotion, rollback, and drift management.
  • Experience owning internal CI/CD infrastructure, such as GitLab pipelines, self-hosted runners, and container registries. Ability to establish reusable pipelines, protect releases and credentials, and coordinate delivery across services.
  • Experience designing secure, reproducible container builds using Docker and tools such as BuildKit or Buildx, including AMD64/ARM64 builds, image digests, build caching, and artifact promotion.
  • Experience defining and improving software supply-chain security and vulnerability posture. Ability to integrate code, dependency, container, secret, and infrastructure scanning into software development lifecycles, prioritize remediation, and establish SBOM, signing, and attestation practices.
  • Strong understanding of secure service networking and access controls. Ability to diagnose ingress, service communication, DNS, and TLS using technologies such as Istio and Kubernetes Gateway API; secure configuration and enforce least privilege through tools such as SOPS, Kyverno, and cloud IAM.
  • Strong working knowledge of operating stateful services such as PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, Qdrant, and S3-compatible storage. Ability to guide capacity planning, persistence, migrations, backups, restoration, upgrades, and failure recovery.
  • Proficiency building maintainable automation in Python or Bash, with fluency in Git and YAML/JSON configuration. Ability to debug across infrastructure and application boundaries and turn recurring problems into reusable engineering improvements.
  • Strong working knowledge of metrics, logs, traces, and incident diagnosis using tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, and OpenTelemetry. Ability to define service-level objectives, own actionable alerting, and guide improvements based on operational evidence.
  • Strong working knowledge of authentication and identity federation using technologies such as Keycloak and OIDC/OAuth2, including token validation and service authorization. Ability to resolve identity issues across customer, platform, and application boundaries.
  • Must be eligible to work in the US without sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience designing packaging and delivery for restricted or disconnected environments using tools such as Defense Unicorns UDS Core or Zarf, including dependency bundles, SBOMs, attestations, and controlled publishing.

Your primary duties include cloud automation, DevOps, triage, review, response, design, implementation, and maintenance of cloud infrastructure solutions and client environments. You will also serve as a technical leader on the team, leading process improvement and mentoring junior engineers.

In a typical week, you will ensure the stability of our clients' infrastructure through triage and problem solving, and you will build and engineer infrastructure either from the ground up or to fit within a client's existing environment. What sets a Sr. Cloud Engineer apart is greater scope, responsibility, mentoring, and knowledge. We expect those in this role to understand the end goal of a project before work begins, to peer review their colleagues' projects, and to identify patterns and commonalities across client networks and alerts. Senior engineers are also expected to anticipate technical risks, make sound architectural decisions, and deliver secure, cost-conscious solutions that can be supported after project completion.

Accountabilities
  • Cloud Infrastructure Design & Deployment
    • Build, configure, and deploy secure and scalable cloud infrastructure in Microsoft Azure and AWS.
  • Codify security baselines and guardrails in Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code tools so every deployment is secure, repeatable, and scalable by default.
  • Drive infrastructure automation and DevOps improvements, helping establish standards for reusable modules, version control, code reviews, and secure deployments.
    • Lead migrations from on-premises or hosted environments to AWS or Azure, evaluating dependencies, cutover sequencing, rollback plans, and hybrid integration requirements.
    • Automate infrastructure provisioning, deployment validation, testing, and configuration management.
    • Continuously improve CI/CD pipelines to enhance efficiency, reliability, and security.
    • Leverage Terraform, Python, PowerShell, and other automation tools to provision, manage, and optimize infrastructure.
  • Design and troubleshoot AWS/Azure networking and hybrid connectivity, including VPCs/VNets, VPNs, routing, DNS, firewalls, and private connections.
  • Implement cloud governance and access controls, including account/subscription structures, AWS IAM, Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC, and least-privilege permissions.
  • Analyze cloud spend, utilization, and performance, recommending resource rightsizing, capacity improvements, and cost optimization opportunities.
  • Security & Resiliency
    • Implement infrastructure solutions that increase the stability, resiliency, and security of client and internal cloud environments.
    • Harden cloud workloads, operating systems, networks, identities, and storage using security baselines and applicable compliance requirements.
  • Design, implement, and test backup, high availability, and disaster recovery solutions against defined recovery time and recovery point objectives (RTO/RPO).
  • Follow change control processes, assess technical implementation risks, and define validation and rollback plans for production changes.
  • Project Delivery
    • Develop technical implementation plans, engineering task breakdowns, effort estimates, dependencies, and risk assessments in coordination with PMO.
  • Peer review technical designs and deliverables, and recommend standard operating procedures (SOPs) for approval through the established Cloud leadership process.
    • Own technical execution of assigned projects, communicate progress and blockers, and promptly escalate delivery risks or potential scope changes to PMO and Cloud leadership.
    • Provide expert technical assistance for internal teams and clients, including configuration, diagnostics, troubleshooting, and issue resolution across infrastructure, systems, and applications.
  • Troubleshoot and upgrade Azure and AWS environments, supporting both implementation and migration projects.
  • Participate in technical discovery, solution scoping, and migration readiness reviews to validate requirements and dependencies before work begins.
  • Complete technical validation, as-built documentation, monitoring, knowledge transfer, and handoff to ongoing support teams before project closeout.
  • Managed Cloud Operations
  • Serve as a senior escalation resource for complex AWS, Azure, and hybrid incidents; perform root cause analysis and drive corrective actions.
  • Improve proactive monitoring, alerting, logging, availability, capacity, and performance across client environments to reduce repeat incidents.
  • Maintain accurate engineering task updates, time entries, change records, and support documentation in designated company systems.
  • Client & Team Collaboration
  • Mentor junior and peer engineers on new or complex technologies, and review escalation requests to guide resolution.
  • Lead process improvement initiatives across the Cloud team, using recurring issues and alert patterns to standardize solutions and reduce repeat incidents.
    • Deliver an exemplary customer service experience, building strong relationships with clients and internal teams.
    • Communicate complex technical concepts in a clear, approachable manner.
  • Partner with Security, Networking, Infrastructure, Service Delivery, and PMO to ensure coordinated technical execution and supportable client solutions.
  • Documentation & Knowledge Sharing
    • Document technical processes, configurations, root cause analyses, and project details for both technical and non-technical audiences.
    • Contribute to knowledge bases and internal training resources to strengthen team expertise.
  • Continuous Learning & Growth
    • Stay current with evolving cloud technologies, security practices, and industry trends.
    • Pursue professional certifications and development opportunities, while mentoring and sharing knowledge with peers.
  • Other duties as assigned
Qualifications
  • Associate degree in Technology, IT Engineering or equivalent level of work experience and certifications
  • 10+ years of engineering experience
  • 6+ years of hands-on AWS or Microsoft Azure engineering, with deep expertise in both platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience independently designing, delivering, troubleshooting, and supporting complex cloud and hybrid infrastructure solutions.
  • Strong working knowledge of Windows Server and/or Linux, Active Directory/Entra ID, IAM/RBAC, DNS, cloud networking, and hybrid connectivity.
  • Advanced proficiency in multiple cloud infrastructure domains such as compute, networking, identity, storage, security, monitoring, and disaster recovery.
  • Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform or equivalent), Git, scripting (Python/PowerShell), and deployment automation; Docker and Kubernetes experience a plus.
  • Experience with cloud monitoring, security controls, backup and disaster recovery, and cloud cost/performance optimization in production environments.
  • Ability to correlate client incidents, telemetry, and alert data to identify root causes and recurring patterns.
  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage concurrent technical deliverables, dependencies, deadlines, and documented processes.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical clients and internal team members
  • Preferred certifications: AWS Solutions Architect Associate/Professional, Azure Administrator (AZ-104), Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), or equivalent.
Why work at Netcov?
  • Innovative Solutions: Work with cutting-edge cybersecurity and IT services tailored to the financial sector’s evolving needs.
  • Competitive Compensation: Competitive base salary plus performance-based incentives and commissions.
  • Professional Growth: Access to continuous training, career development, and opportunities for advancement within a rapidly growing company.
  • Collaborative Culture: Join a team of passionate professionals who work together to solve complex challenges and deliver exceptional service to our clients.
Role Logistics
  • This is a full-time, exempt position
  • This position may require travel dependent on company needs for client on-site support or team meetings.

Job Description:

Job Title: Delivery Director

Location: Remote: USA/Canada
Reports to: VP, Professional Services

Employment Type: Full-time

This is an existing vacancy.


About the Role:

The Delivery Director is the senior leader accountable for the successful planning, execution, and completion of client engagements across one or more JD Power OEM programs. Working alongside client stakeholders and internal account teams, you provide strategic direction, leadership, and hands-on guidance to delivery teams, ensuring every project lands on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.


This is a dual-mandate role. You are the primary point of contact for stakeholders, keeping them informed of progress and managing their expectations, and you lead the project managers and delivery professionals who execute the work, owning governance, budgets, risk, and quality across a portfolio of concurrent engagements.


Your work determines whether JD Power delivers what it promised, on schedule and within budget, across a portfolio of concurrent OEM engagements. By setting clear governance, holding teams to rigorous quality and financial standards, and surfacing risk before it becomes a client issue, you make delivery predictable and repeatable. Strong performance in this role protects revenue and margin, strengthens client confidence in our ability to execute, and builds a bench of capable project managers and delivery leaders.


In this role, you will be responsible for:

Strategic Planning & Intake

  • Requirements Gathering: Lead initial client meetings, stakeholder interviews, and requirement sessions to understand project needs, goals, constraints, and success criteria.
  • Scope & Plan Definition: Work with project managers to define scope, objectives, deliverables, milestones, timelines, resource requirements, and budget, and review and approve the resulting project plans, including work breakdown structures and dependencies.
  • Governance Structure: Establish project governance, team roles and responsibilities, communication strategy, quality standards, and documentation requirements for each engagement.
  • Strategic Alignment: Align project plans with client and organizational priorities, and anticipate changes to scope, schedule, or budget before they become problems.

Program Delivery & Execution

  • Execution Leadership: Implement delivery methodologies, direct project teams, and monitor progress against the baseline plan, taking corrective action when deviations arise.
  • Resource Allocation: Allocate personnel, technology, and vendor resources effectively so that tasks are completed on time and within budget.
  • Methodology Compliance: Ensure adherence to delivery standards and best practices, and track project metrics, performance indicators, and lessons learned to drive continuous improvement.
  • Reporting & Documentation: Deliver regular status reports covering progress, KPIs, milestones, risks, issues, and decisions, and keep plans, schedules, and budgets.

Quality, Risk & Financial Management

  • Quality Assurance: Set quality expectations for each engagement, work with the QE team to confirm those standards are met before deliverables reach the client, and step in when quality issues arise.
  • Risk Management: Ensure project managers identify, assess, and mitigate risks, review the risk picture across your engagements on a regular basis, and communicate significant risks to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Budget Management: Oversee budgets across your engagements, monitor revenue and margin against plan, review forecasts from project managers, and act early on variances or overrun risk.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve cost, efficiency, and delivery processes across your portfolio, and share lessons learned across teams.

Stakeholder Management & Communication

  • Stakeholder Engagement: Identify clients, sponsors, vendors, and other affected parties, understand their priorities, and build positive relationships through regular, transparent communication.
  • Expectation Management: Set realistic goals, timelines, and deliverables, solicit stakeholder feedback, and address concerns proactively.
  • Negotiation: Negotiate scope changes, deliverables, and priorities to resolve conflicts and reach agreements that protect project success.
  • Executive Communication: Facilitate internal and client meetings that drive toward a decision, solution, or clear next step, and communicate the big picture whenever project parameters change.
  • Risk & Escalation: Raise issues with internal leadership and sales early, and escalate in a timely and tactful manner.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Vision & Accountability: Set clear goals for the team and define roles and responsibilities so every member understands their contribution to the project.
  • People Leadership: Lead, coach, and mentor project managers and delivery professionals, including remote team members, through regular one-on-ones, constructive feedback, and performance management.
  • Team Culture: Foster collaboration, trust, and ownership, empower team members to make decisions, resolve conflict constructively, and recognize achievements.

Required Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree required in business administration, project management, engineering, information technology, or a related discipline.
  • Experience: 7+ years of project or program delivery experience leading complex, multi-workstream engagements from initiation through completion, with a track record of on-time, on-budget delivery.
  • Industry Knowledge: Automotive industry experience preferred, including work with OEMs or with an agency or solution provider serving OEMs.
  • Leadership: Demonstrated success leading and developing multidisciplinary teams, including remote team members, and inspiring accountability and high performance.
  • Delivery & Technical Literacy: Working knowledge of the software development lifecycle (Waterfall, Agile, DevOps, CI/CD) and a general understanding of IT infrastructure, cloud platforms, cybersecurity, and data analytics sufficient to engage credibly with technical teams.
  • Tools: Proficiency with project management tools such as Microsoft Project, Jira, Asana, or similar.
  • Financial & Risk Acumen: Strong command of budgeting, forecasting, and cost control, with proven risk management skills.
  • Strategic Acumen: Ability to align project objectives with business goals, assess business impact and ROI, and plan for change management across stakeholder groups.
  • Communication & Negotiation: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with confidence presenting to senior audiences and negotiating scope, priorities, and deliverables.
  • Problem Solving & Resilience: Sound decision-making in ambiguity, adaptability as circumstances change, and a commitment to continuous learning.
  • Travel: Willingness to travel to client locations as program needs require.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Certifications: PMP, PRINCE2 Practitioner, Certified ScrumMaster, or PMI-ACP preferred.

Compensation and Benefits:

This position has a starting salary range of CAD $125,000-$136,000 / USD $160,000-$175,000 per year. The range represents what we reasonably and in good faith expect to pay for the role at the time of posting. An employee’s pay within the range is determined by a number of factors, including relevant skills, education, qualifications, experience, performance, business or organizational needs, and geographic location.


Eligible employees may participate in medical, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, retirement savings programs, paid time off, wellness programs, and other company-sponsored benefits. Benefits vary by country and employment status.

Why Join JD Power

JD Power powers auto-related decisions through proprietary data, advanced analytics, deep industry expertise, and workflows that connect insight to action. Operating across North America, Europe, and Australia, we help customers make better decisions and achieve better outcomes.

As a virtual-first company, we offer flexible work arrangements, opportunities for learning and development, and a culture centered on the Values that guide how we work every day.

· We power our customers’ success. Everything we do is focused on helping customers make better decisions and achieve better outcomes.

· We are innovative, collaborative, and grounded in data. We combine advanced analytics with human expertise to deliver insight that holds up in the real world.

· We make things easy. We turn complexity into clarity so teams can act faster and with confidence.

· We get it done. We focus on execution, accountability, and results.

· We start with trust and prove it every day. Independence, integrity, and credibility are the foundation of our work.


Equal Opportunity & Accommodations

JD Power is committed to employing a diverse workforce. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.

JD Power is committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for individuals with disabilities or other protected needs under applicable local laws. Please contact for accommodation request.


Data Privacy

JD Power does not disclose your personal data to unauthorized third parties. However, as a global corporation consisting of multiple affiliated companies in various countries, JD Power has international sites and JD Power uses resources located throughout the world. JD Power may from time to time also use third parties to act on JD Power’s behalf. You agree to the fact that to the extent necessary your personal data may be transferred and/or disclosed to any company within JD Power group of companies as well as to third parties acting on JD Power’s behalf, including also transfers to servers and databases outside the country where you provided JD Power with your personal data. Such transfers may include for example transfers and/or disclosures outside the European Economic Area and in the United States of America. If you are a California or United Kingdom resident, additional disclosures about the information we collect and how we use that information can be found by clicking here.

Applications

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where employment is offered. JD Power does not provide employment sponsorship for this position.

This position is posted exclusively on and select trusted job boards such as LinkedIn or Indeed. All official communication comes from email addresses ending in @jdpower.com or @jdpa.com. We will never ask for payment, equipment purchases, or upfront fees. We may take additional steps to verify candidate information to protect the integrity of our recruitment process.

To all recruitment agencies: JD Power does not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

jobs.excerpt: We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production.
jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!
